title: IL-10 rs1800896 polymorphism predicts biochemical remission in IBD patients undergoing biologic therapy
comment: 22 pages; 2 main tables and 1 main figure; supplementary tables and figure included. Pre-peer-reviewed author manuscript. The final article was published in Immunology, 2026, volume 177, issue 2, pages 432-438
summary: Background. Genetic factors, including single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), may modulate disease course and therapeutic efficacy in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Aim. We investigated the association between four SNPs in cytokine genes and clinical phenotype as well as the response to molecular-targeted drugs in patients with IBD. Materials and Methods. A total of 197 IBD patients (142 Crohn's disease [CD], 55 ulcerative colitis [UC]) undergoing targeted treatment were enrolled. The SNPs analyzed were TNF-alpha rs1800629 (-308 G>A), TGF-beta rs1800471 (codon 10 C>T), IL-6 rs1800795 (-174 G>C), and IL-10 rs1800896 (-1082 G>A). Biochemical response at 12 months (T12) was defined as CRP <5.0 mg/L and fecal calprotectin <250 microg/g at T12, in the absence of ongoing corticosteroid therapy. Results. The IL-6 rs1800795 C allele was significantly associated with a younger age at diagnosis (p=0.049), while the TNF-alpha rs1800629 A allele was more frequently observed in patients with CD than UC (p=0.036). Among 134 patients included in the per-protocol analysis, 41.0% achieved biochemical remission at T12. The IL-10 rs1800896 variant allele was associated with remission (OR 2.15, 95% CI 1.03-4.44; p=0.041), and the association remained significant in multivariable analysis (adjusted OR 4.15, 95% CI 1.49-11.56; p=0.007). Conclusions. Genotyping of cytokine-related SNPs may help identify patients with distinct disease phenotypes and support personalized treatment strategies in IBD.

AI.tldr: 本研究纳入197名接受分子靶向治疗的IBD患者（142例克罗恩病，55例溃疡性结肠炎），分析了TNF-α、TGF-β、IL-6和IL-10四个细胞因子基因SNPs与临床表型及治疗反应的关系。结果显示IL-6 rs1800795 C等位基因与更早的诊断年龄相关，TNF-α rs1800629 A等位基因在CD中更常见，而IL-10 rs1800896变异等位基因与12个月时的生化缓解显著相关（多变量校正OR 4.15），提示细胞因子SNP基因分型可能有助于个性化治疗策略。
AI.motivation: 炎症性肠病（IBD）的疾病进程和治疗疗效可能受遗传因素（如SNPs）影响，本研究旨在探讨细胞因子基因SNPs与IBD临床表型及分子靶向药物应答之间的关联，为个体化治疗提供分子依据。
AI.method: 研究纳入197名接受靶向治疗的IBD患者（CD 142例，UC 55例），对四个SNP位点进行基因分型：TNF-α rs1800629 (-308 G>A)、TGF-β rs1800471 (codon 10 C>T)、IL-6 rs1800795 (-174 G>C) 和 IL-10 rs1800896 (-1082 G>A)。生化反应定义为治疗12个月（T12）时CRP<5.0 mg/L且粪便钙卫蛋白<250 μg/g，同时无持续糖皮质激素治疗。采用单变量和多变量logistic回归分析SNPs与表型及治疗反应的关系。
AI.result: （1）IL-6 rs1800795 C等位基因与更年轻的诊断年龄显著相关（p=0.049）；（2）TNF-α rs1800629 A等位基因在CD患者中较UC更常见（p=0.036）；（3）在134名符合方案分析的患者中，41.0%在T12达到生化缓解；（4）IL-10 rs1800896变异等位基因与缓解显著相关（OR 2.15, 95% CI 1.03-4.44; p=0.041），多变量分析后仍显著（调整OR 4.15, 95% CI 1.49-11.56; p=0.007）。
AI.conclusion: 细胞因子相关SNPs的基因分型可能有助于识别具有不同疾病表型的IBD患者，并支持个性化治疗策略的制定。特别是IL-10 rs1800896变异等位基因可作为预测靶向治疗生化缓解的潜在遗传标志物。

title: A Low-Power Wearable Respiratory Sensor for Non-Invasive Stress Monitoring
comment: Code available at this URL: https://github.com/mohamad-hoseini/FSResp
summary: Respiration provides a continuously available window into physiological state and behavior. However, monitoring it outside controlled settings remains challenging because a wearable system must capture small body deformations while remaining comfortable, low power, and robust to changes in posture and motion. We present a compact non-invasive respiratory sensing system based on a force-sensitive resistor (FSR) embedded in an abdominal belt and integrated with a custom Bluetooth Low Energy acquisition board. The system combines a simple piezoresistive readout with a mechanical holder designed to transfer abdominal expansion to the sensor without analog amplification. We evaluate the complete sensing pipeline across multiple breathing patterns and body positions. In stationary settings, the recorded signals exhibit consistent amplitude changes and recurring peak-to-peak timing across breathing maneuvers; under light movement, these variations remain visible despite motion-induced baseline shifts. We further design a five-phase stress-induction protocol and collect respiratory recordings from 12 participants. Using interpretable time-domain features and standard classifiers, we examine whether the acquired signals distinguish relaxation from stress-induction phases. In this preliminary experiment, the best-performing model achieves 88.0% test accuracy, indicating that the extracted respiratory features distinguish stress-induced phases from relaxation phases in this dataset. Overall, our results show that the proposed platform enables real-time respiratory monitoring across diverse daily-life scenarios and captures respiratory changes that distinguish stress-induction from relaxation phases, supporting its potential for affective-computing applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于力敏电阻（FSR）嵌入腹带并集成定制低功耗蓝牙采集板的紧凑非侵入式呼吸监测系统。该系统在静止和轻度运动场景下均可捕获呼吸信号，并通过五阶段压力诱导实验在12名受试者上实现88.0%的测试准确率，能够区分压力诱导阶段与放松阶段，展示了其在情感计算等日常场景中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 传统呼吸监测系统受限于受控环境，难以在自然生活场景中部署。挑战在于可穿戴系统需要同时满足舒适性、低功耗、对身体微小形变的灵敏捕捉以及对姿态和运动变化的鲁棒性。因此，需要一种能够在日常场景中持续、舒适、可靠监测呼吸的紧凑平台。
AI.method: 系统采用压阻式力敏电阻（FSR）嵌入腹带，搭配定制蓝牙低功耗采集板。核心设计是将简单的压阻读数与机械固定结构相结合，将腹部扩张直接传递到传感器而无需模拟放大器。评估包括多种呼吸模式和身体姿态下的信号采集；后续设计了五阶段压力诱导协议，在12名参与者中收集呼吸记录，使用可解释的时域特征和标准分类器区分放松与压力诱导阶段。
AI.result: 在静止条件下信号展现一致的幅度变化和规律的峰间周期；轻度运动下信号在基线漂移中仍保持可见变化。在五阶段压力诱导实验中，最优模型达到88.0%的测试准确率，表明提取的呼吸特征能有效区分压力诱导阶段与放松阶段。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的平台能够在多种日常场景中实现实时呼吸监测，捕捉区分压力诱导与放松阶段的呼吸变化，支持其在情感计算应用中的潜力。该系统在无需模拟放大器的条件下实现紧凑、低功耗、舒适的呼吸监测方案。

title: Curriculum Multiple Shooting for Robust Training of Neural and Universal Differential Equations
summary: Neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs) and universal differential equations (UDEs) provide flexible and popular frameworks for learning interpretable dynamical systems from noisy time-series data. However, training these models remains challenging, and versatile methods that robustly handle sparse and noisy data as well as partially observed models are lacking. To address this, we introduce curriculum multiple shooting (CMS), a general-purpose training strategy for fitting ordinary differential equation (ODE) models to time-series data by integrating curriculum learning with multiple shooting. Across twelve benchmarks spanning simulated and real data, and covering NODEs, UDEs, and mechanistic ODEs, CMS accelerates and stabilises training convergence, outperforms state-of-the-art training strategies, and ranks among the best methods in generalisation. Finally, we discuss possible explanations for the strong performance of CMS in light of contemporary theories of what makes training on time-series challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出课程多重打靶（CMS），一种将课程学习与多重打靶相结合的通用训练策略，用于拟合ODE模型到含噪时间序列数据，在十二个基准上加速并稳定训练收敛，优于现有最先进训练方法。
AI.motivation: 神经ODE和通用微分方程（UDEs）是学习可解释动态系统的流行框架，但这些模型的训练仍然具有挑战性，现有方法缺乏对稀疏、含噪数据和部分观测模型的鲁棒处理能力。
AI.method: 将课程学习（curriculum learning）与多重打靶（multiple shooting）集成，提出课程多重打靶（CMS）训练策略，用于拟合ODE模型到时间序列数据。
AI.result: 在十二个涵盖模拟和真实数据的基准上，覆盖NODEs、UDEs和机制性ODE，CMS能加速并稳定训练收敛，优于最先进的训练策略，在泛化性能上位居最佳方法之列。
AI.conclusion: CMS是一种鲁棒且通用的ODE训练策略，论文还结合当代关于时间序列训练挑战的理论，讨论了CMS强性能的可能解释。

title: PyOMES: an open-source framework for biochemical process modelling
summary: PyOMES is a Python-based, Open-source Modelling Environment for (bio)chemical process Simulation that aims to simplify the modelling of dynamic (including steady state) processes. This is done in a generalied, modular way to facilitate modelling a broad range of biological, chemical, and biochemical systems under a single modelling framework. PyOMES has been built to be accessible to a broad range of users - ranging from those with little modelling experience, such as experimentalists and students, through to more experienced power-users. Here, an introduction is provided to the PyOMES software including a summary of the design, architecture and vision. Use cases are then provided to demonstrate applicability of PyOMES to a number of (bio)chemical process modelling scenarios. Comparisons of predictions against existing benchmark software (i.e. PHREEQC) demonstrate the robustness of the package. Finally, a summary is provided of future directions for the PyOMES package - highlighting its establishment as a unified modelling framework and its potential for community-driven improvement as future developments.

AI.tldr: PyOMES是一个基于Python的开源（生物）化学过程模拟建模环境，采用通用化、模块化的设计框架，旨在简化动态及稳态过程的建模，适用于从建模新手到资深用户的不同层次使用者，并通过与PHREEQC等基准软件的对比验证了其预测可靠性。
AI.motivation: 目前（生物）化学过程建模缺乏一个既通用又易于访问的统一建模框架。现有工具往往针对特定领域或需要较高的编程门槛，导致实验人员和学生等非专业建模者难以使用。PyOMES旨在通过模块化、泛化的设计降低建模门槛，同时保持对复杂系统的建模能力。
AI.method: PyOMES采用Python语言开发，以模块化的架构设计支持生物、化学及生物化学等多种系统的建模。该框架支持动态（含稳态）过程模拟，提供了一个统一的建模环境。论文通过多个用例展示其在（生物）化学过程建模中的适用性，并使用PHREEQC作为基准软件对预测结果进行比较验证。
AI.result: PyOMES成功应用于多种（生物）化学过程建模场景，其预测结果与基准软件PHREEQC的对比显示出良好的一致性，证明了该软件包的鲁棒性和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: PyOMES有望成为统一的（生物）化学过程建模框架，其开源特性为社区驱动的持续改进和未来发展提供了潜力，未来将进一步完善功能并扩大应用范围。

title: EdgeXpert: An Edge Device for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Mixture-of-Experts and Speculative Decoding
comment: Accepted at the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
summary: On-device deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become essential for personalized edge applications. A primary bottleneck is external memory access (EMA) in feed-forward network (FFN) layers. Speculative decoding and mixture-of-experts (MoE) are promising solutions. Speculative decoding reduces the number of decoding stages by generating multiple tokens per stage, and MoE minimizes per-stage cost through sparse expert activation. However, there is an incompatibility when combining these two techniques. We propose EdgeXpert, a software-hardware co-designed LLM accelerator that resolves this incompatibility. In the prefill stage, the prompt-wise expert reuse reformulates routing as prompt-level expert reuse rather than independent per-token expert selection. It identifies important tokens using a lightweight encoder, constructs a shared expert set from them, and routes less important tokens with a reduced expert budget to lower expert EMA. In the decode stage, depth-aware expert coalescing exploits the contextual similarity and mutual exclusivity of same-depth candidate tokens. Rather than loading the union of all required channels, EdgeXpert loads only salient channels and applies computational calibration to recover accuracy without additional memory access. Synthesized in Samsung 28nm technology at 800 MHz, EdgeXpert achieves up to 56.3% latency reduction and 44.1% energy reduction compared to prior works, while maintaining near-baseline accuracy.

AI.tldr: EdgeXpert是一个软硬件协同设计的LLM加速器，解决了推测解码与混合专家（MoE）结合时的兼容性问题，通过提示级专家复用和深度感知专家融合两种技术，分别降低预填充阶段和解码阶段的外部内存访问（EMA），在三星28nm工艺下实现高达56.3%的延迟降低和44.1%的能效提升。
AI.motivation: 端侧部署LLM的关键瓶颈是前馈网络层的外部内存访问（EMA）。推测解码和MoE分别是减少解码阶段数量和每阶段成本的可行方案，但两者结合时存在不兼容问题，需要新的架构设计来释放二者的协同潜力。
AI.method: EdgeXpert提出了两项关键技术：(1) 预填充阶段的提示级专家复用——通过轻量编码器识别重要token，构建共享专家集，并为次要token分配减少的专家预算以降低专家EMA；(2) 解码阶段的深度感知专家融合——利用同深度候选token的上下文相似性和互斥性，仅加载显著通道并施加计算校准来恢复精度，避免额外内存访问。
AI.result: 在三星28nm工艺、800 MHz主频下综合实现，EdgeXpert相比先前工作实现高达56.3%的延迟降低和44.1%的能量降低，同时保持接近基线的精度。
AI.conclusion: EdgeXpert通过软硬件协同设计有效地解决了推测解码与MoE相结合时的兼容性瓶颈，在端侧LLM推理中实现了显著的延迟和能耗优化，同时维持了模型精度，为个性化边缘应用中的LLM部署提供了可行方案。

title: The ethics of artificial intelligence in the life sciences: Universality, cultural diversity and an architecture of care
summary: The life sciences and health research have started to benefit from artificial intelligence, which raises ethical concerns that are real but, we argue, not special. Any science should be governed by values that rest on how the human brain is built and socialised rather than anything distinct to artificial intelligence. Importantly, the human brain has a different, much less costly computational architecture than these machines. This is achieved through the orchestration of a global neuronal workspace, and through reward best described not as a quantity to be maximised but as a continuous cycle of wanting, liking and satiety. As such, this creates the deep tension running through the ethics of the human person, between the universality of ethical judgement and the diversity of morals. The brain networks of the global workspace and emotion are universally shared, but the diversity of content is shaped by epigenetic appropriation of the particulars of the physical, social and cultural world, which makes every person unique. Still, if we were to build machines on these principles rather than the present unaffordable reward maximisers, the question of their governance would change from restraint to upbringing. We set out the institutions such a future would require, together with the questions that remain open.

AI.tldr: 本文论证：生命科学与健康研究中的AI引发的伦理关切虽真实但并非独特，任何科学均由基于人脑结构和社会的价值观所支配。人脑通过全局神经元工作空间和"想要-喜欢-满足"的奖励循环，以远低于AI的计算成本运作，形成伦理判断的普遍性与道德多样性之间的张力。若按这些原则而非当前昂贵的奖励最大化器构建机器，治理将从约束转向教养。
AI.motivation: 针对AI在生命科学与健康研究中引发的伦理问题，作者认为当前讨论过于聚焦AI的特殊性，忽视了真正的伦理基础在于人脑架构及其社会化过程。文章试图重新框定AI伦理问题的本质，并探索基于人脑原理构建AI的伦理治理前景。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证方法：通过对比人脑与人工计算架构的计算成本差异，引入全局神经元工作空间（global neuronal workspace）和神经科学中"想要-喜欢-满足"（wanting-liking-satiety）的奖励循环概念，从认知神经科学与价值理论的角度重新审视AI伦理的哲学基础。
AI.result: 指出人脑通过全局神经元工作空间及奖励的循环而非最大化模型，实现远超AI的能效；揭示了伦理判断普遍性与道德多样性之间的深层张力；提出若以人脑原理构建AI，其治理范式应从约束（restraint）转变为教养（upbringing），并概述了所需的制度框架及尚待解决的问题。
AI.conclusion: AI伦理问题应回归到以人脑认知架构为根基的人本价值框架内讨论；以人脑原理构建的智能机器的治理范式将发生根本转变，从外部约束转向类似人类教养的培育过程，这要求建立新型制度体系，同时仍有多项开放性议题有待探索。

title: Hierarchical Server Architecture for Agentic Science
summary: Agentic science is transforming the landscape of computational work, extending to scientific pipelines and workload managers. The workloads require specialized hardware within and across institutions. If assessing workload needs against environments is required for scheduling, automated discovery of resources is an essential step. In this paper, we present a hierarchical, dynamic architecture and software to discover resources across diverse cloud, edge, and HPC systems. The design enables concurrent, asynchronous negotiation, selection, and dispatch of requests for work using secretary agents. The agents probe and discover 51 real and simulated providers across 7 categories. We perform 19,973 negotiation and 6,952 selection simulations to assess reliability of decisions, demonstrating high (87.71\%) negotiation accuracy and selection costs comparable to more traditional strategies. Designed for extensibility and currently supporting the Genesis Mission, this architecture exemplifies the importance of careful coordination between agents, discovery tools, and infrastructure for agentic science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向智能体科学的分层动态资源发现架构，通过秘书代理在云、边缘和HPC等多样化环境中进行并发的异步协商、选择和调度，在51个真实及模拟提供商上完成了19,973次协商和6,952次选择模拟，实现了87.71%的协商准确率和与传统策略相当的选择成本。
AI.motivation: 智能体科学正在改变计算工作的格局，延伸到科学流水线和工作负载管理器。这些工作负载需要机构内外的专用硬件，而在进行调度时，评估工作负载需求与环境之间的匹配需要自动化的资源发现能力，这是实现有效调度的关键前提。
AI.method: 设计了一个分层动态的架构和软件系统，用于跨云、边缘和HPC等多样化系统发现资源。该架构采用秘书代理实现并发的异步协商、选择和调度请求分配，代理能够在7个类别的51个真实及模拟提供商中进行资源探测和发现。
AI.result: 进行了19,973次协商模拟和6,952次选择模拟来评估决策可靠性，实现了87.71%的高协商准确率，且选择成本与更传统策略相当。该架构已被Genesis Mission采用。
AI.conclusion: 该架构证明了智能体、发现工具与基础设施之间精心协调对于智能体科学的重要性，并具有很好的可扩展性，目前已在Genesis Mission中得到实际支持。

title: Post-Hoc Trajectory-Risk Certification for Modular LLM-Based Security Agents
summary:
Autonomous security agents operate as staged pipelines, such as classifying network traffic and then attributing attacks to a specific technique. Split conformal prediction gives each stage finite-sample coverage, but deployment requires a trajectory-level guarantee across the full chain. These guarantees do not compose automatically when stages are independently trained and calibrated. Bonferroni allocation is distribution-free but conservative under correlated errors. We show that a natural pairwise-correlation extension to three or more stages is invalid because it gives a lower rather than an upper bound, and derive a valid spanning-tree alternative. We distinguish whether stages are dependent from whether an audit sample is large enough to certify that dependence, and give matching upper and information-theoretic lower sample-complexity bounds. We also show that coarse-to-fine label selection can create near-perfect measured correlation without learned dependence.
  On a two-stage intrusion-detection pipeline across 6 open LLMs and 2 datasets, removing this artifact reduces measured correlation from near 1 to 0-0.78. A direct audit of trajectory failure becomes 13.7% tighter than Bonferroni once the audit reaches the required sample size, but is worse when undersized. A modular certificate using per-stage certificates and a pairwise overlap bound yields a positive average gain of 0.6%, quantifying the cost of lacking joint access. Same-model, cross-model, and permuted-pairing tests show that residual dependence reflects shared sample difficulty, not shared model representations. Average trajectory coverage across 12 configurations is 92.7% +/- 2.4% at alpha = 0.10. Under cross-dataset deployment, single-step miscoverage reaches 100% even when accuracy remains 78%, showing that distribution shift destroys calibrated confidence before raw accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自主安全代理多阶段流水线（如流量分类后归因攻击）的轨迹级（trajectory-level）覆盖保证问题。分裂共形预测（split conformal prediction）在每阶段有有限样本覆盖，但独立训练的阶段性保证无法自动组合为全链条的轨迹级保证。作者证明了Bonferroni分配在多阶段（≥3）下因相关误差而失效（给出下界而非上界），并提出了有效的生成树（spanning-tree）替代方案。同时区分了阶段依赖性本身与审计样本量是否足以证明该依赖性，给出了匹配的上下样本复杂度界。实验方面，在两阶段入侵检测流水线上使用6个开源LLM和2个数据集，发现粗到细标签选择会制造近完美的测量相关性（从近1降至0-0.78）；直接审计轨迹失败率比Bonferroni紧13.7%（在达到所需样本量后），但样本量不足时反而更差。平均轨迹覆盖率在12种配置下为92.7%±2.4%（α=0.10）。跨数据集部署时，单步错误覆盖达到100%而准确率仍为78%，表明分布偏移会先于原始精度摧毁校准置信度。
AI.motivation: 自主安全代理通常以阶段化流水线形式部署，例如先对网络流量分类再归因攻击技术。分裂共形预测为每个单独阶段提供了有限样本覆盖保证，但实际部署需要整个链条的轨迹级保证。由于各阶段独立训练和校准，这些保证无法自动组合。现有方法（如Bonferroni分配）虽然无分布假设，但在误差相关时过于保守，且作者发现其多阶段扩展在数学上无效。因此需要一种既能提供有效轨迹级覆盖保证、又能高效利用样本的框架，特别是在安全审计场景中。
AI.method: 论文首先证明Bonferroni分配扩展到三个或更多阶段时给出的是下界而非上界，从而失效。继而推导出有效的生成树替代方案，利用阶段间成对相关性提供有效的上界。论文区分了两个关键概念：阶段之间是否实际依赖（dependence）与审计样本量是否足以证明这种依赖（certifying dependence），并为两者给出了匹配的上下样本复杂度界（upper and information-theoretic lower sample-complexity bounds）。实验采用两阶段入侵检测流水线，使用6个开源LLM和2个数据集，设置了相同模型、跨模型和乱序配对测试来区分残差依赖的来源（共享样本难度 vs 共享模型表示）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：(1) 粗到细标签选择会人为制造近完美的测量相关性（去除该伪影后相关度从近1降至0-0.78）；(2) 当审计达到所需样本量时，直接轨迹失败审计比Bonferroni紧13.7%，但样本不足时效果更差；(3) 使用每阶段证书加成对重叠界的模块化证书产生了0.6%的正平均增益，量化了缺乏联合访问的代价；(4) 残差依赖反映的是共享样本难度而非共享模型表示；(5) 12种配置下平均轨迹覆盖率为92.7%±2.4%（α=0.10）；(6) 跨数据集部署时，即使准确率保持在78%，单步误覆盖率达100%，表明分布偏移在原始精度下降之前就破坏了校准置信度。
AI.conclusion: 本文为自主安全代理的多阶段流水线提供了有效的轨迹级共形预测框架。理论贡献在于揭示了Bonferroni多阶段扩展的数学缺陷并给出生成树替代方案；实践贡献在于通过大量实验量化了阶段间依赖的真实性、审计样本量的影响，以及分布偏移对校准置信度的破坏性影响。论文表明轨迹级覆盖保证需要专门的审计和理论工具，不能简单地从阶段级保证组合而来，且在实际部署中必须警惕测量伪影和分布偏移带来的误导性信号。

title: CLARA: Clarification of Language Ambiguity through Result Analysis for Natural-Language Cancer Genomics Queries
comment: Preprint of an article submitted for consideration in the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB 2027). Copyright 2026 World Scientific Publishing Company. https://psb.stanford.edu/
summary: A natural language interface can be used to make cancer genomics databases easier to use, but even if a question is perfectly fluent, its scientific meaning can be ambiguous. We propose CLARA, a framework that represents a question as a typed scientific query specification, considers a few possible interpretations, executes them, and asks for clarification when the estimates diverge. CLARA was assessed on mutation-prevalence contrasts among eight TCGA PanCancer Atlas cohorts and a 30-gene panel. This benchmark consisted of 330 unique executable contrasts varying in mutation scope, assay denominator, and sample context; 115 contrasts were result-sensitive and 215 were result-stable, per the preregistered definition of relative divergence greater than 0.10 or absolute divergence greater than 5 percentage points. An independently implemented pandas execution engine perfectly replicated all 660 results from the SQLite engine. In a separate 120-question LLM-generated, manually vetted language stress test, CLARA recognized all 60 result-sensitive contrasts and needlessly clarified 13 of 60 stable contrasts (accuracy 89.2%, sensitivity/recall 100%, specificity 78.3%). Standalone machine learning had superior overall accuracy (97.5%) but missed one critical contrast. This demonstrates that downstream execution can distinguish consequential from inconsequential ambiguity and reveal an explicit trade-off between safety and burden.

AI.tldr: CLARA是一个用于癌症基因组学数据库的自然语言查询框架，通过将问题表示为带类型的科学查询规范，执行多种可能的解释，并在结果分歧时请求澄清，从而区分有实质影响和无关紧要的歧义。
AI.motivation: 自然语言界面可以简化癌症基因组学数据库的使用，但即使是完全流畅的问题，其科学含义也可能存在歧义。这种歧义可能导致查询结果产生实质性偏差，因此需要一种机制来识别并处理这些歧义。
AI.method: CLARA将用户问题表示为带类型的科学查询规范，生成少量可能的解释并执行它们；当执行结果出现分歧时，向用户请求澄清。使用了SQLite和独立的pandas执行引擎对330个变体对比进行基准测试，并通过120个LLM生成、人工审核的语言压力测试评估其性能。
AI.result: 在330个可执行对比中，115个为结果敏感、215个为结果稳定的对比；两个执行引擎在全部660个结果上完全一致。在120问题的压力测试中，CLARA识别了全部60个结果敏感对比，并对13个稳定对比进行了不必要的澄清（准确率89.2%，灵敏度100%，特异度78.3%）。独立的机器学习方法总体准确率更高（97.5%），但遗漏了一个关键对比。
AI.conclusion: 下游执行能够区分有实质意义和无关紧要的歧义，并揭示安全性与负担之间的明确权衡。与独立机器学习相比，CLARA虽然特异性略低，但能确保识别所有关键歧义，体现了执行驱动方法在安全优先场景下的价值。

title: VLAff: Vision-Language-Affordance Model for Unified Actionable Affordances
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026. Project page: https://ojh6404.github.io/vlaff/
summary: Learning manipulation skills from human videos is promising for scalable robot learning. However, the embodiment mismatch between humans and robots makes this challenging. One promising solution is to learn object-centric actionable affordances that are embodiment-agnostic. In this work, we propose a framework that leverages egocentric human videos with state-of-the-art 3D Structure-from-Motion and hand mesh reconstruction to extract actionable affordances such as visual, grasp, and trajectory affordances that explicitly encode where to interact, how to grasp, and how to move. We construct EgoAffordance, a large-scale dataset comprising 204K episodes with 5.6M visual affordances and 11.6M grasp and trajectory affordances. Building on this, we introduce VLAff, a large vision-language model-based unified foundation model that learns cross-modal correlations across all actionable affordances. Given a visual observation and instruction, VLAff generates visual affordance heatmaps, grasp poses, and trajectories, which are then converted into directly executable actions by utilizing 3D scene information. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that VLAff not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual affordance prediction, but can also be effectively applied to real robot applications such as zero-shot manipulation and affordance-guided robot learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLAff框架，利用第一人称人类视频结合3D Structure-from-Motion和手部网格重建，提取视觉、抓取和轨迹三大类可执行的动作可供性，构建了包含204K集、560万视觉可供性和1160万抓取/轨迹可供性的大规模数据集EgoAffordance，并基于大型视觉语言模型学习跨模态关联，实现零样本机器人操作和可供性引导的机器人学习。
AI.motivation: 从人类视频中学习操作技能是实现可扩展机器人学习的有前景途径，但人类与机器人之间的具身差异（embodiment mismatch）使其极具挑战性。现有方法缺乏能跨具身泛化的可执行动作表示。
AI.method: 1) 利用第一人称人类视频，结合先进3D Structure-from-Motion和手部网格重建技术，提取三种动作可供性：视觉可供性（在哪里交互）、抓取可供性（如何抓取）和轨迹可供性（如何移动）；2) 构建EgoAffordance大规模数据集；3) 提出VLAff，一种基于大型视觉语言模型的统一基础模型，学习所有动作可供性之间的跨模态相关性，根据视觉观察和指令生成视觉可供性热图、抓取姿态和轨迹，并利用3D场景信息转换为可直接执行的动作。
AI.result: VLAff在视觉可供性预测上达到当前最优性能，并成功应用于真实机器人场景，包括零样本操作和可供性引导的机器人学习。
AI.conclusion: 通过从人类视频中提取具身无关的动作可供性并利用大型视觉语言模型统一学习，可以有效弥合人类与机器人之间的具身差异，实现可迁移的机器人操作技能学习。

title: MapTCL: Temporal Consistency Learning via Bidirectional Alignment for Vectorized HD Map Construction
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: Constructing reliable online HD maps remains challenging in dynamic urban environments due to moving objects and occlusions. While recent works employ feature-level temporal fusion to address this, they rely solely on per-frame ground truth supervision. Consequently, they lack an explicit objective to directly penalize the geometric noise and temporal jitter between consecutive online HD maps. To address this, we propose MapTCL, an auxiliary training strategy that formulates temporal consistency loss between current and past frames via bidirectional alignment. Specifically, Bidirectional Vector Consistency Learning (BVCL) models the geometric and semantic discrepancies between associated past and current vector instances as an auxiliary loss. We also employ Raster map Consistency Learning (RCL) as an additional loss to stabilize dense BEV features. By jointly training with these dual losses, MapTCL improves the temporal stability of generated HD maps. Extensive experiments on two standard benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. As a versatile plug-and-play module, MapTCL consistently enhances existing baseline models, achieving gains of +3.7 mAP & +2.8 C-mAP on nuScenes and +3.1 mAP & +2.5 C-mAP on Argoverse 2 without additional inference overhead.

AI.tldr: MapTCL是一种辅助训练策略，通过双向对齐公式化当前帧与过去帧之间的时间一致性损失，包括双向向量一致性学习（BVCL）和栅格图一致性学习（RCL），以惩罚连续在线高清地图之间的几何噪声和时间抖动，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上分别为基线模型带来+3.7/+2.8 mAP和+3.1/+2.5 mAP的性能提升，且无额外推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有在线高清地图构建方法虽然采用特征级时间融合，但仅依赖逐帧真值监督，缺乏显式目标来直接惩罚连续在线高清地图之间的几何噪声和时间抖动，导致动态城市场景中地图的时序稳定性不足。
AI.method: 提出MapTCL辅助训练策略，包含两个损失：（1）双向向量一致性学习（BVCL），建模关联的过去和当前向量实例之间的几何与语义差异作为辅助损失；（2）栅格图一致性学习（RCL），稳定密集BEV特征。两者联合训练以改善生成的HD地图的时间稳定性。
AI.result: 在两个标准基准（nuScenes和Argoverse 2）上，MapTCL作为即插即用模块一致性地增强现有基线模型：nuScenes上+3.7 mAP和+2.8 C-mAP，Argoverse 2上+3.1 mAP和+2.5 C-mAP，且不增加推理开销。
AI.conclusion: MapTCL通过引入显式的时间一致性损失，有效解决了在线高清地图构建中因动态物体和遮挡导致的几何噪声与时间抖动问题，是一种通用且高效的辅助训练方法，能够显著提升现有模型的性能与稳定性。

title: Simulator-Grounded Large Language Models for Industrial Causal Reasoning: Tool-Use, Structured Injection, and Plant-Portable Retrieval for Wastewater Treatment Decision Support
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier
summary: Wastewater operators need answers grounded in how their plant's variables interact and how fast effects propagate, not in generic pretraining text, when asking causal questions such as "why is N2O rising?" or "what happens if I cut aeration by 20%?". We compare three concrete ways to ground a frozen Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct model in an architecturally interpretable wastewater simulator (CCSS-IX): a live simulator oracle (Method 1), structured parameter injection (Method 2), and a Decoupled Recall-Reasoning (DRR) retriever (Method 3). On a 198-question causal benchmark the three reach 99.5%, 79%, and 75.8%, forming a deployment ladder above the strongest retrieval-augmented baseline at 48%. The DRR retriever has 110M parameters and trains per plant in ~17 seconds; after cross-plant transfer to a biologically distinct plant it still reaches 88%, while Method 2's static table cannot transfer. On a 60-question counterfactual benchmark only Method 3 handles queries about what happens after an intervention: +16.3 pp over Method 2, paired 95% CI [+7.1, +26.4] pp, with 100% on the timescale and operating-regime categories. On the AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC) with an OpenBookQA fact corpus, the same selective-retrieval mechanism reaches 79% versus unconstrained Llama-3.1-8B 76% and full-injection 74%, a +3 pp out-of-domain replication that argues against a result specific to wastewater treatment. We provide the first single-simulator comparison of live tool-use, static parameter injection, and learned numerical-parameter retrieval for industrial causal question answering.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种将冻结的Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct大语言模型与可解释性污水处理模拟器（CCSS-IX）接地的方法：实时模拟器工具调用（Method 1）、结构化参数注入（Method 2）和解耦召回-推理（DRR）检索器（Method 3）。在198问因果基准上分别达到99.5%、79%和75.8%的准确率，远超最强检索增强基线（48%）。DRR检索器仅110M参数、每厂训练约17秒，且能跨厂迁移（88%），在60问反事实基准上独占鳌头（+16.3pp）。在ARC出域任务上该检索机制同样有效（79% vs 76%），证明其并非污水处理领域的特例。
AI.motivation: 污水处理厂运维人员需要基于自身工厂变量相互作用和效应传播速度的答案来回答因果性问题（如"为什么N2O在上升？"或"减少20%曝气会怎样？"），而非通用预训练文本。然而现有方法缺乏将LLM接地到具体工厂模拟器的系统比较，作者希望提供首个统一的单模拟器对比框架。
AI.method: 将冻结的Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct模型通过三种方式与架构可解释的污水处理模拟器CCSS-IX接地：Method 1使用实时模拟器作为工具（oracle）；Method 2将模拟器的结构化参数静态注入提示；Method 3提出Decoupled Recall-Reasoning（DRR）检索器——一个110M参数的轻量检索网络，解耦记忆召回与推理步骤，按工厂训练（约17秒）并能跨厂迁移。实验在两个基准（198问因果基准和60问反事实基准）及ARC出域基准上评测，并配以标准检索增强基线（48%）对比。
AI.result: 因果基准上三种方法分别达99.5%、79%和75.8%，较48%的检索增强基线显著提升。DRR检索器跨厂迁移至生物学不同的工厂仍达88%，而Method 2的静态表无法迁移。反事实基准上仅Method 3能处理干预后查询（+16.3pp，95% CI [+7.1, +26.4]pp），在时间尺度和运行工况类别上达100%。ARC出域测试中DRR达79%，优于无约束Llama-3.1-8B的76%和全参数注入的74%（+3pp）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了工业因果问答中实时工具调用、静态参数注入和学习型数值参数检索三种方案的首次单模拟器系统对比。三种方法构成"部署阶梯"（deployment ladder），可根据算力、实时性和迁移需求选择：Method 1适合可实时访问模拟器的场景，Method 3在需跨厂迁移和反事实推理时最优，Method 2在两者之间提供简单静态方案。DRR的跨域成功表明选择性检索机制具有通用性。

title: MS-MLB: An Open Machine Learning Benchmark for Blood-Based MS Classification
summary: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is diagnosed through clinical assessment, magnetic resonance imaging, laboratory evidence when appropriate, and exclusion of better explanations. Blood RNA expression data may contain disease associated immune signal, but a blood RNA classifier cannot be treated as a replacement for clinical diagnosis. This paper presents MS-MLB (Multiple Sclerosis Machine Learning Benchmark), a reproducible open benchmark for machine learning based MS research classification from whole blood RNA expression data. MS-MLB uses the public GSE17048 cohort, converts it into an MS versus healthy control task, and evaluates multiple algorithms under a shared, leakage controlled pipeline that a researcher can rerun without reconfiguring the evaluation. The evaluation includes nested cross-validation, an untouched stratified holdout set, bootstrap confidence intervals, ROC and precision recall analysis, calibration measurement, and an exploratory MS Research Score. In the final benchmark summary, Gradient Boosting ranked first by MS Research Score on the holdout set, with an MS Research Score of 93.83, AUC-ROC of 0.989, sensitivity of 0.950, specificity of 0.778, $F_{1}$ score of 0.927, and Brier score of 0.050. Prior studies have applied machine learning to MS blood transcriptomic data, including PBMC stage classification and whole blood diagnostic signature modeling. The contribution here is different and narrower. To our knowledge, MS-MLB is the first open benchmark focused on MS versus healthy control classification from GSE17048 whole blood RNA expression data with a documented external model submission pathway built into the framework. The score is intended for research comparison only and has not been clinically validated. The benchmark is accessible here: https://github.com/duckyquang/MS-MLB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MS-MLB（多发性硬化机器学习基准），一个可复现的开源基准框架，用于基于全血RNA表达数据区分多发性硬化与健康对照。采用GSE17048公共数据集，在共享的防泄露评估流水线下比较多种机器学习算法，最终Gradient Boosting在留出集上以MS研究得分93.83、AUC-ROC 0.989等指标排名第一。该基准提供外部模型提交路径，但评分仅用于研究比较，未经临床验证。
AI.motivation: 多发性硬化的诊断依赖临床评估、MRI和实验室证据，血液RNA表达数据可能包含疾病相关的免疫信号，但血液RNA分类器不能替代临床诊断。现有研究虽已应用机器学习于MS血液转录组数据，但缺乏一个可复现、防数据泄露、有标准化评估流程的开源基准，以便公正地比较不同机器学习方法在MS与健康对照分类任务上的性能。
AI.method: 使用公共GSE17048队列，构建MS对健康对照的二分类任务；在统一的防泄漏评估流水线下评测多种机器学习算法，该流水线包含嵌套交叉验证、未曾触碰的分层留出集、bootstrap置信区间、ROC与精确率-召回率分析、校准测量及探索性MS研究得分；框架内建了文档化的外部模型提交路径，保证研究者无需重新配置即可复跑评估。
AI.result: 在最终基准汇总中，Gradient Boosting在留出集上按MS研究得分排名第一，MS研究得分为93.83，AUC-ROC为0.989，敏感性0.950，特异性0.778，F1分数0.927，Brier分数0.050。
AI.conclusion: MS-MLB是首个聚焦于GSE17048全血RNA表达数据上MS与健康对照分类、并内置文档化外部模型提交途径的开源基准。其贡献明确且有别于既往研究（后者侧重PBMC阶段分类或全血诊断特征建模）。该评分仅用于研究比较，未经临床验证，不应作为临床诊断的替代品。

title: Agentic Nesting: A New Methodology for Existing Enterprise Application Integration and Services
summary: Enterprise operations extensively rely on multiple heterogeneous business systems and information applications, which also result in severe data silos and process fragmentation. Enterprises have invested considerable financial and material resources in building these applications, however, effectively leveraging and orchestrating them remains a formidable challenge. Conventional approaches to enterprise application integration, encompassing middleware architectures such as Enterprise Service Bus (ESB), API gateway infrastructures, and Robotic Process Automation (RPA), suffer from inherent limitations like high architectural coupling, escalating operation and maintenance costs, and limited intelligence capabilities. This paper proposes Agentic Nesting, a multi-agent collaboration framework in which existing enterprise applications are encapsulated as autonomous AI agents within a hierarchically nested structure. Rather than flat interconnection, agents are organized into layered stewardship topologies that mirror the compositional complexity of enterprise ecosystems. The framework extracts a digital agent proxy from each legacy application to enable natural-language interaction and autonomous manipulation, coordinates multiple agents through a central orchestrator for task decomposition and dynamic dispatching, and exposes a unified conversational interface for cross-application querying and process orchestration. The main contributions of this paper are the proposition of the "Application-as-Agent" integration paradigm and the "Conversation-as-Integration" interaction philosophy, together with an exploration of the generalization potential of this methodology in scenarios encompassing heterogeneous system coordination, and large-scale data applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Nesting，一种多智能体协作框架，将现有企业应用封装为分层嵌套结构中的自主AI智能体，通过"应用即智能体"的集成范式和"对话即集成"的交互理念，实现跨异构系统的自然语言交互与流程编排，以克服传统ESB、API网关和RPA等集成方式的高耦合、高运维成本和智能化不足等缺陷。
AI.motivation: 企业运营依赖多个异构业务系统和信息应用，导致严重的数据孤岛和流程碎片化。传统企业应用集成方式（如ESB、API网关、RPA）存在架构耦合度高、运维成本攀升、智能化能力有限等固有局限，亟需一种新的集成范式来有效编排和利用现有企业应用。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Nesting多智能体协作框架：（1）将现有企业应用封装为分层嵌套结构中的自主AI智能体，而非扁平互联；（2）从每个遗留应用中提取数字代理代理（digital agent proxy），支持自然语言交互和自主操作；（3）通过中央编排器（central orchestrator）协调多个智能体，实现任务分解与动态调度；（4）提供统一的对话式接口用于跨应用查询和流程编排。
AI.result: 论文的主要贡献包括：（1）提出"Application-as-Agent"（应用即智能体）集成范式；（2）提出"Conversation-as-Integration"（对话即集成）交互理念；（3）在异构系统协调和大规模数据应用等场景中探索了该方法的泛化潜力。
AI.conclusion: Agentic Nesting通过分层托管拓扑模拟企业生态系统的组合复杂性，以智能体化和对话化方式解决企业应用集成难题，在异构系统协调和大规模数据应用场景中展现出广阔的应用前景。

title: PowerScope: ML-based Intra-Cycle Power Estimation
summary: Power estimation at sub-clock-cycle temporal resolutions is critical for tasks such as power delivery network (PDN) design, dynamic voltage droop analysis, and pre-silicon power side-channel security evaluation. Designers commonly rely on commercial post-layout gate-level power analysis tools for these tasks, but these flows are computationally expensive and scale poorly with design size and workload length. Machine learning (ML)-based power estimation frameworks have shown promise in accelerating power estimation, but prior efforts only address average power or per-cycle power estimation. We propose PowerScope, the first ML-based intra-cycle power estimation framework. PowerScope operates purely on RTL simulation traces at inference time, eliminating the need for post-layout gate-level simulation and power analysis per workload. Across a diverse benchmark suite, PowerScope achieves 5.88% median and 9% mean absolute percentage error compared to commercial post-layout gate-level power estimates while running ~80x faster. We further demonstrate that PowerScope's predictions can be reliably used for the downstream task of pre-silicon power side-channel leakage assessment.

AI.tldr: PowerScope是首个基于机器学习的亚时钟周期（intra-cycle）功耗估计框架，仅依赖RTL仿真迹线即可推断功耗，无需后布局门级仿真和功耗分析，在保持中位绝对百分比误差5.88%的同时实现了约80倍的加速，并可靠支持预硅片功耗侧信道安全评估。
AI.motivation: 亚时钟周期时间分辨率的功耗估计对供电网络设计、动态电压跌落分析和预硅片功耗侧信道安全评估至关重要。现有的商业后布局门级功耗分析工具计算昂贵且扩展性差，而已有的ML功耗估计方法仅能处理平均功耗或逐周期功耗，缺乏亚时钟周期级别的估计能力。
AI.method: PowerScope提出了一种仅以RTL仿真迹线为输入的ML-based intra-cycle功耗估计框架。在推理时无需后布局门级仿真和功耗分析，通过机器学习模型直接从RTL层面的仿真信号预测亚时钟周期分辨率的功耗曲线。
AI.result: 在多样化的基准测试集上，PowerScope与商业后布局门级功耗估计相比，中位绝对百分比误差为5.88%，平均绝对百分比误差为9%，运行速度约为传统方法的80倍。此外，其预测结果可可靠地用于预硅片功耗侧信道泄漏评估这一下游任务。
AI.conclusion: PowerScope证明了基于机器学习的亚时钟周期功耗估计是可行且高效的，填补了现有ML功耗估计方法在时间分辨率上的空白，为预硅片功耗侧信道安全评估等关键下游任务提供了一种可靠的加速方案。

title: Effective pruning of task-trained recurrent neural networks using noisy fluctuations and connection rescaling
summary: The pruning of network connections is key to brain function but, despite its importance, there exist few biologically-plausible pruning rules with demonstrated good performance. In this work we evaluate noise-prune, a recently introduced unsupervised local pruning rule for recurrent networks that uses noisy fluctuations to determine the importance of connections. Noise-prune has previously only been empirically tested on random networks without a specific computational function. We show that noise-prune preserves task-performance in task-trained recurrent neural networks, greatly outperforming a strategy that only uses the magnitude of connections and performing on par with or exceeding a non-local strategy that uses second-order information. Rather than deterministically removing connections that fall below a certain threshold importance, noise-prune samples connections to preserve based on their importance and strengthens retained connections to preserve average synaptic strength. We show that this sampling and rescaling is essential to good performance, but that the optimal empirical degree of rescaling is lower than that predicted by the original theoretical argument. Our work thus validates noise-prune as a biologically-plausible pruning rule for functional recurrent network architectures and characterizes its optimal parameter settings.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了噪声修剪（noise-prune）这一生物合理的无监督局部剪枝规则在任务训练过的循环神经网络中的表现，证明其能保持任务性能，优于仅基于连接强度的剪枝策略，与使用二阶信息的非局部策略相当或更好，并发现采样和重新缩放至关重要，但最优缩放程度低于理论预测。
AI.motivation: 网络连接的剪枝对大脑功能至关重要，但现有的生物合理剪枝规则很少且性能未得到充分验证。noise-prune此前仅在无特定计算功能的随机网络上测试过，需要验证其在功能性循环网络中的实际表现。
AI.method: 在任务训练过的循环神经网络上应用noise-prune剪枝规则，与仅用连接幅度的策略和使用二阶信息的非局部策略进行对比；分析剪枝、采样保留和重新缩放（以保持平均突触强度）各组件的作用，并系统搜索最优重新缩放程度。
AI.result: noise-prune在任务训练的循环神经网络中保持了任务性能，大幅优于基于连接幅度的剪枝策略，与基于二阶信息的非局部策略相当或更优。采样和重新缩放对性能至关重要，但最优经验缩放程度低于原始理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了noise-prune是一种适用于功能性循环网络架构的生物合理剪枝规则，并刻画了其最优参数设置，为生物合理的人工神经网络压缩提供了重要依据。

title: Application Failures and Machine Computational Efficiency
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the 2026 SIAM Conference on Parallel Processing for Scientific Computing (PP)
summary: We present a framework for evaluating uptime efficiency of Exascale-class scientific computers when application failure rates are appreciable. This is the situation that confronts current leadership-class scientific computing platforms and large AI training installations. What distinguishes scientific computing platforms is the heterogeneity of their applications. We argue that this diversity requires that failure rates and mean intervals between failures should be specified in terms of \emph{usage} (e.g. node-hours) rather than time, as is currently customary. We consider the usage loss terms due to failures, to checkpointing, and to restart costs, and update the framework of Daly (2006) allowing users to specify optimal checkpointing usage intervals that minimize such losses. We derive the machine computational efficiency, which specifies the expected fractional resource allocation that is available for scientific computation. We illustrate the methodology using one year of production runtime data from the \emph{Frontier} supercomputer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个评估百亿亿次（Exascale）级科学计算平台在应用故障率显著时的正常运行（uptime）效率框架，强调以"使用量"（如节点小时）而非时间来表达故障率和平均故障间隔，并扩展了Daly（2006）框架以支持用户指定最优检查点设置，最后用橡树岭国家实验室Frontier超级计算机一年的生产运行数据进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 当前领导级科学计算平台和大型AI训练设施面临显著的应用故障率，且科学计算平台的特点是应用异构性极强。现有的故障率与平均故障间隔时间（MTBF）通常以时间为单位定义，但科学计算的异构应用多样性要求以"使用量"（如节点小时）来定义这些指标，因此需要一个更新、更贴合实际的评估框架。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个评估框架，包含：（1）将故障率和平均故障间隔以使用量（节点小时）而非时间进行规范化定义；（2）考虑故障、检查点（checkpointing）和重启（restart）成本带来的使用量损失项；（3）更新Daly（2006）的框架，允许用户指定最优检查点使用间隔以最小化损失；（4）推导机器计算效率（machine computational efficiency），用于给出可分配给科学计算的预期资源比例；（5）使用橡树岭国家实验室Frontier超级计算机一年的生产运行数据进行实证验证。
AI.result: 作者用Frontier超级计算机一年的生产运行时数据证明了该方法的可行性，表明该框架可以量化在显著故障率条件下科学计算平台的实际计算效率，并帮助用户确定最优的检查点使用间隔以最小化故障、检查点和重启造成的使用量损失。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为Exascale级科学计算平台的正常运行效率评估提供了一种以使用量为基准的新方法，相较于传统以时间为基准的评估方式更贴合科学计算应用异构性的现实，同时扩展了Daly（2006）的最优检查点理论，并通过实际超算数据验证了其有效性。

title: ASTELD: A Six-Axis Classification Framework for Autonomous AI Agents - Design, Evaluation, and an OpenClaw Case Study
comment: 40 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Introduces and empirically evaluates the ASTELD six-axis classification framework across eight autonomous AI agent platforms, with OpenClaw as an in-depth case study
summary: Autonomous AI agent platforms differ substantially in architecture, security, tool integration, execution, autonomy, and deployment, yet the field lacks a common classification scheme for comparing these design choices. We propose ASTELD, an operational six-axis classification framework for autonomous AI agents: Architecture pattern, Security posture, Tool integration model, Execution paradigm, Level of autonomy and human control, and Deployment topology. ASTELD is constructed by synthesizing prior agent taxonomies with observable platform properties and explicit category-assignment rules. We evaluate its discriminative and explanatory utility by mapping eight representative frameworks and by using OpenClaw as an in-depth case study. The resulting profiles separate all eight platforms under their dominant configurations and reveal three cross-platform patterns: a security-accessibility diagonal, strong execution-architecture coupling, and capability convergence with persistent architectural differentiation. We further classify 50+ OpenClaw derivatives and find that innovation concentrates on the Security, Execution, and Deployment axes, indicating that ASTELD can explain where ecosystem fragmentation occurs. The OpenClaw case study also supplies a six-category vulnerability taxonomy, evidence from five institutional assessments, and adoption and governance analyses that connect platform coordinates to observed risks. These results position ASTELD as a reproducible method for comparing agent platforms, identifying unoccupied design regions, guiding framework selection, and organizing future empirical research. The analysis also exposes a consequential empty region: none of the evaluated systems combines local-first deployment with enterprise-grade security.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASTELD，一个面向自主AI代理平台的六轴分类框架（架构模式、安全态势、工具集成模型、执行范式、自主性与人类控制水平、部署拓扑），通过映射八个代表性框架和OpenClaw深度案例研究，验证了其判别性与解释性效用，并揭示了跨平台模式、生态系统创新分布及一个重要的空置设计区域。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理平台在架构、安全、工具集成、执行、自主性和部署等方面差异显著，但该领域缺乏统一的分类方案来比较这些设计选择，导致平台间难以进行系统化对比与评估。
AI.method: ASTELD框架通过综合既有代理分类学与可观测的平台属性，结合明确的类别分配规则构建。评估方法包括映射八个代表性框架以检验判别力，并以OpenClaw作为深度案例研究，包括对其50多个衍生品的分类、六类别漏洞分类、五项机构评估结果以及采纳与治理分析。
AI.result: ASTELD成功分离了所有八个平台的主导配置，揭示了三个跨平台模式（安全-可访问性斜线、执行-架构强耦合、能力收敛伴随架构持续分化），并将OpenClaw衍生品创新集中于安全、执行和部署三个轴。同时发现一个空置区域：没有系统同时具备本地优先部署与企业级安全。
AI.conclusion: ASTELD可作为可复现的代理平台比较方法，用于识别未占用的设计区域、指导框架选择和组织未来实证研究，同时暴露了本地优先部署与企业级安全结合这一尚未被填补的关键设计空白。

title: Frozen but Not Always Accessible: A Representation Analysis of Genomic Language Models
summary: Genomic foundation models are increasingly reused as frozen feature extractors for downstream sequence prediction, offering a compute-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning. However, it remains unclear when biological information encoded by these models is accessible without task-specific adaptation. We present a representation-accessibility analysis of frozen genomic language models across regulatory, epigenetic, promoter, splice-site, and variant-effect prediction tasks. We evaluate DNABERT-2, Nucleotide Transformer, HyenaDNA, GENERATOR-v2, and Omni-DNA under unified frozen-probing protocols, while separating diagnostic readout analyses from validation-selected checks. Our results reveal a consistent task-dependent pattern: frozen probes recover 95-100 % of fine-tuned performance on promoter tasks, but average splice-site recovery drops to 60-88 %. Frozen embeddings are also competitive on broad Genomic Benchmark tasks such as coding-region and species-discrimination classification, but show larger gaps on some regulatory and OCR tasks. Layer-wise probing, in-silico mutagenesis, variant-effect prediction, and embedding geometry show that local biological signal is partially present in frozen representations, but is not always accessible through final pooled embeddings.

AI.tldr: 该研究对多种冷冻（frozen）基因组基础模型进行表示可访问性（representation-accessibility）分析，揭示在不同下游序列预测任务中，冷冻嵌入能恢复微调性能的比例存在显著的任务依赖性差异。
AI.motivation: 基因组基础模型越来越多地被作为冻结特征提取器复用于下游序列预测，比全量微调更节省计算资源。然而，这些模型编码的生物信息在未经过任务特定适配的情况下是否可被访问尚不明确，作者希望系统性地回答这一问题。
AI.method: 在统一的冷冻探测器（frozen-probing）协议下，对DNABERT-2、Nucleotide Transformer、HyenaDNA、GENERATOR-v2和Omni-DNA五个模型进行跨调控、表观遗传、启动子、剪接位点和变异效应预测任务的评估；区分了诊断性读出分析与验证集选择检查；并采用分层探测（layer-wise probing）、原位诱变（in-silico mutagenesis）、变异效应预测和嵌入几何分析等多种手段。
AI.result: 冷冻探测在启动子任务上可恢复95-100%的微调性能，但在剪接位点任务上平均恢复率降至60-88%；在Genomic Benchmark的编码区与物种判别任务上表现竞争力，但在部分调控和开放染色质区域（OCR）任务上差距较大。分层探测、原位诱变等分析表明局部生物信号部分存在于冷冻表示中，但并非总能通过最终池化嵌入访问。
AI.conclusion: 冷冻基因组表示的可访问性具有强任务依赖性：某些任务（如启动子）几乎无需适配即可充分获取生物信息，而其他任务（如剪接位点）则需要任务特定适配或更好的读出策略；最终池化嵌入可能不是访问全部局部生物信号的最佳方式。

title: A System for Train Condition Monitoring and Structural Health Assessment of Rail Vehicles
summary: The ongoing digitalization of rail systems and the increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) are fundamentally transforming the design, operation, and maintenance of rail vehicles. While fully automated operation at Grade of Automation 4 (GoA4) is well established in metro systems, its deployment in mainline rail remains limited. This is primarily due to stringent safety requirements and the complexity of open operational environments. Current perception systems based on cameras, radar, and lidar are effective in detecting objects but provide limited capability for reliably identifying impacts, collisions, and driving-over events. This paper presents a novel approach for real-time vehicle condition monitoring and impact detection that integrates structural sensor technologies with AI-based data analysis. The proposed framework addresses three key applications: (1) automated detection of impacts, structural damage, and driving-over events, (2) condition-based maintenance enabled by continuous monitoring, and (3) long-term data analytics to support vehicle design optimization. The results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approach and highlight its potential to enhance operational safety, enable predictive maintenance strategies, and support the transition toward fully automated operation in mainline rail systems

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将结构传感器技术与AI数据分析相结合的新型实时车辆状态监测与碰撞检测方法，旨在解决主线铁路在GoA4级全自动运行中面临的碰撞和碾压事件检测难题，并支持基于状态的维护和长期数据驱动的设计优化。
AI.motivation: 主线铁路的全自动运行（GoA4级）虽然在地铁系统中已成熟，但受限于严格的安全要求和开放环境的复杂性，在主线铁路中部署仍有限。现有的基于摄像头、雷达和激光雷达的感知系统虽然能有效检测物体，但在可靠识别碰撞、撞击和碾压事件方面能力不足，需要新的监测方法。
AI.method: 提出一个集成结构传感器技术与AI数据分析的框架，用于实时车辆状态监测和碰撞检测。该框架涵盖三个关键应用场景：(1)自动检测碰撞、结构损伤和碾压事件；(2)基于连续监测的状态维护；(3)支持车辆设计优化的长期数据分析。
AI.result: 研究结果证明了所提出方法的可行性，凸显其在增强运营安全、实现预测性维护策略以及支持主线铁路向全自动运行过渡方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为铁路车辆的状态监测和碰撞检测提供了一种创新方案，通过结构传感器与AI的结合，弥补了传统感知系统在事件检测方面的不足，为推进主线铁路全自动化运营提供了技术支持。

title: Innocent Panels, Hateful Stories: Evaluating and Detecting Hateful Intent in Multi-Turn Visual Story Generation
summary: Picture books and comics have long been used to disseminate hateful narratives because they are easily understood even by children, as exemplified by the notorious Nazi propaganda picture book \emph{Der Giftpilz}. Recently, frontier text-to-image (T2I) systems such as Gemini and GPT-Image have enabled conversational generation with consistent characters and scenes across turns, making hateful visual stories, namely ordered image groups that collectively convey hateful narratives, cheap and scalable to produce. Although prior work has studied hateful content generation by T2I systems, it focuses on individual images, leaving group-level hateful meaning largely unexplored. We aim to address the gap. Concretely, we introduce \texttt{HatefulStoryPrompts}, comprising 330 multi-turn configurations from 55 hateful stories across two languages and three visual styles, and evaluate five frontier models over 4,950 attempts. Every model completes over 80\% of the stories, with the strongest reaching 99.0\%. We further evaluate existing moderation systems on \texttt{HatefulVisualStory}, a human-labeled dataset of 969 hateful image sets and 990 benign controls, and find that they frequently miss group-level hateful meaning: dedicated safety models achieve at most 34.9\% recall, while a strong vision-language model reaches 67.5\%. Finally, we propose complementary proactive and post-generation defenses. An interaction-aware monitor achieves 97.3\% recall for prompt-only sessions and 92.6\% when the user supplies the first image, while post-generation methods jointly analyzing completed image groups reach 80.2\%. Our work shows that, as image generation evolves from isolated outputs to coherent visual narratives, safety must evolve accordingly, from per-image moderation to stateful reasoning over interactions and image relationships.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究文本到图像（T2I）系统生成群体级仇恨叙事（即有序图片组构成的仇恨故事）的问题，构建了HatefulStoryPrompts基准数据集并评估五个前沿模型，发现所有模型都能完成80%以上的仇恨故事；同时揭示现有审核系统在检测群体级仇恨含义上严重不足，并提出交互感知监控和事后联合分析等防御方案。
AI.motivation: 前沿T2I系统（如Gemini、GPT-Image）已能跨轮次生成具有一致角色和场景的图像，使得生成有序图像组以集体传达仇恨叙事变得廉价且可规模化。然而，以往研究只关注单张图像的仇恨内容生成，群体级别的仇恨含义（即多张图像共同表达的仇恨叙事）尚未被探索，存在显著的研究空白。
AI.method: 1) 构建HatefulStoryPrompts数据集，包含55个仇恨故事、330个多轮配置，覆盖两种语言和三种视觉风格；2) 在4,950次尝试中评估五个前沿T2I模型；3) 构建HatefulVisualStory人工标注数据集（969个仇恨图片组和990个良性对照组）来评估现有审核系统；4) 提出互补的前置（交互感知监控器，可检测提示词会话或用户提供首图）和后置（对完整图像组进行联合分析）防御方法。
AI.result: 所有被评估的模型均完成超过80%的仇恨故事，最强模型达到99.0%；现有审核系统在检测群体级仇恨含义上表现不佳：专用安全模型最多仅34.9%的召回率，强视觉语言模型达到67.5%；提出的交互感知监控器在仅提示词会话中达到97.3%的召回率，用户提供首图时达到92.6%；后置的联合图像组分析方法达到80.2%。
AI.conclusion: 随着图像生成从孤立输出演变为连贯的视觉叙事，安全防护必须相应演进——从逐图像审核转向对交互和图像关系的状态化推理。群体级仇恨含义远比单张图像更难被现有系统检测，需要创新的防御策略。

title: Mean-Field Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) with chain-of-thought reasoning have been widely applied in recent years, and theoretical explanations of their behavior may help deepen our understanding and guide model optimization. In this study, we introduce a framework that seeks statistical regularities and theoretical interpretations in LLM reasoning without simplifying the model architecture or making analogies to existing physical systems. We formulate LLM reasoning as a guided discovery process on a clue graph, and derive a one-dimensional ordinary differential equation for the fraction of discovered clues using the mean-field approximation. Experimentally, clue tokens are identified using the normalized surprisal of a student LLM on the outputs of a teacher LLM, and statistical regularities are obtained by averaging over many reasoning chains of thought. Our experiments show that the resulting statistical regularities are reproducible within the same dataset and can be fitted by the solving the proposed theoretical equation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个框架，将大语言模型（LLM）的链式思维推理形式化为线索图上的引导式发现过程，利用平均场近似推导出一维常微分方程来描述已发现线索比例，并通过实验验证该方程能拟合LLM推理中的统计规律。
AI.motivation: LLM链式思维推理已被广泛应用，但缺乏不简化模型架构、不做物理类比的理论解释。作者希望找到LLM推理中的统计规律和理论诠释，以加深理解并指导模型优化。
AI.method: 将LLM推理建模为线索图上的引导式发现过程；通过平均场近似推导出一维常微分方程，描述已发现线索比例随时间演化的动力学方程；实验中用学生LLM对教师LLM输出的归一化surprisal来识别线索token，并对多条推理链求平均获得统计规律，最后用理论方程拟合实验数据。
AI.result: 实验表明，在相同数据集内，LLM推理中的统计规律是可复现的，且这些统计规律能够用所提出的理论常微分方程进行拟合。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为LLM链式思维推理提供了不依赖模型简化或物理类比的统计力学式理论解释，验证了LLM推理过程中存在可由平均场方程描述的可复现统计规律。

title: When Do Corrective Features Help? An Agent for Corrective Feature Discovery on Black-Box Forecasters
summary: Frozen pretrained forecasters often fail in structured, recurring ways that are costly to repair through fine-tuning. We study corrective feature discovery: mining interpretable features of a frozen forecaster's residual to drive a lightweight post-hoc corrector. Prior automated feature engineering models the data-generating process; corrective features instead model the model-failure process. We present CRAFTER (Corrective Residual Agent with Feature-based Temporal Exploration and Reasoning), which keeps the backbone frozen and mines its residual with two complementary generators: a compositional search over the raw input channels, and a large language model (LLM) that proposes named feature combinations, binary flags, and short executable code. A single validation-grounded gate accepts or rejects every candidate regardless of its origin, and a validation-selected corrector applies the accepted features or leaves the forecast unchanged. This source-agnostic pipeline also allows prior feature-engineering systems to be evaluated under identical conditions, making CRAFTER an instrument for attributing forecast improvements to the feature source alone. Across six public datasets and six frozen backbones, CRAFTER surpasses every dedicated feature-engineering system at every feature budget, roughly doubling the improvement achieved by the corrector alone and reducing the error of the weakest backbones by up to 27%. These gains are robust across different LLM backends and persist even when applied on top of fine-tuned backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRAFTER（修正残差智能体），通过挖掘冻结预训练预测器的残差来发现纠正性特征，驱动轻量级事后修正器。该方法使用两种互补的生成器（组合搜索和LLM）生成特征候选，经验证门控筛选后由修正器应用，在六个公共数据集和六个冻结骨干网络上超越所有专用特征工程系统。
AI.motivation: 冻结的预训练预测器常常以结构化的、可重复的方式失败，通过微调来修复这些失败代价高昂。传统自动特征工程建模的是数据生成过程，而本文提出建模"模型失败过程"——即从冻结预测器的残差中挖掘可解释的纠正性特征，以低成本的事后修正代替昂贵的微调。
AI.method: CRAFTER保持骨干网络冻结，通过两种互补的特征生成器挖掘残差：(1) 对原始输入通道的组合搜索；(2) 利用大型语言模型（LLM）提出命名特征组合、二元标志和短可执行代码。所有候选特征无论来源如何，都经过统一的基于验证集的"门控"（gate）接收或拒绝，再由验证集选择的修正器应用被接受的特征（或保持预测不变）。该流水线与特征来源无关，允许在相同条件下评估先前的特征工程系统，从而将预测改进归因于特征来源本身。
AI.result: 在六个公共数据集和六个冻结骨干网络上，CRAFTER在所有特征预算下超越所有专用特征工程系统，比单独使用修正器所达到的改进提升约一倍，并且将最弱骨干网络的误差最多降低27%。这些增益在不同的LLM后端下保持稳健，即使应用于微调后的骨干网络之上也依然有效。
AI.conclusion: CRAFTER展示了"纠正性特征发现"（建模模型失败过程）比传统"预测性特征工程"（建模数据生成过程）更有效，其源无关的流水线不仅提供了优越的性能，还成为了一个可用于归因分析的工具——能够将预测改进的贡献单独归因于特征来源。

title: The Ignition Index: Measuring Global Workspace Dynamics in Language Models
summary: We introduce the Ignition Index (I), a validated scalar metric that operationalizes Global Workspace Theory's (GWT) all-or-none ignition prediction in transformer language models. The metric fits a four-parameter sigmoid to per-layer linear probe accuracy as a function of input signal strength, extracting steepness parameter beta-hat: high values indicate abrupt, ignition-like transitions; low values indicate graded build-up. Across 11 models spanning five architecture families, shuffled-label controls demonstrate 9.6-fold selectivity for genuine linguistic structure over spurious probe capacity (p < 0.001, Mann-Whitney U-test). We find: (1) Feedforward transformers exceed SSMs by 89% in aggregate beta-hat (p < 1e-13, Cohen's d = 0.52), with Mamba exhibiting near-linear profiles consistent with absent global broadcast. (2) Huginn-3.5B exhibits 2.12-fold higher ignition along its iteration axis than its depth axis, demonstrating that recurrent architectures manifest workspace-like transitions along the recurrence dimension. (3) Pythia-410M shows a PELT-detected phase transition at training step 256 (+67%), preceding induction-head formation. (4) Hypotheses linking ignition to model scale and signal strength were not confirmed, suggesting transformer architectures may saturate available ignition mechanisms. The Ignition Index provides the first validated quantitative bridge between GWT's dynamical predictions and mechanistic interpretability, with 9.6-fold measurement selectivity and architecture-level discriminability not previously characterized in the scaling literature. Code: https://github.com/saman-rahbar/ignition-index

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ignition Index (Γ)指标，通过四参数sigmoid拟合各层线性探针准确率与输入信号强度的关系，提取陡峭度参数β̂来量化变压器语言模型中的"全有或全无"点火（GWT预测）。在11个模型、5种架构家族上验证了9.6倍选择性，发现前馈变压器比SSM高89%的聚合β̂，Mamba表现为近线性轮廓，Huginn沿迭代轴比深度轴高2.12倍点火，Pythia在训练256步出现相变，同时驳斥了点火与规模/信号强度的假设。
AI.motivation: 将全局工作空间理论(GWT)的"全有或全无"点火这一神经科学中的动态预测，首次可验证地桥接到变压器语言模型的机械可解释性上，填补该理论预测与可解释性之间缺乏定量指标的空白。
AI.method: 提出Ignition Index指标：对每层线性探针准确率作为输入信号强度的函数拟合四参数sigmoid，提取陡峭度参数β̂作为点火指数的代理；通过打乱标签的对照组（9.6倍选择性，Mann-Whitney U检验）验证其测量真实性；在11个模型、5种架构家族（前馈变压器、SSM/Mamba、循环架构Huginn、Pythia等）中进行跨模型、跨训练阶段和跨维度的系统性比较，并使用PELT检测训练过程中的相变。
AI.result: (1) 前馈变压器聚合β̂比SSM高89%（p<1e-13, Cohen's d=0.52），Mamba呈现近线性轮廓，缺乏全局广播；(2) Huginn-3.5B沿迭代轴的点火比深度轴高2.12倍；(3) Pythia-410M在训练步256处检测到PELT相变（+67%），先于归纳头形成；(4) 点火与模型规模、信号强度的假设未获证实。指标具备9.6倍测量选择性和架构级区分能力。
AI.conclusion: Ignition Index是首个验证过的、连接GWT动态预测与机械可解释性的定量桥梁，具有高选择性和架构级判别力，揭示了不同架构家族在信息广播机制上的根本差异，同时表明现有变压器架构可能已饱和可用的点火机制，为后续架构设计和训练动态研究提供了新的量化工具。

title: PLoRA: An NDP-Enhanced Pooled-Memory System for Cost-Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving
summary:
Multi-LoRA serving is how one base model becomes thousands of specialized variants, one adapter per user, task, or agent, and the deployments can hold 1000-plus adapters. Serving them is hard because the workload inverts what GPUs provide: terabytes of memory against only tens of TFLOPS, and because every published system stages its adapters from CPU DRAM over PCIe, where each access pays a kernel stop and a host-run copy and capacity ends at the motherboard's DIMM slots. Meanwhile, memory-semantic fabrics such as CXL and NVLink are converging on pooled memory that an accelerator addresses with its own loads and stores, and near-data processing (NDP) can place compute beside the pooled data. How to serve multi-LoRA workloads on such hardware remains unexplored.
  This paper introduces PLoRA, an NDP-enhanced pooled-memory system for cost-efficient multi-LoRA serving. PLoRA keeps adapters and KV cache in the pool and returns only reduced results over the link, through a read-compute interface the GPU drives with its own loads and stores. Above this architecture, a GPU memory management system picks among four LoRA and two attention execution strategies for each adapter and caches the most performance-critical bytes in GPU memory, guided by a link-parameterized cost model. On one H100 serving 1000 adapters, PLoRA attains the lowest decode latency on every model and workload we measure, averaging 6.6x below a real-machine S-LoRA at under 3.4% added device area. The link itself stops mattering: throughput saturates at 32 GB/s on short contexts, a quarter of CXL 3.1, and the verdict survives scale: per-GPU demand falls from 7B to a modeled 1.2T deployment once adapter traffic shards with the tensor parallelism. The design runs unchanged from CXL-class to NVLink-class fabrics, and surplus bandwidth buys pooled capacity rather than speed.

AI.tldr: PLoRA是一种NDP增强的池化内存系统，用于高效的多LoRA服务。它通过在内存池中存放适配器和KV缓存、只通过读-计算接口返回缩减结果，在单一H100上服务1000个适配器时，解码延迟平均比真实机器上的S-LoRA低6.6倍，且设备面积增加值不到3.4%。
AI.motivation: 多LoRA服务面临的核心挑战是工作负载与GPU硬件能力之间的倒挂：1000+适配器需要TB级内存，但GPU仅提供几十TFLOPS计算能力；现有系统都通过PCIe从CPU DRAM分段加载适配器，每次访问都产生内核停顿和主机拷贝，且容量受限于主板DIMM槽。与此同时，CXL和NVLink等内存语义网络正在汇聚到可池化的内存，但如何在多LoRA负载上利用此类硬件尚未被探索。
AI.method: PLoRA将适配器和KV缓存保存在内存池中，通过GPU以自身load/store驱动的读-计算接口仅返回缩减结果。在此架构之上，GPU内存管理系统为每个适配器选择四种LoRA和两种注意力执行策略之一，并通过链路参数化的成本模型将最关键的字节缓存在GPU内存中。设计可从CXL级无缝运行到NVLink级网络。
AI.result: 在单块H100上服务1000个适配器时，PLoRA在所有测试的模型和工作负载上均获得最低解码延迟，平均比真实机器上的S-LoRA低6.6倍，设备面积增加仅3.4%。链路不再成为瓶颈：短上下文场景下吞吐量在32GB/s（CXL 3.1的四分之一）处饱和；当适配器流量随张量并行分片时，每GPU需求从7B降至建模的1.2T部署规模。多余带宽用于购买池化容量而非速度。
AI.conclusion: PLoRA证明了池化内存结合NDP可以有效消除多LoRA服务中的PCIe分段瓶颈和高昂延迟。其统一设计在不同链路类别（CXL至NVLink）间可移植，且剩余带宽被转化为池化容量，为千级适配器规模的高性价比推理服务提供了切实可行的路径。

title: From Local Learning to Global Prediction Through Layered Surprise Cascades
summary: Hierarchical predictive coding proposes a compelling hypothesis of brain computation, suggesting that the cortex builds layered predictions to minimize surprise. Yet most models rely on error-coding neurons or generative modeling of unclear biological plausibility. Here, we examine a biologically plausible framework in which the functional goals of predictive coding emerge from local contrastive learning and simple activity cancellation. Building on recent machine learning advances, we present a recurrent variant of the Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm with an inverted objective that increases activity for negative data. This setup yields predictive representations across layers, capturing hallmark features of cortical computation such as top-down modulation and surprise signaling. Our results suggest that key principles of predictive coding can emerge from simple, local learning rules, offering a new bridge between neuroscience and machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于局部对比学习与简单活动消减的生物学上可信的预测编码框架，通过引入具有反向目标的循环前向-前向（FF）算法，使分层预测表示得以涌现，捕捉了自上而下调制和惊喜信号等皮层计算的核心特征。
AI.motivation: 现有多数预测编码模型依赖于错误编码神经元或具有不明确生物学合理性的生成模型。作者希望探索一种更符合生物实际的框架，使预测编码的功能目标能够从简单的局部学习规则中自然涌现。
AI.method: 基于前向-前向（Forward-Forward）算法提出循环变体，并采用反向目标（inverted objective）以增加负样本数据的活动。该设置使预测性表征在层间产生，结合局部对比学习和活动消减机制实现预测编码的功能目标。
AI.result: 该框架成功捕获了皮层计算的特征性标志，包括自上而下调制和惊喜信号，表明预测编码的关键原则可以从简单、局部的学习规则中涌现。
AI.conclusion: 研究为神经科学与机器学习之间构建了一座新的桥梁，证明预测编码的核心原理无需依赖复杂的生成模型或错误编码神经元，即可通过简单的生物合理的局部学习规则实现。

title: Serverless platform driven CPU loadbalancing
summary: Serverless platforms maintain a global view of function invocations and resource utilization, yet existing systems largely restrict CPU scheduling decisions to the operating system scheduler. This paper presents a serverless platform-driven CPU load balancing framework that enables the control plane to directly influence CPU scheduling through a custom Linux scheduler built on SchedExt(SCX). The proposed scheduler introduces configurable scheduling domains and a shared interface that allows the control plane to assign functions to domains based on their historical inter-arrival times. Within each domain, a single-queue load-balancing strategy combined with a virtual-time prioritization policy improves task placement while reducing interference from busy-polling tasks. Results show that an eight-domain configuration achieves the best trade-off, reducing system energy consumption by approximately 15% while increasing invocation cost by only 5%. Under heavily loaded workloads, the proposed scheduler also reduces request latency by up to 50% compared to the default Linux Completely Fair Scheduler (CFS). These results demonstrate that exposing CPU scheduling decisions to the serverless control plane can improve both energy efficiency and workload performance while preserving scheduling flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个由Serverless平台驱动的CPU负载均衡框架，通过基于SchedExt(SCX)构建的自定义Linux调度器，让控制平面直接影响CPU调度决策。该调度器引入可配置调度域和共享接口，根据函数历史到达间隔分配任务到不同域内，采用单队列负载均衡与虚拟时间优先级策略。八域配置下系统能耗降低约15%，调用成本仅增加5%；高负载下请求延迟相比CFS降低高达50%。
AI.motivation: Serverless平台掌握函数调用和资源利用的全局视图，但现有系统的CPU调度决策仍局限于操作系统调度器，控制平面无法直接影响调度，导致资源分配和能耗优化受限。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于SchedExt(SCX)的自定义Linux调度器，使控制平面能直接干预CPU调度；2) 引入可配置的调度域（scheduling domains），通过共享接口让控制平面根据函数历史到达间隔分配函数到不同域；3) 每个域内采用单队列负载均衡策略结合虚拟时间优先级化策略，改善任务放置并减少繁忙轮询任务带来的干扰。
AI.result: 八域配置达到最优权衡：系统能耗降低约15%，调用成本仅增加5%；在高负载工作负载下，请求延迟相比默认Linux CFS调度器最高降低50%。
AI.conclusion: 将CPU调度决策暴露给Serverless控制平面可以在保持调度灵活性的同时，提升能耗效率和工作负载性能，为Serverless平台的资源调度提供了一种新的设计思路。

title: A Survey of Adversarial Efficiency Degradation for Vision Transformer by Exploiting Input-adaptive Optimization
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) increasingly rely on input-adaptive inference, such as token pruning and early halting, to meet energy and latency budgets. This survey examines a recent class of adversarial efficiency degradation attacks that target these mechanisms to increase computation without necessarily degrading accuracy. We unify and compare two representative attacks, SlowFormer (a universal adversarial patch) and DeSparsify (per-image perturbations), across three popular token-pruning frameworks: A-ViT, ATS, and AdaViT. We standardize reporting using GFLOPs, accuracy loss, and an Attack Success (AS) metric that measures how much of the model's compute savings the attack takes away. Understanding these attacks is crucial for designing countermeasures that not only mitigate risk but also remain lightweight, since deployment often occurs in low-power settings such as mobile or embedded devices. To organize our analysis, we focus on three questions: how input-adaptive optimizations (e.g., token pruning and early halting) create attack surfaces for efficiency degradation; how such attacks operate in practice and which optimizations are most vulnerable; and which defenses exist today and whether they meaningfully restore efficiency under attack.

AI.tldr: 本文调查了一类针对视觉Transformer（ViT）输入自适应推理机制（如token剪枝和提前停止）的新型对抗性效率退化攻击，统一比较了SlowFormer和DeSparsify两种代表性攻击方法在三套流行token剪枝框架上的表现，并讨论了现有防御手段的有效性。
AI.motivation: ViT越来越多地依赖输入自适应推理（token剪枝、提前停止）来满足能效和延迟预算。然而，针对这些机制的对抗性效率退化攻击可以增加计算量而不一定降低精度，这使得模型在移动或嵌入式等低功耗部署场景中的效率保障面临严重威胁。理解这些攻击对于设计轻量级防御措施至关重要。
AI.method: 本文采用调查综述的方法，统一并比较了两种代表性攻击方法——SlowFormer（通用对抗补丁）和DeSparsify（逐图像扰动），在三套流行的token剪枝框架（A-ViT、ATS、AdaViT）上进行评估。标准化了报告指标，包括GFLOPs、精度损失和攻击成功率（AS）指标（衡量攻击夺走模型计算节省的比例），并围绕三个核心问题组织分析：输入自适应优化如何产生攻击面、攻击如何运作及哪些优化最脆弱、现有防御是否有效恢复效率。
AI.result: 文章通过统一比较框架揭示了token剪枝和提前停止机制存在的可利用攻击面，给出了两种攻击方法在不同剪枝框架上的效率损失和攻击成功率数据，并评估了现有防御手段在恢复效率方面的实际效果。
AI.conclusion: 输入自适应推理机制虽然带来了计算效率提升，但也引入了新的安全漏洞。设计能够缓解效率退化攻击的轻量级防御对策是必要的，尤其是在低功耗部署场景（如移动或嵌入式设备）中。

title: EpiBench: Can LLMs Understand Epitopes for Antibody Drug Discovery?
summary: Epitopes determine where antibodies bind antigens and shape downstream therapeutic properties such as functional blockade and escape resistance, making epitope understanding central to antibody drug discovery. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown strong biomedical reasoning ability, it remains unclear whether they can infer epitope information directly from antigen and antibody sequences. Existing epitope resources typically focus on isolated prediction tasks or rely on specialized structural settings, while general protein benchmarks do not evaluate epitope-centered decisions across the antibody development workflow. To address this gap, we introduce EpiBench, a closed-book, sequence-based, and automatically scorable benchmark for evaluating epitope reasoning in LLMs. EpiBench contains 1,609 curated samples grounded in structural antibody--antigen contacts, curated functional B-cell assays, and deep mutational scanning escape measurements. It covers five connected tasks: targetable region discovery, antibody-conditioned epitope identification, epitope binning, functional epitope assessment, and antibody escape assessment, with controlled sampling to reduce shortcut-based evaluation artifacts. We evaluate nine general-purpose LLMs and analyze their behavior through task-specific baselines, antigen length stratification, explicit-reasoning comparison, and failure-mode inspection. The results show that current LLMs capture partial epitope-related signals but remain limited in antibody-specific sequence grounding, long-context residue localization, and biologically grounded reasoning. Therefore, EpiBench provides a diagnostic testbed for measuring and improving sequence-aware biomedical LLMs toward reliable LLM-assisted antibody discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EpiBench，一个基于序列、封闭书、可自动评分的基准，用于评估大语言模型在抗体表位推理方面的能力。该基准包含1,609个精选样本，覆盖五个相互关联的任务，实验表明当前LLM虽能捕获部分表位信号，但在抗体特异性序列接地、长上下文残基定位和生物学接地推理方面仍存在局限。
AI.motivation: 表位决定抗体与抗原的结合位置并影响治疗特性（如功能阻断和逃逸抗性），是抗体药物发现的核心。虽然LLM展现出强大的生物医学推理能力，但现有表位资源多聚焦于孤立的预测任务或依赖专门的结构设定，通用蛋白质基准也未覆盖抗体开发工作流中表位中心的决策。因此需要一个新的基准来系统地评估LLM在表位推理方面的能力。
AI.method: EpiBench包含1,609个精选样本，其数据基于三类实验来源：结构抗体-抗原接触、功能B细胞实验、深度突变扫描逃逸测量。基准覆盖五个相互关联的任务：可靶向区域发现、抗体条件表位识别、表位分箱、功能表位评估和抗体逃逸评估。通过受控采样减少捷径评估偏差。作者评估了九个通用LLM，并通过任务特定基线、抗原长度分层、显式推理对比和失败模式检查分析其行为。
AI.result: 实验表明当前LLM能捕获部分表位相关信号，但在抗体特异性序列接地、长上下文残基定位和生物学接地推理方面仍然有限。九个通用LLM在EpiBench的任务上表现不理想，反映出它们表位推理能力的局限性。
AI.conclusion: EpiBench为测量和改进序列感知的生物医学LLM提供了一个诊断测试平台，旨在推动可靠、LLM辅助的抗体发现。该基准填补了现有表位资源与通用蛋白质基准之间的空白，为评估从序列到功能决策的完整表位推理链路提供了标准化评测手段。

title: Failing Gracefully: Mitigating Impact of Inevitable Robot Failures
comment: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)
summary: Service robots operate in household environments shared with humans, pets, and everyday objects, where they are highly susceptible to failures such as software crashes, hardware degradation, or unpredictable interactions. While roboticists strive to minimize failures, some remain inevitable, making it critical to mitigate their potential consequences for safe and reliable deployment. This paper introduces a novel safety formulation that evaluates both the probability of impactful interactions between robots and surrounding entities during failures, and the severity of their outcomes. By quantifying the impact of failures on different entities, our approach enables robots to make informed planning decisions that balance safety with task efficiency. To support systematic evaluation, we also present FailBench, a MuJoCo-based simulation framework for studying robot-environment interactions under diverse failure modes, including sensing issues and actuator malfunctions. Together, our safety formulation and FailBench provide a foundation for developing safer and more robust motion plans and learned policies in real-world household environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型安全公式，用于评估服务机器人在家庭环境中发生故障时与周围实体的交互概率和后果严重性，并配套推出基于MuJoCo的FailBench仿真框架，以支持在多种故障模式下系统性地研究机器人-环境交互，从而实现安全与任务效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人在家庭环境中与人类、宠物和日常物体共享空间，极易遭受软件崩溃、硬件退化或不可预测交互等故障。虽然机器人学家努力最小化故障，但某些故障不可避免，因此必须缓解其潜在后果，以确保安全可靠的部署。
AI.method: 提出一种新型安全公式，同时评估故障期间机器人与周围实体之间具有影响力的交互概率及其结果的严重性。通过量化故障对不同实体的影响，使机器人能够做出在安全性与任务效率之间取得平衡的规划决策。此外，提出FailBench——一个基于MuJoCo的仿真框架，用于在多种故障模式（包括感知问题和执行器故障）下研究机器人-环境交互。
AI.result: 该安全公式使机器人能够在故障情况下做出知情规划决策，在安全与任务效率之间取得平衡；FailBench提供了系统化评估不同故障模式下机器人-环境交互的仿真基础设施。
AI.conclusion: 安全公式与FailBench共同为在真实家庭环境中开发更安全、更稳健的运动规划和学策略奠定了基础。

title: StyleComposer: Training-Free Multi-Reference Style Composition
summary: The style of a painting is not monolithic: color, texture, and structure may come from different sources. Existing reference-guided methods transfer them as one style signal, leaving each attribute's source and strength outside the user's control. We ask where in a diffusion model one attribute can change while the others hold, and find that no single representation isolates all three. The proposed StyleComposer therefore routes each style attribute through the representation where it separates best and coordinates the routes over denoising time. Without training or inversion, it satisfies three references and the prompt jointly more closely than prior methods, and exposes one strength slider per attribute. Project page: https://lexxsh.github.io/StyleComposer

AI.tldr: 本文提出StyleComposer，一种无需训练或反转的参考引导图像生成方法。它发现扩散模型中没有任何单一表示能同时隔离色彩、纹理、结构三种风格属性，因此针对每种属性选择最适合分离其信息的表示层进行路由，并在去噪时间上协调各路由。该方法支持三张参考图+文本提示的联合控制，并为每种属性提供独立的强度滑块。
AI.motivation: 现有参考引导方法将绘画风格视为单一整体信号进行迁移，用户无法控制色彩、纹理、结构各自来源的参考图，也无法独立调节各属性的强度。作者希望实现细粒度的风格属性分离控制。
AI.method: 1) 系统性探索扩散模型中各表示层（如自注意力、交叉注意力、特征空间等）对不同风格属性的分离能力，发现没有任何单一表示能同时隔离三种属性。2) 基于此发现，为色彩、纹理、结构各自选择分离效果最好的表示层进行路由。3) 在去噪时间轴上协调多条路由，使属性在正确的生成阶段被注入。整个方法无需训练，也无需图像反演。
AI.result: 在同时满足三张参考风格图与文本提示的联合条件方面，StyleComposer比现有方法更接近期望，并且每种属性都配有独立的强度调节滑块，提供了更强的用户控制力。
AI.conclusion: 风格不是单一的，应当按属性拆解并映射到扩散模型中各自最合适的表示层，通过时间协调实现多参考多属性的可控风格迁移，且无需额外训练。

title: Universal Pathologies, Conditional Consequences: A Triple-Robustness Analysis of RAG for Multi-Hop Traceability
summary: GraphRAG underperforms vector RAG on citation precision in many reports, but where and why have remained corpus-bound. We present a triple-robustness analysis that holds the retrieval architecture fixed and varies three orthogonal axes embedder (local e5-small -> Azure text-embedding-3-small), corpus (DO-178C typed-edge requirements -> Wikipedia paragraph chains via MuSiQue), and judge (paired GPT-5.4 x GPT-4.1) across 4,440 main-matrix runs, 600 cross-corpus runs, and 1,200 paired faithfulness judgments. (C2a) Over-citation is architecturally universal: GraphRAG emits 11-15 IDs per answer at citation precision 0.12-0.23 and retrieval recall 0.68-0.87 across all three settings. (C2b) Its faithfulness consequence is corpus-conditional: in typed-edge DO-178C, GraphRAG faithfulness collapses 74%->40% across hops; on Wikipedia chains the same pipeline rises 42%->58% because over-cited paragraphs remain topically supporting. (C1) Stratum-conditional winners are corpus-conditional but embedder-robust: vanilla wins 2-hop on DO-178C, GraphRAG wins 2-hop on MuSiQue, identical under either embedder. (C3) Single-judge LLM faithfulness is fragile to retrieval state: same-judge self-kappa across embedders is 0.137 for GPT-5.4 (verdict change on 41% of items). A learned router on dense embeddings alone reaches macro-F1 0.86 on hop classification (C4). We argue triple-robustness is the minimum bar for trustworthy RAG architecture claims.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三重鲁棒性分析（嵌入器×语料×评判器三个正交轴），在4440次主矩阵运行、600次跨语料运行和1200次配对忠实度评判中系统比较了GraphRAG与向量RAG。发现过度引用是GraphRAG的架构性普遍缺陷（引用精度仅0.12-0.23），但其对忠实度的影响因语料而异：在类型边DO-178C上忠实度崩塌（74%->40%），在维基百科链上反而上升（42%->58%）。胜出者依语料分层但不受嵌入器影响；单一评判器LLM的忠实度评判在跨嵌入器下极不稳定（kappa=0.137）。
AI.motivation: 现有文献中GraphRAG相对向量RAG在引用精度上表现不佳的报告层出不穷，但结论因语料而异且缺乏可泛化性。研究者旨在通过跨越嵌入器、语料和评判器三个正交维度的系统性鲁棒性分析，揭示GraphRAG性能差异的根本原因，并提出可信RAG架构结论的最低评估标准。
AI.method: 采用三重鲁棒性分析框架：固定检索架构不变，变化三个正交轴（①嵌入器：e5-small→Azure text-embedding-3-small；②语料：DO-178C类型边需求→MuSiQue维基百科段落链；③评判器：配对GPT-5.4×GPT-4.1）。总计4440次主矩阵运行、600次跨语料运行和1200次配对忠实度评判，并训练基于稠密嵌入的router进行跳数分类。
AI.result: (C2a)过度引用是GraphRAG的架构性普遍现象：跨所有设定均输出11-15个ID/答案，引用精度仅0.12-0.23，检索召回0.68-0.87。(C2b)忠实度后果因语料而异：DO-178C上忠实度74%->40%崩塌，维基百科上42%->58%上升。(C1)胜出者因语料分层但对嵌入器鲁棒：DO-178C上vanilla赢2跳，MuSiQue上GraphRAG赢2跳。(C3)单一评判器LLM的忠实度评判脆弱：GPT-5.4跨嵌入器自kappa仅0.137，41%条目翻案。(C4)基于稠密嵌入的router在跳数分类上达宏观F1=0.86。
AI.conclusion: 三重鲁棒性分析是进行可信RAG架构声明的最低门槛。GraphRAG的过度引用是架构固有的，但其忠实度效应高度依赖语料语义结构——过度引用的段落是否仍主题性地支撑答案决定了成败。嵌入器的选择不影响相对结论，但评判器的选择对忠实度评估有决定性影响，研究者应对评判器鲁棒性给予充分关注。

title: PPDL: LLM-Based Flows as Probabilistic Programs
summary: Building reliable applications that leverage large language models (LLMs) remains a significant challenge. While LLMs offer impressive capabilities across diverse tasks, their outputs often lack accuracy and provide no clear measure of confidence. This uncertainty compounds in flows of multiple calls to LLMs and other tools, making it difficult for developers and end-users to trust the results. This paper introduces a probabilistic language for programming LLM-based flows. It enables developers to quantify and propagate uncertainty throughout the application's flow, and experiment with different inference scaling techniques without adding a single line of code beyond the flow's logic. We present an experimental study to demonstrate this capability, and a case study building a theorem proving agent for the Rocq theorem prover.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种概率编程语言，用于编程基于LLM的流程，使开发者能够量化并在整个应用流程中传播不确定性，同时无需修改流程逻辑即可试验不同的推理扩展技术。论文通过实验研究和基于Rocq定理证明器搭建的智能体案例研究展示了该能力。
AI.motivation: 构建基于LLM的可靠应用仍面临重大挑战。LLM输出缺乏准确性和置信度度量，且多个LLM及工具链式调用时的不确定性会累积放大，导致开发者和终端用户难以信任结果。现有方法难以系统地量化和传播这种不确定性。
AI.method: 提出一种概率语言来编程LLM流程，它允许开发者在流程中量化和传播不确定性，并通过概率语义支持在不同的推理扩展（inference scaling）技术间进行实验，且无需修改流程逻辑代码。
AI.result: 通过实验研究展示了该方法的有效性，并构建了一个针对Rocq定理证明器的定理证明智能体案例研究来验证其实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该概率语言为开发者提供了一种量化LLM流程不确定性的系统性方法，从而提升基于LLM应用的可靠性和可信任度，同时保持流程逻辑的简洁与灵活。

title: Woodpecker Distillation: Weak Models Diagnose Reasoning Bugs in Strong Models
summary:
Large language models often fail on reasoning tasks despite possessing the capability to solve them. We argue that many such failures arise from localized reasoning bugs in intermediate steps rather than from global incompetence. We show that these bugs are frequently repairable: inserting a short patch generated by a weak probe model after the same strong-model reasoning prefix can redirect the trajectory toward a correct solution.
  However, this corrective effect is not reliably internalized by directly fine-tuning on weak patches or repaired trajectories, suggesting that the useful signal lies not in the intervention text itself, but in how it reshapes the model's future reasoning distribution. We therefore propose Woodpecker Distillation, a weak-to-strong training framework that learns from contrastive local interventions. Our method contrasts successful and unsuccessful weak-model patches at the same prefix, constructs a corrective teacher distribution from their induced future token predictions, and distills this signal into the strong model.
  Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that Woodpecker Distillation consistently improves strong-model performance and outperforms direct imitation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Woodpecker Distillation框架，利用弱模型生成的对比性局部干预来修复强模型在推理任务中的局部推理错误，并通过蒸馏这一信号提升强模型性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在推理任务上常常失败，尽管具备解决这些任务的能力。作者认为这些失败大多源于中间步骤中的局部推理缺陷，而非整体能力不足，并发现这些缺陷可以通过弱模型生成的短补丁进行修复，但直接微调修复轨迹无法可靠内化这种修正效果。
AI.method: 提出Woodpecker Distillation弱到强训练框架：在相同前缀处对比成功与不成功的弱模型补丁，基于它们引发的未来token预测构建校正性的教师分布，并将此信号蒸馏到强模型中。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，Woodpecker Distillation能够持续提升强模型性能，并优于直接模仿基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 推理修复的关键信号不在于干预文本本身，而在于它如何重塑模型未来的推理分布，通过从对比性局部干预中学习可以有效提升强模型的推理能力。

title: THBKG: A Temporal Biomedical Knowledge Graph for Decision-Aligned Clinical Advancement Prediction
summary: Inadequate target--disease linkage accounts for 40--50\% of Phase~II efficacy failures, so anticipating which programmes will advance would let sponsors back the hypotheses most likely to reach patients. What a programme can be judged on is the evidence that supported its linkage \emph{when it entered the clinic}. No existing biomedical knowledge graph allows that evidence profile to be assembled as of a past date. We present the Temporal Heterogeneous Biomedical Knowledge Graph (THBKG), which describes and predicts therapeutic target--disease links through time: 110,396 entities and 11.1M edges across nineteen relation types, each edge carrying the year its evidence changed, so a pair's profile can be recovered as it stood when its own decision fell due. On this graph we define a decision-aligned benchmark that predicts, for a target--disease pair entering Phase~II, whether it advances to Phase~III on evidence datable before that decision. Graph propagation over the THBKG outranks every direct-evidence reference scored under the same decision-aligned protocol, reaching a relative success of 4.3--4.5 at the top ten pairs per therapeutic area. The gain concentrates on the 72.8\% of pairs with no direct target--disease evidence at their decision point, where a direct-edge model has nothing to read: the encoders still rank five- to sixfold above chance, recovering the signal by propagating over the intervening biology. Adapting a path-based explainer to the decision-time subgraph decomposes each prediction into the evidence landscape behind the hypothesis for explainable prediction. We release the THBKG as a continually updated substrate for studying therapeutic target hypotheses by retrospective validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时间异构生物医学知识图谱（THBKG），按时间戳记录靶点-疾病关联证据的变更，使研究者在任意历史时点重建证据画像；并定义决策对齐基准评估从II期进入III期的预测，图传播方法在无直接证据的72.8%样本上仍能超过随机5-6倍。
AI.motivation: 靶点-疾病关联证据不足是40-50% II期临床疗效失败的原因，但现有生物医学知识图谱无法按历史日期重现启动临床时的证据状态，导致无法客观评估和回溯验证治疗假说的成功概率。
AI.method: 构建THBKG（110,396实体、11.1M边、19种关系类型），每条边携带其证据变更的年份；定义决策对齐基准预测靶点-疾病对从II期进入III期的概率，输入仅限决策时点之前的证据；使用图传播模型进行预测，并引入基于路径的解释器在决策时点子图上进行可解释预测。
AI.result: 图传播方法在决策对齐协议下优于所有直接证据参考模型，在治疗领域前十对样本上相对成功率达4.3-4.5；对72.8%无直接靶点-疾病证据的样本，模型仍超过随机5-6倍，通过中间生物学路径传播恢复信号。
AI.conclusion: THBKG作为持续更新的时间敏感知识图谱，为治疗性靶点假说的回顾性验证提供了基础设施，使药物研发决策可在历史证据画像的基础上做出更可解释、更可靠的判断。

title: Zero-Instruction Sensor Reads: Register-Mapped Peripherals and Hardware PWM on a Five-Stage Soft Processor
summary: We present a case study in application-driven specialization of a five-stage soft processor, evaluated on the inner control loop of a reaction-wheel self-balancing bicycle. Starting from a custom 32-bit RISC core in the MIPS tradition, we specialize the design in two ways. First, two frequently accessed peripheral inputs are mapped directly into architectural register state, written every cycle by hardware and owned exclusively through the register file's write-port structure rather than by arbitration. Second, four periodic PWM channels are offloaded to hardware and driven continuously from four exported registers, removing periodic actuation from software entirely.
