Because peripheral values are addressable as ordinary register operands, all ten sensor reads in the control loop cost no dedicated instruction and no dedicated cycle, folding into arithmetic that executes anyway; the memory-mapped equivalent requires an explicit load per snapshot and costs five extra instructions and cycles. The actuation path likewise removes waveform maintenance from software entirely. We report two configurations, because the extensions and the single-cycle array multiplier they were deployed alongside are not present together in a single archived build: an archived configuration, whose worst-case loop is 91 cycles, and the integrated configuration matching the deployed system, at 43 cycles. Against a 20 ms actuation frame these are margins of roughly 7,300x and 15,000x. The deadline is met by so wide a margin in either case that the specialization was not necessary for real-time compliance; its value lies in instruction count and software simplicity, not in determinism, which an on-chip single-cycle I/O region already provides. The zero-instruction sensor read is independent of that choice: the multiplier cannot affect whether a peripheral read needs an instruction of its own.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个五级软处理器针对自平衡自行车内环控制的应用驱动定制案例。通过将两个高频外设输入直接映射为架构寄存器状态，以及将四个周期PWM通道卸载至硬件，实现了传感器读取零指令零周期、执行机构驱动完全脱离软件，最高将最坏情况控制环从91周期降至43周期，相对20ms执行帧留有约7300倍和15000倍的余量。
AI.motivation: 探索应用驱动的处理器定制设计，将常用的外设访问直接融入架构，消除控制和执行路径中不必要的指令与周期开销，简化软件复杂度。不过作者也明确指出，由于片上单周期I/O区已提供确定性，这种定制并非为了实时合规，核心动机在于减少指令数量并简化软件。
AI.method: 基于MIPS传统风格的定制32位RISC五级软处理器，采用两种专项化手段：(1) 将两个高频访问的外设输入直接映射为架构寄存器状态，由硬件每周期写入，通过寄存器文件写端口的专属所有权而非仲裁机制实现；(2) 将四个周期PWM通道卸载至硬件，由四个导出寄存器连续驱动，周期执行任务完全从软件移除。外设值作为普通寄存器操作数寻址，使控制环中十次传感器读取折叠进本应执行的算术中，无需专用指令和周期。
AI.result: 报告了两种配置：归档配置的最坏情况控制环为91周期，集成配置（集成扩展与单周期阵列乘法器）为43周期。相对20ms执行帧分别有约7300倍和15000倍的余量。等效的内存映射读取方式每个快照需显式加载，多花费5条指令和5个周期。由于两种配置分开归档，扩展与单周期阵列乘法器未同存于单一构建中。
AI.conclusion: 该专项化并非为实时确定性所必需——片上单周期I/O区已能满足实时要求，其价值在于指令数减少和软件简化。零指令传感器读取与该选择无关：乘法器不会影响外设读取是否需要自身指令。定制以极宽的时限余量达成了实时合规，但本质收益是降低指令开销和提升软件简洁性。

title: Transcutaneous Spinal Cord Stimulation Disrupts Conscious Ankle Proprioception and Produces a More Constrained Locomotor Pattern in Unimpaired Adults
summary: Transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation (tSCS) modulates spinal sensorimotor circuits primarily through activation of afferent networks. While prior work has emphasized locomotor performance and spinal excitability, how tSCS affects conscious proprioceptive perception and the extent to which such effects parallel changes in locomotor control remain unclear. We investigated the acute and training-related effects of tSCS on ankle proprioception and gait in unimpaired adults (n = 14), with an independent control group (n = 14) completing identical proprioceptive training without stimulation. Proprioception was quantified using a bilateral robotic assessment of dynamic ankle localization ability (Crisscross), gross motor output using maximum dorsiflexion strength, and gait during normal and tandem treadmill walking using spatiotemporal, trunk-sway, and mediolateral center-of-mass (CoM) excursion measures. Acute tSCS increased ankle proprioceptive error (p < 0.001) while dorsiflexion strength was unchanged (p = 0.30). Gait shifted toward a modestly more constrained locomotor pattern, characterized by reduced step width and ML CoM excursion (p < 0.05). With continued training under stimulation, proprioceptive error decreased and, unlike the control group, the tSCS group showed progressive improvement that persisted after stimulation ended. Sagittal-plane gait measures recovered toward or beyond baseline, whereas mediolateral measures remained constrained, revealing a direction-dependent reorganization of locomotor control. Together, these findings show that tSCS influences multiple aspects of the sensorimotor control loop, disrupting conscious proprioception while reshaping locomotor behavior, and that the nervous system can adapt to altered afferent input through training.

AI.tldr: 经皮脊髓电刺激（tSCS）通过激活传入网络调节脊髓感觉运动回路。研究发现，tSCS急性期会损害踝关节本体感觉（误差增加，p<0.001），同时将步态转向更受约束的模式（步宽和质心侧向偏移减少）；但在持续刺激训练下，本体感觉误差逐渐下降并出现持续改善，且矢状面步态指标恢复/超越基线，而侧向指标仍受约束，揭示了方向依赖性的运动控制重组。
AI.motivation: 既往研究集中于tSCS对运动表现和脊髓兴奋性的影响，但tSCS如何影响意识性本体感觉感知、以及这种影响是否与步态控制变化平行仍不清楚。理解这些方面有助于全面认识tSCS的作用机制和训练适应过程。
AI.method: 14名健康成年人接受tSCS，另设14名独立对照组进行相同的本体感觉训练但不接受刺激。使用双侧机器人动态踝关节定位评估（Crisscross）评估本体感觉，最大跖屈力量衡量粗大运动输出，并在正常及串联跑步机行走中测量步态时空参数、躯干摆动和质心（CoM）侧向偏移。
AI.result: 急性tSCS使踝关节本体感觉误差显著增加（p<0.001），而跖屈力量不变（p=0.30）。步态转向更受约束的模式，步宽和ML CoM偏移减小（p<0.05）。持续刺激训练下本体感觉误差下降，且tSCS组相比对照组表现出进行性改善并在刺激结束后持续。矢状面步态恢复或超过基线，而侧向指标仍保持受限，呈方向依赖性重组。
AI.conclusion: tSCS影响感觉运动控制环路的多个方面，同时破坏意识性本体感觉并重塑步态行为；神经系统能够通过训练适应改变的传入输入，提示tSCS联合训练可能具有治疗潜力。

title: RepoOMP: Repository-Aware Hotspot OpenMP Parallelization via Dependency-Aware Context Reduction
summary: OpenMP parallelization of hotspots in mature repositories remains difficult because loop safety and optimization payoff often depend on non-local evidence. Rule-based tools under-parallelize when legality is not locally provable, while agent-based approaches become unstable when retrieval misses decisive dependencies or includes irrelevant code. We present RepoOMP, a hybrid framework that recovers parallelization-relevant evidence before generation. RepoOMP builds a Multi-granularity Attributes Performance graph (MAP), routes hotspots between deterministic rules and an LLM agent, and constructs a Structured Transformation Context (STC) that exposes dependency facts without flooding the model with unrelated repository text. We evaluate RepoOMP on 951 profiled hotspots from NPB, BOTS, FFmpeg, NCNN, and GROMACS. Under compilation, workload-specific checks, and positive speedup, 372 hotspots are accepted, including 330 real-world repository hotspots. RepoOMP achieves average speedups of $8.23\times$ on NPB and $8.96\times$ on BOTS. For the nine detailed real-world kernels used in matched-backbone and robustness analyses, RepoOMP reaches a cross-backbone mean of $5.25\times$, improves speedup by 18--28\%, and reduces agent-side token cost by 47--68\% relative to the unstructured Claude Code baseline. Across 330 accepted real-world hotspots, median speedup is $2.25\times$. Overall, RepoOMP provides an evidence-guided workflow for hotspot parallelization in repository settings. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/Qlalq/RepoOMP_Simplified.

AI.tldr: RepoOMP是一个混合框架，通过构建多粒度属性性能图(MAP)和结构化变换上下文(STC)来恢复并行化关键证据，在规则工具和LLM代理之间路由hotspot，从而在不淹没模型的情况下实现成熟仓库中热点代码的OpenMP并行化。
AI.motivation: 在成熟代码仓库中，OpenMP并行化hotspot仍然困难，因为循环安全性和优化收益通常依赖于非局部证据。基于规则的工具在合法性无法局部证明时会欠并行化，而基于代理的方法在检索遗漏关键依赖或包含无关代码时会变得不稳定。需要一个能先恢复并行化相关证据再进行生成的混合框架。
AI.method: RepoOMP包含三个核心组件：1) 构建多粒度属性性能图(MAP)来捕获并行化相关证据；2) 在确定性规则和LLM代理之间路由hotspots；3) 构造结构化变换上下文(STC)，暴露依赖事实而不向模型灌入无关仓库文本。
AI.result: 在951个来自NPB、BOTS、FFmpeg、NCNN和GROMACS的profiled hotspots上评估。372个hotspots被接受（含330个真实仓库hotspots）。在NPB上平均加速8.23x，BOTS上8.96x。在9个详细分析的真实世界内核中，跨骨干平均5.25x加速，比Claude Code基线提升18-28%加速，减少47-68%代理端token成本。330个接受的真实世界hotspots中位数加速2.25x。
AI.conclusion: RepoOMP提供了一个证据引导的hotspot并行化工作流，有效解决了规则工具欠并行化和代理方法不稳定的问题，在真实世界仓库场景中实现了显著的加速收益和更低的token开销。

title: CyberBridge: Bridging the Gap Between Cybersecurity Education and Industry
summary:
This full research paper presents CyberBridge, a framework that automatically maps cybersecurity job descrip- tions to professional role profiles. As the cybersecurity landscape evolves rapidly, it is difficult for academic programs to align curricula with the competencies expected in practice.
  CyberBridge addresses this gap by decomposing a given vacancy description into its constituent Knowledge, Skill, and Task (KST) statements, embedding them using a sentence- BERT model, and matching them to the most semantically similar workforce profiles. A key contribution of our approach is its interpretability. Rather than functioning as a black box, CyberBridge enables users to trace recommendations back to the specific competencies driving each match, providing a human- readable justification for the resulting mappings.
  CyberBridge supports three primary use cases; (1) job recom- mendation, providing students with vacancies and closely match- ing professional roles based on their completed curriculum, (2) market analysis, enabling educators and curriculum developers to analyze which roles are currently in demand, and (3) curriculum planning, assessing which course program best prepares students for in-demand cybersecurity roles.
  As such, CyberBridge can be used by educational institutions as a practical tool for career guidance and evidence-based curriculum development in cybersecurity education.

AI.tldr: CyberBridge是一个自动将网络安全职位描述映射到专业角色画像的框架，通过将职位空缺分解为知识、技能和任务（KST）陈述，使用sentence-BERT模型进行语义嵌入和匹配，并提供可解释的推荐理由。它支持职位推荐、市场分析和课程规划三大应用场景，可作为教育机构进行职业指导和循证课程开发的实用工具。
AI.motivation: 网络安全领域快速演变，学术项目难以及时将课程与行业实践中期望的能力对齐，存在课程与职业能力要求之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 将职位描述分解为知识（Knowledge）、技能（Skill）和任务（Task）三类陈述，使用sentence-BERT模型进行嵌入，并与最语义相似的工作力角色画像进行匹配。关键贡献在于可解释性，能够追溯每个匹配背后的具体能力因素，而非黑盒模型。
AI.result: CyberBridge支持三个主要用例：(1)职位推荐，基于学生已完成课程推荐职位和匹配的专业角色；(2)市场分析，帮助教育者和课程开发者分析当前市场需求角色；(3)课程规划，评估哪些课程最能培养学生胜任高需求的网络安全角色。
AI.conclusion: CyberBridge可作为教育机构的实用工具，用于网络安全教育中的职业指导和循证课程开发。

title: Unified Planning-Learning Framework for Robust UUV Navigation Under Partial Observability
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026), Philadelphia, PA, USA
summary: This paper presents an observation-only autonomy framework for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) navigation in dynamic underwater environments that integrates persistent occupancy mapping, global clearance-aware planning, and risk-aware local control. The proposed pipeline constructs occupancy maps solely from onboard sonar and depth image observations, adapts a clearance-constrained global planner (GP) to provide long-horizon structure, and integrates a reinforcement learning (RL) policy to handle short-range tracking and reactive avoidance. To further support decision-making under partial observability, the system learns a compact latent state representation from onboard sensor data, encoding environmental structure, obstacle dynamics, and uncertainty. Behavior tree (BT) distillation with staged supervision is introduced to improve safety and training stability, while an uncertainty-calibrated distillation mechanism reweights teacher guidance using online latent-model uncertainty, emphasizing uncertain regimes during learning, with time-to-collision (TTC) and clearance cues remaining explicit in planning and local policy features. To demonstrate the efficacy of the framework, a reproducible multi-seed evaluation protocol is established in high-fidelity GPU-accelerated simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and performance is benchmarked against BT-only and standard RL baselines. The results obtained demonstrate improved robustness and safety under dynamic conditions, thus providing a general pipeline with a unified hybrid planning learning architecture and a reproducible methodology for robust UUV autonomy under partial observability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向动态水下环境的UUV观测自主导航框架，融合持久占用映射、全局无碰撞规划和风险感知局部控制，通过行为树蒸馏和不确定性校准机制提升安全性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 无人水下航行器（UUV）在动态水下环境中导航面临部分可观测性和动态障碍物的挑战，现有方法难以在长时程规划与短程反应式避障之间取得平衡，且缺乏可复现的评估协议。
AI.method: 该框架包含四个核心组件：(1) 基于声纳和深度图像构建持久占用映射；(2) 约束间隙的全局规划器（GP）提供长时程结构；(3) 强化学习（RL）策略处理短程跟踪和反应式避障；(4) 从传感器数据学习紧凑的潜在状态表示以编码环境结构、障碍动态和不确定性。此外，引入行为树（BT）蒸馏和分阶段监督提高训练稳定性，并通过不确定性校准蒸馏机制（利用在线潜在模型不确定性重加权教师指导）强调学习过程中的不确定区域。时间到碰撞（TTC）和间隙线索在规划和局部策略特征中保持显式。
AI.result: 在高保真GPU加速仿真（NVIDIA Isaac Sim）中建立了可复现的多种子评估协议，与纯BT基线和标准RL基线进行对比，结果表明该框架在动态条件下的鲁棒性和安全性均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个统一的混合规划-学习架构和可复现的评估方法，为部分可观测条件下鲁棒的UUV自主导航提供了通用解决方案。

title: NeuroAdaptTrainer: A Fiji/ImageJ Plugin for YOLO-Based Neuron Segmentation, InteractiveCorrection and Transfer Learning
summary: Neuron counting and segmentation in microscopy images of neuronal cultures is a routine and time-consuming task in neuroscience research, traditionally performed through manual inspection or semi-automatic tools. We present NeuroAdaptTrainer, an open-source Fiji/ImageJ plugin that integrates a YOLO instance-segmentation model directly into the microscopist's workflow. The plugin allows a user to run automatic neuron detection on a single image or a batch of images, manually correct the resulting detections from within Fiji, and use those corrections to adapt the model to new imaging conditions via transfer learning. A built-in external validation module allows the base and adapted models to be compared quantitatively on a held-out annotated set. NeuroAdaptTrainer lowers the barrier for non-specialist users to benefit from deep-learning-based segmentation while keeping expert supervision at the center of the workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍NeuroAdaptTrainer，一个开源Fiji/ImageJ插件，将YOLO实例分割模型集成到显微镜工作流程中，实现自动神经元检测、人工校正和迁移学习自适应，降低非专业用户使用深度学习分割的门槛。
AI.motivation: 神经元培养显微镜图像中的神经元计数和分割是神经科学研究中常规且耗时的任务，传统上依赖人工检查或半自动工具。需要一种将深度学习分割能力无缝集成到显微镜学家现有工作流程中的解决方案，以降低专业使用门槛。
AI.method: 该插件将YOLO实例分割模型直接集成到Fiji/ImageJ工作流程中，支持单张或批量图像自动神经元检测；用户在Fiji内手动校正检测结果，并通过迁移学习利用这些校正来使模型适应新的成像条件；内置外部验证模块允许在保留注释集上定量比较基础模型和自适应模型。
AI.result: NeuroAdaptTrainer成功降低了非专业用户从深度学习分割中获益的障碍，同时保持专家监督在工作流程中的核心地位。
AI.conclusion: 通过将深度学习模型嵌入显微镜学家熟悉的Fiji环境并提供交互式校正与迁移学习机制，该插件实现了一种人机协同的神经元分割方案，兼具自动化效率和专家把关的可靠性。

title: RIG-RoPE: Relation- and Instance-Gated Rotary Positional Encoding with Duration-Aware Temporal Coordinates
summary:
Rotary positional encoding (RoPE) is a core component of modern language models and has been extended to multimodal LLMs through multidimensional variants such as multimodal RoPE (M-RoPE), which split positional channels into temporal, height, and width subspaces. This report identifies two limitations of static multidimensional position assignment in interleaved multimodal contexts. First, height/width rotations may be applied to token pairs whose spatial displacement is not a well-defined geometric object, producing cross-modal and inter-instance spatial interference. Second, temporal coordinates are often treated as equal-step counters, so a text token, an image block, and a video segment can advance the temporal phase by comparable amounts despite different information density.
  We propose RIG-RoPE, a relation- and instance-gated RoPE mechanism with duration-aware temporal coordinates. RIG-RoPE augments each token with a modality indicator, a visual instance identifier, and a scalar information-duration coordinate. It enables H/W rotations only for query-key pairs from the same visual instance; otherwise the unknown spatial displacement is marginalized rather than set to zero. Temporal rotations use interpolated cumulative block durations: text tokens consume unit duration, images use a dimension-aware logarithmic spatial scale, and videos further apply a logarithmic temporal extension over effective frames. We provide a gauge-invariance argument for avoiding ordinary cross-instance spatial rotation, an impossibility result for static IDs under shared H/W subspaces, and a duration-consistency argument against equal-step multimodal time. RIG-RoPE adds no learned parameters and can be implemented inside tiled attention kernels with constant additional metadata per token. This preliminary report establishes the formulation and validation path without claiming empirical superiority.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIG-RoPE，一种基于关系和实例门控的旋转位置编码机制，用于解决交错多模态上下文中静态多维位置分配的缺陷，包括跨模态/跨实例空间干扰和时序坐标信息密度不均问题。该机制无需学习参数，可在tiled注意力内核中实现。
AI.motivation: 现有M-RoPE在多维位置编码中采用静态分配方式，存在两个核心局限：(1) 高度/宽度旋转可能应用于空间位移无法明确定义的token对，导致跨模态和跨实例空间干扰；(2) 时间坐标被当作等步长计数器，忽略了文本token、图像块和视频片段信息密度的巨大差异。
AI.method: RIG-RoPE为每个token增补模态指示符、视觉实例标识符和标量信息时长坐标。其核心设计包括：仅对同一视觉实例内的query-key对启用H/W旋转，否则将未知空间位移边缘化而非设为零；时间旋转采用插值累积块时长——文本token消耗单位时长，图像采用维度感知的对数空间尺度，视频在此基础上对有效帧施加对数时间扩展。同时提供三个理论论证：避免跨实例空间旋转的规范不变性、静态ID在共享H/W子空间下的不可能性结果、以及反对等步长多模态时间的时长一致性论证。
AI.result: RIG-RoPE不引入任何可学习参数，仅需在tiled注意力内核中为每个token增加常量级额外元数据。本文作为初步报告确立了公式化和验证路径，未声称经验性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过理论论证和机制设计，为交错多模态语言模型的位置编码提供了一种更符合几何和时间语义的方案，为后续经验验证奠定了基础。

title: Decoupling Perception from Description: Computation-Grounded Representation Alignment between Multivariate Time Series and Language
comment: 46 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material. Submitted to AAAI 2027. Xinran Feng and Yi Xie contributed equally
summary: Training multimodal models to align time series with language runs into a self-supervision trap. The usual recipe asks an LLM to read a series and write a description, so label quality is capped by the perceptual skill the model is supposed to learn. The data can never teach more than the labeler already knows. A second gap makes this worse: most datasets use a single variable, but the patterns that matter (cross-channel correlation, lead-lag structure, co-occurring anomalies) appear only with several variables, right where the labeling LLM's limits are most exposed. These two problems create a trilemma: existing methods are reliable, realistic, or scalable, but none achieves all three. We resolve this by decoupling perception from description. Deterministic code computes a set of statistics from real, open-source multivariate series; the LLM verbalizes those precomputed facts. Perception, which LLMs do poorly, is handled by computation, while the LLM handles expression. This produces CGTime, our 4B-parameter computation-grounded time-series-language model. CGTime outperforms far larger general-purpose models on multivariate understanding tasks: it attains the best multivariate fact score on our held-out benchmark (0.283 vs. 0.173 for GPT-4o-mini and 0.203 for GPT-5.4-nano), a gap that survives Holm-corrected paired significance tests against every baseline. It also states verifiable numerical facts in generated captions more accurately and covers a broader range of statistical properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CGTime，一个4B参数的计算接地时间序列-语言模型。通过将感知与描述解耦——用确定性代码从真实多变量时间序列中计算统计量，再由LLM将预计算事实语言化——解决了多模态时间序列对齐中的"自监督陷阱"。在多变量理解基准上超越更大规模的通用模型（事实分数0.283 vs GPT-4o-mini 0.173）。
AI.motivation: 现有训练多模态模型对齐时间序列与语言的方法存在两个核心缺陷：(1) 自监督陷阱——让LLM读取序列并生成描述，标签质量受限于模型本身的感知能力，数据无法教会模型超出标注者已知的内容；(2) 大多数数据集仅使用单变量，而真正重要的模式（跨通道相关、领先-滞后结构、共现异常）只出现在多变量场景中，恰好是标注LLM局限性最突出的地方。由此形成"可靠性、真实性、可扩展性"不可兼得的三难困境。
AI.method: 核心思路是将感知与描述解耦：使用确定性代码从真实开源多变量序列中计算一组统计量，由LLM将这些预计算事实转化为自然语言描述。感知（LLM不擅长的部分）由计算完成，LLM专注于表达。基于此构建4B参数的CGTime模型。
AI.result: CGTime在多变量理解任务上超越远大于自身的通用模型：在预留基准上取得最佳多变量事实分数（0.283，对比GPT-4o-mini的0.173和GPT-5.4-nano的0.203），该优势在Holm校正配对显著性检验中对所有基线均成立。生成的标题中可验证数值事实更准确，覆盖的统计属性范围更广。
AI.conclusion: 通过"计算处理感知、LLM负责表达"的解耦范式，可以打破时间序列-语言对齐中的自监督天花板，以小参数模型实现超越大规模通用模型的多变量理解能力，同时保证事实准确性和覆盖广度。

title: From Continuous Predictors to Clinical Thresholds: Early Evidence on Performance Trade-offs of Guideline-Based Categorisation for Ischaemic Stroke Outcome Prediction
summary: Machine learning models achieve strong predictive accuracy for 90-day outcome prediction in acute ischaemic stroke, yet clinical adoption is limited by the misalignment of model explanations with clinicians' reasoning. Motivated by a clinician user study calling for clinical guideline-aligned cut-offs, we ask whether continuous predictors can be replaced by clinically informed categorical encodings without sacrificing performance. On a multi-centre European registry stratified into three treatment cohorts, we compare standard and fully categorised gradient-boosted models, the latter using stroke guideline-aligned, treatment-specific thresholds. The fully categorised models are statistically indistinguishable from their continuous counterparts in two of the treatment cohorts, with a significant drop in predictive accuracy in one cohort. Global feature importance rankings remain consistent, suggesting that discretising continuous predictors into guideline-based categories preserves the core hierarchy of prognostic factors across all treatment groups. Guideline-based categorisation is thus a viable design choice for stroke-outcome models.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在急性缺血性卒中90天结局预测中，是否可以用临床指南对齐的分类特征替代连续预测变量而不损失模型性能。在多中心欧洲注册数据的三个治疗队列中，完全分类的梯度提升模型在两个队列中与连续特征模型的性能统计上无显著差异，且全局特征重要性排序保持一致，表明指南导向的分类化是卒中结局建模的可行设计选择。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型在急性缺血性卒中90天结局预测上表现优异，但临床采用受限，原因是模型解释与临床医生的推理方式不一致。此前临床医生用户研究呼吁采用与临床指南对齐的截断值，促使作者探索是否能用临床信息化的分类编码替代连续预测变量而不牺牲性能。
AI.method: 在多中心欧洲注册数据上，将患者按三种治疗方案分为三个队列。构建两组梯度提升模型进行对比：一组使用标准连续特征，另一组使用完全分类特征，后者采用基于卒中指南对齐且治疗特异性的阈值进行离散化。通过统计检验比较两组模型的预测准确性，并对比全局特征重要性排序。
AI.result: 完全分类模型在三个治疗队列中的两个队列上与连续特征模型统计上不可区分；在剩余的一个队列中预测准确性显著下降。但所有治疗组的全局特征重要性排序保持一致，表明离散化保留了预后因素的核心层级结构。
AI.conclusion: 基于指南的分类化是卒中结局模型的一种可行设计选择，既能保持预测性能（在多数队列中），又能保留特征重要性的核心层级，同时使模型解释更贴合临床医生的推理方式。

title: An Open-Source Power Measurement Platform for System-Level Semiconductor Testing
summary:
Accurate power measurement is not only essential for evaluating the energy efficiency of modern embedded and semiconductor systems, but power draw is an important proxy during stress testing. Industrial semiconductor test equipment, however, is often expensive and difficult to integrate into flexible experimental workflows.
  This paper presents a compact and extensible hardware platform for automated system-level power measurement of embedded devices. The proposed setup integrates a Raspberry Pi controller, a precision current measurement device, and a microcontroller-based Device-under-Test (DUT). The system supports automated firmware deployment, synchronized device execution, and high-resolution current acquisition.
  A lightweight HTTP-based interface allows remote clients to upload firmware binaries and retrieve measurement results. This design enables automated benchmarking and reproducible experiments across multiple firmware variants.
  The platform is implemented using accessible hardware components and open-source software tools, making it suitable for research, prototyping, and educational environments. We describe the architecture of the platform, the automated testing workflow, and potential application scenarios, including firmware energy profiling and regression testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于Raspberry Pi、精密电流测量设备和微控制器DUT的紧凑可扩展硬件平台，用于嵌入式设备系统级功耗的自动化测量，支持固件远程部署、同步执行和高分辨率电流采集，并通过HTTP接口实现自动化基准测试和可复现实验。
AI.motivation: 准确的功率测量对评估现代嵌入式和半导体系统的能效至关重要，且功耗是压力测试中的重要指标；然而工业级半导体测试设备昂贵且难以集成到灵活的实验工作流中。
AI.method: 搭建一个集成Raspberry Pi控制器、精密电流测量器件和微控制器DUT的硬件平台；通过轻量级HTTP接口支持远程固件上传和测量结果获取；平台采用可访问的硬件组件和开源软件工具实现。
AI.result: 实现了支持自动固件部署、同步设备执行和高分辨率电流采集的自动化功耗测量系统，适用于固件能量分析和回归测试等多个应用场景。
AI.conclusion: 该平台以低成本、易集成的方案替代昂贵的工业测试设备，适用于研究、原型开发和教学环境，为嵌入式系统功耗测量提供了一种可复现、自动化且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Complexity and Stability of Neural Activity Across Aging and Neurodegenerative Disease
summary: Objective: EEG signals fluctuate continuously even within a fixed cognitive state, but an important question is whether the brain still reuses similar activity patterns to represent information over time. Methods: To address this, we model EEG as distributions of windowed activity patterns and quantify their temporal stability using Wasserstein distance, while intrinsic dimensionality captures representational complexity. Results: Across multi-task, lifespan, and clinical EEG datasets, we find that neural representations show constrained, condition-specific stability rather than unconstrained drift. Higher intrinsic dimensionality is consistently associated with lower stability, suggesting that richer representational spaces are less reproducible over time. Both measures exhibit reproducible spatial organization, with posterior regions showing higher dimensionality and lower stability than frontal regions. Healthy aging is characterized by increased dimensionality and reduced stability, whereas mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease show a joint collapse of both. Conclusions: These findings provide a distribution-level framework for understanding neural stability across cognition, aging, and disease. Significance: This framework offers a principled approach to quantifying neural representational stability, with potential utility as a sensitive biomarker for tracking cognitive aging and neurodegeneration in clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分布层面（Wasserstein距离和固有维度）的框架来量化EEG神经表征的时间稳定性，发现神经表征呈现受约束的条件特异性稳定而非无约束漂移，且该框架可作为追踪认知老化和神经退行性疾病的敏感生物标志物。
AI.motivation: EEG信号即使在固定的认知状态下也会持续波动，但大脑是否随时间复用相似的活动模式来表征信息仍是一个悬而未决的问题。现有研究缺乏从分布层面系统量化神经表征时间稳定性的方法。
AI.method: 将EEG建模为窗口化活动模式的分布，利用Wasserstein距离量化其时间稳定性，同时通过固有维度评估表征复杂性。在多任务、生命周期和临床EEG数据集上进行验证。
AI.result: 发现神经表征呈现受约束的条件特异性稳定；固有维度越高，稳定性越低；两个指标均呈现可复现的空间组织（后部区域维度高但稳定性低）；健康老化表现为维度增加和稳定性降低，而轻度认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病表现为两者共同塌缩。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解认知、老化及疾病中的神经稳定性提供了分布层面的系统性视角，并有望作为临床中追踪认知老化和神经退行性疾病的敏感生物标志物。

title: Operating Multi-Node Full Fine-Tuning on NVIDIA B300: A Field Report on Telemetry-Based Triage, Negative Results, and Operational Hardening
summary: We report operational experience full-fine-tuning a 32.76B-parameter dense model (Qwen3-32B) on 16 x NVIDIA B300 (two nodes, FSDP / ZeRO-3) -- among the first published field accounts on this accelerator. We claim no new algorithm. The individual mechanisms we use are established practice; our contribution is the integrated field experience and a set of calibrated measurements on new hardware. Concretely we offer four practitioner artifacts. (1) A B300-calibrated power-draw triage table that distinguishes compute / communication / data-starvation / checkpoint-or-deadlock / idle by board wattage (utilization% reads 100% during an NCCL hang). (2) A set of honest negative results that dispel common optimization folklore at this scale: a controlled A/B in which per-step NFS reading matches a pretokenized local cache (~53k tok/s) because the corpus fits in page cache and the job is compute-bound; and a reconstruction of an earlier "throughput collapse" as NFS/CPU contention rather than a storage-medium limit. (3) Calibrated 4/8/16-GPU strong-scaling and GPU-hour numbers on B300 (near-linear, as expected in this regime; we report absolute values as reference data). (4) A worked failure case -- an epoch-end NCCL deadlock from per-rank token-packing imbalance -- together with a 2.7-second pre-run invariant gate and an external watcher that turn multi-hour silent failures into instant rejections. This deadlock and its remedy correspond to PyTorch's documented Join / equalize-to-minimum practice; we position our instantiation against that prior art and report the GPU-hours the failure cost and the gate saves. The transferable takeaway is operational, not algorithmic: for data-dependent data-parallel jobs, watch power rather than utilization, and verify invariants before launch -- a passing smoke test is not evidence of a safe full run.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了在16块NVIDIA B300（两节点，FSDP/ZeRO-3）上全量微调32.76B参数稠密模型（Qwen3-32B）的实操经验，提供了四项工程实践产物：基于板卡功耗的故障排查表、破除常见优化迷思的负面结果、B300上的强扩展基准数据，以及一个NCCL死锁故障案例及其秒级预检方案。
AI.motivation: B300是新型加速器，公开的实操部署经验稀缺；同时大规模数据并行训练中存在大量未经实证的优化"迷思"和隐性故障，作者希望以系统化的现场测量填补这一空白，并为同类任务提供可复用的校准数据。
AI.method: 作者在16×B300、FSDP/ZeRO-3环境下对Qwen3-32B进行全量微调，采用受控A/B对比（NFS读取vs预分词本地缓存）、强扩展性测量（4/8/16 GPU）、功耗分诊表建模，以及针对epoch末尾NCCL死锁设计的2.7秒预运行不变量检查和外部watcher。
AI.result: 强扩展近线性（该规模下符合预期）；NFS每步读取与本地缓存吞吐相当（约53k tok/s），证明任务为计算受限；早期"吞吐崩塌"实为NFS/CPU争用而非存储介质限制；死锁源于每rank令牌打包不均，加入预检门与watcher后可将数小时的静默故障转为即时拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 可迁移的经验是运维层面的而非算法层面的：对数据相关的数据并行任务，应监测板卡功耗而非利用率（利用率在NCCL挂起时会误报100%）；上线前必须验证不变量——通过冒烟测试不等于全量运行安全。

title: The Hidden Life of Public Safety Communications Signals: A Comparative Security Analysis of TETRA, TETRAPOL, and P25
summary:
Public-safety agencies and critical infrastructure operators rely on trunked land-mobile radio (LMR) systems, based on P25, TETRA, and TETRAPOL. These systems are expected to protect not just the content of a communication but the fact of it. Yet LMR standards leave a stark gap between confidentiality of \emph{content} and of \emph{communication}: underneath an encrypted traffic plane, their signaling plane is almost entirely in the clear. We probe the depth and impact of adversarial inference from this exposed signaling.
  Prior security analyses of these systems have concentrated on the content plane---recovering encryption keys or capturing accidental cleartext. We show that comparably sensitive information can be \emph{inferred from passively observed signaling even if the content encryption were perfect}.
  In particular, we show that across the trunked LMR standards, a passive, receive-only software-defined radio (SDR) observer can recover operationally sensitive network topology and geography details, unit presence, mobility across cells and groups, organizational structure, as well as operational security details such as special key domains and key-epoch rotation. This signaling-plane inference reaches far beyond the observer's direct area of reception, turning \emph{local} sniffing into \emph{nationwide} network mapping capabilities that degrade or defeat LMR standards' identity obfuscation through timing and association. In the case of TETRAPOL, we demonstrate how inference and tracking of such signaling metadata and a standards-level confidentiality failure in emergency call handling enable unencrypted voice extraction.
  Finally, we discuss potential countermeasures and mitigations, including specific recommendations for protecting inter-cell, base station and subscriber identities.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了集群陆地移动无线电（LMR）系统中信令层在加密流量层之下几乎完全暴露的安全漏洞。研究者证明，即使内容加密完美，被动SDR观察者仍可从信令中推断出网络拓扑、单元位置、移动性、组织结构及密钥轮换等操作敏感信息，且推断范围远超直接接收区域，可将局部嗅探扩展为全国性网络映射，甚至暴露TETRAPOL系统不经加密的语音内容。
AI.motivation: 公共安全机构和关键基础设施依赖基于P25、TETRA和TETRAPOL的集群LMR系统，这些系统不仅要保护通信内容，还要保护通信本身的事实。然而现有LMR标准在内容加密与通信保密之间存在明显差距：加密流量层之下，信令平面几乎完全公开。先前安全分析集中于内容平面（如恢复加密密钥或捕获意外明文），而本文旨在证明即使内容加密完美，被动观察信令仍可推断出高度敏感信息。
AI.method: 采用被动、仅接收的软件定义无线电（SDR）作为观察工具，对P25、TETRA和TETRAPOL三种集群LMR标准进行信令平面分析。通过信令中的时序和关联信息，恢复网络拓扑与地理信息、单元存在性与移动性、群组组织结构、特殊密钥域和密钥纪元轮换等操作安全细节。评估局部嗅探如何扩展到全国范围的网络映射能力，并针对TETRAPOL展示其紧急呼叫处理中的标准级保密性缺陷如何导致未加密语音提取。
AI.result: 研究表明，跨所有集群LMR标准，被动SDR观察者可恢复操作敏感的网络拓扑和地理细节、单元存在性、跨小区和群组的移动性、组织结构、特殊密钥域和密钥纪元轮换等安全细节。信令平面推断能力远超直接接收区域，将局部嗅探转化为全国性网络映射，削弱或击败LMR标准的身份混淆机制。在TETRAPOL中，信令元数据推断与紧急呼叫处理的标准级保密性失败相结合，可实现未加密语音提取。
AI.conclusion: 集群LMR系统的信令平面暴露构成了与内容加密无关的重大安全漏洞，允许被动攻击者进行广泛的元数据推断。需要采取针对性的对策和缓解措施，包括保护小区间、基站和订户身份的具体建议，以缩小内容保密与通信保密之间的差距。

title: World-to-Wrist: Task-Conditioned Future Wrist Modeling for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often treat main-view and wrist-view observations as parallel visual inputs, overlooking their distinct roles in robot manipulation. Fine-grained manipulation, however, benefits from anticipating how wrist-local interactions may evolve under the global task context. To address this limitation, we present World-to-Wrist VLA (W2-VLA), a VLA model for fine-grained robot manipulation with task-conditioned future wrist modeling. Given current multi-view observations and a task instruction, W2-VLA contextualizes a set of latent modeling tokens as a compact interface between the vision-language model and the wrist predictor. Conditioned on this interface and the observed wrist history, the predictor forecasts future wrist latents, which are transformed into future-aware context for action prediction. In addition, we introduce W2-CoT, a synthesis pipeline that produces structured annotations describing manipulation progress, physical transition cues, and wrist-local evidence. These annotations provide auxiliary supervision that shapes the task-conditioned latent interface. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved fine-grained and contact-sensitive manipulation across both single-arm and bimanual settings, while maintaining action-generation rates above 80 Hz.

AI.tldr: 本文提出W2-VLA，一种面向精细机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作模型。该模型通过任务条件下的未来腕部建模，将主视图与腕部视图分别处理，利用潜变量建模令牌作为视觉语言模型与腕部预测器之间的紧凑接口，预测未来腕部状态并生成未来感知的动作上下文。同时引入W2-CoT合成管道，生成结构化标注作为辅助监督。实验表明该方法在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实任务上均优于基线，且动作生成频率保持80Hz以上。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型将主视图和腕部视图视为并行的视觉输入，忽略了它们在精细操作中的角色差异。实际上，精细操作需要预测腕部局部交互在未来任务上下文中的演化方式，而现有方法缺乏这种前瞻性建模能力。
AI.method: W2-VLA包含三个核心组件：(1) 将一组潜变量建模令牌作为视觉语言模型与腕部预测器之间的紧凑接口；(2) 条件于该接口和观测到的腕部历史，预测器预测未来腕部潜变量，并将其转化为未来感知的动作上下文；(3) W2-CoT合成管道生成描述操作进度、物理转换线索和腕部局部证据的结构化标注，提供辅助监督以塑造任务条件化的潜变量接口。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，W2-VLA在单臂和双臂场景下均提升了精细及接触敏感操作性能，同时保持动作生成率在80Hz以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模腕部视角的未来动态并将其与全局任务上下文关联，W2-VLA有效弥合了粗略的任务理解与精细的腕部局部交互之间的鸿沟，为精细操作提供了新的建模范式。

title: In-Context Forcing: Uncovering Context Effects in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Current few-step autoregressive video diffusion models depend on previous fully denoised clean frames as context for all denoising steps of the current frame. However, these clean frames leak excessive local details, which causes the model to take shortcuts, resulting in compromised temporal semantics and dynamics. Inspired by the perspective of diffusion as masking, we explore the impact of noisy contexts on few-step autoregressive generation. Yet, simply applying contexts with the same noise levels provides insufficient guidance, leading to poor temporal consistency. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce In-Context Forcing, a progressive autoregressive paradigm that utilizes contexts with decreasing noise levels. By applying less masking to distant frames and more masking to adjacent ones, this approach provides adaptive guidance, effectively ensuring both robust temporal consistency and high inter-frame dynamics. Furthermore, by decoupling the strict dependence on previous clean frames, our paradigm enables cross-frame parallel denoising, achieving substantial inference acceleration without sacrificing performance. Extensive experiments on VBench demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both visual fidelity and inference speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出In-Context Forcing，一种渐进式自回归视频生成范式，利用噪声水平递减的上下文（对远处帧施加更少掩码、对相邻帧施加更多掩码）来替代传统依赖完全去噪干净帧的做法，在保证时间一致性和帧间动态的同时支持跨帧并行去噪，从而大幅加速推理。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频扩散模型依赖前帧完全去噪的干净帧作为当前帧所有去噪步骤的上下文，但干净帧泄露过多局部细节，导致模型走捷径，损害时序语义和动态表现。简单地使用相同噪声水平的上下文又提供不足的引导，造成时间一致性差。
AI.method: 受"扩散即掩码"视角启发，提出In-Context Forcing渐进式自回归范式：使用噪声水平递减的上下文，即对较远帧施加更少掩码（较低噪声）、对相邻帧施加更多掩码（较高噪声），提供自适应引导。同时解耦对前帧干净帧的严格依赖，使跨帧并行去噪成为可能。
AI.result: 在VBench基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在视觉保真度和推理速度上均显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入噪声水平递减的上下文，In-Context Forcing在时序一致性和帧间动态之间取得了良好平衡，同时通过跨帧并行去噪实现了显著的推理加速，无需牺牲生成质量。

title: Beyond Sentiment: Comparing Traditional NLP and LLM-Based Multi-Dimensional Analysis for Political News Evaluation
comment: Accepted at PoliticalNLP 2026, the 3rd Workshop on Natural Language Processing for Political Sciences, co-located with LREC 2026. 10 pages, 3 figures
summary: Traditional sentiment analysis (SA) models, while effective for polarity classification, provide limited insight into the rhetorical, ideological, and framing dimensions of political discourse -- dimensions that are central to research in the social sciences and humanities (SSH). In this paper, we present a comparative study of RoBERTa-based sentiment analysis and an LLM-based multi-dimensional framing analysis platform applied to a corpus of 50 political news articles from 17 international media outlets. The results reveal a critical limitation we term neutral collapse: RoBERTa classifies 70% of articles as neutral, effectively flattening substantively rich political content into an analytically uninformative category. We find that 23% of neutral-classified articles exhibit negative probability scores above 0.30. By contrast, the LLM-based approach captures political bias direction and intensity, sensationalism, emotional appeal, and political framing -- yielding multi-dimensional analytical outputs aligned with SSH epistemologies. We argue that for political media analysis, traditional SA alone is insufficient, and that LLM-based multi-dimensional frameworks offer a more epistemologically adequate computational lens for SSH research needs.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了RoBERTa情感分析与基于LLM的多维框架分析在50篇政治新闻文章中的应用，发现RoBERTa将70%文章归类为中性（neutral collapse），而LLM方法能捕捉政治偏见、煽情性、情感诉求和政治框架等多维信息，更契合社会科学与人文学科（SSH）的研究认知论需求。
AI.motivation: 传统情感分析模型虽擅长极性分类，但在政治话语的修辞、意识形态和框架等维度上提供有限洞察，而这些维度正是社会科学与人文学科（SSH）研究的核心关切。作者旨在论证传统SA分析不足以支撑政治媒体研究，需要更适配SSH认识论的计算分析框架。
AI.method: 采用比较研究方法，在来自17家国际媒体的50篇政治新闻文章语料上，同时应用RoBERTa情感分析模型和基于LLM的多维框架分析平台，系统对比两类方法在政治话语分析中的信息产出能力。
AI.result: RoBERTa将70%的文章归类为中性（即"中性坍缩"现象），其中23%的中性分类文章呈现高于0.30的负向概率分数；而LLM方法则成功提取了政治偏见方向与强度、煽情性、情感诉求及政治框架等多维分析输出，与SSH认识论范式相契合。
AI.conclusion: 对于政治媒体分析而言，传统情感分析方法单独使用是不够的；基于LLM的多维分析框架为SSH研究需求提供了更具认识论充分性的计算透镜。

title: Disentangling 3D Modeling from Spatial Reasoning
summary: In this work, we explore an alternative paradigm for spatial reasoning by explicitly disentangling 3D perception from reasoning, rather than jointly acquiring implicit 3D perception and reasoning through large-scale training. Our key observation is that modern perception models excel at estimating continuous 3D geometry, whereas large language models (LLMs) are particularly effective at compositional and symbolic reasoning. Motivated by these complementary strengths, we propose the Disentangled Spatial Reasoner (DiSR), a simple yet effective framework that reconstructs the physical world into structured 3D evidence using off-the-shelf expert perception models and fine-tunes an LLM with LoRA to perform reasoning solely over this explicit geometric evidence. Without large-scale 3D VQA training or complex tool-use policies, DiSR achieves competitive performance on popular spatial reasoning benchmarks. Beyond its strong performance, DiSR offers improved interpretability, modularity, and computational efficiency, demonstrating that explicit separation of perception and reasoning is a scalable and effective alternative paradigm to end-to-end modeling for spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种空间推理的新范式DiSR，通过将3D感知与推理明确解耦——使用现成的专家感知模型将物理世界重建为结构化的3D证据，再利用LoRA微调的LLM仅基于这些显式几何证据进行推理，在不进行大规模3D VQA训练的情况下取得了具有竞争力的性能，同时还提升了可解释性、模块化与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理方法通常通过大规模训练联合获取隐式的3D感知和推理能力，但作者观察到现代感知模型擅长估计连续3D几何，而LLM擅长组合性和符号性推理，两者优势互补，因此提出将3D感知与推理显式解耦的替代范式。
AI.method: DiSR框架包含两个关键组件：1) 利用现成的专家感知模型将物理世界重建为结构化3D证据（如物体的几何属性）；2) 使用LoRA对LLM进行微调，使其仅基于这些显式几何证据进行空间推理。该框架无需大规模3D VQA训练或复杂的工具使用策略。
AI.result: DiSR在主流空间推理基准上取得了具有竞争力的表现，与端到端方法相当。同时，相比端到端建模，DiSR在可解释性、模块化和计算效率方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离感知与推理是一种可扩展且有效的空间智能替代范式，证明端到端建模并非空间推理的唯一最优路径，基于显式3D证据的LLM推理是更具效率和可维护性的方案。

title: SkillTrace: Multi-Trace Provenance Auditing for LLM-Agent Skill Reuse
summary: LLM-agent ecosystems are rapidly growing around reusable skills: mixed-modality packages of metadata, natural-language instructions, code, tools, references, and operational workflows. As skills become marketplace artifacts, auditing their reuse is no longer the same problem as ordinary code clone detection. Existing detectors target single-modality source code or whole-package similarity, yet skill reuse evidence is distributed across authored text, implementation fragments, and operational structure. As a result, they can miss reuse that preserves only one part of a skill. We present SKILLTRACE, a multi-trace provenance auditing framework for LLM-agent skill reuse. SKILLTRACE extracts three provenance traces: Expression, Implementation, and Operational. It represents the Operational Trace as a Skill Operational Graph (SOG) that captures activation, procedure, and resource-flow structure. An LLM assists only the Operational-trace extraction, once at ingestion; at audit time SKILLTRACE compares cached traces deterministically, calibrates each trace against same-function strict negatives, and reports which trace supports a reuse decision. On SKILLTRACE-BENCH, with 820 transformed reuse positives over 100 marketplace anchors and 751 negative controls, SKILLTRACE achieves AUROC 0.938 and F1 0.898. A 36,446-skill wild audit further shows that trace-attributed evidence surfaces actionable reuse review queues beyond repository-level baselines.

AI.tldr: SKILLTRACE是一个面向LLM-agent技能复用的多痕迹溯源审计框架，通过提取Expression、Implementation和Operational三种溯源痕迹，在审计时确定性比较缓存痕迹，在SKILLTRACE-BENCH基准上达到AUROC 0.938和F1 0.898。
AI.motivation: LLM-agent生态系统围绕可复用技能快速增长，技能作为市场制品后，其复用审计与传统代码克隆检测不再等同。现有检测器针对单模态源代码或整体包相似性，无法捕捉技能复用证据分散在文本、实现片段和操作结构中的情况，可能漏掉仅保留技能某一部分的复用。
AI.method: SKILLTRACE提取三种溯源痕迹：Expression（表达）、Implementation（实现）和Operational（操作）。操作痕迹被表示为技能操作图（SOG），捕获激活、流程和资源流结构。LLM仅在摄取时辅助操作痕迹提取一次，审计时通过确定性比较缓存痕迹进行判定，并使用同功能严格负样本校准每种痕迹，最终报告哪些痕迹支持复用决策。
AI.result: 在SKILLTRACE-BENCH基准上（820个变换复用正样本、100个市场锚点、751个负控制），SKILLTRACE达到AUROC 0.938和F1 0.898。在36,446个技能的野外审计中，痕迹归因证据生成了可操作的复用审查队列，优于仓库级基线。
AI.conclusion: 多痕迹溯源比单模态或整体包相似性方法更能捕捉分散的技能复用证据，痕迹级别的归因能够提供可操作的审计结果，支持更精细的技能复用审查流程。

title: Automated Synthesis of Heterogeneous, Hierarchical, Scoped Coherence Protocols
summary:
Processor design is converging on a new model of cache-coherent shared memory characterized by heterogeneity, hierarchy, and scopes. Protocols like CXL or AMBA CHI are used as global protocols to combine multiple clusters, each with its own cluster-level coherence protocols. Manually designing shims to interface between these cluster and global protocols is subtle and error-prone. Automatic synthesis, on the other hand, makes simplifying assumptions like the single-writer multiple-reader (SWMR) invariant, that sacrifice performance for simplicity and guaranteed correctness.
  We present a shim API \textemdash a generic abstraction that enables us to classify protocol transactions by their semantic coherence guarantees. Our automated synthesis engine, ShimGen, uses this shim API to automatically compose protocols with both SWMR and relaxed accesses, taking advantage of modern architectural optimizations like scoped memory accesses and lazy invalidation. We demonstrate ShimGen's efficacy on two case studies. First, we compare its output to a manually-designed hierarchical protocol for the AMD APU released in gem5. ShimGen's output is similar to the existing protocol. However, we identify one scenario where the manually-designed protocol fails to uphold compound consistency, while ShimGen's does. Second, we compare the performance of a hierarchical protocol with a global protocol that exploits non-SWMR accesses to a hierarchical protocol with a strictly SWMR global protocol. The result shows the performance benefits of accommodating global protocols with non-SWMR behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ShimGen自动化合成引擎，通过一个通用的shim API对协议事务按其语义一致性保证进行分类，从而自动组合具有SWMR和宽松访问的缓存一致性协议，支持作用域内存访问和惰性失效等现代架构优化。在两个案例研究中验证了其有效性：与AMD APU手工设计的层级协议相比，ShimGen能发现并修复手工设计中的一致性缺陷；同时证明了支持非SWMR的全局协议能带来显著的性能收益。
AI.motivation: 随着处理器设计走向异构、层级和基于作用域（scopes）的缓存一致性共享内存模型，全局协议（如CXL、AMBA CHI）与各集群内部一致性协议之间的shim手工设计极为微妙且易出错。现有的自动合成方法因假设单写者多读者（SWMR）不变式而牺牲性能来换取简化与正确性保证，无法利用现代架构优化。因此需要一种既能保证正确性、又能利用非SWMR访问优势的自动化合成方法。
AI.method: 1）提出一个shim API——一种通用抽象，用于按语义一致性保证对协议事务进行分类。2）基于该shim API构建自动化合成引擎ShimGen，能自动组合同时包含SWMR事务和宽松（relaxed）访问的协议。3）引擎能够利用现代架构优化，如作用域内存访问（scoped memory accesses）和惰性失效（lazy invalidation）。4）通过两个案例研究进行验证：与gem5中AMD APU手工设计的层级协议对比，以及对比支持非SWMR全局协议与严格SWMR全局协议的性能。
AI.result: 在第一个案例中，ShimGen合成的输出与AMD APU手工设计的层级协议类似，但发现了一处手工设计协议违反复合一致性（compound consistency）的场景，而ShimGen的输出能满足该约束。在第二个案例中，允许非SWMR行为的全局协议相比严格SWMR的全局协议在层级协议中展示了明确的性能优势。
AI.conclusion: ShimGen证明了通过语义分类的shim API，可以在不牺牲正确性的前提下自动化合成层级缓存一致性协议，同时利用SWMR和宽松访问的优势。该工作不仅发现了手工设计协议中隐藏的一致性缺陷，也量化了非SWMR全局协议在层级系统中的性能价值，为未来异构多集群缓存一致性系统设计提供了自动化工具和设计方向。

title: Convergent Evolution in Algorithmic Space
summary: In evolutionary biology, unrelated organisms can independently evolve similar structures when exposed to similar functional demands. Here we ask whether an analogous form of convergent evolution occurs during neural network training: do networks with different random initializations develop similar internal weight structures when trained on the same task? This question is technically nontrivial because hidden neurons can be arbitrarily permuted without changing the represented function, making direct matrix comparisons misleading. We introduce a matching-based framework for comparing multilayer perceptrons in structural weight space. Hidden neurons are first coarsely aligned using permutation-invariant features and then refined by iterative Hungarian matching. After alignment, networks are compared with structural distance metrics designed to emphasize task-relevant weight patterns. Applying this approach to ensembles of small MLPs trained on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and KMNIST, we find that networks trained on the same task remain closer to one another than to networks trained on different tasks. Thus, task-specific training appears to guide initially random networks toward distinct regions, or attractors, in structural network space. The earliest phase of training reveals an additional and unexpected phenomenon. Classification accuracy rises rapidly before the matched structural distances show strong task-specific separation, and before the global weight distribution visibly changes. Nevertheless, individual weight entries already begin to drift in a coordinated manner. This suggests that early learning may first operate through subtle, distributed adjustments that strongly affect function while leaving coarse network morphology almost unchanged. We treat this early morphogenesis as a first glimpse of a richer dynamical process that will be investigated in future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于匹配的框架，用于在结构权重空间中比较多层感知机，证明了不同随机初始化的网络在相同任务上训练后会趋同于结构网络空间中的特定吸引子，并发现了训练早期阶段中功能先于形态改变的"早期形态发生"现象。
AI.motivation: 进化生物学中，不相关的生物体在相似功能需求下会独立演化出相似结构。作者想知道神经网络训练中是否存在类似的趋同进化：不同随机初始化的网络在相同任务上训练后，是否会形成相似的内部权重结构？由于隐藏神经元可以任意排列而不改变所表示的函数，直接比较矩阵具有误导性，因此需要新的比较框架。
AI.method: 提出基于匹配的MLP结构比较框架：首先使用置换不变特征对隐藏神经元进行粗略对齐，然后通过迭代匈牙利匹配进行精细对齐。对齐后使用专为强调任务相关权重模式而设计的结构距离度量来比较网络。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和KMNIST上训练的小型MLP集成实验中，相同任务上训练的网络彼此之间的距离显著小于不同任务上训练的网络。训练的最早期阶段出现意外发现：分类准确率快速上升，但匹配后的结构距离尚未显示强任务特异性分离，全局权重分布无显著变化，然而单个权重条目已开始协调漂移。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定训练引导随机初始化的网络朝向结构网络空间中不同的吸引子区域；训练早期阶段的功能变化先于形态变化，早期学习可能通过细微的分布式调整运作，在保持粗略网络形态几乎不变的同时强影响功能。这种"早期形态发生"被视为更丰富动力学过程的初步发现，有待未来研究。

title: TensorCast: The Missing Tensor Management Layer in Large Language Model Infrastructure
summary: Modern LLM infrastructure increasingly manages tensors not only as computation data, but also as persistent states shared across distributed components. Existing systems optimize individual tensor management tasks, such as model weight loading, KV cache management, and checkpoint synchronization, by deeply integrating task-specific mechanisms with execution engines, networks, or storage backends. However, this specialization creates isolated silos that hinder the reuse and composition of tensor management strategies across evolving LLM workloads. In this paper, we identify tensor lifecycle management as a missing abstraction layer in LLM infrastructure and propose Tensor-as-a-Service (TaaS), which decouples tensor state management from computation logic. We design and build TensorCast, a distributed tensor management layer that provides first-class tensor abstractions, programmable lifecycle primitives, and a runtime that separates tensor management policies from execution mechanisms. This enables developers to write tensor management programs using TensorCast APIs while transparently leveraging distributed execution and data movement. We integrate TensorCast with vLLM and SGLang and evaluate it across diverse tensor lifecycle workloads, including model weight materialization, weight synchronization, KV cache management, and programmable request routing. Our results show that TensorCast achieves competitive performance with specialized tensor management systems while enabling new cross-component optimization policies. A programmable policy implemented with TensorCast improves median TTFT by up to 93.2% under highly concurrent multi-turn agent workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tensor-as-a-Service (TaaS)抽象层及其实践TensorCast，将张量状态管理与计算逻辑解耦，为LLM基础设施提供统一的张量生命周期管理。在vLLM和SGLang上的实验表明，TensorCast性能与专用系统相当，并通过可编程策略将高并发多轮Agent工作负载的中位TTFT提升最多93.2%。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM基础设施中张量不仅作为计算数据，还作为跨分布式组件共享的持久状态。现有系统通过深度集成任务专用机制来优化单个张量管理任务（如模型权重加载、KV缓存管理、检查点同步），但这种专门化导致孤岛效应，阻碍了张量管理策略在演进中的LLM工作负载上的复用与组合。作者识别出张量生命周期管理是LLM基础设施中缺失的抽象层。
AI.method: 论文提出TensorCast，一个分布式张量管理层，提供一等张量抽象、可编程生命周期原语，以及将张量管理策略与执行机制分离的运行时。开发者使用TensorCast API编写张量管理程序，同时透明地利用分布式执行和数据移动。该方法通过解耦张量生命周期管理与计算逻辑，实现了跨组件的优化策略组合。
AI.result: 在vLLM和SGLang上集成TensorCast，覆盖模型权重物化、权重同步、KV缓存管理和可编程请求路由等工作负载。结果表明TensorCast与专用张量管理系统的性能相当，同时支持新的跨组件优化策略。实现的可编程策略在高并发多轮Agent工作负载下将中位TTFT提升最多93.2%。
AI.conclusion: 张量生命周期管理是LLM基础设施中缺失的关键抽象层，TensorCast通过解耦策略与机制，在保持与专用系统相当性能的同时，实现了张量管理策略的复用与跨组件组合优化，显著提升特定工作负载的性能。

title: eMicro: Real-Time Multi-Hop Access Control for Microservices with eBPF
comment: Accepted at the 33rd ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS) 2026
summary: Modern cloud applications often comprise thousands of microservices whose interactions form complex request paths. Traditional inter-service access control restricts individual service-to-service requests, but fails to prevent multi-hop attacks, where each hop appears legitimate yet the overall path violates security intent. This gap leaves systems exposed to unauthorized access and data exfiltration. In this paper, we present eMicro, a path-aware defense system for microservices that prevents such attacks while remaining efficient and deployable. eMicro enforces real-time multi-hop access control through three key techniques: (1) history-based access control extended to capture service invocation sequences; (2) security policies encoded as efficient deterministic finite automaton (DFA), supporting constant-time lookups and compact label propagation; (3) eBPF-based in-kernel request tracing for transparent, low-overhead enforcement without code changes. Evaluations on DeathStarBench and production cloud traces from Uber, Alibaba, and ByteDance, covering 12 million request workflows and thousands of services, demonstrate the scalability of eMicro. eMicro performs policy checks in 1 microsecond, stores 50 million policies in only 100 MB, and reduces propagation overhead by 90% with negligible runtime impact. These results show that eMicro delivers scalable and efficient protection against multi-hop attacks, making it practical for deployment in large-scale microservice environments.

AI.tldr: eMicro是一个面向微服务架构的路径感知防御系统，通过基于历史记录访问控制、确定性有限自动机（DFA）编码安全策略以及eBPF内核级请求追踪，实现实时多跳访问控制，在DeathStarBench及Uber、Alibaba、ByteDance的生产轨迹上验证了其高效性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现代云应用由数千个微服务组成，服务间交互形成复杂请求路径。传统服务间访问控制仅限制单个请求，无法防御多跳攻击——每一跳看似合法但整体路径违反安全意图，导致未经授权的访问和数据泄露风险。
AI.method: eMicro通过三项关键技术实现实时多跳访问控制：(1) 将基于历史的访问控制扩展至捕获服务调用序列；(2) 将安全策略编码为高效确定性有限自动机（DFA），支持常数时间查找和紧凑的标签传播；(3) 使用eBPF实现内核内请求追踪，实现透明、低开销的强制执行且无需代码修改。
AI.result: 在DeathStarBench和来自Uber、Alibaba、ByteDance的生产云轨迹上评估，覆盖1200万请求工作流和数千个服务。策略检查耗时1微秒，5000万条策略仅占用100MB存储，传播开销降低90%，运行时影响可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: eMicro提供了可扩展且高效的多跳攻击防护方案，能够实际部署于大规模微服务环境中。

title: Sliding Sensors: Configurable Confidence in State Estimation for Continuum Robots
comment: Accepted as an extended abstract at 2026 IEEE 9th International Conference on Soft Robotics (RoboSoft). * Equal contribution
summary: Continuum robots often operate in uncertain environments, where accurate state estimation is essential for safe interactions. Estimate uncertainty is inherently spatially non-uniform: confidence varies depending on where measurements are available. Global estimation accuracy is not always the top priority, but rather achieving sufficient confidence at task-relevant locations along the robot. This extended abstract introduces mechanically reconfigurable sensing enabling uncertainty-shaping in state estimation for continuum robots. We present a concept hardware design demonstrating the feasibility of longitudinal translation of a sensor within a continuum robot. We demonstrate that state estimation confidence can be reconfigured by varying the sensor location, and show a reduction of full-body shape estimation errors when sliding the sensor back and forth over time, compared to a single fixed tip sensor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种机械可重构传感方案，通过传感器在连续体机器人内部的纵向平移来主动塑造状态估计的不确定性分布，从而在任务相关位置实现足够的估计置信度，而非单纯追求全局精度。
AI.motivation: 连续体机器人在不确定环境中运行时，状态估计的准确性至关重要，但估计不确定性在空间上天然不均匀——不同位置的置信度取决于该处是否有测量覆盖。全局估计精度并非总是首要目标，更重要的是在任务相关位置获得足够置信度，因此需要一种能主动塑造不确定性空间分布的方法。
AI.method: 提出机械可重构传感的概念，设计了一个可在连续体机器人内部沿纵向平移传感器的硬件概念方案。通过随时间滑动传感器位置（来回扫描），动态改变测量覆盖区域，从而重构状态估计的不确定性分布。
AI.result: 证明了改变传感器位置可以重构状态估计置信度，并且与单一固定尖端传感器相比，来回滑动传感器能够降低全身形状估计误差。
AI.conclusion: 机械可重构传感为实现连续体机器人在任务相关位置的目标置信度提供了一条可行途径，证明了通过动态调整传感器位置来主动塑造估计不确定性的有效性。

title: Grad-CAM for Vision Transformers: A Systematic Taxonomy and Audit of Methodological Ambiguity in Explainable AI
summary: Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is widely used to visualize model decisions, but it was originally formulated for convolutional neural networks, where spatial feature maps and channel dimensions have clear architectural meanings. Vision Transformers (ViTs) do not provide the same structure, instead representing images through tokens, attention, residual streams, and multimodal interactions. This paper presents a systematic taxonomy and literature audit of how Grad-CAM and related methods are adapted, justified, and reported for ViT-based architectures. From an initial search of more than 550 papers, we identify 175 papers that apply Grad-CAM or Grad-CAM-adjacent methods to ViTs. We find that most papers do not provide a full mathematical or implementation-level account of how Grad-CAM is adapted to transformer representations. To characterize this gap, we introduce a descriptive taxonomy of ViT Grad-CAM adaptations that makes explicit the feature locations, gradient targets, spatial reconstruction steps, and aggregation choices that are often left implicit. This taxonomy is not intended to prescribe a single correct adaptation, but to clarify the range of methodological choices being made. The study shows that Grad-CAM on ViTs is often treated as a trivial extension of CNN-based Grad-CAM, despite requiring nontrivial choices that affect rigor, reproducibility, and interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文对Grad-CAM及其相关方法在Vision Transformer (ViT)架构中的适配进行了系统性综述和文献审计。从550余篇论文中筛选出175篇应用Grad-CAM到ViT的论文，发现大多数论文缺乏对适配方法完整数学或实现层面的描述。作者提出了一套描述性分类体系（taxonomy），明确阐述了特征位置、梯度目标、空间重建步骤和聚合选择等常被隐式处理的维度，并指出Grad-CAM在ViT上的应用常被视为CNN版本的无缝扩展，尽管实际上涉及一系列影响严谨性、可复现性和解释性的非平凡选择。
AI.motivation: Grad-CAM最初为CNN设计，其空间特征图和通道维度的架构含义清晰；但ViT通过token、注意力、残差流和多模态交互表示图像，缺乏对应结构。然而大量文献直接将Grad-CAM应用于ViT而不提供完整的适配细节，导致方法论的严谨性和可复现性受到质疑。作者希望通过系统审计和分类体系来揭示这一方法论空白。
AI.method: 作者进行了系统的文献审计：从550余篇初始搜索中筛选出175篇对ViT应用Grad-CAM或相关方法的论文，并对其进行了分类分析。在此基础上，提出了一套描述性分类体系，明确了四个关键但常被隐式处理的维度：特征位置（feature locations）、梯度目标（gradient targets）、空间重建步骤（spatial reconstruction steps）和聚合选择（aggregation choices）。该分类体系旨在澄清做法的多样性而非规定唯一正确答案。
AI.result: 研究发现大多数论文未提供Grad-CAM适配到ViT的完整数学或实现级描述。研究表明，Grad-CAM在ViT上的应用常被当作CNN版本Grad-CAM的平凡扩展来处理，尽管其实际涉及影响严谨性、可复现性和解释性的非平凡方法学选择。
AI.conclusion: Grad-CAM在ViT上的应用需要更明确的方法论报告。所提出的分类体系有助于使这些常被隐式化的选择显式化，从而提升该领域研究的严谨性、可复现性及解释质量，但作者并不主张存在单一的正确适配方式。

title: Scaffold-Mediated Post-Training: Co-Evolving Model Parameters and Procedural Scaffold Graphs
summary: Post-training of large language models optimizes only parameters, while inference-time procedural scaffolds are typically designed independently of parameter training. This disconnect makes it difficult to automatically acquire and internalize complex strategies. We propose scaffold-mediated post-training: procedural scaffolds are organized into an evolvable graph structure that co-evolves with model parameters through discovery, distillation, and dynamic recompilation. We instantiate this paradigm as Skill Training. On FeatureBench, automatically discovered skills improve the passed rate by 8.1pp, and after progressive distillation the model still achieves a 27.7% passed rate without any external scaffold (distillation retention rate 85.2%, defined as post-distillation / with-skill passed rate), significantly outperforming standard SFT on the same data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"脚手架介导的后训练"（scaffold-mediated post-training）范式，将推理时的程序化脚手架组织成可进化图结构，与模型参数通过发现、蒸馏和动态重编译共同进化。该方法实例化为Skill Training，在FeatureBench上自动发现技能使通过率提升8.1个百分点，蒸馏后无外部脚手架仍达27.7%通过率（保留率85.2%），显著优于相同数据上的标准SFT。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型后训练仅优化参数，而推理时的程序化脚手架通常独立于参数训练设计，这种脱节导致复杂策略难以自动获取和内化。核心动机在于弥合参数训练与推理时程序脚手架之间的鸿沟，使模型能够自动发现并内化复杂策略。
AI.method: 提出脚手架介导的后训练范式：(1) 将程序化脚手架组织为可进化的图结构；(2) 通过发现（discovery）、蒸馏（distillation）和动态重编译（dynamic recompilation）三个机制实现脚手架与模型参数的共同进化；(3) 将该范式实例化为Skill Training方法。
AI.result: 在FeatureBench基准上：自动发现的技能将通过率提升8.1个百分点；渐进式蒸馏后，模型在无外部脚手架情况下仍达到27.7%的通过率，蒸馏保留率为85.2%（定义为蒸馏后/带技能的通过率），显著优于相同数据上的标准SFT。
AI.conclusion: 脚手架介导的后训练能有效实现推理时程序化策略的自动发现与内化，参数训练与程序脚手架共同进化优于独立设计，且蒸馏后的模型即使脱离外部脚手架仍能保持较高性能，证明该范式优于传统SFT方法。

title: Marginal Matching Does Not License Factorized Sampling: Auditing Conditional Style Leakage in Factorized Generative Models
summary:
Factorized generative models commonly regularize a latent style variable z_s by matching its marginal distribution to a fixed Gaussian prior and interpret this as evidence that the style representation is independent of class information. We show that this interpretation is incorrect. Matching only the marginal distribution places no constraint on the class-conditional distributions, allowing the latent style to remain highly predictive of the label despite appearing perfectly Gaussian in aggregate. We derive an exact decomposition showing that this mismatch is one of four conditions required for factorized sampling, and demonstrate that eliminating it is necessary but not sufficient to obtain the intended factorization.
  Empirically, our case-study model and four representative latent baselines achieve near-zero global MMD while still allowing a linear probe to recover class labels with 74%--100% accuracy (10% chance level). Our model reaches 99.15% clustering accuracy, whereas externally evaluated class-conditional generation succeeds only 16% of the time. This leakage remains under six independent perturbations involving model capacity, curriculum, prior geometry, and supervision across two datasets. Four mitigation strategies reduce probe accuracy to 21%--46%, although they leave within-class dependence largely unchanged. A post-hoc conditional prior improves externally evaluated class generation to 0.97 on MNIST without retraining but reaches only 0.41 on CIFAR-10, while an empirical style bank achieves 0.88 on CIFAR-10. These results demonstrate that no divergence computed solely on the marginal distribution of the style latent can certify independence from class labels, and that reporting marginal statistics alone does not verify the property commonly claimed in factorized generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文指出因子化生成模型中常用的"将潜风格变量边缘分布匹配到高斯先验"并不能保证风格与类别标签独立。作者推导出边缘匹配仅是因子化采样所需四个条件之一，并证明了即使全局MMD接近零，线性探针仍能以74%-100%的准确率从风格潜变量中恢复类别标签。多种缓解策略只能部分改善问题，表明仅报告边缘统计量无法验证因子化生成模型的核心声明。
AI.motivation: 因子化生成模型普遍假设将风格潜变量z_s的边缘分布匹配到固定高斯先验即可证明风格表示与类别信息独立。作者指出这一解释在数学上是不正确的，因为边缘分布匹配对类别条件分布没有任何约束，风格潜变量在总体分布上看似完美高斯，却仍可能高度预测类别标签。这一错误理解可能误导整个研究社区对因子化生成模型的评估和验证。
AI.method: 作者首先推导了精确分解，证明边缘分布匹配只是因子化采样所需的四个条件之一，消除该不匹配是必要但不充分的。然后在案例研究模型和四个代表性潜变量基线上进行了实证分析：通过全局MMD、线性探针、聚类准确率和外部类别条件生成评估来量化风格潜变量中的标签泄漏。此外，在六个独立扰动（模型容量、课程学习、先验几何、监督方式、两个数据集）下验证泄漏的鲁棒性，并测试四种缓解策略以及后验条件先验和经验风格库两种修复方案。
AI.result: 案例模型和四个基线在全局MMD接近零的同时，线性探针仍能以74%-100%恢复类别标签（随机水平10%）。模型聚类准确率达99.15%，而外部评估的类别条件生成仅成功16%。泄漏在六种扰动下持续存在；四种缓解策略将探针准确率降至21%-46%但未改变类内依赖。后验条件先验在MNIST上达到0.97（无需重训练）但在CIFAR-10上仅0.41，经验风格库在CIFAR-10上达到0.88。
AI.conclusion: 没有任何仅基于风格潜变量边缘分布计算的散度能够证明其与类别标签的独立性，仅报告边缘统计量不能验证因子化生成模型声称的属性。研究者需要寻求更强、更全面的验证方法，例如类别条件评估或联合分布的检查。

title: Abstract Event Causal Rules: Induction and Application
summary: Event-centric intelligent analytical systems heavily depend on explicit causal event knowledge for risk early warning, decision-making support and narrative comprehension. Nevertheless, existing instance-level causal pairs suffer severe generalization deficits on low-frequency long-tail and unseen event combinations. To address this limitation, this work proposes Abstract Event Causal Rule (AECR), a novel relation-level causal abstraction paradigm that transforms concrete cause-effect pairs into generalized abstract causal logic while retaining their intrinsic causal relationships. We design a multi-agent Concrete-to-Abstract Causal Induction (CACI) system coupled with similarity-constrained clustering to distill trustworthy AECRs from noisy raw causal data, based on which two complete AECR knowledge bases are built. To validate the practical utility of abstract causal knowledge, we propose an Abstract Rule-Guided Causal Attention Encoder (AR-GCAE), which injects the retrieved AECRs into the causality Graph Event Prediction (CGEP) benchmark task via rule-guided attention layers and gated representation fusion. Quantitative experimental results reveal that applying AECRs substantially strengthens the generalization capacity of event causal reasoning and brings consistent performance improvements to event prediction, with the most prominent gains observed on rare and unseen event samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AECR（抽象事件因果规则）范式，将具体因果对转化为广义抽象因果逻辑以克服低频率长尾和未见事件组合上的泛化不足，并设计CACI多智能体系统与AR-GCAE编码器将抽象因果知识注入事件预测任务，实验证明其在稀有与未见事件样本上带来显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有事件中心智能分析系统依赖显式因果事件知识，但实例级因果对在低频长尾和未见事件组合上存在严重的泛化缺陷，限制了风险预警、决策支持和叙事理解等应用的效果。
AI.method: 提出AECR关系级因果抽象范式，将具体因果对转化为保留内在因果关系的广义抽象因果逻辑；设计结合相似性约束聚类的多智能体CACI系统从含噪原始因果数据中提炼可信AECR，构建两个完整知识库；提出AR-GCAE编码器，通过规则引导注意力层和门控表示融合将检索到的AECR注入CGEP事件预测任务。
AI.result: 定量实验表明应用AECR能显著增强事件因果推理的泛化能力，为事件预测带来一致的性能提升，且在稀有和未见事件样本上增益最为突出。
AI.conclusion: 抽象因果规则知识能够有效弥补实例级因果数据在长尾与未知场景下的不足，是提升事件因果推理系统泛化能力的可行路径。

title: Breaking Memory Bottlenecks in Quantum Control Systems for More Precise Experiments and Higher Throughput Computing
summary: As quantum computing continues to demonstrate promise and attract growing attention, there is an increasing need for more precise experiments to advance the development of quantum devices, as well as higher circuit throughput to validate more domain applications. However, this need is hindered by a memory bottleneck at the quantum control system layer, arising from limited on-chip BRAM capacity and the non-deterministic latency of DRAM. To break this bottleneck, we present Ant-Q, a memory hierarchy design that integrates DRAM with BRAM to support pipelined quantum circuit execution while ensuring deterministic inter-circuit timing. We evaluated Ant-Q using 26 real-world experimental and computing circuits. The results show that Ant-Q supports deep circuits for 1Q and 2Q Randomized Benchmarking and reduces the overhead of circuit loading and readout uplink relative to execution time from 22.90%-1417.05% to near zero. Ant-Q is being integrated into QubiC 3.0, with part of its functionalities already available.

AI.tldr: Ant-Q 是一种面向量子控制系统的内存层次设计，通过将 DRAM 与 BRAM 集成，实现了流水线化的量子电路执行并确保确定性的电路间时序，从而打破了量子控制系统层的内存瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 量子计算的发展需要更精确的实验和更高的电路吞吐量来验证更多领域应用，但量子控制系统层的片上 BRAM 容量有限以及 DRAM 的延迟不确定性造成了内存瓶颈，限制了这一需求的实现。
AI.method: 设计了一种将 DRAM 与 BRAM 集成的内存层次结构，支持流水线化的量子电路执行，同时保证电路间的确定性时序。
AI.result: 使用 26 个真实世界的实验和计算电路进行评估，Ant-Q 支持 1Q 和 2Q 随机基准测试的深电路，并将电路加载和读出上行链路相对于执行时间的开销从 22.90%-1417.05% 降至接近零。
AI.conclusion: Ant-Q 正在集成到 QubiC 3.0 中，其部分功能已经可用。

title: Convergent Evolution in Neural Representation Space: Emergent Order in Deep Belief Networks
summary: Deep Belief Networks (DBNs) learn hierarchical generative models without class supervision. Here, we ask whether this purely unsupervised process nevertheless organizes internal representations according to the unknown data classes. We analyze successive layers of DBNs trained on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and KMNIST using the Generalized Discrimination Value (GDV), supervised probes applied only after training, a reconstruction-based measure of abstraction distance, effective dimensionality, and free sample generation. Remarkably, class-specific clustering generally increases with depth across datasets and network widths, although no label information is available during DBN training. Control experiments show that this effect depends on the learned feature structure and cannot be explained by random transformations, weight marginals, dimensionality reduction, or sigmoid saturation. The first hidden layers also frequently make class identity more accessible to linear and nonlinear probes. With greater depth, representations become increasingly compact and prototype-like as neurons acquire correlated feature directions. At the same time, GDV and probe accuracy reveal complementary aspects of class structure: improved average clustering can coexist with reduced accessibility for a few difficult class pairs. These findings demonstrate that layer-wise generative learning can spontaneously uncover and progressively amplify class-related structure in unlabeled data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了无监督训练的深度置信网络（DBN）是否会在内部表示中自发组织和放大与未知数据类别相关的结构。通过GDV、监督探针、抽象距离、有效维度和自由样本生成等多种方法，在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和KMNIST数据集上分析DBN各层，发现类特异性聚类随深度增加而增强，且该效应不能被随机变换、权重边际、降维或sigmoid饱和等因素解释。
AI.motivation: 过去对深度置信网络的研究主要集中在无监督特征学习和泛化能力上，但一个关键问题尚未被系统回答：纯无监督训练过程中，网络是否会在其内部表征中自发地组织出与未知数据类别相关的结构？如果存在，这种组织如何随深度演化，其机制和边界是什么？
AI.method: 使用广义判别值（GDV）、训练后监督探针、基于重构的抽象距离度量、有效维度和自由样本生成等多种分析手段，在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和KMNIST三个数据集上，对不同深度和宽度的DBN逐层分析。同时设计控制实验（随机变换、权重边际、降维、sigmoid饱和）排除非特征结构的干扰因素。
AI.result: 类特异性聚类随深度增加而普遍增强，且在多个数据集和网络宽度上保持一致；第一隐藏层已能使类别信息对线性和非线性探针更易获取；更深的表示更紧凑、更像原型，神经元获得相关特征方向；GDV与探针准确率揭示互补的类别结构方面——平均聚类改善可能与少数困难类对的访问性降低并存；控制实验确认该效应依赖于学习到的特征结构。
AI.conclusion: 逐层生成式学习能够自发揭示并逐步放大未标记数据中的类别相关结构，这种能力是深度网络无监督表示学习的内在属性，而非实验伪影。GDV与监督探针的互补性表明，网络不同层次对类别信息的组织方式存在细微差别。

title: Routing LLM Inference to the Cleanest Grid in Real Time
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Live multi-region GPU validation plus a one-year historical marginal-emissions replay
summary: Large-language-model inference is a fast-growing electricity load whose marginal carbon intensity varies by more than an order of magnitude across grid regions and across the day, making request placement an attractive lever: no retraining, no hardware change. We report a live validation of carbon-aware inference routing on multi-region GPU testbeds driven by marginal operating emissions rate (MOER) signals, with three properties uncommon in prior work: a blind baseline that is an actual production pressure-based router rather than uniform placement; per-request energy attributed from GPU telemetry (NVIDIA DCGM) via measured concurrency curves rather than nameplate TDP; and carbon settlement of every request against historical MOER, not only the forecast that drove the decision. The central live result is feasibility: a MOER signal steered inference across regions with no observed dispatch failures, as a strict and reversible overlay on the production router. To size the effect, we replay a year of hourly MOER across a grid-diverse CONUS fleet. In the primary modeled configuration, carbon-aware placement reduces modeled GPU-attributable operational emissions by 50.9% versus round-robin (95% block-bootstrap CI 48.5-53.3%). Because the replay dispatches against historical MOER rather than a forecast, this is an upper bound under that configuration; forecast error would reduce operationally realized savings. Before session pinning, hourly lowest-MOER routing contributes about 22.4 percentage points, roughly 40% of the 54.0% placement reduction, beyond a static annual-mean-MOER policy. These are modeled results for one fleet and historical year, not a universal estimate. We also record a practical observation: when comparing regions, rank by absolute MOER rather than the percentile signal-index, which is normalized within each region and answers a temporal, not a spatial, question.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了碳感知推理路由（carbon-aware inference routing）的实时验证，在多区域GPU测试平台上由边际运行排放率（MOER）信号驱动，碳排放感知的请求放置在不改变训练或硬件的情况下，可比轮询调度减少约50.9%的GPU可归因运营排放（95%置信区间48.5-53.3%）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理的电力负载快速增长，其边际碳强度在不同电网区域和一天中不同时段变化超过一个数量级，因此请求放置成为减少碳排放的有效杠杆——无需重新训练或改变硬件。
AI.method: 该方法包含三个关键特性：1) 以实际生产环境中的压力感知路由器为盲基线（而非均匀放置）；2) 通过GPU遥测（NVIDIA DCGM）和实测并发曲线进行每请求能耗归因（而非铭牌TDP）；3) 每个请求都依据历史MOER进行碳结算，而非仅依据决策时使用的预测。采用实时验证测试平台和多区域GPU测试台，并用一年的小时级MOER数据在横跨多样电网的CONUS机群上进行回放。
AI.result: 实时验证表明MOER信号可以跨区域引导推理且无调度失败，是可严格反转的叠加层。在主配置中，碳感知放置比轮询减少50.9%的GPU可归因运营排放（95%块自举CI 48.5-53.3%）。在会话固定之前，每小时最低MOER路由比静态年均MOER策略额外贡献约22.4个百分点（约占54.0%放置减少的40%）。
AI.conclusion: 碳感知路由在生产路由器上作为严格且可逆的叠加层是可行的。由于回放使用历史MOER而非预测，所得节省是上界；预测误差会降低实际操作中的节省。结果仅针对单一机群和年份，不是普适估计。实际观察建议：跨区域比较时应按绝对MOER排序，而非使用每个区域内归一化的百分位信号指标。

title: The Trust-Free Aggregation Layer of the Unicity Infrastructure
summary: Unicity is a novel blockchain infrastructure for enabling users to execute off-chain peer-to-peer token transactions while preventing parallel states of tokens (double-spending) with minimal blockchain complexity and storage. A key component of the infrastructure is the Aggregation Layer responsible for storing information about the spent states of tokens and providing compact cryptographic proofs of no double-spending for the users without making any compromises in trust. Aggregation Layer is a layer 2 style service that holds an append-only key-value repository that periodically certifies its state using a traditional blockchain that we call the Consensus Layer. Every time while certifying a changed state the Aggregation Layer provides a cryptographic proof to the Consensus Layer about the append-only consistency of the key-value store. We use the Radix Sparse Merkle Trees (RSMTs) to create the cryptographic digest r_i of the store in every round i and authentication paths of special type in order to prove that the next digest r_{i+1} was obtained while only adding some key-value pairs (k,v) to the repository. The proof verification code is implemented as an Algebraic Intermediate Representation (AIR) circuit on top of the Plonky3 STARK toolkit. Our implementation uses no trusted setup, achieves throughput of 10,000 insertions per second and and millisecond range verification time on a single consumer-class CPU.

AI.tldr: Unicity是一个新颖的区块链基础设施，通过聚合层实现链下点对点代币交易，防止双重支付，同时最小化区块链复杂度和存储开销。聚合层使用Radix稀疏Merkle树（RSMTs）维护追加式键值存储，并通过STARK证明验证追加一致性，无需可信设置即可实现每秒1万次插入和毫秒级验证。
AI.motivation: 现有区块链在执行链下点对点代币交易时面临双重支付（双花）问题，同时需要在区块链上存储大量状态信息，导致复杂度和存储开销过高。论文旨在设计一种基础设施，使用户在链下执行交易的同时，能够以最小的区块链复杂度和存储防止代币的平行状态出现。
AI.method: 设计Unicity基础设施，核心组件为聚合层（Aggregation Layer），它是一个layer 2风格服务，持有追加式键值仓库，周期性地通过传统区块链（共识层）认证其状态。使用Radix稀疏Merkle树（RSMTs）生成每轮密码学摘要r_i，并构造特殊类型的认证路径来证明下一摘要r_{i+1}仅通过添加键值对获得。证明验证代码实现为基于Plonky3 STARK工具包的代数中间表示（AIR）电路。
AI.result: 该实现无需可信设置，在单台消费级CPU上实现了每秒10,000次插入的吞吐量和毫秒级验证时间。系统能提供紧凑的密码学证明（无双重支付证明），同时不妥协信任假设。
AI.conclusion: Unicity通过聚合层和RSMTs结合STARK证明，实现了链下交易中防双重支付与最小区块链开销之间的平衡，为构建更高效、可扩展的区块链代币交易基础设施提供了可行的技术方案。

title: ARGUS: Aligning Robot Scene Geometry Under Shifting Views with Large 3D Vision Models
summary: Large-scale visuomotor policies have demonstrated impressive performance across a wide range of robot manipulation tasks. However, despite this success, manipulation polices often entangle scene geometry with the corresponding viewpoint, learning where objects lie in an image rather than where it lies in the task space. This entanglement inherently limits the corresponding policy's ability to learn from viewpoint-diverse datasets (ex. DROID, BridgeV2) and generalize beyond the viewpoints captured in their training data. In this work, we present ARGUS, an observation pre-processing pipeline that uses large-scale 3D vision models to align image observations from arbitrary camera viewpoints into a canonical viewpoint before passing it to downstream visuomotor policies. Experiments across training datasets with varying levels of viewpoint diversity, from fixed multi-view camera configurations to highly varied camera placements, show that our method consistently outperforms prior approaches across both limited-view and view-diverse training regimes. In efficiency comparisons, ARGUS demonstrates an ability to learn from view-diverse data, converging to high success rates 4-6x faster than previous methods by leveraging a simplified observation space. Overall, our findings show that leveraging large-scale 3D vision models reduces the learning burden on visuomotor policies, enabling more efficient learning from large-scale, viewpoint-diverse robot datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARGUS，一个观测预处理管线，利用大规模3D视觉模型将任意相机视角的图像观测对齐到规范视角后再输入下游视觉运动策略，从而解耦场景几何与视角，提升策略在视角多样化数据集上的学习和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 大规模视觉运动策略在机器人操作任务中表现优异，但现有策略常常将场景几何与相机视角纠缠在一起，即在图像空间中学习物体位置而非任务空间中的真实位置。这种纠缠限制了策略利用视角多样化数据集（如DROID、BridgeV2）的能力，也限制了其泛化到训练数据未覆盖的视角。因此需要一种方法来解耦几何与视角，降低策略的学习负担。
AI.method: 提出ARGUS，一个观测预处理管线。它利用大规模3D视觉模型，将来自任意相机视角的图像观测对齐到一个统一的规范视角（canonical viewpoint），然后再将对齐后的观测传递给下游视觉运动策略进行学习和推理。
AI.result: 在从固定多相机配置到高度多变相机布局等多种训练数据集上，ARGUS在有限视角和视角多样化训练场景下均持续优于先前方法。在效率对比中，ARGUS通过简化观测空间，在视点多样数据上的收敛速度快4-6倍，能更快达到高成功率。
AI.conclusion: 利用大规模3D视觉模型减少视觉运动策略的学习负担，能够有效提升从大规模、视角多样化的机器人数据集中的学习效率，为处理视点多样化的真实世界机器人学习提供了有效途径。

title: A Paragraph is Worth a Thousand Captions: Rethinking Text Supervision for Vision-Language Retrieval
comment: Accepted at the MUCG workshop, ECCV 2026
summary: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP and BLIP are typically trained on short image captions, limiting their ability to retrieve images from detailed textual descriptions. While methods such as Long-CLIP extend the token limit through positional embedding interpolation, we ask a simpler question: does training text granularity alone determine long-text retrieval performance? We present a systematic study of supervision ranging from single captions to multi-sentence paragraphs for contrastive image-text retrieval. Using a synthetic pipeline based on Qwen2-VL and Llama 3.2 Vision, we generate diverse captions, hard negatives, and quality-scored paragraphs for 500K CC3M images. To isolate the effect of text granularity, we fine-tune only the BLIP text encoder while keeping the vision encoder frozen across 10 training configurations. Our paragraph-supervised models match Long-CLIP-L on ShareGPT4V and outperform it by more than 14 points on DOCCI for image-to-text retrieval, without architectural changes. We further show that paragraph supervision enables effective use of long token sequences, whereas caption-only training degrades beyond 60 tokens. Increasing caption diversity improves short-caption retrieval with diminishing returns, while paragraph supervision consistently benefits long-description benchmarks and hard negatives prove detrimental in text-only fine-tuning. Evaluations on Flickr30k, COCO, ShareGPT4V, and DOCCI provide a comprehensive analysis of the trade-offs between text granularity, retrieval direction, and description length.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了训练文本粒度（从短标题到多句段落）对对比式视觉-语言模型长文本检索性能的影响。通过在冻结视觉编码器的情况下仅微调BLIP文本编码器，使用由Qwen2-VL和Llama 3.2 Vision合成生成的多粒度监督数据，证明仅改变文本粒度即可使段落监督模型在ShareGPT4V上匹配Long-CLIP-L性能，并在DOCCI上超越其14个百分点以上，无需任何架构改动。
AI.motivation: 现有的对比式视觉-语言模型（如CLIP、BLIP）通常使用短图像标题训练，限制了从详细文本描述中检索图像的能力。已有方法如Long-CLIP通过位置嵌入插值扩展token限制，但作者提出一个更基础的问题：训练文本粒度本身是否就决定了长文本检索性能？
AI.method: 作者构建了一个基于Qwen2-VL和Llama 3.2 Vision的合成数据管线，为500K张CC3M图像生成多样化标题、困难负样本和质量评分的段落。设置10种训练配置，仅微调BLIP文本编码器（冻结视觉编码器），系统比较从单一标题到多句段落等不同粒度的监督信号对图像-文本检索的影响。
AI.result: 段落监督模型在ShareGPT4V上匹配Long-CLIP-L，在DOCCI的图像到文本检索上超越其14个百分点以上，且无需架构更改。段落监督使长token序列得以有效利用，而仅标题训练在超过60个token时性能退化。增加标题多样性可改善短标题检索（收益递减），困难负样本在仅文本微调中反而有害。
AI.conclusion: 训练文本粒度是决定长文本检索性能的关键因素，段落级监督可以替代架构改动来实现长描述检索。研究在Flickr30k、COCO、ShareGPT4V和DOCCI上的全面评估揭示了文本粒度、检索方向和描述长度之间的权衡关系。

title: Large Language Models Threaten Double-blind Review
summary: Double blind peer review serves as the scientific community primary defense against status and affiliation bias. Its effectiveness rests on the assumption that anonymized manuscripts convey scientific merit without revealing their authors. While authorship can often be recovered using citation networks or stylistic markers, we show that this assumption is increasingly fragile in the presence of large language models (LLMs). Using only titles and abstracts from papers published after model training, we find that LLMs collapse anonymity more efficiently than humans, with belief concentrating onto a small subset of plausible authors drawn from pools of five domain expert candidates. This vulnerability persists even when stylistic and bibliographic cues are excluded, indicating that stable patterns in problem framing and research focus function as latent conceptual signatures of authorship. Together, these findings indicate that double blind review is vulnerable to automated semantic inference, necessitating a revaluation of how anonymity and fairness are maintained in an AI augmented research ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了大语言模型（LLMs）能够仅凭论文标题和摘要中的语义信息，比人类更高效地破解双盲同行评审中的作者匿名性，表明问题框架和研究焦点中稳定的模式构成了潜在的"概念签名"，对双盲评审制度的有效性构成重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 双盲同行评审被视为科学界抵御地位和隶属关系偏见的主要防线，其有效性建立在"匿名稿件不泄露作者身份"的假设之上。尽管已有研究表明作者身份可通过引文网络或文风标记被恢复，但在大语言模型日益普及的背景下，这一假设是否仍然成立尚不明确，亟需系统验证。
AI.method: 使用模型训练之后发表的论文标题和摘要作为测试数据，从五名领域专家候选作者池中进行作者身份推断，并与人类的推断效率进行对比；同时设计排除文风和文献计量线索的对照组，以分离出语义层面的作者身份线索。
AI.result: LLMs比人类更高效地破解作者匿名性，且置信度集中在少数可能的作者子集上；即使排除文风和引文线索，该漏洞依然存在，说明问题框架和研究焦点中的稳定模式构成了隐性的"概念性作者签名"。
AI.conclusion: 双盲评审在AI增强的研究生态中易受自动化语义推断攻击，需要重新审视匿名性和公平性的维护机制，以应对大语言模型带来的新挑战。

title: PRISM: Priority-aware Rubric Internalization via Structured Multimodal Data Synthesis
summary: Real-world multimodal instructions often bundle multiple requirements with unequal importance, yet most multimodal training data still reduce instruction following to answering one self-contained question. We study this gap through \textbf{rubric comprehension}, which casts the model not as a generator measured against rubrics but as an \textbf{executor} that follows them: given an image and a typed, prioritized rubric, the model must verify each rule before producing an overall judgment. To support this setting, we propose \textbf{PRISM}, a four-stage data synthesis framework that produces persona--task pairs, prefix-guided rule sets, quality-filtered rubrics, and structured verification traces. We further introduce \textbf{PRISM-Eval}, whose Loose and Strict metrics use deterministic matching against fixed labels and therefore require no inference-time judge model. With only 10K synthesized samples, PRISM lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 9.5\% to 30.1\% Strict accuracy on PRISM-Eval while preserving average performance on general benchmarks, and the gains transfer to four additional open-source MLLMs across dense and MoE architectures, suggesting that structured rubric supervision is a scalable path toward multi-rule, priority-aware multimodal instruction following.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISM，一个四阶段数据合成框架，用于训练多模态大语言模型（MLLM）遵循带优先级的评分细则（rubric comprehension）。仅用10K合成样本即可将Qwen3-VL-4B的Strict准确率从9.5%提升至30.1%，且不损害通用基准性能，并可迁移到四种其他开源MLLM。
AI.motivation: 现实中的多模态指令往往包含多个重要性不等的需求，但现有多模态训练数据大多将指令遵循简化为回答单一自包含问题。作者希望通过rubric comprehension这一设定弥合这一差距，让模型扮演评分细则的执行者而非被测者，从而学会多规则、优先级感知的指令遵循。
AI.method: 提出PRISM四阶段数据合成框架：(1) 生成persona-task配对；(2) 生成前缀引导的规则集；(3) 质量过滤评分细则；(4) 生成结构化验证轨迹。同时引入PRISM-Eval评测基准，其Loose和Strict指标基于固定标签的确定性匹配，无需推理时的评判模型。
AI.result: 仅用10K合成样本，PRISM将Qwen3-VL-4B的Strict准确率从9.5%提升至30.1%，同时保持通用基准的平均性能。增益可迁移到四种额外的开源MLLM（包括稠密和MoE架构）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化评分细则监督是迈向多规则、优先级感知的多模态指令遵循的可扩展路径，证明合成数据驱动的rubric comprehension训练能够显著提升模型执行复杂指令的能力。

title: Otter: A Time-Aware, History-Conditioned Human Chess AI
summary:
Otter is a 15.3M-parameter human chess AI that predicts human move selection by modeling play as a time-aware, sequential process rather than treating each position in isolation. It combines two conditioning signals: (1) a move history encoder that conditions predictions on the last 20 moves, capturing opening preferences, positional drift, and intra-game behavioral tendencies; and (2) a time control module that modulates predictions based on clock pressure. Otter is trained on 6.1 billion positions from 117 million Lichess rapid games over 30 days on a single T4 GPU.
  Otter achieves 55.23% top-1 and 90.95% top-5 move-prediction accuracy, surpassing the prior state-of-the-art human chess model, Maia 2, with far fewer parameters and less training data. Across 11 Elo brackets (<1100 to >=2000), accuracy peaks at 57.38% in the 1900-1999 bracket. These results show that modeling chess as a time-aware, sequential activity yields more human-accurate move prediction than position-only approaches, using a smaller model. Code, trained models, and complete training logs are publicly released.
