AI.method: 提出per-ID行为残差化表示：从滑动窗口中提取十四种涵盖时间、协议和载荷维度的特征，并将这些特征相对每个仲裁ID的正常基线进行残差化处理（去除该ID的正常行为模式）。使用六种无监督检测器评估该表示的有效性，而非依赖单一检测器。
AI.result: 在HCRL数据集上21/24的评估中，在ROAD数据集上30/36的评估中，残差化表示相比基线提升了平均F1分数。在ROAD数据集上，对目标信号操纵攻击实现召回率≥0.99且ROC-AUC较高。同时明确量化了两个局限：HCRL DoS的F1=0.02（新ID洪泛）和ROAD交叉ID模糊的F1=0.27。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是CAN入侵检测的性能提升主要来源于所提出的残差化表示本身，而非具体的检测算法。该表示对复用合法ID的攻击更为鲁棒，但其覆盖边界也被明确限定——对新ID洪泛和交叉ID模糊攻击检测效果有限。

title: Hijacking Robots with a Piece of Paper: A Systematic Study of Physical Prompt Injection in VLM-Controlled Robots
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as planners in robotic systems, where they translate natural-language commands into executable actions grounded in visual scene understanding. This tight coupling between perception and instruction-following introduces a new attack surface: adversarial text placed within the robot's visual field can act as an indirect prompt injection into the VLM's reasoning stack. We present a systematic study of physical prompt injection attacks against VLM-controlled sorting, introducing a four-category taxonomy, indirect signage, task redefinition, authority impersonation, and conflict injection, instantiated as a benchmark of 20 attack prompts evaluated across three physical scene layouts and three command formulations that vary in destination specificity and rule explicitness. Across 5,670 trials on three frontier VLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3-VL-32B), attacks succeed at 27.0%, 29.4%, and 5.0% respectively, with authority-impersonating and negation attacks transferring across all three models. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals that successful compromise is nearly always conscious (99.9% acknowledgment rate), and that models defend through structurally different mechanisms, explicit rejection for Gemini, perceptual inattention for GPT-4o. We evaluate three simple mitigations: prompt-based defense (75-100% effective, model-dependent), two-stage verification (85-100%), and pre-processing text masking (100%). Our findings show that VLM-controlled manipulation is meaningfully vulnerable to human-readable physical signage, and that simple defenses substantially reduce risk, though defense choice involves trade-offs. The defenses preserve general task capabilities in our benchmark, but they may impair tasks that require reading in-scene labels.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了针对视觉语言模型（VLM）控制的机器人分拣系统的物理提示注入攻击。作者提出了四类攻击分类法（间接标识、任务重定义、权威冒充、冲突注入），包含20个攻击提示的基准测试，在三种物理场景布局和三种指令表述下，对GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash和Qwen3-VL-32B三个前沿VLM进行了5,670次试验。结果显示攻击成功率分别为27.0%、29.4%和5.0%，权威冒充与否定类攻击可跨模型迁移。论文还评估了三种防御措施（提示词防御75-100%、两阶段验证85-100%、文本掩码预处理100%），表明简单防御可大幅降低风险但存在权衡。
AI.motivation: VLM越来越多地被部署为机器人系统中的规划器，将自然语言指令转化为基于视觉场景理解的可执行动作。感知与指令遵循之间的紧密耦合引入了新的攻击面：放置在机器人视野内的对抗性文本可作为对VLM推理栈的间接提示注入。目前缺乏对这一物理攻击面的系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出了一个包含四个类别（间接标识、任务重定义、权威冒充、冲突注入）的攻击分类法，构建了20个攻击提示的基准，在三种物理场景布局和三种命令表述（目的地特定性和规则明确性不同）下进行实验。在5,670次试验中评估了三个VLM（GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3-VL-32B），并分析了推理轨迹。同时评估了三种防御策略：基于提示词的防御、两阶段验证和预处理文本掩码。
AI.result: 攻击成功率在三个模型上分别为27.0%（GPT-4o）、29.4%（Gemini 2.5 Flash）和5.0%（Qwen3-VL-32B）。权威冒充和否定类攻击可跨所有三个模型迁移。推理轨迹分析显示成功入侵几乎总是有意识的（99.9%确认率），且模型通过结构不同的机制防御（Gemini采用显式拒绝，GPT-4o采用感知性忽视）。三种防御措施分别达到75-100%、85-100%和100%的效果。
AI.conclusion: VLM控制的机械操作对普通人可读的物理标识具有实际可被利用的脆弱性。简单防御措施能大幅降低风险，但防御选择涉及权衡：现有防御手段在基准测试中保留了通用任务能力，但可能削弱需要读取场景内标签的任务能力。

title: Invisible Shortcuts: Why Vision Encoders Know Your Camera
summary: Deep vision models exploit shortcuts, relying on cues that correlate with supervision signals. Prior work has focused on visible biases, such as object-background or texture correlations. We identify a different source of shortcut learning: invisible metadata traces embedded at the pixel level, for metadata such as image processing and photo acquisition. We hypothesize that large-scale semantic supervision, whether through categorical labels (ImageNet) or billion-scale captions (LAION), naturally induces metadata-semantics correlations during pretraining, leading models to convert low-level signals into predictive features. By introducing controlled metadata-semantics correlations, we show that stronger ones produce systematically higher sensitivity to metadata traces and larger performance degradation under metadata distribution shifts. We further explore mitigation strategies applied during and after pretraining that reduce sensitivity not only to targeted metadata but also to unseen ones, without sacrificing performance on downstream tasks. Metadata sensitivity also has a positive side: it partly explains the strong generated-image detection ability of some encoders, while its mitigation can improve out-of-distribution generalization. Code: https://github.com/ryan-caesar-ramos/visual-encoder-traces

AI.tldr: 本文发现深度视觉模型会利用像素层面的不可见元数据痕迹（如图像处理、拍摄信息）作为捷径学习信号。大规模语义监督（如ImageNet类别标签或LAION的十亿级图文配对）会在预训练过程中自然引入元数据-语义关联，使模型将低层信号转化为预测特征。更强的元数据-语义关联会带来更高的元数据敏感性及更大的分布偏移性能下降。作者提出了预训练中和预训练后的缓解策略，能降低对目标甚至未见元数据的敏感性且不影响下游任务性能。此外，元数据敏感性有助于解释某些编码器对生成图像的强检测能力，缓解它还能提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的捷径学习研究主要关注可见偏差（如物体-背景、纹理相关），而忽略了像素层面隐藏的元数据痕迹（如处理参数、拍摄信息）所引发的捷径学习。作者想要揭示这类不可见元数据痕迹如何被大规模语义监督隐式编码为预测特征，并探索相应的缓解方法。
AI.method: 作者通过引入受控的元数据-语义关联来验证假设，证明更强的关联会导致更高的元数据敏感性和更大的性能退化。同时提出了两种缓解策略：预训练阶段的和预训练后的干预方法，用于降低对目标及未见元数据的敏感性。
AI.result: 实验表明：（1）更强的元数据-语义相关性系统地提高了模型对元数据痕迹的敏感性并加剧分布偏移下的性能下降；（2）所提缓解策略能减少对目标及未见元数据的敏感性且不牺牲下游任务性能；（3）元数据敏感性部分解释了某些编码器对生成图像的强检测能力；（4）缓解元数据敏感性可改善分布外泛化。
AI.conclusion: 像素级不可见元数据是一种被忽视的捷径学习来源，理解并缓解其对视觉模型的影响，既能改善泛化能力，也有助于解释生成图像检测等任务中的模型行为。

title: A Study of ASR Adaptation and Representation Dimensionality Reduction in Persian Speech Emotion Recognition Using Whisper
summary: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) in low-resource languages remains a challenging problem due to limited labeled data. In this work, we study the use of Whisper for Persian SER with a particular focus on representation dimensionality reduction and language-specific model adaptation. We propose a SER framework in which frame-level embeddings extracted from the Whisper encoder are reduced in dimensionality using PCA, eliminating the need for learned projection layers and substantially reducing the number of trainable parameters. The reduced representations are aggregated using an attention-based pooling mechanism and classified with a lightweight prediction head. In addition, we investigate whether fine-tuning Whisper on a Persian automatic speech recognition (ASR) task improves downstream SER performance. Experiments conducted on the ShEMO dataset under a speaker-independent evaluation protocol show that PCA-based dimensionality reduction consistently improves emotion recognition performance while reducing training latency and memory usage. ASR fine-tuning yields only modest gains for SER, suggesting limited transfer from language adaptation to emotion-related representations under the evaluated conditions. These findings provide practical insights into the efficient use of large pretrained speech models for emotion recognition in low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对低资源语言（波斯语）语音情感识别（SER）的框架，利用Whisper编码器提取帧级嵌入，通过PCA进行降维以减少可训练参数，并采用基于注意力的池化机制和轻量级分类头完成情感识别。实验表明PCA降维能一致地提升情感识别性能并降低训练延迟和内存占用，而ASR微调对SER的改善有限。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的语音情感识别（SER）面临标注数据稀缺的挑战，如何高效利用大型预训练语音模型（如Whisper）进行情感识别是亟待解决的问题。作者旨在探索在不引入额外学习投影层的前提下，通过降维和语言适配来提升低资源语言SER的性能与效率。
AI.method: 该框架包括：（1）从Whisper编码器提取帧级嵌入；（2）使用PCA对这些嵌入进行降维，替代可学习的投影层，显著减少可训练参数；（3）通过基于注意力的池化机制聚合降维后的表示；（4）使用轻量级分类头进行情感分类。此外，作者还探究了在波斯语ASR任务上微调Whisper是否有助于提升下游SER性能。
AI.result: 在ShEMO数据集上、采用说话人无关评估协议下，实验结果表明：（1）PCA降维一致地提升了情感识别性能，同时降低了训练延迟和内存占用；（2）ASR微调对SER仅带来有限的增益，说明在该条件下语言适配对情感相关表示的迁移效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为高效利用大规模预训练语音模型进行低资源语言情感识别提供了实用洞见。PCA降维作为参数高效的方法被证明有效，而ASR微调的语言适配策略对SER的提升空间有限，提示在低资源场景下应更注重嵌入降维与池化策略的优化而非大规模微调。

title: QEvict: Recoverable Quantized KV Eviction for Attention-Drift-Robust Long-Context Decoding
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. The first four authors contributed equally
summary: Autoregressive large language model inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache. A dominant line of work reduces this footprint by evicting tokens that appear unimportant under attention-derived scores. However, such policies make an implicit irreversible decision: once a token is evicted, it cannot become useful again. We show that this assumption is brittle during decoding. Token and window importance drift as generated queries evolve, causing standard eviction policies to permanently discard states that later receive substantial attention under the full-cache model. To characterize this behaviour, we introduce Future Missed Mass and Global LIR, two diagnostics that measure future attention assigned to discarded states and the reactivation of historically inactive regions. We propose QEvict, a three-tier KV-cache management scheme that replaces binary retain-or-delete eviction with recoverable eviction. QEvict maintains high-confidence windows in full precision, stores intermediate windows in a quantized recoverable tier, and deletes only the lowest-confidence windows. During decoding, cumulative attention scores update window importance and when a quantized window becomes important again, it is dequantized and promoted to the full-precision. Under a fixed memory budget, this design preserves broader historical context while retaining exact full precision for the most important regions. Across long-context understanding, retrieval, and reasoning benchmarks, QEvict consistently improves over representative eviction and quantization baselines, reducing missed attention and improving information retention

AI.tldr: 本文提出QEvict，一种三层的KV缓存管理方案，用可恢复的驱逐（量化中间层+全精度高置信层）替代传统的二值驱逐策略，解决了LLM解码过程中被驱逐token无法重新变得重要的问题。
AI.motivation: 自回归大模型推理受限于KV缓存的显存占用。现有驱逐方法基于注意力分数淘汰"不重要"的token，但该决策是隐式不可逆的——token一旦被驱逐就无法再次被利用。然而在解码过程中，token和窗口的重要性会随着生成的query演化而漂移，标准驱逐策略会永久丢弃那些之后可能重新获得大量注意力的状态，导致信息丢失。
AI.method: 作者提出两个诊断指标：Future Missed Mass和Global LIR，用于量化被丢弃状态未来的注意力与历史非活跃区域的重新激活。基于此设计QEvict三层KV缓存管理：(1) 高置信窗口保留全精度；(2) 中间窗口存入量化可恢复层；(3) 仅删除最低置信窗口。解码时累积注意力分数更新窗口重要性，被量化窗口重新变重要时会被反量化并提升回全精度层。
AI.result: 在长上下文理解、检索和推理基准上，QEvict在固定内存预算下持续优于代表性的逐出和量化基线方法，减少了被错过的注意力并改善了信息保留。
AI.conclusion: QEvict证明"可恢复驱逐"比"二值驱逐"更优：在有限显存下既能保留更广的历史上下文，又能对最重要区域保持全精度，兼顾了信息保留与内存效率。

title: TriQua: Reconciling Granularity and Context in Factuality Evaluation
summary: The "decompose-then-verify" paradigm for LLM factuality evaluation faces a fundamental trade-off: atomic facts, i.e., one sentence conveying one unit of information, often omit essential context, while broader statements lack the granularity needed for precise assessment. To address this, we introduce TriQua, a framework that flexibly models facts based on their complexity. Simple claims are extracted as standard triples, while complex claims are represented as hyperrelational facts by attaching auxiliary contextual qualifiers. This adaptive structure preserves the necessary context for accurate retrieval and verification without sacrificing atomicity. Furthermore, TriQua's verification process directly annotates concrete errors within specific triples and qualifiers, providing fine-grained explainability for error detection. Alongside the framework, we propose TriQuaScore to quantify the factuality of these structured fact units. Empirical evaluations show that TriQuaScore strongly aligns with human annotated factuality scores, TriQua achieves robust decomposition quality, and outperforms existing decomposition-based frameworks in evidence-based fact verification.

AI.tldr: 提出TriQua框架，通过将简单事实建模为标准三元组、复杂事实建模为带上下文物化符的超关系事实，解决了LLM事实性评估中"分解后验证"范式的粒度与上下文保真之间的权衡问题，并配套TriQuaScore实现细粒度可解释的事实性量化评分。
AI.motivation: 现有"分解后验证"范式在LLM事实性评估中存在根本性权衡：原子事实（一句话传递一个信息单元）常常丢失关键上下文，而更宽泛的表述又缺乏精确评估所需的粒度。需要一种既能保持原子性又能保留必要上下文的灵活事实建模方式。
AI.method: TriQua框架采用自适应的复杂感知事实建模：简单声明提取为标准三元组，复杂声明则通过附加辅助上下文限定符（qualifiers）表示为超关系事实（hyperrelational facts）。验证过程直接在具体三元组和限定符上标注具体错误，提供细粒度的可解释性。同时提出TriQuaScore用于量化这些结构化事实单元的事实性。
AI.result: 经验评估表明TriQuaScore与人工标注的事实性评分高度一致，TriQua在分解质量上表现稳健，并在基于证据的事实验证任务上优于现有基于分解的框架。
AI.conclusion: TriQua通过自适应的事实结构建模成功兼顾了原子性和上下文保真，为LLM事实性评估提供了更精准且可解释的验证方案。

title: A Self-Explainable Deep Architecture for Security Applications
summary: Deep learning models have become integral to security applications due to their ability to model complex relationships in data and detect sophisticated threats. However, their complexity makes it difficult to understand how predictions are generated, posing significant challenges for interpretability, particularly in security applications where transparency is critical. Existing explanation methods, such as visual explanation techniques and post-hoc approaches, suffer from several limitations: reduced faithfulness due to local approximation errors, instability caused by reliance on randomness, and computational inefficiency that hinders real-time usage. To address these issues, we introduce XSec, a self-explainable deep architecture developed for security applications. During training, XSec uses a novel mask-based approach to extract informative sub-features from the data and learns prototypes, representative patterns that characterize each class. XSec then leverages the prototypes in a dedicated similarity layer at test time to compute similarity scores and generates interpretable explanations without the need for post-hoc analysis. We evaluate XSec across five diverse security scenarios, demonstrating its ability to achieve an average classification accuracy of 97.33% with minimal performance compromise. XSec produces deterministic explanations for a fixed trained model and input and substantially reduces explanation latency compared with approximation-based and perturbation-based post-hoc methods. Through this effort, we extend the applicability of self-explainable AI to security applications, bridging the gap between deep learning performance and the need for explainability in critical scenarios.

AI.tldr: XSec是一个面向安全应用的自解释深度架构，通过掩码机制提取关键子特征并学习类原型，在测试时利用相似度层生成确定性解释，无需事后分析。在五个安全场景中达到97.33%的平均分类准确率，同时大幅降低解释延迟。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在安全应用中至关重要，但其黑盒特性导致可解释性不足。现有解释方法（可视化技术、事后方法）存在三个主要缺陷：局部近似导致忠实度降低、依赖随机性导致不稳定、计算开销大难以实时使用。安全应用对透明性要求极高，亟需一种兼顾性能与可解释性的方案。
AI.method: XSec采用训练-测试两阶段设计。训练阶段：(1) 使用新颖的基于掩码的方法从数据中提取信息丰富的子特征；(2) 学习表征每个类别的原型（prototype）。测试阶段：通过专门的相似度层计算输入与学习到的原型之间的相似度分数，直接生成可解释的解释，无需任何事后分析（post-hoc）。
AI.result: 在五个不同的安全场景中评估，XSec实现了97.33%的平均分类准确率，性能损失极小；对固定的训练模型和输入产生确定性解释；与基于近似和基于扰动的传统事后方法相比，显著降低了解释延迟。
AI.conclusion: XSec将自解释AI的适用范围扩展到安全应用领域，弥合了深度学习高性能与关键场景可解释性需求之间的鸿沟，展示了无需事后分析即可同时获得高精度和透明解释的可行性。

title: ATP: Anatomical Torque with Passivity-based Control Framework for Safe Upper-Limb Exoskeleton Assistance
summary: Providing assistance across diverse movements is a central objective of exoskeletons, and anatomical knowledge can enable responsive support that generalizes across tasks. However, anatomical assistance has mainly been studied for lower-limb exoskeletons, where periodic, weight-bearing motions impose lower demands on torque precision. Extending such assistance to complex, nonperiodic upper-limb movements remains challenging. This paper proposes Anatomical Torque with Passivity-Based Control (ATP) for safe upper-limb exoskeleton assistance. First, a scalable musculoskeletal simulation framework trains a unified reinforcement-learning muscle controller that generalizes across upper-limb movements and generates anatomical reference torques without complex biomechanical computations. Second, an online torque-refinement scheme adapts the reference to diverse movements, suppresses tendon-induced spikes, and incorporates a learned anomaly score for safe and comfortable assistance. Third, an interaction torque controller delivers assistance through a cable-driven compliant exoskeleton without constraining motion to predefined trajectories, while an energy tank preserves passivity with theoretical guarantees on torque tracking and system passivity. Simulations and real-world experiments show accurate tracking of long-duration motion sequences and generalization to real-time human movements. The controller achieves accurate torque tracking while preserving passivity and resumes tracking after energy-tank replenishment. An EMG study with five participants further shows reduced target-muscle activity during static and dynamic tasks compared with gravity compensation and open-loop assistance, with reductions of up to 48% relative to movement without the exoskeleton in a dynamic multi-joint task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于解剖力矩与无源性控制（ATP）的上肢外骨骼辅助控制方法。该方法通过可扩展的肌肉骨骼仿真框架训练统一的强化学习肌肉控制器，生成跨多类上肢运动的解剖参考力矩；再利用在线力矩细化方案抑制肌腱尖峰并整合异常评分；最后通过线驱柔顺外骨骼接口实现力矩输送，并利用能量罐保证系统无源性。仿真与真实实验验证了长时程运动序列跟踪和实时人体运动泛化能力，EMG实验显示目标肌肉活动最多降低48%。
AI.motivation: 外骨骼辅助的核心目标是跨多样运动的响应式支持，解剖学知识可以提升泛化能力。然而，现有解剖辅助研究主要集中于下肢外骨骼（周期性、承重运动对力矩精度要求较低），将其拓展到复杂、非周期性的上肢运动仍具挑战。本文旨在解决上肢外骨骼解剖辅助中力矩精度与安全性的难题。
AI.method: 提出ATP控制框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 可扩展的肌肉骨骼仿真框架，训练统一的强化学习肌肉控制器以泛化多类上肢运动并生成解剖参考力矩（无需复杂生物力学计算）；(2) 在线力矩细化方案，自适应调整参考值以匹配多样运动、抑制肌腱诱发尖峰，并利用学习到的异常评分确保安全舒适；(3) 交互力矩控制器，通过线驱柔顺外骨骼输送辅助力矩而不约束运动至预定轨迹，能量罐机制保证系统无源性，并提供力矩跟踪与无源性的理论保证。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验表明，该方法能够准确跟踪长时间运动序列，并泛化至实时人体运动。控制器在保持无源性的同时实现精确力矩跟踪，并在能量罐补充后恢复跟踪。包含5名参与者的EMG研究表明，与重力补偿和开环辅助相比，在静态和动态任务中目标肌肉活动均有所降低；在动态多关节任务中，相对于无外骨骼运动，肌肉活动最多降低48%。
AI.conclusion: ATP框架成功将解剖学力矩辅助从下肢外骨骼拓展到复杂的上肢运动场景，通过强化学习肌肉控制器与无源性控制相结合，在保证安全性的前提下实现了精确的力矩跟踪和有效的肌肉活动降低，展示了非周期性复杂运动中解剖辅助的可行性与潜力。

title: MOSAIK: Multi-Patch Content-Aware Spatial Allocation of Image Tokens for Efficient Generation
summary: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the reconstruction ceiling of latent diffusion models by generating directly in image space. However, their substantially higher token count makes generation expensive due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Several existing efficiency methods reduce this cost by using larger patches at selected denoising steps, thereby representing the image with fewer tokens. Yet, each step still uses a single patch size uniformly across the entire image, overlooking that different regions suffer different fidelity losses when coarsened. We introduce MOSAIK, a damage-guided framework that varies patch size across regions and denoising steps. MOSAIK adapts the PixelDiT backbone to generate arbitrary heterogeneous patch layouts, and a lightweight predictor uses intermediate denoising features to estimate the fidelity loss caused by coarsening each region. Given a token budget, our damage-guided layout predictor assigns fine patches to sensitive regions and coarse patches elsewhere. Remarkably, while reducing FLOPs by 70% and token count by 83%, MOSAIK matches the full-compute PixelDiT on GenEval and its DPG-Bench score drops by only 1.0 point. Compared to diverse efficiency paradigms, including temporal patch scheduling and feature caching, our approach delivers highly competitive performance at moderate budgets and consistently outperforms these baselines in highly constrained compute regimes.

AI.tldr: MOSAIK是一种损伤引导的框架，通过在像素空间扩散模型中基于去噪中间特征动态分配不同大小的补丁（patch），在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低计算成本（FLOPs减少70%，token数量减少83%），并且与全计算PixelDiT在GenEval上性能持平，DPG-Bench仅下降1.0分。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散模型直接生成图像，避免了潜空间扩散模型的重建天花板问题，但其自注意力机制的二次复杂度导致生成成本高昂。现有的效率方法虽然通过在不同去噪步骤使用更大补丁减少token数量，但每个步骤对整个图像统一采用单一补丁大小，忽略了图像不同区域在粗化时遭受的保真度损失互不相同这一事实。
AI.method: MOSAIK框架包含两个核心组件：1) 改造PixelDiT骨干网络以支持任意异质补丁布局的生成；2) 一个轻量级预测器，利用中间去噪特征估计每个区域因粗化而造成的保真度损失。在给定token预算下，损伤引导的布局预测器将细粒度补丁分配给敏感区域，将粗粒度补丁分配给其他区域。
AI.result: 在减少70% FLOPs和83% token数量的情况下，MOSAIK在GenEval上匹配全计算量的PixelDiT，DPG-Bench分数仅下降1.0分。与多种效率方案（包括时间补丁调度和特征缓存）相比，MOSAIK在中等计算预算下具有高度竞争力，并在高度受限的计算条件下持续优于这些基线。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIK证明了在像素空间扩散模型中，通过在空间维度和时间维度联合、自适应地调整补丁粒度，可以在极端计算压缩下保持生成质量，为像素空间扩散模型的高效生成提供了一种新范式，其效果优于现有的时间补丁调度和特征缓存等效率方法。

title: Conditional Cognitive Biases in LLMs: How Biased User Turns Modulate In-Context Reasoning
summary: We present an evaluation of cognitive bias expression in state-of-the-art instruction-tuned LLMs under realistic multi-turn interaction settings. Our work introduces a novel three-condition experimental framework that disentangles the effect of exposure to a biased user turn from the effect of the turn's semantic content, alongside a benchmark of 24,300 jury-validated user prompts spanning all 81 cells of a 9x9 target-human bias interaction matrix. Across eight frontier LLMs, we find that biased conversational context systematically increases bias expression relative to zero-shot baselines in 6 of 8 models. We identify two competing behavioral dynamics underlying this effect: conversational exposure to biased reasoning generally amplifies downstream bias tendencies, while explicitly stated bias cues often trigger alignment-related suppression behaviors that reduce overt bias expression. We release our framework, codebase, and dataset to support future research on context-conditioned cognitive biases and behavioral adaptation in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了前沿指令微调大语言模型在多轮真实交互场景下的认知偏差表达，提出了一个三条件实验框架来区分用户偏置轮次暴露效应与语义内容效应，并在含24,300条经陪审团验证的提示、覆盖9×9目标-人类偏置交互矩阵全部81个单元的基准上进行了测试。结果发现，8个前沿模型中6个模型在偏置对话上下文下偏差表达系统性增加，且存在两种竞争性行为动态：对话暴露通常放大偏差，而显式偏置线索常触发对齐抑制从而减少偏差表达。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM认知偏差的研究主要集中在零样本或单轮设置下，缺乏对多轮真实交互场景中偏置如何影响模型表达的系统性评估。已有研究无法区分偏置暴露效应与其语义内容效应，也缺乏大规模、系统化的基准来覆盖不同偏置类型与不同人类目标之间的交互。
AI.method: 提出三条件实验框架，设计对照实验以分离用户偏置轮次暴露效应与语义内容效应；构建包含24,300条经陪审团验证的提示、覆盖9×9（9种目标×9种人类偏置）共81个单元格的偏置交互矩阵基准；对8个前沿LLM进行多轮对话场景下的系统性评估。
AI.result: 在8个前沿LLM中，6个模型在偏置对话上下文下偏差表达相对于零样本基线系统性增加。识别出两种竞争性行为动态：对话中暴露于偏置推理通常会放大下游偏差倾向；而显式表述的偏置线索往往触发对齐相关抑制行为，减少显式偏差表达。
AI.conclusion: LLM在真实多轮交互中会受到对话上下文偏置的显著影响，其表现介于"偏差放大"与"对齐抑制"两种动态之间。研究者公开了框架、代码库和数据集，以支持未来关于上下文条件化认知偏差和LLM行为适应的研究。

title: Coherence-Oriented Dream Scene Visualisation
summary: Dreams can be emotionally intense but difficult to communicate. We describe the Dream Scene Visualiser (DSV) system which turns written dream descriptions into a temporal sequence of four panel images visualising the dream. This starts with a large language model prompted to split a dream description into four chronological parts. Then a text-to-image model produces images for each part with visual coherence maintained across the sequence, and DSV regenerates any image not suitably matching the text. We evaluate DSV over 50 visualisations from dream descriptions in DreamBank, and report quality, fidelity and coherence results via objective measures employing the CLIP, DINOv2 and Qwen2-VL vision-language models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Dream Scene Visualiser (DSV)系统，该系统将书面梦境描述转化为包含四个时间序列面板的图像序列。系统使用大语言模型将梦境描述分为四个时间部分，再通过文本到图像模型生成图像，并在生成质量不佳时进行重新生成。作者使用CLIP、DINOv2和Qwen2-VL视觉语言模型，在DreamBank数据集的50个可视化结果上评估了质量、保真度和一致性。
AI.motivation: 梦境通常具有强烈的情感体验，但难以用语言准确传达。现有的文本到图像技术虽然能够生成图像，但尚未被应用于将梦境这类主观、叙事性强的内容可视化。该工作旨在解决梦境描述难以视觉化表达的问题，帮助人们更好地理解和分享梦境。
AI.method: DSV系统包含两个核心阶段：首先，使用大语言模型(LLM)将梦境描述按时间顺序拆分为四个部分；然后，使用文本到图像模型为每个部分生成图像，并通过再生机制确保每幅图像与对应文本的匹配。在评估阶段，采用CLIP、DINOv2和Qwen2-VL视觉语言模型从质量、保真度和一致性三个维度进行客观度量。
AI.result: 在DreamBank数据集的50个梦境可视化结果上，DSV展示了结合大语言模型与文本到图像模型进行梦境可视化的可行性，并通过客观度量报告了图像的生成质量、与文本的保真度以及序列间的一致性表现。
AI.conclusion: DSV系统验证了利用大语言模型进行叙事分解与文本到图像生成相结合的方法能够有效地将梦境描述转化为连贯的多面板可视化序列，为梦境等主观叙事内容的自动视觉化提供了可行的技术路径。

title: When Experience Becomes Instruction: Trajectory Poisoning in Self-Evolving Agent Skill Systems
summary: Self-evolving skill (SES) systems distill agent trajectories into persistent skills, allowing untrusted experience to become trusted instruction. We introduce PoisonedEvolution, a trajectory-poisoning attack on this promotion process. Our skill-visible black-box attacker can inspect a target skill and contribute bounded evidence, but cannot observe private pools or evolution logic or edit the skill bank. Artifact poisoning requires Inclusion, Evolution Attribution, and Realization. Attribution is the distinctive bottleneck: the target behavior must appear causally useful, recurrent, and generalizable before promotion. We evaluate four representative security-effect families using inert canary specifications. At 10% attacker support, across six mainstream LLM evolvers in SkillClaw, PoisonedEvolution embeds target behaviors in 546/600 trials (91.0% SER). On the structurally different Trace2Skill pipeline at the same ratio, it embeds target behaviors in 369/600 trials (61.5% SER), demonstrating transfer across evolution architectures. In a representative controlled study, three consistent attacker records suffice in a 30-record batch, whereas a single record is much weaker. Ablations identify recurring support, causal framing, and domain-aligned encoding as the main determinants of success. These findings expose evidence promotion as a security boundary for self-evolving agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PoisonedEvolution，一种针对自进化技能（SES）系统的轨迹投毒攻击，揭示了证据晋升机制是自进化智能体的安全边界。
AI.motivation: SES系统将智能体轨迹蒸馏为持久技能，使不可信的原始经验转化为可信的指令。这种"晋升"过程可能被攻击者利用——通过投毒轨迹来向技能库注入恶意行为。作者旨在证明这种晋升流程并非安全可靠的，并系统地探索其安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出一种技能可见的黑盒攻击者模型，攻击者可检查目标技能、贡献受限数量的证据，但无法观察私有池或进化逻辑。攻击需要满足三个条件：包含（Inclusion）、进化归因（Evolution Attribution）和实现（Realization），其中归因是关键瓶颈——目标行为必须在晋升前显得因果有用、具有重复性和泛化性。使用惰性canary规范评估四个安全效应族，在SkillClaw和Trace2Skill两个不同管道上验证。
AI.result: 在SkillClaw中，10%攻击者支持率下，六个主流LLM进化器上546/600次试验成功嵌入目标行为（91.0% SER）；在Trace2Skill管道上369/600次成功（61.5% SER），表明攻击可跨进化架构迁移。受控研究中，30条记录批次中三条一致的攻击者记录即可生效，单条记录效果很弱。消融实验确定重复支持、因果框架和领域对齐编码是成功的主要决定因素。
AI.conclusion: 证据晋升机制是自进化智能体不可或缺的安全边界，现有SES系统的晋升流程易受轨迹投毒攻击，需要重新审视其信任模型和安全设计。

title: Near-sensor Computing for Rapid Visuotactile Perception
summary: Visuotactile sensors reconstruct dense contact geometry from measured surface gradients, but host-based processing increases power consumption and introduces data-transfer delays and variable scheduling latency, limiting the sensing and response speed of robotic systems. To address these limitations, we implement a near-sensor computing framework that includes a spectral Poisson solver as a fully streaming hardware pipeline. The computational core logic has an estimated power consumption of 347 mW and achieves high throughput without data-dependent branching or iterative convergence, thereby providing deterministic latency. Operating at 166 MHz, the pipeline produces the first depth value of each 128x128 frame 35,107 cycles after receiving the first input pixel, corresponding to a fixed latency of 0.211 ms. Across 15 contact geometries, the reconstructed depths differ from a double-precision reference by 0.17 % of the peak contact depth. On-chip decisions based on these reconstructions close a robot protective reflex loop in 28.3 +/- 4.9 ms, compared with 169.9 +/- 27.8 ms for an equivalent host-based loop using the same actuator. These results demonstrate that near-sensor reconstruction can provide accurate, energy-efficient, and deterministic tactile geometry on timescales suitable for rapid robotic contact responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向视触觉传感器的近传感计算框架，通过全流式硬件流水线实现光谱泊松求解器，在166 MHz下以347 mW功耗实现128x128深度图重建，固定延迟0.211 ms，并将机器人保护性反射回路从宿主方案的169.9 ms缩短至28.3 ms，展示了准确、低功耗、确定性延迟的触觉几何重建能力。
AI.motivation: 视触觉传感器需要从表面梯度重建密集接触几何，但基于宿主处理器（host）的重建存在功耗高、数据传输延迟和调度延迟不确定等问题，限制了机器人系统的感知与响应速度，亟需一种低功耗、确定性延迟的近传感计算方案。
AI.method: 实现一个近传感计算框架，将光谱泊松求解器设计为全流式（fully streaming）硬件流水线。该流水线无数据依赖分支和迭代收敛过程，从而提供确定性延迟；以166 MHz时钟运行，基于重建结果在芯片上直接做出决策，闭环机器人保护性反射。
AI.result: 计算核心功耗约347 mW；流水线在收到首个输入像素后35,107个周期（即0.211 ms）产生每帧128x128的首个深度值；在15种接触几何下，重建深度与双精度参考的偏差仅为峰值接触深度的0.17%；芯片上决策闭环反射时间为28.3±4.9 ms，而等效宿主方案为169.9±27.8 ms。
AI.conclusion: 近传感重建能够在适合快速机器人接触响应的时间尺度内提供准确、节能且具有确定性延迟的触觉几何信息，有望成为高速机器人感知的重要计算范式。

title: CDSeg: A Renderable Gaussian Carrier for Image-to-3D Label Transfer
summary: Modern image models provide strong cues about \emph{what} should be segmented in each view, but their masks do not by themselves determine \emph{where} those labels should persist in 3D. We present Cross-Domain Segmentation via Gaussian Splatting (CDSeg), a label-transfer interface that requires no task-specific 3D segmentation training and uses Gaussian primitives as a renderable label carrier. An external mask source supplies the labels, while renderer-derived visibility determines which 3D primitives receive them. The carrier is instantiated either by completing each input point into one Gaussian, preserving its index, or by reusing the native primitives of an optimized Gaussian scene. CDSeg records pixel--primitive associations during rendering and fuses multi-view masks through voting and a local filter. The resulting labels can be returned to the original points, retained on the native Gaussian scene, or rendered into other views. CDSeg covers promptable, automatic instance, semantic, and LiDAR settings and processes scenes with millions of primitives in seconds. It obtains 92.35\% mIoU on DesktopObjects-360, 95.89\% on NeRDS-360, and 65.77\% on the full ScanNet-v2 validation split using the provided 2D semantic annotations. CDSeg thereby provides one interface for reusing 2D masks across point clouds, Gaussian scenes, and image views without a task-specific 3D segmentation network.

AI.tldr: CDSeg是一种基于高斯泼溅的跨域标签迁移接口，无需任务特定的3D分割训练，通过高斯基元作为可渲染标签载体，利用渲染器导出的可见性信息将外部2D掩码的标签关联到3D基元上，并通过多视图投票和局部滤波融合标签。在多个基准上取得优异性能（DesktopObjects-360达92.35% mIoU，NeRDS-360达95.89%，ScanNet-v2达65.77%），支持点云、高斯场景和图像视图间的标签复用。
AI.motivation: 现代图像模型能够很好地判断每个视图中"应该分割什么"（what），但无法自行确定这些标签在3D空间中"应该在哪里持续存在"（where）。现有方法通常需要任务特定的3D分割网络进行训练，这增加了复杂度和标注成本。作者希望构建一个无需3D分割训练的通用标签迁移接口，将2D掩码的语义信息无缝传递到3D表示中。
AI.method: CDSeg利用高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）作为核心框架：1) 实例化标签载体——将输入点云中的每个点补全为一个高斯基元（保留索引），或复用已优化的高斯场景中的原生基元；2) 在渲染过程中记录像素-基元关联关系，确定哪些3D基元可见；3) 通过渲染器导出的可见性信息将外部掩码源的标签分配给可见的3D基元；4) 通过多视图投票和局部滤波融合多视角掩码标签。该过程覆盖可提示、自动实例、语义和LiDAR等多种设定。
AI.result: CDSeg在DesktopObjects-360上达到92.35% mIoU，在NeRDS-360上达到95.89% mIoU，在完整ScanNet-v2验证集上使用提供的2D语义标注达到65.77% mIoU。能够在数秒内处理包含数百万基元的场景。
AI.conclusion: CDSeg提供了一个统一的接口，可以在无需任务特定3D分割网络的情况下，将2D掩码复用到点云、高斯场景和图像视图中，有效弥合了2D分割与3D场景理解之间的领域差距。

title: CNM-BERT: A Drop-In Structural Embedding for Chinese Characters via Ideographic Description Sequences
summary: Token-based encoders like BERT treat Chinese characters as atomic identifiers, ignoring their recursive orthographic structure. Consequently, models rely on contextual co-occurrence, degrading performance on rare and out-of-vocabulary (OOV) characters. We propose the Compositional Network Model (CNM), a lightweight augmentation that injects discrete compositional structure into Transformer encoders. CNM parses Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS) into trees, encodes them via a recursive Tree-MLP, and fuses the structural embeddings into BERT without modifying the backbone. Evaluated on the Wu et al. (2025) structural-probing benchmark, CNM-BERT outperforms the strongest baseline (ChineseBERT) on long-tail and OOV characters by +9.8 Structure accuracy and +7.7 Radical F1. Furthermore, CNM-BERT achieves consistent gains across CLUE, MRC, and NER tasks at both base and large scales, demonstrating that explicit structural injection delivers both robust OOV understanding and tangible downstream value.

AI.tldr: 提出组合网络模型（CNM），通过将汉字的意符描述序列（IDS）解析为树结构，并以递归Tree-MLP编码后注入BERT模型，从而增强模型对罕见字和未登录字的理解能力。CNM-BERT在结构探测基准上超越最强基线ChineseBERT，并在CLUE、MRC、NER等下游任务中均取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 基于token的编码器（如BERT）将汉字视为原子标识符，忽略了其递归的字形结构，导致模型只能依赖上下文共现信息，在罕见字和未登录字（OOV）上表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出组合网络模型（CNM），一种轻量级增强方法：将意符描述序列（IDS）解析为树结构，使用递归Tree-MLP进行编码，然后将结构嵌入融合进Transformer编码器（BERT）中，且不修改BERT主干结构。
AI.result: 在Wu等人(2025)的结构探测基准上，CNM-BERT相比最强基线ChineseBERT，在长尾和OOV字符上Structure accuracy提升+9.8，Radical F1提升+7.7；在CLUE、MRC、NER任务上，base和large两个规模下均取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 显式注入汉字组合结构不仅带来稳健的OOV理解能力，还能在实际下游任务中产生可观的性能提升，证明了结构注入方法的有效性。

title: Quantum-Structured World Models (QSWMs) for Predictive Latent Dynamics
summary: World models learn latent states that summarize interaction histories, evolve over time, and support prediction, simulation, or planning. Most existing world models represent these states using classical vectors, probability distributions, recurrent hidden states, or transformer activations. In this paper, we introduce Quantum-Structured World Models (QSWMs), a quantum-inspired framework for predictive world modeling with structured latent states, latent transition operators, and measurement-inspired decoding maps. We study whether mathematical structures inspired by quantum theory, such as complex-valued representations and density-matrix-like latents, provide useful inductive biases for world modeling. We establish three foundational properties: classical inclusion, predictive sufficiency, and structured compactness. We then instantiate complex-valued and density-matrix-like QSWM variants and evaluate them on elementary cellular automata against strong classical baselines. Results show promising local predictive potential for complex-valued QSWMs, while also revealing limitations in long-horizon rollout, density-matrix variants

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子结构化世界模型（QSWMs），探索量子理论启发的数学结构（复值表示、密度矩阵式潜在状态）是否为世界建模提供有用的归纳偏置，并在元胞自动机任务上与经典基线对比，发现复值变体在局部预测上表现有潜力，但在长程滚动预测和密度矩阵变体上存在局限。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型大多使用经典向量、概率分布、循环隐藏状态或Transformer激活来表示潜在状态，尚未系统研究量子理论启发的数学结构（如复值表示和密度矩阵式潜在状态）是否能提供更优的归纳偏置来捕捉交互历史的演化规律。
AI.method: 提出量子结构化世界模型（QSWMs）框架，包含结构化潜在状态、潜在转移算子、以及基于测量的解码映射。建立三个基础性质：经典包含性（classical inclusion）、预测充分性（predictive sufficiency）和结构紧凑性（structured compactness）。实例化复值变体和密度矩阵式变体，在初等元胞自动机任务上与强经典基线进行对比评估。
AI.result: 复值QSWM在局部预测方面展现出有前景的潜力，但在长时程滚动预测上存在局限；密度矩阵式变体表现不理想。
AI.conclusion: 量子启发的复值表示在局部预测中可提供有益的归纳偏置，但当前框架在长时程预测和密度矩阵变体方面仍有待改进，提示量子结构带来的收益可能具有任务依赖性。

title: Search2Skill: Skill Distillation Beyond Knowledge Boundaries Via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reusable skills, which encapsulate the procedural knowledge required to solve real-world professional tasks, offer LLM-based agents a path toward self-evolution in expert domains. Existing self-evolving skill methods construct skills internally from the model's parametric knowledge or trajectories, and are therefore bounded by what the model already knows. However, the domain conventions and standard procedures underlying professional skills often lie beyond this boundary and are hard to elicit from the agent alone. To address this issue, we therefore propose a novel framework, Search2Skill, that automatically identifies the agent's capability gaps, searches external sources to address them, and distills the retrieved evidence into structured, reusable skills. Specifically, Search2Skill is optimized by a rubric-based reinforcement learning scheme that jointly improves when to search, how to search, and how to generate skills. Experiments on eight expert-level domains from three benchmarks show that Search2Skill consistently outperforms both search-augmented and trajectory-based skill-learning baselines under both streaming and held-out evaluation protocols. Further analyses show that the gains arise from skill abstraction rather than raw retrieved evidence, and that the acquired skills transfer across model scales.

AI.tldr: Search2Skill是一个新颖的框架，通过自动识别智能体的能力缺口、搜索外部资源填补缺口，并将检索到的证据提炼为结构化可复用技能，从而突破LLM智能体在专家领域自进化的知识边界。该方法采用基于规则的强化学习方案，联合优化搜索时机、搜索方式和技能生成策略。在三个基准的八个专家级领域上的实验表明，Search2Skill在流式和留出评估协议下均一致优于搜索增强和基于轨迹的技能学习基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化技能方法仅从模型参数化知识或轨迹中内部构建技能，受制于模型已知知识的边界。然而，专家领域的领域惯例和标准程序往往超出这一边界，难以仅靠智能体自身引出，因此需要外部知识源来弥补这一能力缺口。
AI.method: Search2Skill框架包含三个关键步骤：自动识别智能体的能力缺口、搜索外部资源以填补这些缺口、将检索到的证据蒸馏为结构化可复用的技能。框架核心由一个基于规则（rubric）的强化学习方案驱动，该方案联合优化三个决策维度：何时搜索、如何搜索以及如何生成技能。
AI.result: 在三个基准的八个专家级领域上，Search2Skill在流式和留出评估协议下均一致优于两种类型的基线方法（搜索增强基线和基于轨迹的技能学习基线）。进一步分析表明，性能提升来源于技能抽象而非原始检索证据本身，且学到的技能可跨模型规模迁移。
AI.conclusion: Search2Skill证明了外部知识搜索与技能抽象提炼相结合可以有效突破LLM智能体在专家领域的自进化知识边界，其学得的技能不仅带来性能提升，还具有良好的跨模型规模迁移性，为LLM智能体的专家领域自我进化提供了新范式。

title: Detecting Safety Training Modification in Language Models via Activation Analysis
summary: We introduce AMS (Activation-based Model Scanner), a tool that detects modifications to safety training in language models by measuring the geometric structure of safety-relevant concepts in activation space. Safety training creates measurable separation between harmful and benign content classes; certain safety modifications collapse or rotate this structure, while others leave it intact. We validate AMS across 14 model configurations spanning 4 architecture families (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, Mistral) and four safety-modification categories (instruction-tuned, base, abliterated, uncensored fine-tunes). Leave-one-out cross-validation of thresholds achieves 71% accuracy (10/14); bootstrap 95% confidence intervals on sigma point estimates have median width 3.4 sigma. We measure behavioral compliance on 20 stratified JailbreakBench prompts per model and find that sigma on the harmful-content concept predicts compliance with Pearson r = -0.546 (p = 0.043), directionally but with meaningful noise. Mechanistic analysis identifies a four-class taxonomy of safety-training modifications distinguished by activation-space signature: training removal collapses cluster separation; weight-orthogonalization abliteration both collapses separation and rotates the refusal direction; rotation-without-collapse abliteration preserves separation while rotating direction; and behavioral fine-tuning preserves both magnitude and direction. AMS's Tier 1 sigma-threshold detects the first two classes; Tier 2 direction-similarity verification detects the third. The fourth is undetectable by activation-only probing and represents a documented failure mode. We discuss threshold calibration, limitations of single-run measurement, and the open problem of detecting behavioral-only safety modifications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AMS（基于激活的模型扫描器），通过测量安全相关概念在激活空间中的几何结构来检测语言模型安全训练被修改的情况，在14种模型配置和4种安全修改类别上验证，准确率71%，并识别出四类安全训练修改的激活空间特征谱系。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型广泛部署，安全训练可能会被各种手段（如去消融、未经审查的微调）悄悄移除或破坏。现有方法难以有效检测这些安全修改，需要一种基于模型内部表征的检测工具来识别安全训练是否被篡改。
AI.method: AMS通过测量激活空间中安全相关概念的几何结构（有害/良性内容类别之间的分离程度及拒绝方向）来检测安全修改。使用sigma点估计衡量类别分离度，并采用Tier 1（sigma阈值）和Tier 2（方向相似性验证）两级检测机制。在4个架构家族（Llama、Gemma、Qwen、Mistral）和4种安全修改类别（指令微调、基础模型、去消融、未审查微调）上进行验证，采用留一法交叉验证和bootstrap置信区间。
AI.result: 留一法交叉验证达到71%准确率（10/14）；bootstrap 95%置信区间sigma点估计中位宽度为3.4 sigma。在20个分层JailbreakBench提示上，有害内容概念的sigma与行为合规性的Pearson相关系数为r=-0.546（p=0.043），方向性相关但噪声较大。
AI.conclusion: AMS识别出四类安全训练修改：训练移除（塌缩聚类分离）、权重正交化去消融（塌缩分离并旋转拒绝方向）、旋转而不塌缩的去消融（保持分离但旋转方向）、行为微调（保持幅度和方向）。Tier 1可检测前两类，Tier 2可检测第三类，第四类无法通过纯激活探测检测，是已记录到的失败模式。文章讨论了阈值校准、单次测量的局限性和行为-only安全修改检测这一开放问题。

title: In-Context VLA: Endowing Vision-Language-Action Models with Language via In-Context Post-Training and Agentic Tool Use
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become the dominant recipe for generalist manipulation, yet they are almost universally trained by behavior cloning: a policy imitates expert action chunks conditioned on a static image and a fixed instruction. A natural remedy is to inject explicit reasoning through textual chain-of-thought (CoT). We show, both empirically and analytically, that free-form textual CoT degrades low-level control: the reasoning it produces is ungrounded, its latency breaks closed-loop timing, and, crucially, the reasoning and action tokens are optimized against conflicting objectives so that the policy learns to narrate rather than to act. We argue that what a VLA needs is not the ability to generate language, but the ability to consume grounded language. To this end we introduce \textbf{\ourmethod{}}, a framework that endows a VLA with language competence through (i) in-context post-training, in which perceptual evidence is injected as structured context and the model is supervised only on actions, and (ii) an agentic tool-use interface, in which the policy queries open-vocabulary detectors, monocular depth, and a vision--language model to actively acquire task-relevant information. Rather than emitting a single templated caption, our data engine produces diverse, paraphrased, and evidence-conditioned spatial descriptions, so that the policy learns to interpret language it has never seen verbatim. Across the RoboCasa-GR1, SimplerEnv, and LIBERO simulation benchmarks, together with 8 real-world robot manipulation tasks, our method consistently achieves SOTA results in both performance and efficiency when compared with CoT-based approaches under matched configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个名为\ourmethod{}的框架，通过"注入式的上下文后训练"和"智能体工具调用接口"赋予VLA模型语言理解能力而非生成能力，在RoboCasa-GR1、SimplerEnv、LIBERO模拟基准及8个真实机器人操作任务上均达到SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型普遍采用行为克隆训练，而其改进思路——注入自由文本链式推理（CoT）——存在根本性问题：推理文本缺乏接地（ungrounded）、延迟破坏闭环时序，且推理与动作token优化目标冲突导致模型学会"叙述"而非"行动"。因此需要一种不产生语言、但能消费接地语言的VLA方案。
AI.method: 该方法包含两个核心组件：(i) 上下文后训练（in-context post-training），将感知证据作为结构化上下文注入，且仅对动作token进行监督；(ii) 智能体工具调用接口（agentic tool-use interface），策略可主动查询开放词表检测器、单目深度和VLM以获取任务相关信息。数据引擎生成多样化、改写化、证据条件化的空间描述，使策略学会理解从未逐字见过的语言。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa-GR1、SimplerEnv、LIBERO三个模拟基准以及8个真实机器人操作任务上，该框架在匹配配置下相比于基于CoT的方法在性能和效率两方面均取得SOTA结果。
AI.conclusion: VLA模型需要的是"消费"接地语言的能力而非"生成"语言的能力。通过上下文后训练与工具调用接口，可以同时解决CoT带来的接地性、延迟和优化冲突问题，在提升性能的同时保持效率。

title: VideoArgus: Agentic Rubric-Grounded Unified Evaluation for Video Generation and Editing
summary: Evaluating generated videos remains challenging because existing benchmarks rely on fixed evaluation content, cover only a subset of generation and editing settings, and provide limited evidence for their scores. We introduce VideoArgus, a unified rubric-grounded framework covering five video generation and editing settings. For each input instance, VideoArgus generates an output-blind, sample-specific rubric once and reuses it to evaluate all corresponding candidate videos. The rubric defines concrete criteria, scoring rules, failure modes, and evidence plans, which guide criterion-specific VLM QA and visual tools to produce evidence-grounded criterion scores, rationales, and a diagnostic report. We further construct VideoArgus-Bench, containing 1,026 curated input instances built from 653 high-quality images and 416 high-quality videos, with all benchmark rubrics pre-generated, frozen, and released. On a separate 1,260-video human-alignment set, VideoArgus achieves higher within-input Spearman and Kendall correlations with human judgments than the corresponding benchmark-specific evaluators across all five tasks. Model rankings also remain largely consistent across different rubric-generation and evaluation-VLM backbones. All code and data are released. Visit our project page: https://zzzmyyzeng.github.io/VideoArgus

AI.tldr: 提出了VideoArgus，一个统一基于评分标准（rubric）的视频评估框架，覆盖五种视频生成与编辑场景。它为每个输入实例生成一次输出盲的、样本特定的评分标准，并用其评估所有候选视频。还构建了包含1026个精选输入实例的VideoArgus-Bench数据集，在1260个视频的人类对齐集上超越各基准专用评估器，且模型排名在不同骨干下保持一致。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成评估基准存在三个局限：依赖固定评估内容、仅覆盖部分生成与编辑设置、评分证据不足。这些限制导致评估结果缺乏通用性和可解释性。
AI.method: VideoArgus为每个输入实例生成一次输出盲（output-blind）且样本特定（sample-specific）的评分标准，并复用于评估所有对应候选视频。评分标准包含具体标准、评分规则、失败模式和证据计划，引导基于标准的VLM问答和视觉工具产生有证据支撑的标准分数、理由及诊断报告。同时构建VideoArgus-Bench基准数据集（1026个实例，源自653张图像和416个视频），所有评分标准预先生成、冻结并发布。
AI.result: 在1260个视频的人类对齐评测集上，VideoArgus在全部五项任务中，与人类判断的输入内Spearman和Kendall相关系数均高于对应基准专用评估器。模型排名在不同评分标准生成和评估VLM骨干下保持大致一致。
AI.conclusion: VideoArgus提供了一个统一、有证据支撑且覆盖面广的视频生成与编辑评估框架，优于各任务专用评估器，具备良好的鲁棒性，并将全部代码与数据开源。

title: ConWriter: Transition-Constrained Stateful Long-Form Story Generation with Lightweight Neuro-Symbolic Consistency Control
summary: Long-form story generation requires models to preserve narrative consistency across extended contexts, yet existing prompting-based methods often accumulate temporal, factual, character, commonsense, and stylistic errors as the story grows. We propose ConWriter, a training-free framework for consistency-aware long story generation. ConWriter writes stories incrementally at the scene level, guided by static story requirements, dynamic narrative memory, symbolic state reasoning, and uncertainty-aware risk signals. Rather than treating long-story generation as a single free-form decoding process, ConWriter maintains evolving story states, checks whether new scenes satisfy required narrative transitions, and uses uncertainty-aware risk signals to prioritize validation and localized repair. This enables consistency control during generation, before local errors propagate into later scenes. We evaluate ConWriter on ConStory-Bench, covering four long-story tasks: continuation, generation, expansion, and completion. Due to the high cost of long-form generation and evaluation, we use the first five cases from each task and test 3k, 6k, and 12k target lengths across Qwen3.5-Plus, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and GPT-5 series. Experiments follow the official ConStory-Bench evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: ConWriter是一个无需训练的、面向长故事生成的场景级一致性控制框架，通过静态需求、动态叙事记忆、符号状态推理和不确定性感知的风险信号，在错误传播之前进行验证和局部修复。在ConStory-Bench上覆盖续写、生成、扩写、完形四类任务，跨三个模型系列和三种目标长度进行评测。
AI.motivation: 长故事生成要求模型在扩展上下文中保持叙事一致性，但现有基于提示的方法在故事增长时容易累积时序、事实、角色、常识和风格错误。这些错误一旦产生就会传播到后续场景，需要一种能够在生成过程中主动控制一致性的方法。
AI.method: ConWriter以场景为单位增量写作，由四部分指导：静态故事需求、动态叙事记忆、符号状态推理、以及不确定性感知的风险信号。它维护不断演化的故事状态，检查新场景是否满足必要的叙事转换，并利用风险信号来确定验证和局部修复的优先级，从而在局部错误传播到后续场景之前进行干预。
AI.result: 在ConStory-Bench上对四类长故事任务（续写、生成、扩写、完形）进行评估，每类任务取前5个案例，测试3k/6k/12k三种目标长度，覆盖Qwen3.5-Plus、DeepSeek-V4-Flash和GPT-5系列模型，遵循官方评测协议。
AI.conclusion: ConWriter将长故事生成从单一的自由解码过程转变为受控的增量生成过程，通过场景级的一致性检查和主动修复，在错误传播扩散之前实现一致性控制。实验结果将验证该方法在多种模型和长度设置下的有效性。

title: Spectral Distillation: From Nonlinear Dynamics to Linear State-Space Models
summary: Can nonlinear dynamical systems be learned through a compact linear state-space representation, without directly solving a non-convex system-identification problem? We give a provable pipeline for doing so. Starting from observations of an unknown nonlinear dynamical system, we first learn an implicit spectral predictor using Observation Spectral Filtering (OSF), a convex method that competes with the best linear observer for the system. We then apply spectral-to-LDS distillation to convert this predictor into an explicit recurrent linear dynamical system. Our main theorem shows that the average prediction error of the distilled LDS decomposes into an exponentially-small distillation term and the OSF learning term governed by the Luenberger complexity of the best observer. The guarantee is dimension-free: it depends on observer complexity rather than on the latent dimension needed to represent the nonlinear system. To our knowledge, this yields the first end-to-end provable method for extracting a best-in-hindsight LDS representation of nonlinear dynamics through convex learning followed by provable distillation. Experiments on linear LDS benchmarks and MuJoCo behavior cloning show that the train-then-distill pipeline produces compact LDS predictors that match or outperform directly trained baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过凸学习加可证明蒸馏的pipeline，将非线性动力系统学习为紧凑的线性状态空间表示（LDS）。首先使用观测谱滤波（OSF）学习隐式谱预测器，再通过谱到LDS蒸馏将其转化为显式的循环线性动力系统。主要定理表明蒸馏后LDS的平均预测误差分解为指数级小的蒸馏项和由Luenberger复杂度决定的OSF学习项，且该保证与维度无关。实验在LDS基准和MuJoCo行为克隆上验证了该方法匹配或超越直接训练的基线。
AI.motivation: 直接求解非线性系统辨识需要非凸优化，缺乏可证明的保证。作者希望找到一条可证明的路径，通过凸方法学习非线性动力系统的紧凑线性状态空间表示，避免直接求解非凸问题。
AI.method: 提出两阶段pipeline：1）观察谱滤波（OSF）：一种凸方法，从非线性系统的观测中学习隐式谱预测器，与最优线性观测器竞争；2）谱到LDS蒸馏：将隐式预测器转化为显式的循环线性动力系统。理论分析表明预测误差分解为指数级小的蒸馏项和由Luenberger复杂度控制的学习项。
AI.result: 主要定理证明蒸馏后的LDS平均预测误差由蒸馏项（指数级小）和OSF学习项（由最优观测器的Luenberger复杂度决定）组成。该保证是维度无关的，取决于观测器复杂度而非非线性系统表示所需的潜在维度。实验表明该pipeline在LDS基准和MuJoCo行为克隆上匹配或优于直接训练的基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是首个端到端可证明的方法，通过凸学习加可证明蒸馏提取非线性动力学的最优事后LDS表示。方法在理论和实验上均验证有效，为非线性系统辨识提供了一条可证明的新途径。

title: LUNAR: Benchmarking Personalized Large Language Models on UNiversal User BehAvioR Logs
summary: Existing personalized LLM benchmarks primarily rely on textual personas or isolated behavioral signals, providing limited evaluation of cross-domain behavioral personalization, where responses must be grounded in heterogeneous daily-life activities. To address this gap, we introduce LUNAR, the first benchmark for evaluating how LLMs personalize responses from longitudinal app interaction histories across universal daily-life domains, including clothing, food, housing, and mobility. To support scalable benchmark construction while mitigating data sparsity and privacy concerns, LUNAR uses a multi-stage coarse-to-fine synthesis pipeline grounded in real-world behavioral patterns. Fidelity analyses show closer alignment with real behavioral distributions than other synthetic benchmarks. Experiments on 19 mainstream LLMs show that access to behavioral logs is necessary but not sufficient for deep personalization: neither more context nor larger models guarantees better performance; effective personalization depends on selecting and integrating relevant evidence across domains. Direct retrieval of fine-grained behavioral records consistently outperforms compressed memory, while stronger personalization can come at the cost of privacy protection. These findings identify evidence selection, cross-domain integration, and privacy control as key challenges for personalized LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LUNAR，这是首个基于纵向应用交互历史来评估LLM跨领域行为个性化能力的基准，覆盖衣、食、住、行四大日常生活领域。在19个主流LLM上的实验表明，访问行为日志对深度个性化是必要但不充分的，有效个性化依赖于跨领域证据的选择与整合。
AI.motivation: 现有的个性化LLM基准主要依赖文本人物设定或孤立的单行为信号，缺乏对跨领域行为个性化（即响应必须基于异构的日常生活活动）的评估。作者旨在填补这一空白，构建一个能够真实反映用户行为习惯的跨领域个性化评估基准。
AI.method: LUNAR采用多阶段、从粗到细的合成流水线，基于真实世界行为模式来构建基准，以支持可扩展的基准构建，同时缓解数据稀疏和隐私问题。通过保真度分析验证合成数据与真实行为分布的一致性，并在19个主流LLM上进行系统实验。
AI.result: 实验发现：访问行为日志对个性化是必要但不充分的；更多的上下文或更大的模型并不保证更好的性能；有效的个性化取决于跨领域选取和整合相关证据；直接检索细粒度行为记录始终优于压缩记忆；更强的个性化可能以牺牲隐私保护为代价。
AI.conclusion: 证据选择、跨领域整合和隐私控制是个性化LLM面临的三大关键挑战，为未来个性化LLM的研究方向提供了重要指引。

title: Enhancing Anomaly Resilience in Research Networks: A Large-Scale Forecasting Benchmark for Dynamic Security Baselining
summary: Research and Education Networks (RENs) serve as critical infrastructure for scientific discovery, yet they face a unique security paradox: their normal traffic patterns which are characterized by massive, bursty "elephant flows" are statistically indistinguishable from volumetric attacks such as DDoS to conventional monitoring systems. This similarity leads to high false-positive rates in anomaly detection, blinding security operators to genuine threats. In this paper, we propose and evaluate a high-fidelity traffic forecasting framework designed to establish dynamic security baselines for RENs. Leveraging an exclusive 57-day Internet2 dataset spanning ten backbone routers (13.7 billion packets), we perform the first large-scale benchmark of anomaly-aware forecasting models in this domain. We systematically evaluate six model families, from SARIMA to state-of-the-art long-sequence architectures (TiDE, PatchTST), across 960 experimental configurations. Our results demonstrate that these advanced architectures, particularly TiDE, reduce baseline prediction error by 30-42% compared to traditional methods ($p < 0.001$), significantly improving the distinction between legitimate scientific bursts and potential anomalies. Furthermore, we introduce a novel anomaly-integration strategy that improves model robustness by 3.3% in the presence of noise. This work provides the first statistically validated framework for distinguishing scientific workflows from network attacks, enabling more autonomous and resilient network security operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一个面向科研教育网络（RENs）的高保真流量预测框架，用以建立动态安全基线。基于涵盖10个骨干路由器、137亿包、57天的Internet2数据集，系统比较了六类模型族（从SARIMA到TiDE、PatchTST等长序列架构），在960种实验配置下验证了先进架构（尤其TiDE）可降低30-42%的基线预测误差，并引入异常集成策略使模型鲁棒性提升3.3%。该工作首次为区分科研工作流与网络攻击提供了统计验证框架。
AI.motivation: 科研教育网络面临独特的安全悖论：正常的突发性"大象流"流量模式在统计上与DDoS等体量型攻击对传统监控系统不可区分，导致异常检测误报率高，使安全运营人员无法察觉真实威胁。
AI.method: 利用独家57天Internet2数据集（覆盖10个骨干路由器、137亿数据包），构建异常感知的流量预测框架；系统评估六类模型族（SARIMA至TiDE、PatchTST等长序列架构），共960种实验配置，并引入新颖的异常集成策略以提升噪声环境下的模型鲁棒性。
AI.result: 先进架构（尤其TiDE）相比传统方法可将基线预测误差降低30-42%（p<0.001），显著改善合法科研突发流量与潜在异常之间的区分度；异常集成策略在噪声存在条件下使模型鲁棒性提升3.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次提供了统计验证的框架，用于区分科研工作流与网络攻击，支持更自主和更具弹性的网络安全运营。

title: Acoustic-driven millimetric helical robot: ultrasonic synergistic manipulation in confined fluidic environment
summary: Acoustic field-driven manipulation provides a non-contact and non-invasive strategy for controlling microscale and nanoscale objects, yet its extension to millimeter-scale robots was limited by insufficient propulsion efficiency in confined biological environments. Here, a coordinated multi-acoustic-field approach is introduced, which harnesses the synergistic action of acoustic radiation forces and acoustic streaming flows to enable controlled locomotion of millimeter-scale helical robots and enhance propulsion. Multiphysics simulations captured the dynamics of millimeter-scale helical robots under combined acoustic fields, and experimental validation demonstrated their locomotion capabilities, including planar navigation, inclined climbing, and vertical motion. Semi-autonomous navigation experiments further confirmed that ultrasonic synergy substantially improved maneuverability. In vitro tests in porcine venous vessels demonstrated that coordinated acoustic fields supported both unidirectional and reciprocating motion under biologically relevant confinement. These findings provide mechanistic insight into scaling acoustic micromanipulation to the millimetre regime and support biomedical applications requiring versatile and controllable robotic mobility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种协调多声场方法，利用声辐射力和声流效应的协同作用，实现毫米级螺旋机器人在受限生物环境中的可控运动，并通过仿真、实验和体外猪静脉实验验证了其推进性能与机动性提升。
AI.motivation: 声场驱动操控为微纳尺度物体提供非接触、无创的控制手段，但将其扩展到毫米级机器人时存在推进效率不足的问题，特别是在受限生物环境中，这限制了其在生物医学领域的应用。
AI.method: 提出协调多声场方法，协同利用声辐射力与声流效应；通过多物理场仿真捕捉毫米级螺旋机器人在组合声场下的动力学；结合实验验证平面导航、斜面爬升和垂直运动能力；并进行半自主导航和体外猪静脉血管实验验证。
AI.result: 实验证明协调声场显著提升毫米级螺旋机器人的机动性；半自主导航实验确认超声协同作用改善操控能力；离体猪静脉实验中，协调声场在生理相关受限条件下支持单向和往复运动。
AI.conclusion: 研究为将声学微操控扩展到毫米尺度提供了机理层面的认识，支持需要多功能、可控机器人运动能力的生物医学应用。

title: APQF: Agentic Profiling-Guided Structured Pruning and Mixed-Precision Quantization with Adaptive Fine-Tuning
summary: Modern deep neural networks achieve strong performance, but their scale makes them costly and slow, especially on resource-constrained edge devices. Pruning and quantization address this, but rely on manual, expert choices and on algorithms that are hard to apply across architectures. Uniform settings also ignore how differently individual layers respond to compression, which costs accuracy. We introduce APQF, an agentic profiling-guided framework that combines structured pruning, mixed-precision quantization-aware training, and accuracy recovery in one automated pipeline. A profiling agent measures how cost is distributed across the model and how sensitive each part is to pruning, and this evidence drives per-layer pruning ratios, per-layer bit-widths, and the recovery strategy, all proposed by LLM planners and validated before execution. To our knowledge, APQF is the first framework to combine LLM-guided, profiling-grounded decisions with a fully training-aware pruning and quantization pipeline for both CNNs and vision transformers. We evaluate APQF on ResNet, VGG7, ViT, DeiT, and Swin using ImageNet-1k and CIFAR-10. On ImageNet it cuts compute to 5.6-7.7 percent of the original bit-operations, a 13-18x reduction, while keeping accuracy close to the baseline, and under a 200K-image budget it stays roughly 17 points higher in Top-1 than existing joint pruning and quantization methods. On CIFAR-10 it compresses further than that method on four of five architectures. On VGG7 it reaches 93.15 percent using only 0.41 percent of baseline bit-operations, the only method at that compression level to improve on its full-precision baseline. Ablations show that uniform compression loses the most accuracy at matched compute, and that withholding profiling data from the planner hurts every model. Six LLM planners, including free open-weight ones, all reach 97.4-97.9 percent on Swin-Tiny.

AI.tldr: APQF是一个由LLM驱动的、基于剖析信息的智能框架，结合结构剪枝、混合精度量化感知训练和精度恢复，在自动化管道中为CNN和视觉Transformer实现高效模型压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有的剪枝和量化方法依赖人工专家选择和难以跨架构推广的算法，且统一的压缩设置忽略了不同层对压缩的差异化响应，导致精度损失严重。
AI.method: APQF包含一个剖析智能体，测量模型成本分布和每部分对剪枝的敏感性，据此由LLM规划器提出逐层剪枝比例、逐层位宽及恢复策略，验证后才执行。整个流程将结构剪枝、混合精度量化感知训练和精度恢复统一在一个自动化管道中。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上将计算量降至原有bit-operations的5.6%-7.7%（13-18倍压缩），在200K图像预算下Top-1精度比现有联合剪枝量化方法高约17个点；CIFAR-10上在四种架构中压缩更优；VGG7达到93.15%精度且仅用0.41% bit-operations。消融实验表明均匀压缩在匹配计算量下精度损失最大，缺少剖析数据会损害所有模型。
AI.conclusion: APQF是首个将LLM引导、剖析驱动的决策与完全训练感知的剪枝量化管道相结合的统一框架，在CNN和视觉Transformer上均实现了显著的压缩比和精度保持。

title: DREAM: LLM-based Dynamic Role-playing via Event-Aware Memory Graph
comment: Accepted at KDD 2026. Camera-ready version to appear. 16 pages, 5 figures
summary: Role-playing agents (RPAs) have emerged as a key application of large language models, enabling immersive and high-fidelity character simulation. Accurate role-playing of established characters requires not only stylistic imitation but also temporally consistent and causally grounded behavioral reasoning. However, existing RPAs primarily rely on static character descriptions and unstructured memory, limiting their ability to maintain long-term narrative and personality coherence. We introduce DREAM, a structured memory framework for role-playing agents inspired by the Activating Event-Belief-Consequence (ABC) cognitive model. DREAM transforms unstructured literary text into an Event-aware Memory Graph (EMG) that organizes character experiences into temporally ordered and causally linked event graph. This representation enables the construction of dynamic, dual-granularity character profiles that capture both stable personality traits and event-driven behavioral evolution. We further propose the Temporal Causal Memory (TCM) benchmark to evaluate temporal consistency and long-range causal narrative coherence. DREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance across CoSER, LIFECHOICE, and TCM, outperforming multiple strong baselines. Our approach demonstrates the effectiveness of structured memory in enhancing the interpretability and consistency of role-playing agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DREAM，一种受ABC认知模型启发的结构化记忆框架，通过事件感知记忆图（EMG）将角色经历组织为时间有序且因果关联的事件图，构建动态双粒度角色画像，并引入时间因果记忆（TCM）基准来评估角色的时间一致性和长程因果叙事连贯性。DREAM在CoSER、LIFECHOICE和TCM基准上均达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有角色扮演代理主要依赖静态角色描述和非结构化记忆，难以维持长期叙事与人格一致性，缺乏对角色行为进行时间一致性和因果推理建模的能力。
AI.method: 基于ABC认知模型，将非结构化文学文本转换为事件感知记忆图（EMG），以时间有序和因果关联的事件图为表征，构建捕捉稳定人格特质与事件驱动行为演化的动态双粒度角色画像。
AI.result: 在CoSER、LIFECHOICE和TCM基准上超越多个强基线，达到最先进性能，证明结构化记忆能增强角色扮演代理的解释性和一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化记忆框架能有效提升角色扮演代理在时间一致性和长程因果叙事连贯性方面的表现，展示了结构化方法在角色一致性建模中的潜力。

title: Perturbation Sensitivity at Convergence: A Simple Signal for Identifying Spuriously Correlated Samples
summary: Models trained by empirical risk minimization on data containing spurious correlations achieve high average accuracy while failing on subpopulations where the correlation does not hold. Existing methods for identifying the affected samples without group annotations rely on signals from early training, which requires locating the epoch at which to intervene, a hyperparameter typically selected using group-labeled validation data. We show that a usable signal is available after convergence, when loss no longer distinguishes the two populations. Samples consistent with the spurious correlation are classified by a shared rule, while the remaining samples are fit through configurations specific to individual inputs and are correspondingly more fragile. Applying a fixed perturbation to a converged model's inputs flips the predictions of the latter far more often than the former. The resulting procedure requires two forward passes per training sample, no group annotations at any stage, and no early-stopping epoch. Using the detected samples to rebalance training raises worst-group accuracy on Waterbirds from 57.3% to 80.8%, against 85.8% with ground-truth group labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需组标注的伪相关子群体识别方法，利用收敛后模型对输入施加固定扰动时预测翻转的差异来区分受伪相关影响的样本（共用一个分类规则，对抗动更鲁棒）与不受影响的样本（依赖个体特定配置，更脆弱）。该方法仅需每个训练样本两次前向传播，无需组标签或早停轮次，在Waterbirds上将最差组准确率从57.3%提升至80.8%（对比使用真实组标签的85.8%）。
AI.motivation: 经验风险最小化在含伪相关数据上训练的模型平均准确率高但在相关不成立的子群体上表现差。现有无需组标注的识别方法依赖早期训练信号，需用带组标签的验证数据选择干预轮次这一超参数，这限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: 利用收敛后模型的行为差异：与伪相关一致的样本由一个共享规则分类，对抗动鲁棒；其余样本通过个体输入特定配置拟合，更脆弱。对收敛模型输入施加固定扰动，比较两次前向传播的预测翻转率，据此识别受影响样本，再用检测结果重新平衡训练。
AI.result: 在Waterbirds数据集上，该方法将最差组准确率从57.3%提升至80.8%，而使用真实组标签可获得85.8%的准确率，接近上界。
AI.conclusion: 收敛后的模型已包含足够信号来识别伪相关受影响的样本，无需早期干预轮次或组注释，为稳健学习提供了一种更简单实用的后收敛识别方案。

title: WorldClaw: Agentic 3D Open-World Generation at Scale
comment: Authors are listed in alphabetical order by given name
summary: Generating large-scale, freely explorable 3D worlds from open-ended text remains challenging because a system must jointly maintain global spatial coherence, rich local content, and explicit assets suitable for downstream editing and reuse. We present WorldClaw, a fully agentic, coarse-to-fine framework for open-world 3D scene generation. Planning agents translate a text prompt into a structured specification of regions, terrain, assets, materials, and spatial relations. WorldClaw then builds a globally coherent terrain foundation from semantic layouts, reusable assets, generative or procedural materials, and a region-aware height field. For detail-demanding regions, it generates terrain-conditioned compositions, reconstructs editable textured meshes, and recovers their placement on the terrain; render-based agents further refine terrain, objects, appearance, and contacts. Across diverse open-world prompts, WorldClaw produces large-scale scenes with coherent spatial organization, visually compelling local content, and editable instance-level assets while preserving a consistent global terrain structure.

AI.tldr: WorldClaw是一个全智能体的粗到细三维开放世界场景生成框架，通过规划智能体将文本提示转化为结构化场景规范，再逐层构建全局一致的地形、可复用资产和可编辑的纹理网格，生成支持后续编辑和复用的大规模可自由探索的三维世界。
AI.motivation: 从开放式文本生成大规模、可自由探索的三维世界仍具挑战性，因为系统需要同时维护全局空间连贯性、丰富的局部内容以及适合后续编辑和复用的显式资产。现有方法难以在同一框架内兼顾这三个方面。
AI.method: WorldClaw采用粗到细的全智能体（agentic）框架。规划智能体将文本提示转化为包含区域、地形、资产、材质和空间关系的结构化规范。随后系统构建全局连贯的地形基础，包括语义布局、可复用资产、生成式或程序化材质以及区域感知的高度场。对于细节要求高的区域，生成地形条件化的组合、重建可编辑的纹理网格、恢复其在地形上的放置位置；渲染智能体进一步细化地形、物体、外观和接触关系。
AI.result: 在多样的开放世界提示下，WorldClaw生成了具有连贯空间组织、视觉吸引力的局部内容以及可编辑的实例级资产的大规模场景，同时保持一致的全局地形结构。
AI.conclusion: WorldClaw成功验证了全智能体粗到细框架在开放世界三维场景生成中的有效性，能够同时实现全局空间连贯性、丰富局部内容与显式可编辑资产，为大规模三维世界生成及下游编辑复用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Breaking Customized LLMs for Coding: Automated Red Teaming for Instruction Backdoor Attacks
comment: Accepted to the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026
summary:
LLM customization platforms allow users to build task-specific models for code intelligence tasks by embedding instructions into system prompts, without modifying the underlying model parameters. While these platforms lower the barrier to developing customized LLMs, they also introduce a new attack surface: instruction backdoor attacks, in which adversaries implant hidden malicious behaviors into customized instructions. However, existing attacks suffer from two key limitations. First, they often rely on explicit trigger patterns readily detected by platform-side or user-side inspection. Second, they require substantial manual effort to craft task-specific backdoored instructions, limiting their scalability.
  In this paper, we propose ARIA, an automated red-teaming framework for crafting covert and effective backdoored instructions against customized LLMs. ARIA leverages an attacker LLM to iteratively generate and refine backdoored instructions, guided by structured feedback from the target LLM along three dimensions: stealthiness, clean-task utility, and backdoor effectiveness. We evaluate ARIA on three code intelligence tasks, using four representative LLMs, and compare it with three baseline attacks. Experimental results show that ARIA achieves the highest attack success rate of 0.945, while maintaining the best clean-task utility across all tasks. ARIA also generalizes well across programming languages and remains robust to generation temperature. Furthermore, ARIA significantly outperforms existing attacks in evading platform-side and user-side detection, achieving a false negative rate of up to 1.000, and stays effective against existing defense methods, demonstrating its strong generalizability and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARIA，一个针对定制LLM的自动化红队框架，用于生成隐蔽且有效的指令后门攻击。ARIA利用攻击者LLM迭代生成和优化后门指令，通过目标LLM在隐蔽性、清洁任务效用和后门有效性三个维度的结构化反馈进行引导，在三个代码智能任务、四个代表性LLM上的实验表明ARIA达到0.945的最高攻击成功率，同时在规避检测和对抗防御方面表现出色。
AI.motivation: LLM定制平台允许用户通过系统提示中的指令构建任务专用模型，但引入了指令后门攻击的新攻击面。现有攻击存在两个关键局限：一是依赖容易被平台方或用户方检查发现的显式触发模式；二是需要大量人工努力来制作任务特定的后门指令，限制了可扩展性。因此需要一个自动化、隐蔽且有效的攻击框架。
AI.method: ARIA架构包含三个核心组件：1) 攻击者LLM，负责迭代生成和精炼后门指令；2) 目标LLM，提供结构化反馈；3) 三维度反馈机制，包括隐蔽性（stealthiness）、清洁任务效用（clean-task utility）和后门有效性（backdoor effectiveness）。通过迭代优化循环，ARIA自动生成兼具隐蔽性和高攻击成功率的后门指令。
AI.result: 在三个代码智能任务和四个代表性LLM上，ARIA取得了0.945的最高攻击成功率，同时在所有任务中保持最佳的清洁任务效用。ARIA在不同编程语言间表现良好，对生成温度具有鲁棒性。在规避平台方和用户方检测方面，ARIA的假阴性率最高达1.000，显著优于现有攻击。此外，ARIA对现有防御方法仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: ARIA证明了自动化红队框架在生成隐蔽且有效后门指令方面的可行性，克服了现有攻击依赖显式触发模式和人工制作指令的局限。其高攻击成功率、优秀的清洁任务效用保持、跨语言泛化能力及对检测和防御的强鲁棒性，表明ARIA是评估定制LLM安全性的有效工具，同时也为防御研究提供了重要参考。

title: XEWorld: Can Action-Conditioned World Models Generalize to Unseen Robot Embodiments?
summary: Action-conditioned world models are promising learned simulators for robotic manipulation, yet evaluating them exclusively on training robots fails to reveal whether they capture physical dynamics or merely memorize visual patterns. To answer whether a model can faithfully render a robot it has never seen, we introduce XEWorld, a controlled cross-embodiment testbed for world models that isolates embodiments by evaluating held-out robots within physically identical scenes. Our systematic analysis uncovers a shared architectural bottleneck: current models act primarily as 2D visual pattern matchers whose generalization is governed by visual similarity rather than physical kinematic similarity. Driven by this limitation, they struggle to translate abstract numeric joint actions into coherent visual trajectories, and fail to predict dynamic visual changes from static initial observations. Consequently, successfully rendering an unseen embodiment zero-shot strictly requires heavily grounded cues, specifically pixel-space actions and explicit spatial-temporal alignment. Even when bypassing this zero-shot barrier via few-shot adaptation, the forced appearance recovery triggers catastrophic forgetting of seen embodiments. Together, these failures expose a critical inability to apply learned physical dynamics to novel visual appearances, highlighting that achieving true cross-embodiment generalization requires architectural innovations that decouple visual appearance from underlying physical dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XEWorld跨具身测试平台，系统性地揭示了当前动作条件世界模型的架构瓶颈：它们本质上是2D视觉模式匹配器，其泛化由视觉相似性而非物理运动学相似性驱动，无法将从学习中学到的物理动力学应用到新视觉外观的机器人上。
AI.motivation: 现有的动作条件世界模型评估仅限于训练机器人，无法判断模型是否真正捕捉了物理动力学，还是仅仅记忆了视觉模式。作者希望回答一个关键问题：模型能否忠实渲染一个它从未见过的机器人，从而探究跨具身泛化的真实现状。
AI.method: 提出XEWorld，一个受控的跨具身世界模型测试平台。其核心设计是在物理相同的场景中隔离不同具身（embodiment），通过评估引入的持出（held-out）机器人来系统测试模型的跨具身泛化能力，并通过多种设置（零样本、少样本适应）进行深入分析。
AI.result: 发现当前模型存在共同架构瓶颈：1) 泛化由视觉相似性而非物理运动学相似性驱动；2) 难以将抽象数值关节动作转化为连贯的视觉轨迹；3) 无法从静态初始观察预测动态视觉变化；4) 零样本渲染不可见具身需要像素空间动作和显式时空对齐等强接地线索；5) 即使通过少样本适应绕过零样本障碍，强制的外观恢复会触发对已见具身的灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 当前世界模型无法将学习到的物理动力学应用于新的视觉外观，实现真正的跨具身泛化需要架构层面的创新——将视觉外观与底层物理动力学解耦。

title: DynaPix: Can Vision-Language Models Identify the Exact Future?
summary: Acting in a physical scene requires knowing its real later state, not a plausible one. Current evaluations often accept words or a realistic-looking image, so the predicted state is never checked against the true one. We introduce DynaPix (Dynamic Pixels), a benchmark that makes prediction checkable. Given a video clip that stops before a key event and a question about a later moment, a model must pick the true future image from close candidates or a large gallery. The scenes come from a physics simulator, so the correct image and its time are known exactly and the wrong options are deliberately similar. Models often succeed when a visible event marks the target moment, but are near chance when only elapsed time marks it. Gallery search is harder still, as the true image rarely ranks first. People handle the elapsed-time items well, so the difficulty lies with the models, not the questions. Training on scene accounts drawn from the simulator's true record, not a teacher's guess, repairs much of this but not the longer elapsed time case. DynaPix thus exposes a temporal-anchoring gap: models attach a prediction to an event far better than to time itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DynaPix基准，通过物理仿真器生成视频，让模型从相似候选中选出真实未来帧。发现模型在事件标记时刻表现良好，但在仅靠时间标记时刻时接近随机；提出用仿真器的真实记录而非教师猜测进行训练可修复大部分问题。
AI.motivation: 现有评估往往接受文字或逼真图像作为预测结果，从不检验预测状态是否与真实状态一致，导致模型预测能力被高估。需要一个可检验的基准来衡量模型是否真正理解物理场景的未来状态。
AI.method: 利用物理仿真器生成视频片段（在关键事件前停止），提出关于稍后时刻的问题，要求模型从相似候选图或大规模图库中选出真实未来图像。仿真器保证正确答案和时间精确已知，错误选项故意设计得与正确选项相似。训练数据使用仿真器的真实场景记录而非教师模型的猜测。
AI.result: 模型在可见事件标记目标时刻时表现良好，但仅靠时间流逝标记目标时刻时接近随机；图库搜索更难，真实图像很少排在首位。人类在纯时间标记项上表现良好，说明困难在模型而非问题本身。用仿真器真实记录训练可修复大部分缺陷，但长时间流逝的情况仍未解决。
AI.conclusion: DynaPix揭示了"时间锚定差距"：模型将预测锚定在事件上的能力远强于锚定在时间本身之上，说明当前模型缺乏对时间的可靠语义理解，需要更明确的时间感知训练。

title: Position: It's Time to Optimize LLMs for Self-Consistency
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026), Position Paper Track
summary: Despite ever-increasing sophistication in language model (LM) pre- and post-training pipelines, many important failures persist: models overcondition on user framing ("sycophancy"), exhibit incomplete logical generalization, and produce confident but incorrect responses. We argue that these failures arise from a modeling assumption permeating all aspects of the pipeline: that behavior can be specified and evaluated independently on single-output pairs. Many model failures are difficult, if not impossible, to detect without reasoning about relationships between a model's responses across inputs. In this position paper, we propose self-consistency as a framework for understanding these failures. We first observe that a wide variety of techniques designed to improve specific aspects of LM behavior-targeting properties as diverse as adversarial robustness and factual coherence-can be understood as special cases of a common "consistency optimization" procedure and addressed with a standard set of optimization tools. We next outline a set of new model properties that could be achieved by optimizing for consistency, and conclude with a discussion of what it would mean to develop generally consistent LMs, including the capabilities they would enable and the objections they raise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自一致性"（self-consistency）作为理解语言模型各类失败现象的统一框架，指出诸多现有技术（如对抗鲁棒性、事实连贯性优化）可归结为"一致性优化"的特例，并探讨了通过一致性优化可实现的新模型属性及构建普遍一致LM的意义。
AI.motivation: 语言模型尽管在预训练和后训练流程上日益复杂，仍存在诸多重要失败：过度依赖用户措辞（谄媚）、逻辑泛化不完整、自信但错误的回答。作者认为这些失败的根源在于贯穿整个流水线的建模假设——即行为可以被独立地在单输出对上指定和评估。许多模型失败如果不考虑模型跨输入响应之间的关系，则很难甚至无法被检测到。
AI.method: 本文为立场论文（position paper）。首先论证，众多旨在改进LM特定行为方面的技术——涵盖对抗鲁棒性到事实连贯性等不同属性——都可以被理解为一种共同的"一致性优化"（consistency optimization）过程的特例，并可用标准优化工具统一处理。随后概述通过一致性优化可达成的一组新模型属性，最后讨论构建普遍一致LM的含义。
AI.result: 提出自一致性作为理解LM失败的统一框架；证明多种看似不同的改进技术可归结为一致性优化的特例；勾勒了通过一致性优化可获得的新模型属性；讨论了普遍一致LM的潜在能力与引发的异议。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张自一致性应为语言模型开发的指导性原则。实现一般一致的LM不仅能解决谄媚、逻辑泛化不完整、过度自信等现有失败，还能解锁新的能力，但也引发需要认真对待的反对意见。

title: IFlowNets: Extending Generative Samplers to Learn Strategies in Incomplete Information Games
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games
summary: While many algorithms blend reinforcement learning (RL) with counterfactual regret (CFR) methods to leverage tradeoffs in computational speed and performance, there are fewer investigations into generative sampling frameworks in game theoretic applications in incomplete information games. We extend a generative flow network framework, Adversarial Flow Networks (AFlowNets), to incomplete information games, called Information Flow Networks (IFNs). We prove that previously established constraints for generative flow networks in complete information games are inadmissible for obtaining valid densities (corresponding to player strategies) and a valid training objective. We show that our proposed generalization, IFlowNets, alleviates this issue and strictly generalizes AFlowNets. In preliminary results for three standard game environments, IFlowNets perform comparably to or better than Outcome Sampling Monte Carlo Counterfactual Regret (OSMCCFR) and standard RL-based methods in performance and speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息流网络（IFNs），将生成流网络框架（AFlowNets）从不完全信息博弈扩展到不完全信息博弈，证明原有约束在不完全信息博弈中不可行，并提出了严格泛化AFlowNets的IFlowNets方法，在三个标准博弈环境中性能与速度均优于或媲美OSMCCFR和标准RL方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量工作将强化学习（RL）与反事实遗憾（CFR）方法结合以权衡计算速度与性能，但生成式采样框架在不完全信息博弈中的研究较少。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索生成流网络在非完全信息博弈场景中的应用。
AI.method: 本文将生成流网络框架Adversarial Flow Networks (AFlowNets)扩展到不完全信息博弈，提出信息流网络（Information Flow Networks, IFNs）。首先证明AFlowNets在完全信息博弈中建立的约束在不完全信息博弈中无法获得有效的密度（对应玩家策略）和有效的训练目标，然后提出IFlowNets泛化方案以解决该问题，并证明其严格泛化了AFlowNets。
AI.result: 初步实验在三个标准博弈环境中表明，IFlowNets在性能和速度方面均与Outcome Sampling Monte Carlo Counterfactual Regret (OSMCCFR)及标准RL方法相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: IFlowNets成功将生成流网络范式推广到不完全信息博弈，证明其是AFlowNets的严格泛化，并在实践中展现出有竞争力的性能与效率，为该类博弈中的生成式采样方法提供了新的研究方向。

title: Posture and Sustainment Optimization Under Adversarial Uncertainty
summary: Pre-commitment posture, the assignment of military assets to theater locations before conflict scenarios resolve, is a critical and formally unsolved problem in joint operational planning. Current practice relies on greedy heuristics that maximize value and ignore geographic coverage and are structurally vulnerable to adversaries that target high-strategic value locations. This paper presents a scenario-weighted adversarially robust posture optimization engine for the Posture and sustainability allocation (PSA) problem, modeled as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process over assets, theater locations, and time steps. We introduce the Composite Expected Value (CEV) optimizer, which places assets by maximizing scenario-weighted expected posture efficiency over a distribution of threat scenarios, and the RobustCEV extension, which iterates against a Bayesian adversary that updates its targeting distribution in response to observed placement. Across three experiments in an Indo-Pacific basing environment with 20 assets and 5 theater locations, we demonstrate that: (1) the greedy baseline incurs a permanent 25.1% posture efficiency penalty due to geographic under-coverage and a 57.3% scenario-weighted readiness collapse under value-correlated adversarial threat; (2) the CEV optimizer recovers up to 19.8% efficiency over greedy when the threat distribution carries a geographic signal, with a curated set of 5 to 20 scenarios sufficient to capture the majority of this gain; and (3) the RobustCEV extension recovers up to 158% efficiency relative to a naive optimizer when an adaptive adversary employs a deceptive threat prior. All findings are validated using paired t-tests with Bonferroni correction and two-level variance decomposition, confirming that the performance gaps reported are structural properties of placement strategies rather than sampling artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向Posture and sustainability allocation (PSA)问题的对抗鲁棒姿态优化引擎，通过场景加权决策过程（CEV优化器）及其贝叶斯对抗扩展（RobustCEV），解决了军事资产前置部署中贪心启发式算法忽视地理覆盖且易受对抗性威胁的问题，实验证明可显著提升姿态效率。
AI.motivation: 前置部署姿态（Pre-commitment posture）是联合作战规划中的关键但尚未形式化解决的问题。当前实践中使用的贪心启发式算法只最大化价值而忽视地理覆盖，且在面对针对高战略价值位置进行精准打击的对手时存在结构性脆弱性。
AI.method: 将PSA问题建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），覆盖资产、战区位置和时间步。提出CEV优化器，通过最大化场景加权的期望姿态效率来放置资产；并进一步提出RobustCEV扩展，与根据观测到的部署更新其目标分布的贝叶斯对手进行迭代对抗。
AI.result: 在包含20个资产和5个战区位置的印太基地环境中验证：（1）贪心基线因地理覆盖不足产生25.1%的姿态效率永久损失，面对价值相关对抗威胁时出现57.3%的场景加权战备崩溃；（2）CEV优化器在威胁分布携带地理信号时比贪心方法恢复高达19.8%的效率，5至20个精选场景即可捕获大部分收益；（3）RobustCEV在面对使用欺骗性威胁先验的自适应对手时，比朴素优化器恢复高达158%的效率。所有结果通过配对t检验（Bonferroni校正）和两级方差分解验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，CEV和RobustCEV优化器能够将地理覆盖和对抗鲁棒性系统性地纳入姿态规划中，性能差距是放置策略的结构性属性而非采样伪影，为军事资源前置部署提供了更稳健的优化框架。

title: Algebraic Cryptanalytic Extraction on Hard-Label Neural Networks
summary: Although the state-of-the-art neural network model extraction attack in the hard-label setting by Carlini et al. at EUROCRYPT 2025 has polynomial-time complexity in theory, its dual-point clustering relies on singular value decomposition (SVD) with a time complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n^2 \cdot (d^{(k)})^3)$, resulting in huge runtime in practice. To address this computational bottleneck, this work transforms Carlini et al.'s geometric-view hard-label attack into an algebraic framework, and proposes a novel Approximate Signature Vector (ASV) method to achieve efficient parameter extraction on Fully Connected Neural Networks (FCNNs) by leveraging two key observations: high-dimensional random vectors are nearly orthogonal, and neurons in practical DNNs tend to learn disentangled features. The proposed ASV method replaces SVD-based rank checking with simple inner-product operations, reducing the clustering complexity to $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot (d^{(k)})^3)$ on average. Furthermore, this paper presents the first model extraction attack against hard-label max-pooling Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) by proposing an advanced ASV method with a kernel-centric clustering scheme instead of the neuron-centric clustering, which fully exploits the property of weight sharing in convolutions and fills the cryptanalysis gap. Experiments on a 64-64$\times$4-10 FCNN and LeNet-5 (CNN) with max pooling demonstrate that our ASV method drastically cuts clustering time, and improves the overall efficiency in the model extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种近似签名向量（ASV）方法，将Carlini等人在EUROCRYPT 2025提出的硬标签模型提取攻击从几何视角转化为代数框架，用简单的内积运算替代SVD分解，将聚类复杂度从O(n²·(d^k)³)降至O(n·(d^k)³)，并首次实现了对硬标签最大池化CNN的模型提取攻击。
AI.motivation: Carlini等人在EUROCRYPT 2025提出的硬标签设置下最优神经网络模型提取攻击虽然理论上具有多项式时间复杂度，但其双点聚类依赖奇异值分解（SVD），时间复杂度为O(n²·(d^k)³)，导致实际运行时开销巨大，成为计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 将Carlini等人的几何视角硬标签攻击转化为代数框架，提出近似签名向量（ASV）方法，利用两个关键观察：高维随机向量近似正交、实际DNN中神经元倾向于学习解耦特征。用简单内积运算替代基于SVD的秩检查，将聚类复杂度降至O(n·(d^k)³)。此外，针对硬标签最大池化CNN，提出带核中心聚类（kernel-centric clustering）方案的进阶ASV方法，取代神经元中心聚类，利用卷积权重共享特性。
AI.result: 在64-64×4-10 FCNN和带最大池化的LeNet-5（CNN）上的实验表明，ASV方法大幅削减了聚类时间，显著提升了整体模型提取效率。
AI.conclusion: ASV方法有效解决了硬标签模型提取攻击中SVD计算瓶颈问题，同时填补了硬标签最大池化CNN模型提取攻击的密码分析空白。

title: Coordinated Multi-Robot Disassembly for Makespan Optimization of Large-Scale Assemblies
summary: Multi-robot task and motion planning for disassembly tasks requires robots to operate in confined workspaces while coordinating their motions with other robots. To tackle this problem, we propose a planning method called coordinated multi-robot disassembly (CoMuDi). CoMuDi coordinates a team of robots for disassembly tasks. The input is a team of robots, an assembly of objects, and a dependency graph. Based on this information, we create compound tasks for pick, place, and exit motions. By propagating temporal constraints, we ensure that each robot can start and end their tasks as early as possible while avoiding collisions with nearby robots. By integrating the space-time RRT* planner (ST-RRT*) into CoMuDi, we ensure that individual tasks minimize arrival time and thereby help us minimize overall makespan. We compare the performance of CoMuDi using both ST-RRT* and RRT* planners with varying time bounds, demonstrating that the combination of CoMuDi and ST-RRT* leads to a higher success rate while minimizing makespan. Finally, we evaluate CoMuDi on six assemblies with up to 49 pieces and up to 9 robots. In those scenarios, we show that CoMuDi returns robot paths that exhibit low idle times, thereby demonstrating that CoMuDi can reliably solve large-scale assemblies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoMuDi（协调多机器人拆解）规划方法，通过结合依赖图、复合任务创建和时序约束传播，配合ST-RRT*规划器，实现多机器人在受限狭小工作空间中的协调运动规划，在多达49个零件和9个机器人的拆解场景中均能可靠求解且保持低空闲时间。
AI.motivation: 多机器人拆解任务的任务与运动规划（TAMP）面临双重挑战：机器人需要在受限的狭小工作空间中操作，同时还需要与其他机器人协调运动。现有的规划方法难以同时应对这两方面的问题，需要一种能够集成任务级协调和运动级规划的综合解决方案。
AI.method: CoMuDi方法主要包括三个步骤：(1) 输入机器人群组、物体装配体及依赖图，基于此创建拾取、放置和退出的复合任务；(2) 通过传播时序约束，确保每个机器人能够尽早开始和结束任务并避免与其他机器人发生碰撞；(3) 将ST-RRT*规划器集成到CoMuDi中，使每个单独任务最小化到达时间，从而整体上最小化总完工时间（makespan）。
AI.result: 在对比实验中，CoMuDi结合ST-RRT*相较于结合RRT*在不同时间限制下具有更高的成功率并能最小化总完工时间。在6个装配体（多达49个零件、9个机器人）的评估场景中，CoMuDi生成的机器人路径表现出低空闲时间，证明其能够可靠地求解大规模拆解装配问题。
AI.conclusion: CoMuDi是一种有效的多机器人协调拆解规划方法，通过任务级时序约束传播与ST-RRT*运动规划器的集成，能够在复杂受限空间中实现多机器人拆解的高效协调规划，并具有良好的可扩展性。

title: HERA: Historical Evidence Routing Adapter for Physical Prediction in Latent World Models
summary: Predictive video models have emerged as promising world models by learning latent visual dynamics from large-scale video.
