AI.motivation: NVIDIA Isaac Sim作为机器人仿真器广泛应用于具身智能领域，但其复杂性不可避免地引入软件缺陷。现有模糊测试方法因无法有效处理上下文感知的对象语义、层次化仿真控制和巨大的仿真状态空间，难以有效测试Isaac Sim，因此需要专门针对这一场景的模糊测试方法。
AI.method: IcFuzz包含三个核心组件：1) 基于LLM的语义阶段分割，将仿真程序分解为结构化阶段以捕获上下文感知的对象语义；2) 多层级变异算子，在层次化粒度上系统地测试仿真器；3) 基于多臂老虎机算法的自适应算子调度机制，高效地导航庞大的仿真状态空间。
AI.result: IcFuzz在代码覆盖率上达到基线的约190%—205%，三轮12小时测试中平均检测到3.7个独特崩溃（基线为0个）。在约四个月内发现11个真实bug，其中9个已获开发者确认或修复。
AI.conclusion: IcFuzz通过结合LLM语义理解、多层级变异和多臂老虎机调度，有效解决了Isaac Sim模糊测试中的核心挑战，显著提升了仿真器测试的效率和缺陷发现能力，为机器人仿真器测试提供了新的方法论方向。

title: Beyond Frame Selection: Rethinking Long-Video Understanding with MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong progress in video understanding, yet it remains challenging because the token limitation makes MLLMs difficult to capture temporally sparse evidence. Existing methods typically rely on uniform sampling, or frame selection, but these strategies usually optimize either broad temporal coverage or local relevance, making it difficult to preserve both global storyline context and fine-grained evidence. We propose VideoRouter(VR) that rethinks long-video understanding as coordinating complementary evidence views rather than selecting a single subset of frames. It first organizes each video into a question-agnostic temporal hierarchy, which partition the video into coarse-to-fine temporally coherent segments. In this hierarchy, upper-level nodes capture broad storyline context and event progression, while lower-level nodes preserve fine-grained local details and evidence-bearing moments. This naturally gives rise to two complementary views: a global view for coverage-oriented reasoning and a local view for detail-oriented evidence recovery. We further introduce a verification-guided router to determine which view is better supported by the selected evidence and select the final answer. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed design through extensive experiments, showing that the verification-guided router effectively coordinates global and local reasoning, and that, on VideoMME, our method outperforms state-of-the-art frame selection methods by 2.9 points, respectively, under the LLaVA-Video-7B backbone. We will release the code.

AI.tldr: VideoRouter（VR）提出了一种将长视频理解重新构思为协调互补证据视角而非选择单一帧子集的方法。它构建一个与问题无关的时间层次结构，产生全局视角（覆盖整个故事情节）和局部视角（保留细粒度证据），并通过验证引导的路由器决定哪个视角更受支持来选择最终答案。在VideoMME上，该方法在LLaVA-Video-7B骨干下比最先进的帧选择方法高出2.9个点。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视频理解中因token限制难以捕获时间上稀疏的证据。现有方法（均匀采样或帧选择）往往只优化广泛时间覆盖或局部相关性之一，难以同时保留全局故事情节上下文和细粒度证据。
AI.method: 1) 将每个视频组织为与问题无关（question-agnostic）的粗到细时间一致片段层次结构；2) 上层节点捕获广泛故事情节和事件进展，下层节点保留细粒度局部细节和关键证据时刻，由此产生全局视角和局部视角两种互补视图；3) 引入验证引导路由器，判断所选证据更支持哪种视角，并选择最终答案。
AI.result: 在VideoMME基准上，使用LLaVA-Video-7B骨干网络，VideoRouter比现有最先进的帧选择方法高2.9个点。实验验证了验证引导路由器能有效协调全局与局部推理。
AI.conclusion: 将长视频理解重构为证据视角的协调而非单一帧子集选择，是提升MLLM长视频理解能力的有效途径。验证引导路由器能够有效协调全局和局部推理。

title: DBLAST: Dependent Block Drafting for Stochastic Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language models' inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens and a target model to verify them. While recent block and diffusion-style drafters can predict several positions in a single pass, their training and sampling procedures are typically optimized for greedy decoding or assume that positions in the draft block are conditionally independent. This assumption becomes brittle in non-greedy speculative decoding, where the target distribution is deliberately stochastic and multiple continuations become plausible. We study this mismatch for block diffusion drafters and show that the accepted draft length degrades as the entropy of the target sampling distribution increases. We propose a dependent block drafter based on a low-rank latent mixture over token positions, complemented by an acceptance-oriented training objective that directly targets the expected verified length. Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on GSM8K, MT-Bench, HumanEval, and creative-writing benchmarks show that our approach, namely DBLast, consistently improves accepted length over independent block sampling, especially in higher-entropy decoding regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DBLast，一种基于低秩潜在混合的依赖块草稿模型，用于改进非贪婪推测解码中独立块采样导致的接受长度退化问题，并通过面向接受的训练目标直接优化期望验证长度。
AI.motivation: 现有的块级和扩散式草稿模型在预测多个位置时假设块内位置条件独立，这一假设在非贪婪推测解码中不成立——因为目标分布是刻意随机的，存在多个可行续写，导致独立采样时被接受的草稿长度随着目标采样分布熵的增加而显著退化。
AI.method: 提出依赖块草稿器DBLast：基于低秩潜在混合模型建模token位置间的依赖关系，同时设计面向接受的训练目标，直接最大化期望验证长度（expected verified length）而非传统的光滑度损失。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，使用GSM8K、MT-Bench、HumanEval及创意写作基准测试，DBLast相较独立块采样在所有数据集上一致提升了接受长度，在高熵解码场景下提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 依赖块建模与面向接受的训练目标能有效缓解非贪婪推测解码中块草稿分布失配问题，提升高熵采样场景下的解码效率。

title: LC-GRPO: Bridging Train-Inference Gap for Flow-Based GRPO with Langevin Correction
summary: Flow-based generative models are typically sampled by solving a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), whereas online reinforcement learning requires stochastic rollouts for policy exploration and optimization. Existing GRPO methods for flow models therefore replace the inference-time ODE with a stochastic differential equation (SDE) during training. Although the ODE and SDE share the same marginal distributions in continuous time, their finite-step discretizations can differ substantially. In particular, SDE rollouts often become blurry as the exploration noise increases, creating a mismatch between the samples used for reinforcement learning and those generated by the test-time ODE sampler. We introduce LC-GRPO, a flow-based GRPO framework with Langevin correction. Each rollout transition first takes an inference-aligned ODE Euler step and then applies a stochastic Langevin correction targeting the marginal distribution at the resulting timestep. The required score is recovered directly from the flow velocity, requiring no additional score model, while the resulting transition remains an isotropic Gaussian with a tractable likelihood for policy optimization. We theoretically show that, under suitable conditions, one Langevin correction step reduces the Wasserstein error of an imperfect ODE Euler step. At a matched randomness level, we further show that the proposed transition can be more accurate than the standard Euler--Maruyama discretization of the reverse SDE. Experiments on SD3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-Dev, and HunyuanVideo demonstrate that LC-GRPO consistently improves reward optimization across text-to-image and text-to-video tasks, preserves generation quality, and substantially narrows the gap between stochastic training rollouts and deterministic test-time ODE inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LC-GRPO，一种带有Langevin校正的基于流的GRPO框架。每个rollout过渡先执行与推理对齐的ODE欧拉步，再施加一个针对目标边际分布的随机Langevin校正，从而弥合训练时随机SDE rollout与测试时确定性ODE采样之间的分布差距，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下提升奖励优化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的GRPO方法在训练流模型时用SDE替换推理时的ODE进行随机rollout，虽然连续时间下二者共享相同的边际分布，但有限步离散化后差异显著——随着探索噪声增加，SDE rollout变得模糊，导致强化学习所用样本与测试时ODE采样器生成的样本之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: LC-GRPO的每个rollout过渡包含两步：首先执行一个与推理对齐的ODE欧拉步，然后再施加一个Langevin校正随机步，其目标是校正到对应时间步的边际分布。所需的score可以直接从流速度中恢复，无需额外训练score模型；且该过渡保持各向同性高斯分布，具有可处理的似然用于策略优化。理论上证明了在适当条件下，一步Langevin校正可降低不完美ODE欧拉步的Wasserstein误差，并在匹配随机性水平下比反向SDE的标准Euler-Maruyama离散化更精确。
AI.result: 在SD3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-Dev和HunyuanVideo上的实验表明，LC-GRPO在文本到图像和文本到视频任务中一致性地提升了奖励优化效果，保持了生成质量，并显著缩小了随机训练rollout与确定性测试时ODE推理之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: LC-GRPO通过引入Langevin校正，有效解决了流模型GRPO训练中SDE rollout与ODE推理之间的离散化不匹配问题，在保持训练随机性以支持策略探索的同时，使训练样本更贴近测试时的确定性采样分布，兼顾了奖励优化性能与生成质量。

title: Adaptive Arena-based Contestable Argumentative Network-of-Experts for Open-Ended Care Plan Coordination
comment: Accepted at the 4th International Conference on Frontiers of Artificial Intelligence, Ethics, and Multidisciplinary Applications
summary: Care plan coordination demands synthesizing heterogeneous clinical, functional, and psychosocial information across multiple professional disciplines, where monolithic LLM pipelines cannot perform in a transparent or safe manner. We present CANOE (Contestable Argumentative Network-of-Experts), a multi-agent neuro-symbolic framework that addresses these limitations through five modules: complexity assessment, adaptive team recruitment, role-based argumentative computation via an Arena-based Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Framework (A-QBAF), human-in-the-loop contestation, and care-plan synthesis. Role-specialized agents generate supporting and attacking arguments for candidate interventions; conflicts are resolved through arena-based clash resolution before acceptability scores propagate across the argumentation graph. Care planners may accept, reject, edit, or add arguments, and the framework will deterministically recompute the final plan. Evaluation on Discharge Me! and MedicalRAG using ROUGE-L, AlignScore, MEDCON F1, FKGL, and LLM-as-a-judge shows that medically fine-tuned models achieve the strongest clinical correctness and safety, while CANOE's argumentative structure provides faithful explanation and human contestability.

AI.tldr: CANOE是一个多智能体神经符号框架，通过五大模块（复杂度评估、自适应团队招募、基于竞技场的量化双极论证框架（A-QBAF）的角色论证计算、人在环路争议与护理计划综合）解决护理计划协调中异构信息综合问题。相比单一LLM流水线，CANOE支持透明的论证链路和人类可争议性，在Discharge Me!和MedicalRAG上评估显示医学微调模型临床正确性和安全性最强，论证结构提供忠实解释与人类可争议性。
AI.motivation: 护理计划协调需要在多学科间综合异构的临床、功能和心理社会信息，单一LLM流水线无法以透明和安全的方式完成此任务，因此需要一种支持多角色论证和人类介入的可解释框架。
AI.method: 提出CANOE多智能体神经符号框架，包含五个模块：复杂度评估、自适应团队招募、基于A-QBAF的角色化论证计算、人在环路争议（护理规划者可接受/拒绝/编辑/添加论证并确定性重算最终计划）、以及护理计划综合。角色专用智能体为候选干预生成支持和攻击论证，通过竞技场冲突消解后，可接受性分数在论证图上传播。
AI.result: 在Discharge Me!和MedicalRAG上使用ROUGE-L、AlignScore、MEDCON F1、FKGL和LLM-as-a-judge评估显示：医学微调模型在临床正确性和安全性上表现最强；CANOE的论证结构在解释忠实性和人类可争议性方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: CANOE通过多智能体论证与人在环路机制，实现了护理计划协调中透明、安全、可争议的决策流程，兼顾了临床效能与解释性，为医疗领域LLM应用提供了新范式。

title: MMAligner: Safeguarding Multimodal Large Language Models through Representation Calibration
comment: To Appear in the Proceedings of The ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS), 2026
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often refuse unsafe text prompts yet generate harmful responses to semantically equivalent multimodal inputs. Existing defenses either rely on external guardrails, which add inference overhead without repairing intrinsic flaws, or safety fine-tuning, which treats alignment as black-box optimization and may sacrifice utility or require large multimodal datasets. To identify the cause of this safety disparity, we analyze MLLM representations geometrically. We find that safety mechanisms learned from text persist across modalities: a shared safety subspace and refusal boundary remain effective, and representations inside this boundary consistently trigger refusals. However, unsafe multimodal inputs undergo a representation shift that places most of them outside the boundary, allowing them to bypass the model's intrinsic safety mechanism. This indicates that multimodal safety degradation stems from representation misalignment rather than the absence of safety capability. Based on this finding, we propose MMAligner, a safeguarding method that calibrates unsafe multimodal representations into the pre-existing refusal region. MMAligner applies a hard lower bound to ensure refusal, a soft upper bound to avoid excessive modification, and a preservation objective for benign inputs. Experiments across multiple open-source MLLMs show that MMAligner raises the average refusal rate on unsafe multimodal inputs to 99% with less than 2% utility degradation and minimal training data, substantially improving the safety-utility trade-off over existing baselines. (*Due to the notification from arXiv, "The Abstract field cannot be longer than 1,920 characters", the Abstract that appeared is shortened.)

AI.tldr: MMAligner通过几何分析发现多模态大语言模型的安全退化源于表征错位而非安全能力缺失，并提出将不安全多模态表征校准到已有拒绝区域的方法，使平均拒绝率达到99%且效用退化低于2%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）虽然能拒绝不安全的文本提示，却会对语义等价的多模态输入生成有害响应。现有防御方法要么依赖外部护栏（增加推理开销且不修复内在缺陷），要么依赖安全微调（黑箱对齐，可能牺牲效用或需要大规模多模态数据集）。本文旨在从几何表征角度揭示安全差距的根本原因。
AI.method: 首先对MLLM表征进行几何分析，发现文本学习到的安全机制跨模态保持：存在共享的安全子空间和拒绝边界，边界内的表征始终触发拒绝。但不安全的多模态输入发生表征偏移，大多数落在边界之外。基于此提出MMAligner：将不安全多模态表征校准到已有的拒绝区域内，包含三个目标——硬下界确保拒绝、软上界避免过度修改、保真目标保护良性输入。
AI.result: 在多个开源MLLM上的实验表明，MMAligner将不安全多模态输入的平均拒绝率提升至99%，效用退化低于2%，且仅需极少的训练数据，显著优于现有基线在安全-效用权衡上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 多模态安全退化的根源是表征错位而非安全能力缺失，通过将不安全多模态表征校准回已有的拒绝区域，MMAligner能在极小训练代价下实现高安全性和低效用损失，为MLLM安全对齐提供了新思路。

title: Visual Grounding in Zero-Shot Vision-Language Control
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as zero-shot controllers, but successful trajectories do not necessarily show that decisions are grounded in visual input: simulator dynamics and conservative action priors can produce favourable scores without meaningful perception. We investigate this with an input-ablation battery: blind-image controls, repeated identical inputs, lane-axis reflection, non-visual baselines, and pipeline-integrity checks. Across nine direct-action models, six structured local VLMs, and an exploratory VLM-MPC hierarchy, we analyse 32,874 scored calls over two embodiments and three simulators. The direct-control results are largely negative: a constant-SLOW policy outperforms a scripted geometric controller, several models are image-invariant or nearly constant, and models that recognize longitudinal hazards still fail to transform LEFT and RIGHT under reflection. No local VLM meets the joint longitudinal and lateral grounding criteria. However, an image-only deterministic positive control estimates the lead gap with 0.090 m MAE and exact mirror equivariance, confirming the stimuli carry sufficient visual information; the failures are modular, not universal. A post-hoc, leakage-controlled symmetry-consensus guardian selects two models from 16 calibration frames and freezes a 2-of-4 hazard vote across original and reflected views. On 272 held-out frames it reaches 0.954 balanced accuracy (episode-cluster bootstrap 95% CI [0.895,0.990]); nested leave-one-episode-out recovers the same pair and threshold in all 12 folds. Abstaining on ties raises committed balanced accuracy to 0.973 at 0.824 coverage. With deterministic perception retaining lateral authority, offline modular replay achieves 0.934 action agreement and exact mirror equivariance. These results support current VLMs as bounded, selective hazard assistants, not monolithic zero-shot controllers.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地测试了视觉语言模型（VLM）作为零样本控制器的能力，通过输入消融测试发现九种直接控制模型和六种结构化局部VLM在感知驱动决策上普遍失败（如对镜像反射不变、输出接近恒定等），但提出了一种基于对称性共识的守护机制，在部分模型中实现了0.954的平衡准确率和精确的镜像等变性，最终结论是当前VLM更适合作为有边界的、选择性的危险辅助工具，而非全能零样本控制器。
AI.motivation: VLM被越来越多地用作零样本控制器，但成功的轨迹并不能证明决策真正基于视觉输入——模拟器动力学和保守的动作先验可能在没有有效感知的情况下产生良好得分。作者希望严格检验VLM的感知是否真的扎根于视觉刺激。
AI.method: 采用输入消融测试组（盲图控制、重复相同输入、车道轴反射、非视觉基线和流程完整性检查），在两种实体、三个模拟器上分析32,874次打分调用，涵盖9种直接控制模型、6种结构化局部VLM和探索性的VLM-MPC层级。并提出一个事后、泄漏受控的对称性共识守护机制，从16个校准帧中选择两个模型并冻结一个2-of-4危险投票。
AI.result: 直接控制结果大多为负面：恒定SLOW策略优于脚本化几何控制器；多个模型对图像不变或接近恒定输出；能识别纵向危险但不具备横向（LEFT/RIGHT）镜像等变性。图像专用的确定性正对照在纵向间距估计上达到0.090m MAE且具有精确镜像等变性。提出的共识守护机制在272个保留帧上达到0.954平衡准确率（95% CI [0.895,0.990]），弃权策略下承诺准确率提升至0.973（覆盖率为0.824）；离线模块化重放在动作一致性上达0.934。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM不应被视为零样本整体控制器，而适合作为有边界的、选择性的危险辅助系统——在确定性感知保留横向权威的情况下，VLM可以在特定子任务中发挥有限但有价值的作用。

title: Uncertainty-Aware World Model for Aerial Image-Goal Navigation
summary: Aerial image-goal navigation requires an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to reach a target location specified by a goal image. Existing world-model-based methods rank candidate trajectories using predicted futures, but typically rely on only one or a few point predictions, which is inadequate for large-scale outdoor environments with substantial future-state uncertainty. To address this limitation, we propose the Uncertainty-Aware Navigation World Model (UA-NWM), an efficient latent world model for aerial image-goal navigation, which formulates trajectory scoring as conditional out-of-distribution detection. UA-NWM represents plausible futures with an uncertainty subspace and decomposes the prediction--goal discrepancy into uncertainty-explainable and unexplainable components. Only the unexplainable residual is used for scoring, enabling robust selection without multiple future samples. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UA-NWM consistently outperforms existing navigation world models while maintaining low inference latency. Real-world UAV experiments further validate its practical applicability. Project page: https://duryi.github.io/UA-NWM-Project-Page

AI.tldr: 本文提出UA-NWM，一种高效的潜空间世界模型，用于无人机航拍图像目标导航。它通过将轨迹评分建模为条件分布外检测，利用不确定性子空间表示多种可能的未来，并将预测-目标差异分解为可解释与不可解释部分，仅用不可解释残差进行评分，在不进行多次未来采样的前提下实现鲁棒轨迹选择。
AI.motivation: 现有基于世界模型的方法在航拍图像目标导航中仅依赖一或少数几个点预测来排序候选轨迹，难以应对大规模户外环境中巨大的未来状态不确定性，导致导航决策不够鲁棒。
AI.method: UA-NWM构建高效的潜空间世界模型，将轨迹评分形式化为条件分布外检测；用不确定性子空间表示多种可行的未来，并将预测-目标差异分解为不确定性可解释部分与不可解释部分，仅用不可解释残差进行评分，从而无需多次未来采样即可实现稳健选择。
AI.result: 大量实验表明UA-NWM在性能上持续优于现有导航世界模型，同时保持较低的推理延迟；真实无人机实验进一步验证了其实用性。
AI.conclusion: UA-NWM通过不确定性感知的轨迹评分机制，有效解决了户外大尺度场景下未来状态不确定带来的导航问题，兼具高效性与实用性。

title: Different Perturbations, Different Mechanisms: Understanding Continued Pre-training for Zero-Shot Dialect Robustness
summary: Dialectal variation remains a major challenge for multilingual language models. Perturbation-based continued pre-training (CPT) has emerged as a promising approach to improving robustness, yet existing work largely evaluates individual perturbation strategies in isolation and provides limited insight into why they work. We present a systematic study of perturbation-based CPT for multilingual dialect robustness in LLMs, comparing six training conditions across nine German, Italian, and Arabic dialect tasks. Perturbation-based CPT, especially character-noised CPT, consistently improves zero-shot dialect robustness while largely preserving standard variety performance. More importantly, we show that methods with similar downstream performance induce distinct mechanisms of robustness, exhibiting different patterns of language model adaptation, representational alignment, and prediction repair. Our results provide a more complete understanding of how synthetic surface variation improves robustness and offer practical guidance for selecting CPT strategies in multilingual and dialectal settings.

AI.tldr: 系统研究基于扰动持续预训练（CPT）对多语言大模型方言鲁棒性的影响，比较六种训练条件、九种德语/意大利语/阿拉伯语方言任务，发现字符噪声CPT效果最佳，并揭示了不同方法在语言模型适应、表征对齐和预测修复层面机制各异。
AI.motivation: 方言变异是多语言大模型面临的主要挑战，现有工作大多孤立评估单一扰动策略，且对为何有效缺乏深入理解。
AI.method: 对基于扰动的持续预训练（CPT）进行系统比较研究，涵盖六种训练条件（包括字符噪声等不同扰动策略），在九种德语、意大利语和阿拉伯语方言任务上进行评估，并从语言模型适应、表征对齐和预测修复三个机制维度进行分析。
AI.result: 基于扰动的CPT（尤其是字符噪声CPT）一致提升零样本方言鲁棒性，同时基本保持标准变体性能；更重要地，表现相近的方法背后存在截然不同的鲁棒性机制，体现了不同的语言模型适应、表征对齐和预测修复模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了对合成表面变异如何提升鲁棒性的更完整理解，并为多语言和方言场景下CPT策略的选择提供了实用指导。

title: GAUGE: Granularity-Adaptive Counterfactual Gating of Evidence for Incomplete Multimodal Classification
summary: Multimodal classification typically assumes all modalities are available, yet real-world inputs are often incomplete. Imputation and dynamic fusion can mitigate such incompleteness, but existing methods operate at a coarse modality level and thus cannot retain reliable components while suppressing misleading ones within the same recovered modality, compromising prediction reliability. To address this issue, we propose GAUGE, a lightweight counterfactual gating framework for incomplete multimodal classification. GAUGE first imputes missing modalities with a frozen imputer and encodes observed and recovered inputs uniformly as fine-grained evidence units. Rather than intervening on each unit explicitly, GAUGE scores the counterfactual effect of replacing every unit with a reference representation through prediction-aware Taylor evidence scores, all obtained in a single forward-backward pass. These scores are mapped to continuous gates, which are converted into additive attention-logit biases for unit-wise evidence modulation without altering the backbone architecture. Experiments across six benchmarks demonstrate that GAUGE outperforms strong baselines across diverse incomplete-input settings. Furthermore, a Taylor remainder theoretical analysis characterizes the error of the first-order approximation relative to the exact counterfactual effect, establishing GAUGE as a principled and scalable framework for fine-grained evidence control under modality incompleteness.

AI.tldr: GAUGE是一个轻量级反事实门控框架，用于不完整多模态分类。它通过预测感知的泰勒证据分数（可在单次前向-后向传播中获得）将缺失模态的恢复单元映射为连续门控，实现对细粒度证据单元的自适应调制，在不改变骨干架构的前提下优于多种强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有处理不完整多模态分类的方法（如插补和动态融合）在粗粒度的模态层面操作，无法在同一恢复模态内保留可靠成分同时抑制误导成分，损害了预测可靠性。
AI.method: GAUGE首先用冻结的插补器填补缺失模态，并将观测与恢复的输入统一编码为细粒度证据单元。不显式干预每个单元，而是通过预测感知的泰勒证据分数（单次前向-后向传播获取）对每个单元的反事实替换效应进行评分，映射为连续门控并转化为加性注意力对数偏差，实现单元级证据调制，无需改动骨干架构。
AI.result: 在六个基准上的实验表明，GAUGE在各种不完整输入设置下均优于强基线。此外，泰勒余项理论分析刻画了一阶近似相对于精确反事实效应的误差。
AI.conclusion: 泰勒余项理论分析确立了GAUGE在模态不完整性下进行细粒度证据控制的原理性与可扩展性，是一个有理论保障的细粒度证据控制框架。

title: Evaluating and Improving Pedagogical Fit in LLM-Based AI Tutors with the Pedagogical Suitability Index
comment: This paper has already been accepted and presented at the IEEE 27th International Conference on Information Reuse and Integration for Data Science (IRI 2026) from July 31 to August 2, 2026, in Seattle, WA, USA
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as AI tutors, but a correct answer is not always a pedagogically appropriate one. In classroom learning, effective help depends not only on correctness, but also on whether a response matches the learner's current foundation, the course sequence, and the timing of concept introduction. Existing evaluations focus mainly on answer quality, leaving this instructional fit under-measured. We present the Pedagogical Suitability Index (PSI), a composite metric of six theory-informed sub-scores that evaluates how well LLM-generated tutoring responses align with learner readiness and curricular progression, and we further use PSI as a structured feedback signal for response improvement. We evaluate four LLM tutors (ChatGPT, Gemini, Gemma4, and Qwen3) across 240 scenario-based evaluations using paired standard and defective prompts, then apply a PSI-guided regeneration protocol to 62 weak-performing cases. Baseline differences across the four tested models were modest overall (PSI range: 0.557 to 0.638), and open-weight and closed models did not exhibit a clear separation in pedagogical fit. Under the tested prompt perturbations, overall PSI remained largely stable (Delta = -0.002), though sub-score trade-offs emerged. More importantly, PSI-guided feedback substantially improved weak-performing cases: 51 of 62 cases improved (82.3%). Focused manual evaluation of the 62 PSI-selected weak cases provides initial evidence that the identified weaknesses are instructionally meaningful and that many PSI-guided regenerations correspond to human-judged improvement. These results suggest that learner- and curriculum-aware alignment may matter more for effective tutoring than model category alone, and that such alignment is both measurable and improvable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出教学适宜性指数(PSI)，一个基于六项理论子指标的综合指标，用于评估LLM辅导回复与学习者准备状态及课程进度的对齐程度，并作为反馈信号改进回复质量。对四种LLM辅导系统在240个场景中的评估表明：模型间差异总体较小（PSI范围0.557-0.638），PSI引导的再生成协议显著改善了62个弱表现案例中的51个（82.3%），且人类评估证实这些改善具有教学意义。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛用作AI辅导者，但正确答案并不等于教学上合适的答案。有效的课堂帮助不仅取决于正确性，还要匹配学习者的现有基础、课程顺序和概念引入时机。现有评估主要关注答案质量，忽略了这一"教学拟合度"维度，需要一种可量化的指标来系统评估和提升LLM辅导回复的教学适宜性。
AI.method: 1）设计PSI（Pedagogical Suitability Index）：一个包含六项理论驱动的子评分的复合指标，综合评估回复与学习者准备状态及课程进度的对齐。2）评估设置：对四种LLM辅导系统（ChatGPT、Gemini、Gemma4、Qwen3）使用成对的"标准"与"缺陷"提示模板，构建240个基于场景的评估。3）改进协议：对62个弱表现案例施加PSI引导的再生成协议（利用PSI子评分作为结构化反馈信号），并辅以聚焦性的手动评估验证改进的教学意义。
AI.result: 四种模型的总体PSI差异较小（0.557-0.638），开放权重与闭源模型在教学拟合度上无明显分离。在提示扰动下总体PSI基本稳定（Delta=-0.002），但子评分间出现取舍权衡。PSI引导的反馈显著改善弱表现案例：62个中51个（82.3%）得到提升；人工评估证实识别出的弱点具有教学意义，且多数PSI引导的再生与人类判断的改进一致。
AI.conclusion: 学习者与课程感知的对齐（learner- and curriculum-aware alignment）对有效辅导的重要性可能超过模型类别本身，且这种对齐既可以被量化测量，也可以被系统性改进。PSI作为一个结构化评估与反馈框架，为LLM辅导系统的教学适宜性提供了新的评测和优化途径。

title: A Note on the Influence of a Zero Length Nonce on GCM and GMAC
summary: In this note, we show a simple attack that can recover the hash key of GCM and GMAC by using a zero length nonce. After recovering the hash key, the adversary can forge an arbitrary ciphertext or message as she wants. We note that the ISO/IEC version of GCM and GMAC allows the nonce to be a zero length string, while the NIST version of GCM and GMAC explicitly requires the nonce to be at least one bit. Hence, our attack works for the ISO/IEC version and cannot work for the NIST version.

AI.tldr: 本文发现ISO/IEC版本的GCM和GMAC允许使用零长度nonce，利用这一特性攻击者可以恢复哈希密钥，从而伪造任意密文或消息；NIST版本因要求nonce至少1比特而不受此攻击影响。
AI.motivation: GCM和GMAC是广泛使用的认证加密算法，其安全性依赖于哈希密钥的保密性。作者发现ISO/IEC标准中关于nonce长度的规定存在安全漏洞，使得攻击者可以通过简单方法恢复哈希密钥，从而完全破坏认证安全性。
AI.method: 利用零长度nonce构造特殊输入，通过分析GCM/GMAC的GHASH认证机制恢复哈希密钥。核心在于当nonce为空时，认证过程中的某些输入块会被简化，从而暴露哈希密钥信息。
AI.result: 攻击成功恢复了GCM和GMAC的哈希密钥，使得攻击者可以伪造任意密文或消息。该攻击适用于ISO/IEC版本（允许零长度nonce），但不适用于NIST版本（要求nonce至少1比特）。
AI.conclusion: ISO/IEC标准的GCM和GMAC实现存在严重安全隐患，建议禁止使用零长度nonce或采用与NIST版本一致的nonce长度要求。

title: Prior-SG: Task and Prior Driven Region Segmentation for Scene Graphs in Arbitrarily-Structured Environments
summary: Hierarchical 3D scene graphs are a promising representation for high-level spatial reasoning in autonomous mobile platforms. However, existing extraction frameworks typically rely on purely local visual clustering or strict geometric heuristics, such as wall-separated rooms, which fail in open-plan or arbitrarily-structured environments. We propose Prior-SG, a task- and prior-driven framework that casts scene graph generation fundamentally as a probabilistic alignment problem. As the robot explores, it continuously aggregates an incoming RGB-D sensor stream into a physically grounded Instance Graph utilizing a multi-scale, open-vocabulary feature fusion strategy. The system then infers the high-level functional semantics of this map through a Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) estimate, guided by a Prior Graph-a logical expectation of the environment's structure and task-relevant vocabulary synthesized dynamically by a Large Language Model. By optimizing a Markov Random Field that fuses heterogeneous experts (visual, geometric, and discrete objects) with these topological priors, the system resolves local perceptual ambiguities. We validate this approach across diverse simulated residential datasets and large, open-plan real-world environments. Prior-SG achieves state-of-the-art semantic region segmentation accuracy compared to recent baselines, robustly delineates distant functional boundaries in the absence of physical walls, and uniquely provides zero-shot ontological flexibility, enabling the robot to entirely restructure its spatial partitioning based on a given high-level task.

AI.tldr: 提出Prior-SG框架，将3D场景图生成建模为概率对齐问题，利用大语言模型合成拓扑先验并通过MAP估计和马尔可夫随机场融合多模态专家，实现了在开放平面环境中的零样本语义区域分割与任务驱动空间分区。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图提取方法依赖局部视觉聚类或严格的几何启发式（如墙体分隔的房间），在开放式平面或任意结构环境中表现不佳，缺乏处理高层功能语义和任务适应性能力。
AI.method: 1) 通过多尺度开放词汇特征融合将RGB-D传感器流聚合为实例图；2) 利用大语言模型动态合成Prior Graph（环境结构逻辑预期与任务相关词汇）；3) 通过最大后验（MAP）估计推断高层功能语义；4) 优化融合视觉、几何和离散物体多模态专家与拓扑先验的马尔可夫随机场，解决局部感知歧义。
AI.result: 在多种模拟住宅数据集和大型开放式真实世界环境中验证，Prior-SG在语义区域分割精度上达到最先进水平，能在无物理墙体情况下稳健划分功能边界，并实现零样本本体论灵活性。
AI.conclusion: Prior-SG证明任务与先验驱动的概率对齐方法能有效克服传统几何启发式的局限，支持机器人在开放式环境中根据高层任务动态重构空间分区，为自主移动平台的空间推理提供了新范式。

title: ALTER: Modeling Longitudinal Changes via Regional Differencing for 3D CT Report Generation
summary: Computed tomography (CT) is widely used for clinical diagnosis and longitudinal follow-up, yet automatically generating accurate and complete radiology reports from three-dimensional (3D) CT remains challenging. Existing methods improve fine-grained correspondence between images and text by modeling anatomical regions, but remain centered on the current examination. Consequently, patient-specific longitudinal changes within individual regions remain insufficiently modeled. Meanwhile, interval changes are often distributed across multiple anatomical regions, complicating a coherent assessment of the overall longitudinal state. We propose Anatomically Localized Temporal Evidence Representation (ALTER) to address these limitations. Global Prior Integration (GPI) incorporates the prior CT and report to establish historical context for the current examination. Regional Proxy Differencing (RPD) enables each current anatomical region to retrieve a historical proxy from a single shared encoding of the prior volume and to derive localized interval evidence. Interval Change Fusion (ICF) further combines current abnormality states with region-distributed differences, converting their joint representation into change-aware soft prompts that guide report generation. ALTER achieves state-of-the-art results on most evaluation metrics across the RadGenome-ChestCT validation and CTRG-Chest-548K test sets. Code and data preprocessing details are available at https://github.com/peytonkarlie/ALTER/tree/main.

AI.tldr: ALTER框架通过全局先验集成、区域代理差分和区间变化融合三大模块，将历史CT与报告的纵向信息与当前检查结合，实现3D胸部CT的放射学报告自动生成，在RadGenome-ChestCT和CTRG-Chest-548K数据集上取得最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CT的放射学报告生成方法虽然通过建模解剖区域改善了图像与文本的细粒度对应关系，但仍聚焦于当前检查，未能充分建模患者个体在特定区域内的纵向变化；同时，区间变化往往分布在多个解剖区域，难以对整体纵向状态进行连贯评估。
AI.method: ALTER由三个核心模块组成：(1) 全局先验集成(GPI)利用既往CT和报告为当前检查建立历史背景；(2) 区域代理差分(RPD)让每个当前解剖区域从既往体积的单一共享编码中检索历史代理，提取局部区间证据；(3) 区间变化融合(ICF)将当前异常状态与区域分布差异结合，转换为变化感知的软提示以引导报告生成。
AI.result: ALTER在RadGenome-ChestCT验证集和CTRG-Chest-548K测试集的大多数评估指标上均取得了最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模解剖区域级别的纵向变化并融合整体区间证据，ALTER有效解决了3D CT报告自动生成中患者特定纵向变化建模不足的问题，验证了该方法在临床报告生成任务上的有效性。

title: Where Models Converge and Humans Diverge: A Coverage Framework for Distributional Pluralism in Open-Ended Generation
summary: When a large language model (LLM) writes Harry Potter fanfiction, it reliably produces fundamental elements of the Hogwarts universe, such as recognizable places and characters. Human-written Harry Potter fanfictions, however, typically include these fundamentals and much more, incorporating stylistically irregular content and relationship-diverse plotlines. This gap between LLM and human writing has been noted across a variety of domains. LLMs tend to produce "average" writing, while human writing contains more diverse content that covers a broader distribution. Existing work has shown the existence of this distributional "gap", but no work has proposed a systematic way to measure it. Our paper proposes a human-grounded framework that uses the empirical distribution of human writing on a topic to measure the distributional breadth of LLM-generated content on that same topic. We propose two metrics, LLM Coverage (LLM-Cov) and In-Boundary Rate (IBR), that separate the plausibility of LLM content from its distributional breadth. Across ideation and narrative tasks, we find that current LLMs produce plausible but narrow content that concentrates near the center of the human response space. Our framework can enable researchers to better assess the distributional breadth of LLM-authored content, which we term its "cultural reach".

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种人类锚定的框架，用于衡量LLM生成内容相对于人类写作的分布广度，并引入两个指标：LLM Coverage（LLM-Cov）和In-Boundary Rate（IBR），以区分LLM内容的合理性与分布广度。实验表明，当前LLM生成的内容虽合理但狭窄，集中在人类响应空间的中心附近。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究指出LLM生成内容与人类写作之间存在分布性"差距"——LLM倾向于产生"平均"内容，而人类写作覆盖更广泛多样的分布——但目前尚无系统性方法来量化这一差距。
AI.method: 提出人类锚定框架，利用人类在同一主题上的经验分布来衡量LLM生成内容的分布广度。设计两个指标：LLM Coverage（LLM-Cov）和In-Boundary Rate（IBR），分别用于衡量覆盖度和边界内比例，从而将内容的合理性与分布广度解耦。
AI.result: 在构思（ideation）和叙事（narrative）两类任务上，实验发现当前LLM生成的内容是合理的但分布狭窄，内容集中于人类响应空间的中心附近。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能为研究者提供评估LLM生成内容分布广度的方法，即所谓的"文化覆盖面"（cultural reach），从而更好地理解和改进LLM的生成多样性。

title: Reasoning Errors Have a Region and a Direction in the Residual-Stream Trajectory of LLMs
summary: As language models are increasingly used for tasks that require verifiable reasoning, reliably distinguishing sound reasoning from flawed reasoning has become an important practical problem. Recent trajectory-based methods seek this signal in layerwise residual-stream displacements, which capture how representations change while attenuating some stable, token-specific information. However, displacement omits the state from which an update originates, whereas restoring the full state risks reintroducing shortcut-prone information. We identify this trade-off and propose a three-stream detector that combines motion with two restricted views of location. A coarse region reader based on vector quantization and a fine direction reader over normalized multi-layer states. This design restores enough state context to interpret the motion without returning to full-state probing. On reasoning benchmarks unseen during training, our method improves selection accuracy by up to 12% over the displacement-only state of the art and 21% over single-layer probing baselines. Although trained only on reasoning benchmarks, it also reads factual completion and fact verification, ahead of every detector we compare against, which places the signal on correctness rather than on a kind of reasoning. Ablations further show that motion, region, and direction provide complementary signals. These results suggest that reasoning validity is better read from state-conditioned motion than from either static states or decontextualized trajectories alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种三流检测器，结合残差流位移（运动）与受限的状态视图（向量量化区域读取器和归一化多层状态方向读取器），用于从语言模型内部表征中识别推理的正确性，在未见推理基准上比仅用位移的方法提升最多12%的选择准确率，并展现出跨任务泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 基于轨迹的方法通过层间残差流位移捕捉推理信号，但位移忽略了更新来源的状态信息；而直接使用完整状态又会重新引入容易走捷径（shortcut-prone）的信息。作者识别到这一权衡，希望在不退化到完整状态探测的前提下，恢复足够的状态上下文来解读运动信号。
AI.method: 提出三流检测器：(1) 运动流——层间残差流位移，捕捉表征如何变化；(2) 区域流——基于向量量化的粗粒度状态读取器，提供状态的大致位置信息；(3) 方向流——基于归一化多层状态的精细方向读取器，提供状态的方向信息。三者结合，在运动之外补充受限的状态上下文视图，避免完整状态探测的弊端。
AI.result: 在训练中未见过的推理基准上，该方法相比仅使用位移的SOTA方法选择准确率提升最高12%，相比单层探测基线提升21%。虽然在推理基准上训练，但在事实补全和事实验证任务上也优于所有对比检测器，表明其捕捉的是正确性信号而非特定推理类型。消融实验证明运动、区域和方向三者提供互补信号。
AI.conclusion: 推理有效性更适合从状态条件化的运动中读取，而非从静态状态或去语境化的轨迹中读取。该信号具有任务泛化性，指向内在的正确性而非特定推理模式。

title: Negotiating Risk Boundaries in AI for Policing Through Mixed-Stakeholder Deliberation
summary: AI tools are being increasingly adopted in policing in the UK and worldwide. Racial bias is a known and well-documented risk, yet representatives of affected communities are rarely included in decisions about AI adoption. We present results from a mixed-stakeholder deliberation workshop bringing together 30 community representatives, police officers, and academics to assess the risks of 13 AI use cases in policing, with an explicit focus on racial bias. We found that participants were broadly open to AI adoption, rejecting only three use cases outright, most notably recidivism risk assessment, where objections targeted the premise rather than the implementation. Our analysis reveals that foregrounding racial equity did not narrow the deliberation. Instead, discussions gravitated toward a fundamental set of questions: does this tool actually work, will it deliver genuine benefit, and will that benefit extend to everyone? This integrated reasoning, reminiscent of the curb-cut effect in inclusive design, highlights the benefit of incorporating the racial bias lens into the risk-benefit analysis of AI use cases from the outset.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一项混合利益相关者研讨会的结果，该研讨会汇集了30名社区代表、警察和学者，共同评估13种警务AI用例的种族偏见风险。研究发现参与者总体上对AI持开放态度，仅否决了三个用例（尤其是累犯风险评估），且事实证明前置种族公平视角并未窄化讨论，反而引导出关于工具有效性、真实效益及普惠性的基础性思考，类似于包容性设计中的"路缘坡效应"。
AI.motivation: 英国及全球警务中AI工具被日益采用，种族偏见是已知且记录充分的风险，但受影响的社区代表很少被纳入AI采用决策。本文旨在弥补这一参与性缺口，让受影响的群体在AI警务决策中发出声音。
AI.method: 采用混合利益相关者协商工作坊方法，召集30名社区代表、警察和学者，对13个警务AI用例进行风险评估，明确聚焦种族偏见维度，分析参与者的讨论模式与决策逻辑。
AI.result: 参与者对AI采用总体持开放态度，仅否决三个用例，其中最引人注目的是累犯风险评估——反对针对的是其前提假设而非技术实施。分析显示，前置种族公平并未缩小讨论范围，讨论反而汇聚到工具是否真正有效、能否带来真实效益以及效益能否惠及所有人这三个核心问题上。
AI.conclusion: 将种族偏见视角从一开始就纳入AI用例的风险-效益分析具有显著价值，其整合式推理体现了类似包容性设计中"路缘坡效应"的普惠收益，即面向边缘群体的设计考量最终惠及全体。

title: dfence: Fine-Grained Speculation Barriers for Efficient and Effective Hardware-Software Protection in the Spectre Era (Extended Version)
summary: Speculative execution attacks such as Spectre-PHT and Spectre-STL remain a critical security concern in modern processors. While software-based mitigations like Speculative Load Hardening (SLH) offer effective protection against Spectre-PHT, they are limited in scope and require software-managed speculative masks, which can be error-prone and costly. Defenses against Spectre-STL, such as the Speculative Store Bypass Disable bit (SSBD), incur additional performance overhead and lack fine-grained control. In this work, we introduce dfence, a new CPU instruction that generalizes SLH to mitigate both Spectre-PHT and Spectre-STL with minimal hardware support. dfence enables developers to annotate sensitive registers, with the hardware ensuring that these values do not leak transiently. We implement dfence in the Proteus CPU and evaluate its security and performance, demonstrating less than 1% average performance overhead for our benchmarks. In addition, to support easy and secure adoption, we design a type system that statically verifies the correct placement of dfence instructions in code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出dfence，一种新的CPU指令，将软件缓解技术Speculative Load Hardening (SLH)泛化以同时缓解Spectre-PHT和Spectre-STL两种推测执行攻击，硬件开销极小，平均性能开销低于1%，并设计了类型系统静态验证dfence指令的正确放置。
AI.motivation: 推测执行攻击（如Spectre-PHT和Spectre-STL）仍是现代处理器中的严重安全问题。现有软件缓解方案（如SLH）作用范围有限且需要软件管理的推测掩码，容易出错且代价高；针对Spectre-STL的防御（如SSBD位）带来额外性能开销且缺乏细粒度控制。迫切需要一种既高效又细粒度的硬件/软件协同防御方案。
AI.method: 作者提出dfence指令，泛化SLH思想：开发者对敏感寄存器进行标注，硬件确保这些值不会在推测执行中瞬时泄漏。在Proteus CPU中实现该指令，同时设计了类型系统，可静态验证dfence指令在代码中的正确放置位置，保障安全采用。
AI.result: 在Proteus CPU上实现dfence，基准测试表明平均性能开销低于1%。类型系统能够静态验证dfence指令的正确放置，支持安全便捷的采用。
AI.conclusion: dfence以极小的硬件支持和低于1%的平均性能开销，统一缓解了Spectre-PHT和Spectre-STL两类主要推测执行攻击，并通过类型系统确保指令放置的正确性，为推测执行防御提供了高效、细粒度且易用的解决方案。

title: ErgoSurf: Ergodic Control for the Coverage of Unknown Surfaces
summary: Contact-centric tasks on surfaces, ranging from inspection and cleaning to sanding and polishing, require robots to systematically cover the surface while maintaining stable contact. Ergodic control generates trajectories that spend time at a location proportional to a desired, task-specific spatial distribution, enabling efficient information gathering and coverage. However, traditional ergodic control methods rely on prior knowledge of surface geometry or require a vision sensory input to scan the geometry beforehand, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios with unknown or dynamic environments. This paper introduces a novel online ergodic control framework that achieves systematic surface coverage while simultaneously reconstructing unknown surface geometry. We employ a Gaussian Process Implicit Surface (GPIS) model that learns global surface geometry from intrinsic tactile sensing during execution. For efficient online planning, we approximate the surface locally using point clouds sampled from tangent planes at observed contact points and iteratively fit them to the Gaussian Process. This approximation simultaneously serves as the sampling domain for both the target and the coverage distributions. We employ a heat-diffusion analogy to compute potential fields that guide ergodic exploration, translating spatial coverage objectives into smooth robot trajectories. We demonstrate our framework through simulation and real-robot experiments, validating simultaneous ergodic coverage and online surface geometry learning with reconstruction errors approaching the ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的在线遍历控制框架，利用高斯过程隐式曲面（GPIS）模型通过固有触觉传感在机器人执行任务过程中同时学习未知曲面几何，实现系统性的曲面覆盖与重建。
AI.motivation: 传统遍历控制方法依赖预先已知的曲面几何或需要视觉传感器预先扫描，限制了其在未知或动态环境中的适用性。因此需要一种无需先验几何知识、能够在线学习曲面并实现覆盖的方法。
AI.method: 采用GPIS模型从触觉传感中学习全局曲面几何；通过从观测接触点的切平面采样点云来局部近似曲面并迭代拟合高斯过程，同时作为目标和覆盖分布的采样域；利用热扩散类比计算势场来指导遍历探索，将空间覆盖目标转化为平滑机器人轨迹。
AI.result: 通过仿真和真实机器人实验验证了框架的有效性，证明能够同时实现遍历覆盖和在线曲面几何学习，重建误差接近地面真值。
AI.conclusion: 该在线遍历控制框架无需先验几何知识，能够在未知环境中实现有效的曲面覆盖与几何重建，拓宽了遍历控制在真实世界接触任务中的应用范围。

title: TruthLens: Object Hallucination Detection via Self-Evaluating Truthfulness Scores in LVLMs
summary: Despite the remarkable progress of large vision language models (LVLMs), object hallucination remains a fundamental challenge that hinders their trustworthy deployment. A key finding motivates our work: real and hallucinated object tokens are clearly separable in hidden representations, yet this separability is largely lost at the language-modeling (LM) head. We propose TruthLens, a self-evaluation framework that teaches the LM head to expose a per-object truthfulness signal without any auxiliary model or additional inference cost. Concretely, a rarely-used special token is repurposed as a reference token. For each object-token position, we extract the log-probability assigned to this special token by the LM head, and define its difference from a predefined constant as the truthfulness score. The model is then fine-tuned with an MSE objective that drives scores toward 1 for real objects and 0 for hallucinated ones, while a divergence constraint preserves the original generation capability. Despite being trained on only a limited set of object categories, TruthLens generalizes effectively to benchmarks with substantially larger label spaces. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs demonstrate state-of-the-art performance; notably, on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, TruthLens outperforms the previous best method on MS-COCO by over 17\% in AUROC. Our code is available at https://github.com/wyqstan/TruthLens.

AI.tldr: TruthLens提出了一种无需辅助模型和额外推理成本的自评估框架，通过将LM头的特殊token log-probability转化为每个对象的真实性评分，有效解决LVLM中的对象幻觉问题，在多个基准上达到SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: LVLM中的对象幻觉问题阻碍了其可信部署。先前观察发现真实和幻觉对象token在隐藏表示中可分离，但这一可分性在LM头处大幅丢失，因此需要一种方法在LM头层面恢复并利用这种真实性信号。
AI.method: TruthLens将稀用的特殊token重新用作参考token。在每个对象token位置，提取LM头赋予该特殊token的log-probability，并与预定义常数做差作为真实性分数。模型通过MSE损失微调，驱使真实对象分数趋近1、幻觉对象分数趋近0，同时采用散度约束保持原有生成能力。
AI.result: 仅用有限对象类别训练，TruthLens能泛化到标签空间大得多的基准。在多个LVLM上达到SOTA，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上于MS-COCO击败此前最佳方法超过17%的AUROC。
AI.conclusion: TruthLens证明通过在LM头层面注入显式的真实性监督信号，可以低成本、高效地缓解对象幻觉问题，并且具备良好的跨类别泛化能力。

title: SkillZip: Contract-Preserving Graph Compression for Scalable Agent Skill Libraries
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as agents whose procedural knowledge is stored in reusable skill packages and loaded at inference time. As skill libraries grow, a central challenge is to expose the smallest sufficient executable context under a limited context budget. Existing systems struggle to reuse routines below the whole-skill level, preserve procedural contracts during compression, keep compressed routines executable and expandable, and update the compressed library as skills evolve. These challenges reveal a unit mismatch: skills are retrieved as packages, compressed as text, and converted into execution graphs only after retrieval, whereas reliable reuse requires a contract-bearing procedural unit. We propose SkillZip, an execution-aware procedural abstraction framework that performs contract-preserving compression over section-level graphs. SkillZip rewrites recurring contract-valid motifs into reversible ported macros while preserving boundary signatures, dependency closure, verifier reachability, and source-level expansion. At inference time, it hydrates a compact, dependency-closed context and expands macros only when required. ReZip further integrates new skills and revises risky macros using execution evidence. Comprehensive experiments1 on technical and embodied agent benchmarks show SkillZip consistently outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 12.2 points, while achieving a 3.46x compression ratio with 99.2% dependency preservation and 98.7% verifier reachability. Scaling analyses further confirm robust retrieval across skill libraries ranging from 200 to 100K skills.

AI.tldr: SkillZip是一个执行感知的程序抽象框架，通过章节级图的契约保持压缩来解决LLM智能体技能库检索中的单元不匹配问题。它在推理时水合紧凑的依赖封闭上下文，仅按需展开宏，实现最高12.2个百分点的性能提升、3.46倍压缩比、99.2%依赖保留和98.7%验证器可达性。
AI.motivation: 随着技能库规模增长，现有系统在有限上下文预算下难以提供最小充分的可执行上下文。核心问题在于单元不匹配：技能作为包被检索、作为文本被压缩、在检索后才转换为执行图，而可靠复用需要带契约的程序单元。此外，现有系统难以在整技能级别以下复用例程、在压缩期间保留程序契约、保持压缩例程可执行且可扩展，以及随技能演化更新压缩库。
AI.method: SkillZip在章节级图上执行契约保持压缩，将重复的契约有效模体重写为可逆的端口化宏，同时保留边界签名、依赖闭包、验证器可达性和源码级扩展。ReZip组件利用执行证据整合新技能并修正高风险宏。推理时将压缩的依赖封闭上下文水合，仅当需要时才展开宏。
AI.result: 在技术和具身智能体基准上，SkillZip相比最强基线最高提升12.2个百分点，实现3.46倍压缩比，99.2%依赖保留率和98.7%验证器可达性。扩展性分析确认在200到10万技能规模的库中均能稳健检索。
AI.conclusion: SkillZip通过引入契约承载的程序单元解决技能库检索中压缩与可执行性之间的张力，在压缩率、依赖保留和验证器可达性上均取得了优异表现，且具备良好的规模扩展性。

title: Potential Matching Optimal Transport: Continuous Normalizing Flows for Exact $p$-Wasserstein Dynamics
summary: We introduce Potential Matching Optimal Transport (PMOT), a potential-flow framework for general $p$-cost optimal transport with $c_p(x,y)=\|x-y\|^p$. PMOT parameterizes the CNF velocity field with a scalar potential in the generalized Benamou--Brenier form for the chosen exponent $p$. It trains the potential gradient with a self-induced matching loss along straight bridges determined by the model's own endpoints, while allowing flexible terminal distribution matching. Our main result establishes zero-loss exactness: under the stated regularity, exact terminal matching, and uniqueness assumptions, any zero-loss solution satisfies the generalized Benamou--Brenier optimality system and recovers the corresponding $p$-optimal transport map and dynamics. On synthetic benchmarks, PMOT learns $p$-specific maps that agree with the corresponding $p$-matched OT references. It also remains competitive as a likelihood-based density model on high-dimensional tabular data, and an MMD-based color transformation experiment demonstrates flexible sample-based terminal matching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Potential Matching Optimal Transport (PMOT)，一种用于一般 p-代价最优传输（c_p(x,y)=‖x-y‖^p）的势流框架。PMOT 用广义 Benamou--Brenier 形式中的标量势参数化连续归一化流的速度场，通过自诱导匹配损失训练势梯度，并允许灵活的终端分布匹配。核心理论结果表明零损失解满足广义 Benamou--Brenier 最优性系统并能恢复对应的 p-最优传输映射与动力学。在合成基准、高维表格数据和颜色变换实验中均验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有连续归一化流（CNF）和最优传输方法通常局限于 p=2 的平方代价情形，缺乏对一般 p-代价最优传输问题的统一处理框架。作者希望提出一个既能学习任意 p 代价下最优传输映射，又能保持终端分布匹配灵活性的可训练框架，并建立理论可证明的最优性保证。
AI.method: PMOT 框架的核心包括：(1) 用广义 Benamou--Brenier 形式中的标量势参数化 CNF 速度场，适配给定指数 p；(2) 引入自诱导匹配（self-induced matching）损失，沿模型自身端点确定的直线桥训练势梯度；(3) 支持灵活的终端分布匹配（如基于样本或 MMD 的匹配方式）；(4) 给出零损失精确性定理，证明在正则性、精确终端匹配和唯一性假设下，零损失解满足最优性系统。
AI.result: 在合成基准上，PMOT 学习到的 p-特定映射与对应 p-匹配 OT 参考结果一致；在高维表格数据上作为基于似然的密度模型保持竞争力；在基于 MMD 的颜色变换实验中展示了灵活的基于样本的终端匹配能力。
AI.conclusion: PMOT 提供了一种统一、可证明最优的一般 p-代价最优传输势流框架，兼具理论严格性与实践灵活性，可同时胜任最优传输映射学习、密度估计和样本级终端匹配等任务。

title: SCP-NL2TL: Selective Conformal Prediction with Semantic Verification for Natural Language to Temporal Logic Specifications
summary: Translating natural language instructions into machine-interpretable formal specifications enables robots and autonomous systems to plan, reason, and formally verify their behavior. However, existing translation models typically generate a specification for every input, even when the result is unreliable or fails to capture the user's intent, creating risks in safety-critical applications. Inspired by selective conformal prediction, we propose a selective translation framework that not only generates formal specifications but also determines when they can be trusted. Reliability is scored by two complementary black-box signals, the fidelity of the specification back-translated into natural language and the dispersion of repeated translations under exact semantic equivalence, which fail on different errors and jointly separate incorrect translations more sharply than either alone. Conformal risk control calibrates this score into a decision that accepts a specification or abstains, with a distribution-free bound on the rate at which incorrect specifications are accepted for execution, and a conformal anomaly detector on instruction embeddings screens out-of-distribution inputs before any translation is attempted. The proposed framework is general across formal specification languages, with experiments on Signal Temporal Logic (STL), Linear Temporal Logic (LTL), and geometric Spatio-Temporal Logic (SpaTiaL) demonstrating improved translation reliability, robustness under the evaluated cross-tier shifts, and effective uncertainty-aware abstention. This work establishes a foundation for trustworthy natural language interfaces by enabling AI systems to recognize when generated specifications may not be reliable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个选择性翻译框架，将自然语言指令翻译为形式化规范时，不仅生成规范，还能判断何时可以信任该结果。通过两个互补的黑盒信号（回译保真度和重复翻译的语义离散度）进行可靠性评分，结合共形风险控制决定接受或弃权，并使用共形异常检测过滤分布外输入。
AI.motivation: 现有翻译模型对每个输入都生成形式化规范，即使结果不可靠或未能捕捉用户意图，这在安全关键应用中存在风险。需要一种机制让系统能够识别何时生成的规范不可信。
AI.method: 提出选择性翻译框架：(1) 两个互补的黑盒信号——将规范回译到自然语言的保真度，以及重复翻译在语义等价条件下的离散度；(2) 共形风险控制将得分校准为接受或弃权决策，提供无分布假设的错误接受率上界；(3) 对指令嵌入构建共形异常检测器，在翻译前过滤分布外输入。
AI.result: 在Signal Temporal Logic (STL)、Linear Temporal Logic (LTL)和几何Spatio-Temporal Logic (SpaTiaL)三种形式化规范语言上实验，展示了改进的翻译可靠性、跨级别偏移下的鲁棒性，以及有效的不确定性感知弃权机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可信的自然语言接口奠定基础，使AI系统能够识别生成的规范何时可能不可靠，对安全关键应用中的形式化规范生成具有重要价值。

title: Hardware Keystores for AI Agent Signing Workflows: A Zero-Trust MCP Enforcement Architecture
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Accompanying code and artifacts available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Hardware-Keystores-for-AI-Agent-Signing-Workflows-Artifact-357C
summary: AI agents performing cryptographic operations (signing Git commits, authenticating API calls, issuing certificates) currently store private keys in software-accessible locations: plaintext files, environment variables, or container memory. Any process with sufficient read privileges can extract the raw key material. A recent production incident demonstrated the practical severity: private keys were exfiltrated from a widely deployed framework via email injection in under five minutes. We aim to enforce both key confidentiality and content-aware authorisation for key use. To that end, we replace software-resident keys with hardware-confined keys accessible through a vendor-neutral PKCS#11 interface. A hardware keystore (HSM, TPM, smart card) executes cryptographic operations on-device; the host receives only the result via opaque handles. Hardware confinement is the primary contribution; it is enabled by a surrounding five-layer Zero-Trust enforcement stack comprising session identity (SAGA), scope bounds (Smax), semantic validation (RAV), taint tracking, and the hardware execution boundary. We evaluate against 12 injection scenarios derived from AgentDojo's ImportantInstructionsAttack template (Debenedetti et al., arXiv:2406.13352). We run four LLM models; three follow injections in baseline mode (gpt-oss-120b, Qwen2.5-72B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, n=192 combined). Baseline Attack Success Rate (ASR): 19.3% [14.3%, 25.4%]; protected ASR: 0% (Wilson 95% CI upper bound 2.0%). Zero false positives across four benign task scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用硬件密钥库（HSM/TPM/智能卡）配合五层零信任强制栈来保护AI代理的加密操作，将攻击成功率从19.3%降至0%，且无误报。
AI.motivation: AI代理执行加密操作（签署Git提交、认证API调用、签发证书）时，私钥存储于明文文件、环境变量或容器内存等软件可访问位置，任何具有足够读权限的进程都能提取原始密钥。实际生产事故显示，私钥可通过邮件注入在5分钟内被外泄，安全形势严峻。
AI.method: 采用硬件受限密钥（Hardware-Confined Keys）替换软件驻留密钥，通过厂商中立的PKCS#11接口访问。硬件密钥库在设备上执行加密操作，主机仅通过不透明句柄接收结果。硬件隔离是首要贡献，并由五层零信任强制栈支撑：会话身份（SAGA）、范围边界（Smax）、语义验证（RAV）、污点追踪和硬件执行边界。
AI.result: 针对AgentDojo ImportantInstructionsAttack模板衍生的12种注入场景，测试4个LLM模型。基线模式下攻击成功率为19.3%（95% CI上限25.4%），受保护模式下为0%（Wilson 95% CI上界2.0%），且4个良性任务场景中零误报。
AI.conclusion: 硬件密钥隔离结合多层零信任强制能够有效防御针对AI代理加密密钥的提示注入攻击，在保证密钥机密性和内容感知授权的同时实现零误报，为代理系统的密钥管理提供了可行方案。

title: VIDP: Variable Impedance Diffusion Policy for Compliant Robot Manipulation from Diverse Demonstrations
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires precise tracking and mechanical compliance, where variable impedance control can improve robustness in task success, whereas static compliance cannot adapt to varying contact constraints. Variable impedance skills can be learned from demonstrations, avoiding complex modeling, but compliance is a hidden variable in force-agnostic kinematic data. While existing methods infer compliance from trajectory variations, these variations may reflect geometric adaptation and not intentional compliance when subject to changing spatial layouts. Therefore, this letter introduces Variable Impedance Diffusion Policy (VIDP), an imitation learning-based variable impedance control framework leveraging a Task-Parameterized Directionality-Aware Mixture Model (TP-DAMM) to extract physically consistent trajectory distributions from diverse demonstrations. By mapping distributions to stiffness profiles, VIDP jointly predicts pose actions and task compliance without force sensors. Real-world experiments show that VIDP significantly outperforms fixed-impedance baselines in task success rate while reducing interaction forces with respect to high stiffness controllers and tracking errors with respect to low stiffness baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIDP（可变阻抗扩散策略），一种基于模仿学习的可变阻抗控制框架，通过TP-DAMM模型从多样化演示中提取物理一致的轨迹分布，并将其映射为刚度轮廓，从而在不使用力传感器的情况下联合预测位姿动作和任务顺应性。实验表明VIDP在任务成功率上显著优于固定阻抗基线，同时在交互力和跟踪误差方面均取得更优表现。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的操作任务需要精确跟踪和机械顺应性，可变阻抗控制比静态顺应性更具鲁棒性，但现有方法从运动学数据推断顺应性时难以区分几何适应与主动顺应性，且顺应性是一个隐藏变量。
AI.method: 提出模仿学习框架VIDP，核心包含任务参数化的方向感知混合模型（TP-DAMM），用于从多样化演示中提取物理一致的轨迹分布，并将分布映射为刚度轮廓，联合预测位姿动作与任务顺应性，无需力传感器。
AI.result: 真实世界实验表明，VIDP在任务成功率上显著优于固定阻抗基线；与高刚度控制器相比降低了交互力，与低刚度基线相比降低了跟踪误差。
AI.conclusion: VIDP验证了从轨迹分布推断顺应性的可行性，在不依赖力传感器的情况下同时实现高任务成功率和合理的力/误差权衡，为接触丰富的变阻抗技能学习提供了有效方案。

title: Dual-Output Multi-Exposure HDR Reconstruction via SDR Fusion and Gain Map Inverse Tone Mapping
summary: We propose DOME-HDR, a dual-output multi-exposure HDR reconstruction framework that jointly produces a perceptually balanced SDR image and a consistent HDR image via gain map inverse tone mapping. Given three bracketed LDR inputs, DOME-HDR first synthesizes a base SDR using a LoRA-adapted latent diffusion model. A dual cross-attention fusion module injects complementary structural and color cues from the under- and over-exposed images while anchoring on the mid exposure for stability. The synthesized SDR then guides HPGM, our HDR Prior-guided Gain Map network, to predict a spatially varying gain map for reliable dynamic-range expansion. We evaluate on Kalantari, Tel, and Challenge123 using both full-reference and no-reference metrics, where DOME-HDR achieves state-of-the-art HDR reconstruction quality; ablations further confirm the effectiveness of dual cross-attention and SDR-guided gain map estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出了DOME-HDR，一种双输出多曝光HDR重建框架，通过增益图逆色调映射同时生成感知均衡的SDR图像和一致的HDR图像，在多个基准数据集上达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 多曝光HDR重建往往只关注HDR输出，忽略了SDR展示需求，且现有方法在动态范围扩展时缺乏有效的先验指导，导致重建质量受限。
AI.method: 给定三张包围曝光的LDR输入：1）用LoRA适配的潜扩散模型合成基础SDR；2）通过双交叉注意力融合模块，从欠曝和过曝图像中注入互补的结构与颜色线索，并以中间曝光为锚点保证稳定性；3）合成的SDR引导HPGM（HDR先验引导的增益图网络）预测空间变化的增益图，实现可靠的动态范围扩展。
AI.result: 在Kalantari、Tel和Challenge123数据集上，使用全参考和无参考指标评估，DOME-HDR实现了最先进的HDR重建质量；消融实验证实了双交叉注意力和SDR引导增益图估计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DOME-HDR通过双输出联合框架和基于增益图的逆色调映射范式，有效地统一了SDR合成与HDR重建任务，为多曝光HDR重建提供了新的技术路径。

title: FOCUS: Decoupling Expert Personas in LLMs to Enhance Domain Expert Capabilities
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can exhibit diverse personas, and activating expert personas has been shown to improve domain expertise and task accuracy. However, existing persona control methods often suffer from cross-domain coupling, which may lead to overly aggressive behavior in high-caution domains such as healthcare, or excessive conservatism in risk-sensitive domains such as financial trading. To address this issue, we propose FOCUS (\textbf{\underline{F}}ine-tuning with \textbf{\underline{O}}rthogonal \textbf{\underline{C}}ontrol for \textbf{\underline{U}}ncoupled persona\textbf{\underline{S}}). FOCUS first automatically extracts expert persona vectors from LLMs, then applies orthogonal decomposition to decouple domain-specific expert personas, and finally introduces an expert gating module to adaptively control persona activation according to task contexts. With a two-stage training strategy and a gated selection regularizer, the model learns to activate appropriate personas for both single-domain and cross-domain tasks. Experiments on financial, legal, medical, and cross-domain benchmarks show that FOCUS improves task accuracy and outperforms existing persona control methods. Our code is available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/openpersona-48F4}{this url}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FOCUS方法，通过对LLM中的专家persona向量进行正交分解解耦跨域耦合，并引入专家门控模块自适应控制persona激活，在金融、法律、医疗及跨域基准上显著提升了任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM persona控制方法存在跨域耦合问题：在医疗等高谨慎度领域可能表现过于激进，在金融交易等风险敏感领域可能过于保守，导致专家persona激活不当影响任务效果。
AI.method: FOCUS包含三个核心步骤：(1) 自动从LLM中提取专家persona向量；(2) 通过正交分解解耦领域特定的专家persona；(3) 引入专家门控模块，结合两阶段训练策略和门控选择正则化器，根据任务上下文自适应控制persona激活，支持单域和跨域任务。
AI.result: 在金融、法律、医疗及跨域基准上的实验表明，FOCUS相比现有persona控制方法提升了任务准确率，验证了正交解耦和门控机制在缓解跨域耦合问题上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS通过正交分解解耦领域专家persona并自适应控制其激活，有效解决了LLM persona控制的跨域耦合问题，为多领域场景下的persona精细调控提供了新思路。

title: When Does Consensus Mean Correctness? Measuring the Agreement-Accuracy Coupling with Semantics-Preserving Re-Rendering
summary: A model's agreement across perturbed inputs is used both as a label-free reliability signal and as a self-training target, on the premise that agreement tracks correctness. That coupling is rarely measured directly: natural-image perturbations preserve meaning only by assumption, and no exact answer key localizes errors. Scientific figures remove both obstacles, a figure is drawn from data by a program, so redrawing it yields images that are semantically equivalent by construction and share a programmatically exact answer. We build RENDEQ, a generator of such render-equivalence sets, and measure the coupling on three open-weight VLMs, checking every finding across three independent instantiations. Re-rendering beats resampling on both accuracy and reliability. Agreement beats an evidence-carrying baseline, mean token log-probability, on two of three models and ties on the third, reversing an intermediate, buggy replication traced to a rendering-pipeline failure. The dispersion behind this is concentrated in one style factor, the plotting library, more than double the next-largest factor and an order of magnitude above the noise floor. Fine-tuning on the model's own cross-render consensus inverts: accuracy falls in every one of five replication runs, the opposite sign to published results on natural images. Agreement certifies correctness only above a threshold set by how diffuse a model's errors are, and an objective that rewards agreement destroys exactly that diffuseness.

AI.tldr: 本文构建RENDEQ生成器，利用科学图形渲染等价性（同一数据由程序重绘）来精确测量模型在扰动输入上的一致性与其正确性之间的耦合关系。研究发现重新渲染优于重采样，一致性在多数模型上优于均标记对数概率基线，但基于模型自身交叉渲染共识进行微调导致准确率下降（与自然图像上的公开结果相反），表明一致性仅在错误分布足够分散时才能认证正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常假设扰动输入上的模型一致性能够反映正确性，既用作无标签可靠性信号，也用作自训练目标，但这种耦合关系很少被直接测量。自然图像的扰动保义仅靠假设，且缺乏精确的答案键来定位错误。科学图形因由程序从数据绘制，重绘可构造语义等价且答案精确可得的图像，从而消除这两个障碍。
AI.method: 构建RENDEQ渲染等价集生成器，从数据程序化绘制图形产生语义等价且答案精确的图像。在三个开放权重VLM上进行测量，每个发现通过三个独立实例验证。对比重新渲染与重采样、一致性信号与均标记对数概率基线，并测试基于模型自身交叉渲染共识的微调。
AI.result: 重新渲染在准确率和可靠性上均优于重采样；一致性在三个模型中两个优于均标记对数概率基线、一个持平（此前的有缺陷复现结论被推翻，原因为渲染管线故障）。差异主要集中于一个风格因素——绘图库，其影响是次大因素的2倍多、比噪声底高一个数量级。基于模型自身交叉渲染共识的微调使准确率在五次复现中全部下降，与自然图像上的公开结果符号相反。
AI.conclusion: 一致性仅在模型错误分布足够分散时才认证正确性；奖励一致性的目标函数恰好会摧毁这种分散性，导致微调后准确率下降。

title: Stochasticity Is Not the Hard Part: Reduction and Complexity in Instructional Sequencing over Prerequisite DAGs
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Equal contribution among Y. Chen, J. Jiang, and T. Shi (alphabetical order)
summary: When a student must learn concepts connected by prerequisite dependencies, when does the order of instruction matter, and what does it cost to find the best one? We study instructional sequencing as a stochastic shortest-path problem in which attempting a concept succeeds with a state-dependent probability and failure leaves the learner state unchanged. We first prove that this stochasticity can be eliminated exactly: the problem collapses to a deterministic shortest-path problem on the lattice of prerequisite order ideals, preserving optimal values and actions. The collapse removes stochastic complexity but not combinatorial complexity: optimal sequencing remains NP-hard -- via reduction from feedback arc set in tournaments -- even with no prerequisite edges, unit costs, uniform binary nonnegative transfer, and success probabilities at least $1/2$. Hardness is not uniform: when realizable transfer preferences remain jointly acyclic with the prerequisites, any topological order of the residual joint graph is optimal, and fixed prerequisite width yields polynomial-time exact dynamic programming. A computable diagnostic, $mΔ$, bounds the value of sequencing before optimization. On 70,893 interactions from an introductory CS course, the diagnostic certifies a doubly easy regime -- little value to optimize and little space to search -- while constructed transfer instances realize the challenging regime, where myopic sequencing suffers large regret yet exact A* with a consistent heuristic expands only linearly many states on that family.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了教学排序（instructional sequencing）问题：在教学依赖关系中，学习顺序何时重要以及寻找最优顺序的代价。作者将随机教学排序问题精确化为确定性最短路径问题，并证明该问题在一般情况下是NP难的（即使在没有先修边、无单位成本等简化条件下），但在特定可实现的转移偏好条件下可多项式求解。论文还提出了一个可计算的诊断指标mΔ用于评估排序优化的价值，并通过真实CS课程数据与构造实例验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在教学过程中，概念之间存在先修依赖关系，学生对概念的学习顺序会影响学习效率。作者希望回答两个核心问题：（1）教学顺序在何时真正影响学习效果？（2）寻找最优教学顺序的计算代价是多少？这为教学设计和智能辅导系统提供理论依据。
AI.method: （1）将教学排序建模为随机最短路径问题，其中学习概念以状态依赖概率成功，失败后状态不变。（2）证明该随机问题可以精确简化为先修序理想（order ideals）格上的确定性最短路径问题。（3）通过反馈弧集（feedback arc set in tournaments）归约证明最优排序为NP难。（4）提出可计算诊断指标mΔ用于评估排序优化的价值下限。（5）通过真实课程数据（70,893条交互记录）和构造的转移实例进行实验验证。
AI.result: （1）随机性可以被精确消除，问题简化为确定性最短路径问题，保留了最优值和最优动作。（2）即使在没有先修边、单位成本、均匀二元非负转移、成功概率≥1/2等强简化条件下，最优排序仍然是NP难的。（3）当可实现转移偏好与先修关系保持联合无环时，任何联合图的拓扑排序都是最优的；固定先修宽度时可用多项式时间动态规划求解。（4）在真实CS课程数据上，诊断指标mΔ证明了"双容易"场景（优化价值小且搜索空间小）；在构造实例上，贪心排序产生大遗憾，而带一致启发式的A*算法仅线性扩展状态数。
AI.conclusion: 教学顺序的排序问题在一般情况下是计算困难的（NP难），但在结构良好的场景下可有效求解。论文通过理论分析与实证验证表明：真实教学场景往往处于"容易"的排序优化区域，而构造的挑战性实例虽然对贪心算法不利，但精确算法（A*）在合适的启发式下仍然高效。这一工作为理解教学排序问题的复杂度提供了完整图景。

title: Reversible Unlearnable Examples: Towards the Copyright Protection in Deep Learning Era
summary: Significant advancements in deep learning have been made possible by the utilization of large datasets, underscoring the critical importance of copyright protection. Adding meticulously designed perturbations to examples, making them unlearnable has become a crucial approach for safeguarding data copyright. Existing methods for creating unlearnable examples overlook the risk of data leakage, which can threaten data ownership. Thus, copyright protection in deep learning faces two main threats: illegal model training and malicious data leakage. We investigate that these two threats cannot be solved by straightforwardly combining existing availability attacks and watermarking techniques as their negative interaction effects. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a novel copyright protection mechanism for the aforementioned security concerns. Considering that the prevention of unauthorized model training requires powerful generalizability of unlearnable perturbations, we generate perturbations to induce the model to learn uncorrelated features of input images. It works by minimizing the mutual information of the input and output of the model. On the other hand, to eliminate the side impact of unlearnable perturbations on the watermark extraction, we design a dual extraction strategy by using two distinct watermark extractors. Extensive experiments on the image datasets {ImageNet, CIFAR10, and Pets} show that our proposed method could provide comprehensive copyright protection to images. The code is available at {https://github.com/Yeah21/ReversibleUnlearnableExamples}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新型版权保护机制，统一解决深度学习中非法模型训练和恶意数据泄露两大威胁。通过最小化输入与输出的互信息生成不可学习扰动，并设计双提取策略消除扰动对水印提取的负面影响，在ImageNet、CIFAR10和Pets数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有不可学习示例生成方法忽视了数据泄露风险，而简单组合现有的可用性攻击（availability attacks）和水印技术无法同时解决非法模型训练与恶意数据泄露两个威胁，因为两者存在负面交互效应。
AI.method: 1) 生成不可学习扰动：通过最小化模型输入与输出的互信息（mutual information），诱导模型学习输入图像中不相关的特征，从而阻止未经授权的模型训练，且扰动具有良好的泛化性。2) 双提取策略：设计两个不同的水印提取器，消除不可学习扰动对水印提取的负面影响，确保版权归属可验证。
AI.result: 在ImageNet、CIFAR10和Pets三个图像数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法能够为图像提供全面的版权保护，同时有效应对非法模型训练和恶意数据泄露两大威胁。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出的方法成功统一了不可学习扰动与水印技术，解决了二者结合时的负面交互问题，为深度学习中的数据版权保护提供了一种全面的解决方案。

title: Design and Evaluation of a Touchscreen-Based Teleoperation Interface for Robotic Manipulators
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, accepted for presentation at the IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026), Kitakyushu, Japan, 24-28 August 2026
summary:
Intuitive teleoperation interfaces are crucial for the safe and effective operation of robotic manipulators in challenging environments. In the nuclear industry, surface contact tasks such as swab sampling require precise path and force tracking, obstacle avoidance, and sustained operator attention, which conventional joystick interfaces struggle to support effectively.
  This study designs and evaluates a novel touchscreen teleoperation interface that maps continuous finger movements directly to robotic manipulator motions, provides finer velocity control, and integrates control with visualization, enabling more natural, precise, and intuitive surface interaction than conventional controllers. A comparative user study with 20 participants evaluated task performance and workload using the proposed touchscreen, a conventional joystick, and a single-click autonomous mode. Tasks simulated realistic surface manipulation using a Franka Emika Panda arm, remotely controlled from another country. Kinematic, physiological, and behavioral data were recorded to comprehensively assess task performance, cognitive load, and operator trust across each control condition.
  Participants completed teleoperation tasks more efficiently and accurately with the touchscreen interface, achieving a 53.5% reduction in completion time (median: 2.50 vs. 5.38 min), higher in-area coverage on the sinusoidal path (90.7% vs. 84.1%), and lower overshoot on both path geometries compared with the joystick. Cognitive load, quantified via NASA-TLX (0-100), decreased from joystick to touchscreen (mean TLX 52 to 43; -9 points, -17.3%) and was lowest under the autonomous one-click mode (31; -21 points vs. joystick, -40.4%; -12 vs. touchscreen, -27.9%). This research presents an easy-to-implement touchscreen interface that improves performance in teleoperated surface tasks while reducing cognitive load.

AI.tldr: 本研究设计并评估了一种新型触摸屏遥操作界面，用于核工业中的表面接触任务（如拭子采样）。该界面将连续手指运动直接映射到机器人操作臂运动，提供更精细的速度控制，并将控制与可视化集成。通过与20名参与者的对比实验（触摸屏、传统操纵杆、单次点击自主模式），结果显示触摸屏相比操纵杆任务完成时间减少53.5%，路径覆盖率更高（90.7% vs 84.1%），认知负荷降低17.3%（NASA-TLX从52降至43）。自主模式认知负荷最低（31分）。
AI.motivation: 核工业中的遥操作表面任务（如拭子采样）需要精确的路径和力跟踪、避障以及持续的注意投入，而传统操纵杆界面难以有效支持这些需求。研究者旨在设计一种更自然、直观且精确的触摸屏遥操作界面来替代传统控制器。
AI.method: 设计了一种将连续手指运动直接映射到机器人操作臂运动的触摸屏遥操作界面，提供更精细的速度控制并集成控制与可视化。采用弗朗卡·艾米卡（Franka Emika）熊猫臂模拟真实表面操作，由另一个国家的操作者远程控制。招募20名参与者进行对比用户研究，比较触摸屏、传统操纵杆和单次点击自主模式三种控制方式。同步记录运动学（路径跟踪、覆盖率）、生理（认知负荷）和行为数据，使用NASA-TLX评估认知负荷。
AI.result: 触摸屏组任务完成时间中位数2.50分钟 vs 操纵杆5.38分钟（减少53.5%）；正弦路径覆盖率90.7% vs 84.1%；两种路径几何上的超调量均更低。NASA-TLX从操纵杆的52降至触摸屏的43（-17.3%），自主模式最低（31分，比操纵杆低40.4%，比触摸屏低27.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 该触摸屏界面易于实现，能显著提升遥操作表面任务的性能并降低操作者的认知负荷，为核工业等挑战性环境中的远程操作提供了更优的人机交互方案。

title: SCI-CLIP: Segment-Centric Inference with Reference Memory for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: Training-free open-vocabulary segmentation remains limited by a missing inference abstraction. Frozen vision-language features are produced at patch level, yet dense prediction requires a unit that simultaneously governs feature interaction, spatial support, contextual recovery, and retrieval-based correction. We present SCI-CLIP, a segment-centric inference framework built around the principle that the same region abstraction should organize all stages of dense open-vocabulary prediction. SCI-CLIP first induces a region-consistent interaction graph over frozen visual tokens, then reconstructs dense features by propagating values over this graph, augmenting them with selective cross-window support only where local evidence is insufficient. The same segment abstraction is subsequently used to construct and query an offline reference memory, aligning exemplar retrieval with the units on which prediction is made. SCI-CLIP turns frozen CLIP-style features into spatially coherent, context-aware, and retrieval-compatible dense predictions without any training. SCI-CLIP consistently improves the structural quality of dense predictions, the robustness of contextual reasoning, and the alignment of exemplar-based correction, yielding stronger open-vocabulary segmentation across eight benchmarks. Project code is available at: https://github.com/mzamini92/SCICLIP.

AI.tldr: SCI-CLIP 提出了一种无需训练的分段中心推理框架，通过统一的区域抽象组织特征交互、空间支持、上下文恢复和检索修正，将冻结的 CLIP 风格视觉特征转化为空间连贯、上下文感知且检索兼容的密集预测，在八个基准上提升了开放词汇分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练的开放词汇分割方法缺乏统一的推理抽象层级：视觉语言特征以 patch 级别生成，而密集预测需要一个能够同时协调特征交互、空间支持、上下文恢复和基于检索的修正的单元。这种不匹配限制了分割质量。
AI.method: SCI-CLIP 围绕"同一区域抽象组织所有阶段的密集开放词汇预测"这一原则构建。首先在冻结的视觉 token 上诱导一个区域一致交互图；随后通过在该图上传播值来重建密集特征，并仅在局部证据不足时选择性添加跨窗口支持；最后利用相同的分段抽象构建和查询离线参考记忆，使范例检索与预测单元对齐。全程无需训练。
AI.result: SCI-CLIP 在八个开放词汇分割基准上一致提升了密集预测的结构质量、上下文推理的鲁棒性以及范例修正的对齐性。
AI.conclusion: SCI-CLIP 验证了"以分段为中心的推理抽象"能够有效统一免训练开放词汇分割的各阶段，在不训练的前提下将冻结特征转化为更高质量的密集预测，代码已开源。

title: Human-Like Anaphor Resolution in Large Language Models
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Presented at CogSci 2026 and the 2026 Annual Meeting of the Society for Text & Discourse. Code: https://github.com/wristy/anaphor
summary: Anaphors are expressions that refer to other expressions, called antecedents. The process of connecting the two is called resolution. Cognitive science has identified multiple factors that affect the speed and success of anaphor resolution, including discourse structure, situation-model properties, and semantic factors. Here, we investigate whether these factors also affect anaphor resolution in five Large Language Models (LLMs) with open weights: GPT-2-XL, Llama-3.1-8B, Pythia-12B, Mistral-7B, and Mistral-24B. To model processing difficulty, we adopt the standard linking hypothesis that relates human reading times to model surprisal at the anaphor. As a second behavioral measure, we compare model accuracy to human accuracy on comprehension questions probing the antecedents of anaphors. The results show selective cognitive alignment: some LLMs exhibit human-like sensitivity to discourse prominence and distance-based factors in anaphor resolution, while showing weaker or absent sensitivity to semantic interference effects. These findings delimit the conditions under which LLMs approximate human anaphor resolution.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察五种开源大语言模型（GPT-2-XL、Llama-3.1-8B、Pythia-12B、Mistral-7B、Mistral-24B）在回指消解中是否展现出与人类相似的认知敏感性。通过将模型惊喜度与人类阅读时间关联、比较模型与人类的理解问题准确率，发现部分模型对语篇突出性和距离因素具有类人敏感性，但对语义干扰效应的敏感性较弱或缺失，呈现选择性认知对齐。
AI.motivation: 认知科学已识别出影响人类回指消解速度与成功率的多种因素（语篇结构、情境模型属性、语义因素）。作者希望探究这些认知因素是否同样影响大语言模型的回指消解行为，以界定LLM在多大程度上近似人类语言处理机制。
AI.method: 采用两种行为测量：一是以模型在回指处的惊喜度（surprisal）作为处理难度的代理指标，与人类阅读时间建立联系（标准链接假设）；二是比较模型与人类在探测回指先行词的理解问题上的准确率。测试对象为五款开源权重LLM。
AI.result: 结果显示选择性认知对齐：部分LLM在回指消解中对语篇突出性和距离因素表现出类人敏感性，但对语义干扰效应的敏感性较弱或完全缺失。不同模型间存在个体差异。
AI.conclusion: LLM对人类回指消解机制的近似是选择性的而非全面的，这界定了它们模拟人类回指消解能力的条件和边界。

title: Consistency Has a Computable Blind Spot: A Commutation Theory of Label-Free Reliability for Vision-Language Figure Reading
summary: Label-free reliability for vision-language models rests on invariance: perturb the input and a faithful reader's answer should not change. This has a known blind spot, a systematic misreading survives the perturbation and gets certified wrong, which we show is computable, not just real: an error is invisible to an edit exactly when the two commute, so the errors a suite cannot reach form its joint centralizer, a set that shrinks as edits are added and can be written down rather than guessed at. We act on the complementary relation, equivariance: edit a figure's data and the correct answer must change by a computable amount. Two matched edits are provably complete for affine reading errors; no suite of swap edits is complete for label permutations, and cyclic relabeling closes most of that gap. We instantiate the theory as the Equivariance-Consistency Score, a label-free, training-free detector, and release REND-EQUIV, pairing matched invariance and equivariance sets over identical data. The predicted ordering holds across three models and a hand-labeled population immune to the one circularity in how it is selected; a second invariance-family method confirms the blind spot belongs to the relation, not to any implementation; and cyclic relabeling delivers its predicted gain on a matched real sample. The same characterization explains a reported inversion of this ordering in the classifier metamorphic-testing literature: detectability is a joint property of the relation and the fault class, never of the relation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于等变性（equivariance）的无标签视觉-语言模型可靠性检测理论。指出仅凭不变性（invariance）存在系统性盲区——某些错误可与扰动交换（commute），形成"联合中心化子"而无法被检出。作者证明对仿射读取错误，两个匹配的编辑对（matched edits）即可完全覆盖；对标签置换，swap编辑不完整而循环重标号可弥补大部分差距。据此实现标签免费、训练免费的Equivariance-Consistency Score检测器及REND-EQUIV数据集，在三个模型和人工标注人群中验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 现有无标签可靠性方法依赖不变性（扰动输入后忠实模型回答不应改变），但存在根本性盲区：系统性误读可经受扰动而持续被错误认证。已有工作仅证明此类错误"真实存在"，本文旨在证明其"可计算"——即能精确刻画哪些错误无法被给定扰动集合检测到，从而设计出可写出的完备性刻画与互补的等变性检测方案。
AI.method: 核心代数框架：将"错误对编辑不可见"形式化为两个操作可交换（commute），所有不可达错误构成编辑集合的联合中心化子（joint centralizer）。据此转向互补关系——等变性（equivariance）：编辑图像数据时正确答案须按可计算量变化。理论证明：仿射读取错误可由两个匹配编辑完全覆盖；swap编辑对标签置换不完备，而循环重标号（cyclic relabeling）可关闭大部分差距。实例化为Equivariance-Consistency Score（无标签、免训练检测器），并构建REND-EQUIV数据集（匹配的不变性与等变性编辑组，作用于相同数据）。
AI.result: 理论预测的排序在三个视觉-语言模型上成立，并在一组对选择循环性免疫的手工标注人群上得到验证；第二个不变性族检测方法确认盲区属于关系本身而非具体实现；循环重标号在匹配真实样本上产生了预期增益。此外，该刻画解释了分类器变形测试文献中排序倒置的现象：可检测性是编辑关系与故障类别的联合属性。
AI.conclusion: 不变性不是无标签可靠性的充分手段，其盲区是结构性且可精确描述的（联合中心化子）。等变性为补充提供了可计算的完备性保证：仿射错误由两个匹配编辑完全覆盖，循环重标号对标签置换高度有效。可检测性本质上取决于编辑关系与故障类别的联合，而非单一关系自身，这一统一视角调和了视觉-语言模型与分类器变形测试两个领域的矛盾发现。

title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
summary: High-quality long-horizon training data for terminal agents is expensive to produce, often costing hundreds to thousands of dollars per task, because each task must keep the instruction, environment, reference solution, and verifier mutually consistent. Human authoring does not scale, and direct generation with large language models (LLMs) often breaks these dependencies. We present Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks (RST), a recursive verified synthesis framework for constructing long-horizon terminal-agent tasks at scale. Starting from verified seed tasks, RST extends the reference solution, realigns the verifier and instruction to the new workflow, validates the result in a fresh sandbox, and reuses accepted tasks as seeds for subsequent rounds. Across fifteen recursive rounds, RST produces 37,484 synthesized terminal-agent tasks at roughly \$0.05 per task. Task difficulty increases substantially over rounds: the median reference solution grows from 67 to 374 lines, the median number of executed commands grows from 40 to 244, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro pass@4 drops from 90\% at $R_1$ to 2.5\% at $R_{15}$. To demonstrate training utility, we collect rejection-sampled Qwen3.5 trajectories on the synthesized tasks and use them for supervised fine-tuning. Fine-tuning on these trajectories improves Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B by up to 10 points on Terminal-Bench~2, Terminal-Bench Hard, and Long-Horizon Terminal Bench, while agentic PPO lifts Qwen3.5-27B to 49.44\%, 32.00\%, and 22.07\% on the three benchmarks, corresponding to relative gains of 20.0\%, 41.2\%, and 21.9\% over the base model. Moreover, after 15 rounds, the recursion shows no ceiling: synthesis yield and validation rates remain stable as difficulty keeps climbing, indicating that the process can continue well beyond the scale reported here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RST（Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks），一种递归验证的合成框架，用于大规模构建长时程终端代理任务。从验证过的种子任务出发，递归地扩展参考解法、重新对齐验证器和指令，并在沙盒中验证。经过15轮递归，生成了37,484个任务，每任务成本约$0.05，任务难度持续显著提升（参考解法中位数从67行增至374行，DeepSeek-V4-Pro的pass@4从90%降至2.5%）。在这些任务上通过拒绝采样和SFT/PPO训练，显著提升了Qwen3.5系列模型在多个终端基准上的表现，且递归过程未显现天花板。
AI.motivation: 高质量长时程终端代理训练数据生产昂贵（每任务数百至数千美元），因为需要保持指令、环境、参考解法和验证器之间的相互一致性。人工编写无法规模化，而LLM直接生成常常破坏这些依赖关系。
AI.method: RST框架的核心是从已验证的种子任务出发，递归地：(1) 扩展参考解法以增长任务时程；(2) 将验证器和指令重新对齐到新工作流；(3) 在全新沙盒中验证结果；(4) 将接受的任务作为后续轮次的种子继续迭代。这是端到端的递归验证合成范式。
AI.result: 经过15轮递归，生成37,484个合成终端代理任务，每任务约$0.05。任务难度逐轮显著提升：参考解法中位数从67行增至374行，执行命令数从40增至244，DeepSeek-V4-Pro pass@4从90%降至2.5%。SFT在Terminal-Bench 2、Terminal-Bench Hard和Long-Horizon Terminal Bench上最高提升10个点；agentic PPO使Qwen3.5-27B分别达到49.44%、32.00%和22.07%，相对提升20.0%、41.2%和21.9%。第15轮后合成产出率和验证率保持稳定，未显现天花板。
AI.conclusion: RST证明了大规模、低成本、高质量长时程终端代理训练数据的递归合成是可行的，且递归过程具有可扩展性，远未触及能力上限。该框架为终端代理训练数据的规模化生产提供了实用且经济的路径。

title: Game Hopping in Lean
comment: The accompanying HOPSCOTCH artifact, is available under the MIT License at https://github.com/ravst/Hopscotch
summary: We present HOPSCOTCH, a Lean 4 framework for mechanizing computationally sound, game-based cryptographic proofs. Security definitions are expressed as indistinguishability between stateful probabilistic oracles, and proofs follow the standard game-hopping paradigm. HOPSCOTCH uses a shallow embedding: oracles and reductions are ordinary Lean definitions, enabling direct integration with the full Lean ecosystem, including general mathematical theories from Mathlib, such as finite-group theory. A game-hopping proof in HOPSCOTCH is represented as an explicit formal object whose constructors correspond to the standard steps of a game-hopping argument, making proofs easier to construct, automate, and inspect. We prove a general computational soundness theorem that interprets these proof objects by constructing reductions against the assumptions they use and deriving a concrete bound on the advantage of any distinguisher. Observational equivalence between oracles is established using a state-abstraction methodology: a simple yet powerful approach that supports transformations such as adding or forgetting state and replacing eager sampling with lazy sampling. We illustrate the framework with formalized proofs of the IND-CCA security of encrypt-then-MAC, the security of ElGamal encryption from DDH, the implication from one-time secrecy to public-key IND-CPA security, and the GGM pseudorandom-function construction. To the best of our knowledge, the last is the first mechanized proof of GGM for non-constant depth.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了HOPSCOTCH，一个基于Lean 4的框架，用于机械化计算上可靠的、基于博弈的密码学证明，其浅嵌入设计使其能与Mathlib等Lean生态直接集成，并证明了通用计算可靠性定理。
AI.motivation: 密码学证明往往是复杂的、容易出错的手工论证，需要机械化来保证正确性。现有框架缺乏与通用数学理论的直接集成，且难以自动化博弈跳跃证明。
AI.method: HOPSCOTCH采用浅嵌入方式，将oracle和reduction定义为普通的Lean定义，与整个Lean生态集成。博弈跳跃证明被表示为一个显式的形式化对象，其构造子对应标准的博弈跳跃步骤。使用状态抽象方法论建立oracle之间的观测等价性，支持添加/遗忘状态、惰性采样替换等变换。证明通用计算可靠性定理，通过构造针对所使用假设的归约来推导具体的安全界。
AI.result: 形式化了多个密码学证明：encrypt-then-MAC的IND-CCA安全性、基于DDH的ElGamal加密安全性、一次性保密到公钥IND-CPA安全的蕴含关系，以及GGM伪随机函数构造。其中GGM证明是非恒定深度的首例机械化证明。
AI.conclusion: HOPSCOTCH展示了浅嵌入方法在机械化密码学证明中的可行性，通过状态抽象方法论简化了博弈跳跃中的变换，并为未来更复杂的密码学证明机械化提供了基础。

title: Robot Learning from Human Demonstrations: Handwritten Alphabet Trajectories and Human-Likeness Evaluation
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables, accepted for presentation at the IEEE International Conference on Development and Learning (ICDL) 2026, Kyoto, Japan, 15-18 September 2026
summary: Learning from demonstration (LfD) provides a developmental framework through which robots can develop motor skills by observing and imitating human dynamics, reducing reliance on explicit programming to teach a skill to a robot. The resulting human-like robot motion is recognised as a key factor in building trust and enabling natural collaboration in human-robot interaction. This paper presents a framework for learning human-like robot motion from demonstration, including data collection, probabilistic trajectory learning, and perceptual user evaluation. A dataset of 3,142 handwriting demonstrations was collected from 22 participants across all 52 Latin alphabet character-case combinations via a touchscreen teleoperation interface, capturing planar position, contact force, and timing.
