summary: Humans understand anomalous events through a coherent perceptual process in which they identify the focal instance, follow its behavior as the event unfolds, and interpret why it violates the expectations of the surrounding scene. Video anomaly understanding (VAU) seeks to endow models with a similar capability, moving beyond deciding whether a video is anomalous toward explaining how the event develops and why it matters. Although recent vision--language models (VLMs) can generate detailed and plausible anomaly descriptions, their semantic fluency does not ensure that these interpretations remain grounded in the correct anomaly instance over time. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate tracking and semantic understanding through separate protocols, leaving such instance--semantic inconsistency largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce TAU-Bench, a track-centric benchmark for jointly evaluating anomaly instance tracking and fine-grained anomaly understanding. TAU-Bench contains 1,118 videos, 1,454 tracks, and 202,438 pixel-level masks spanning 49 event and 45 scene categories, together with track-centric annotations that connect instance-level identification, event-level understanding, and scene-level reasoning. To build TAU-Bench at scale, we developed an automated data engine integrating anomaly suitability filtering, anomaly instance track construction, hierarchical caption annotation, and human quality control. Evaluations across representative VLM families show that models producing plausible anomaly interpretations may still fail to localize and track the correct instance reliably, revealing a persistent gap between semantic reasoning and visual grounding. These findings therefore highlight instance-grounded evaluation as an important step toward more faithful and reliable VAU systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAU-Bench，一个以轨迹为中心的基准测试，用于联合评估视频异常理解中的异常实例跟踪与细粒度语义理解，揭示了视觉语言模型在生成合理的异常描述时仍可能在正确实例的定位和跟踪上失败的"语义-视觉脱节"问题。
AI.motivation: 人类理解异常事件是一个连贯的感知过程，需要在事件展开时识别焦点实例、跟踪其行为并解释其为何违反场景预期。尽管现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）能生成详细且看似合理的异常描述，但语义流畅性并不能保证这些解释始终扎根于正确的异常实例。现有基准通常通过分离的协议评估跟踪和语义理解，导致实例-语义不一致性这一关键问题未被测量。
AI.method: 提出了TAU-Bench基准，包含1,118个视频、1,454条轨迹和202,438个像素级掩码，涵盖49个事件类别和45个场景类别，并配有连接实例级识别、事件级理解和场景级推理的轨迹中心标注。同时开发了一个自动化数据引擎，整合了异常适用性过滤、异常实例轨迹构建、层次化字幕标注和人工质量控制四步流程。
AI.result: 对多个代表性VLM系列的评估表明，能够生成合理异常解释的模型仍可能在定位和跟踪正确实例方面出现本质性失败，揭示了语义推理与视觉基础之间持久存在的差距。
AI.conclusion: 实例层面的基础评估（instance-grounded evaluation）是构建更忠实、更可靠的视频异常理解系统的关键一步，应作为重要方向予以重视。

title: On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is emerging as a promising alternative to reinforcement learning for LLM post-training, yet its effectiveness in multilingual settings remains underexplored. We study OPD and its advanced variant, On-Policy Delta Distillation (OPD$^2$), for mathematical reasoning in English, Korean, and Japanese. OPD$^2$ improves OPD by using the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model as the learning signal. Experiments with Qwen3 show that OPD$^2$ consistently outperforms the original OPD, with particularly strong improvements in Korean and Japanese, and generally narrows the English-Korean performance gap. We further find that English-only OPD can also increase performance for Korean and Japanese, but often shifts the responses toward English, highlighting the importance of multilingual data to preserving target-language responses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了同策略蒸馏（OPD）及其进阶变体OPD²在多语言（英语、韩语、日语）数学推理中的应用，发现OPD²在韩语和日语上显著优于原版OPD，并缩小了英语-韩语性能差距；同时指出仅用英语数据进行OPD会提升韩日性能但会将响应向英语偏移，强调了多语言数据的重要性。
AI.motivation: 同策略蒸馏（OPD）正成为强化学习在LLM后训练中的有前景替代方案，但其在多语言环境下的有效性尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 研究了OPD及其进阶变体OPD²（利用后训练教师模型与其基础模型之间的概率差距作为学习信号），在英语、韩语和日语三种语言的数学推理任务上进行实验，使用Qwen3作为基础模型。
AI.result: 实验表明：OPD²在三种语言上均一致优于原版OPD，在韩语和日语上的提升尤为显著；OPD²总体缩小了英语-韩语的性能差距；仅用英语数据的OPD也能提升韩语和日语性能，但往往导致响应向英语偏移。
AI.conclusion: OPD²是一种更有效的多语言LLM后训练方法，尤其对低资源语言（如韩语、日语）有显著增益；同时，多语言训练数据对于保持目标语言响应至关重要，仅依赖英语数据会牺牲语言保持性。

title: GROM: Gradient-Free Rapid One-Shot Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning has become a critical capability for safely removing specific, sensitive knowledge from large language models (LLMs). Current state-of-the-art approaches primarily rely on iterative, training-time unlearning via fine-tuning. However, even when utilizing parameter-efficient dimensionality reduction techniques like LoRA, gradient-based optimization remains computationally expensive and lacks explicit analytical formulations. It can also leave the targeted knowledge merely hidden rather than removed, to the point that simply quantizing the unlearned model restores much of what it was supposed to have erased. To resolve this, we propose a novel one-shot unlearning approach, abandoning iterative optimization in favor of a direct, exact analytical solution. We frame the unlearning process as a ridge-regularized least-squares optimization problem, deriving a closed-form additive update for targeted weight matrices. This update forces the selected layer to suppress unwanted content while strictly preserving its behavior on retained data. Computed from gradient-free forward passes alone, with no backpropagation and no iteration to convergence, GROM applies the weight edit in mere seconds, which makes it orders of magnitude faster than traditional fine-tuning. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that GROM achieves state-of-the-art forgetting-utility trade-offs on TOFU-5%, TOFU-10%, MUSE-Books, MUSE-News and WMDP, significantly reducing computational overhead without sacrificing overall model performance. Because the update removes the targeted content from the weights instead of masking it, GROM also withstands the low-bit quantization attack that recovers much of the content a gradient-based baseline had appeared to forget. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Batorskq/GROM.

AI.tldr: 提出GROM，一种基于闭式解析解的单次机器学习遗忘方法，通过岭正则化最小二乘优化直接求解权重更新，无需迭代微调，在秒级内完成遗忘且能抵御低比特量化攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有基于迭代微调的机器遗忘方法（即使使用LoRA等参数高效技术）存在计算开销大、缺乏解析公式、且被遗忘的知识只是被隐藏而非真正删除——简单量化即可恢复大部分已"遗忘"内容的问题。
AI.method: 将遗忘建模为岭正则化最小二乘优化问题，导出针对目标权重矩阵的闭式加性更新；仅通过梯度无关的前向传播计算，无需反向传播和迭代收敛，在秒级完成权重编辑。
AI.result: 在TOFU-5%、TOFU-10%、MUSE-Books、MUSE-News和WMDP基准上取得最先进的遗忘-效用权衡，计算开销较传统微调降低数个数量级，并能抵御低比特量化攻击。
AI.conclusion: GROM通过一步解析求解实现真正从权重层面移除目标知识而非掩盖，在效率和安全性上均优于现有梯度式遗忘方法。

title: SkillHEX: Improving Agent Skills via Hypothesis-Driven Autonomous Exploration and Exploitation
summary: Although agent skills equip LLMs with reusable procedural knowledge, manual maintenance suffers from high costs, unscalability, and misalignment. Real-world deployments thus require autonomous, on-demand skill evolution at test time, constrained by limited interaction budgets and a lack of training or validation sets. This setting introduces a severe sparse reward challenge, where outcomes conflate multiple latent failure causes. Under such ambiguity, existing methods that greedily refine a single incumbent skill are particularly vulnerable to an exploitation trap, allowing early misdiagnoses to exhaust limited trials along unproductive trajectories. To address this, we introduce SkillHEX, a closed-loop framework coupling hypothesis-driven self-verification with evidence-guided tree search. SkillHEX translates falsifiable failure hypotheses into executable tests, producing diagnostic evidence as dense reward without additional environment attempts. This evidence guides a search over persistent skill-revision branches, dynamically balancing the exploitation of supported edits with the exploration of plausible alternatives. Evaluated on 87 tasks from SkillsBench, SkillHEX outperforms existing self-evolving methods and achieves an average pass rate of 55.9% and 57.9% using GPT-5.3-Codex and Claude Opus 4.7 under a five-iteration budget, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillHEX框架，通过假设驱动的自我验证与证据引导的树搜索，实现LLM技能在测试时的自主进化，解决了稀疏奖励下的错误诊断困境，在SkillsBench的87个任务中取得了优于现有方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的agent技能为LLM提供了可复用的程序性知识，但手动维护成本高、不可扩展且易失配。真实部署需要在测试时自主、按需地进化技能，受限于有限的交互预算且缺少训练/验证集。这一设定带来了严重的稀疏奖励问题——结果输出混淆了多个潜在失败原因。在这种模糊性下，现有方法贪婪地优化单一现存技能，极易陷入"剥削陷阱"，导致早期误诊消耗有限的尝试次数在无成效的方向上。
AI.method: SkillHEX是一个闭环框架，耦合了假设驱动的自我验证与证据引导的树搜索。具体而言：(1) 将可证伪的失败假设转化为可执行的测试，无需额外的环境尝试即可产生诊断性证据作为稠密奖励；(2) 利用这些证据在持续的技能修订分支上进行搜索，动态平衡对已验证编辑的剥削与对可行替代方案的探索。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench的87个任务上，SkillHEX在5次迭代预算下超越了现有自进化方法，使用GPT-5.3-Codex和Claude Opus 4.7分别取得了55.9%和57.9%的平均通过率。
AI.conclusion: SkillHEX通过将失败假设转化为可证伪测试并产生稠密诊断证据，有效缓解了测试时技能进化中因稀疏奖励和因果混淆导致的错误诊断问题，实现了更稳健的技能自进化。

title: Robust-WAM: Bridging Generative Pretraining and Semantic Foresight in World-Action Models
summary: Mainstream World-Action Models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generation models (VGMs) for robot control, transferring their learned dynamics prior for action prediction. These VGMs are typically trained in a variational autoencoder (VAE) latent space. However, the VAE latent space is optimized for pixel reconstruction, which rewards fine appearance detail and leaves the action prediction fragile under visual shifts. Recent works build WAMs in semantic latent space, which are more robust to appearance shifts. However, these models cannot leverage the large-scale VGM pretraining that exists only in VAE space. To overcome this dilemma, we propose Robust-WAM, a general post-training method for video-generation-based WAMs that preserves the VAE-based generative path and adds a lightweight semantic foresight alignment objective on the action stream. This retains the large-scale VGM pretraining while grounding actions in appearance-invariant dynamics that stay reliable under illumination shifts and other visual out-of-distribution conditions. Specifically, we employ learnable query tokens to bring future-scene semantics into the action stream by aligning their output hidden states with the semantic foresight of future ground-truth frames. To establish the temporal correspondence between each query and the future step it describes, we give it the positional encoding of the matching action tokens. Experiments on out-of-distribution generalization simulation benchmarks and a real-robot setup show that our Robust-WAM consistently improves the success rates of multiple WAM baselines without sacrificing in-distribution performance.

AI.tldr: Robust-WAM是一种针对基于视频生成的世界动作模型（WAMs）的通用后训练方法，通过在现有VAE生成路径上添加轻量级语义前瞻对齐目标，在不放弃大规模VGM预训练的前提下，提升动作预测在光照变化等视觉分布外场景下的鲁棒性。实验在仿真OOD基准和真实机器人上验证均提升了多个WAM基线的成功率，且不牺牲分布内性能。
AI.motivation: 主流WAMs依赖预训练视频生成模型（VGM）在VAE潜在空间中进行动作预测，但VAE空间为像素重建优化，对视觉迁移（如光照变化）下的动作预测脆弱。虽然在语义潜在空间构建的WAMs对外观变化更鲁棒，但无法利用仅存在于VAE空间的大规模VGM预训练。这一矛盾亟待解决。
AI.method: 提出Robust-WAM通用后训练方法，保留基于VAE的生成路径不变，同时在动作流上添加轻量级语义前瞻对齐目标。具体采用可学习查询token，通过将输出隐藏状态与未来真实帧的语义前瞻对齐，将未来场景语义引入动作流。每个查询token通过匹配动作token的位置编码建立与未来时间步的对应关系。
AI.result: 在分布外泛化仿真基准和真实机器人实验上，Robust-WAM持续提升多个WAM基线的成功率，同时不牺牲分布内（in-distribution）性能。
AI.conclusion: Robust-WAM有效解决了VAE空间动作预测脆弱性与语义空间缺乏大规模预训练之间的权衡，通过轻量级对齐策略同时获得了VGM大规模预训练的优势与对外观不变动力学的鲁棒性。

title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Deploying autonomous multimodal agents in continuous, real-world environments requires them to ingest unbounded audio-visual streams and maintain hour-scale memory. However, current evaluations predominantly rely on brief clips and multiple-choice formats. This design allows minimal baselines that process only the last four frames to match or surpass complex streaming models, while answer options also expose language shortcuts. We introduce StreamArena, a benchmark for hour-scale, interactive streaming video understanding. StreamArena contains 243 full-length videos averaging 88.8 minutes and 3,646 rigorously annotated, open-ended question-answer pairs that evaluate real-time perception, historical retrospection, proactive interaction, and multimodal tool utilization. Evaluation across diverse systems exposes a tension between continuous interaction and long-horizon multimodal comprehension. Methods that retain only recent frames cannot recover distant events, methods that convert past observations into text lose visual evidence, and methods that repeatedly compress visual memory struggle to preserve fine-grained details over time. We address this tension with StreamMind, a two-tier architecture that assigns latency-critical interaction and proactive monitoring to independently scheduled frontend workers, while backend workers asynchronously construct persistent multimodal memory and perform historical recall and external search. StreamMind outperforms existing streaming baselines across all four capabilities and reduces query-to-answer latency by reusing persistent state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StreamArena，一个用于小时级交互式流视频理解的基准测试，并提出了StreamMind两层级架构来克服实时交互与长期多模态记忆之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有自主多模态智能体评估过度依赖短视频片段和选择题格式，使得仅处理最近四帧的简单基线就能匹敌甚至超越复杂的流式模型，且答案选项暴露了语言捷径，无法真实评估智能体在连续、实时环境中的长时间记忆和交互能力。
AI.method: StreamArena基准包含243个平均88.8分钟的长视频和3,646个开放式问答对，覆盖四类能力：实时感知、历史回溯、主动交互和多模态工具利用。StreamMind采用两层级架构：前端独立调度的工作进程处理延迟敏感的交互和主动监控，后端工作进程异步构建持久的多模态记忆，并执行历史回忆和外部搜索。
AI.result: 评估表明现有方法存在张力：仅保留近期帧的方法无法恢复远距离事件；将过去观察转成文本的方法丢失视觉证据；反复压缩视觉记忆的方法难以随时间保留细粒度细节。StreamMind在全部四类能力上超越了现有流式基线，并通过复用持久状态降低了查询到答案的延迟。
AI.conclusion: StreamArena和StreamMind揭示了连续交互与长期多模态理解之间的本质冲突，并通过异步两层级架构有效解决，为小时级流式视频理解提供了新的基准和方法框架。

title: Hierarchical Latent Prediction for Language Models
summary: While standard Next-Token Prediction (NTP) lays the foundation of language model pre- training, its teacher-forced training paradigm may not be optimal for long-horizon reasoning and planning. Recent works such as Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) and Next-Latent prediction (NextLat) try to mitigate the problem through predicting multiple future tokens and self-supervised prediction in the latent space. However, those auxiliary objectives either have a limited horizon or suffer from compounding error from multi-step rollout. We introduce Hierarchical Latent Prediction (HiLP), which introduces an auxiliary higher-level abstract latent to help reduce the error accumulation effect in latent-space rollouts. Experiments show that HiLP can lead to longer-horizon coherent belief state representation and demonstrate the effectiveness of our method across coding and multi-step reasoning benchmarks, and offers more speculative decoding efficiency.

AI.tldr: HiLP引入了一个辅助的高层抽象潜变量来减少潜空间rollout中的误差累积效应，从而改善长程推理和规划能力，在编码和多步推理基准上展现出有效性，并提升了投机解码效率。
AI.motivation: 标准的Next-Token Prediction (NTP)基于teacher-forced训练范式，在长程推理和规划任务上可能并非最优。虽然MTP和NextLat等近期工作尝试通过预测多个未来token或在潜空间进行自监督预测来缓解问题，但这些辅助目标要么horizon有限，要么在多步rollout中遭受误差累积问题。
AI.method: HiLP (Hierarchical Latent Prediction) 引入了一个辅助的高层抽象潜变量，通过层次化的潜空间预测来减少误差累积效应，从而提升长程推理时的信念状态表征连贯性。
AI.result: 实验表明HiLP能够产生更长时域连贯的信念状态表征，在编码和多步推理基准上均展现了有效性，同时提供了更高效的投机解码。
AI.conclusion: 层次化潜变量预测是一种有效改善语言模型长程推理能力的方法，通过高层抽象潜变量缓解误差累积问题，兼顾了推理连贯性和解码效率。

title: Predicting Task Difficulty Without Rollouts
summary: Task difficulty dictates an agent's likelihood of success, and estimating it without rollouts means forecasting this directly from a task description before executing costly simulations in stateful environments. Reliable estimates would therefore allow environment designers to calibrate evaluation benchmarks and construct progressive training curricula. This becomes increasingly important as agents move into long-horizon domains, where empirical trial-and-error is a severe computational bottleneck. Prior work on early prediction is limited to static tasks or isolated coding environments, often relying on narrow features and inaccurate evaluation metrics. We study \textit{ex ante} difficulty prediction across 17 agentic benchmarks spanning coding, mathematics, machine learning, web navigation, function calling, and other domains. We show that AUC can mask poor difficulty estimates, identify token-level entropy as a useful predictive signal, and show how residuals between expected and observed difficulty can expose hidden environment flaws such as contamination and infeasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在无rollout情况下对智能体任务的事前难度预测，涵盖17个智能体基准（编程、数学、机器学习、网页导航、函数调用等），发现AUC会掩盖较差的难度估计、token级熵是有用的预测信号，并可利用预期与实际难度之间的残差揭示环境缺陷（如污染和不可行性）。
AI.motivation: 任务难度决定智能体成功概率，但现有方法需要在有状态环境中执行昂贵的模拟才能评估难度。在长时域任务中，试错式评估是严重计算瓶颈。准确的难度估计能让环境设计者校准评估基准并构建渐进式训练课程，而先前的工作仅限于静态任务或孤立编码环境，依赖狭窄特征和不准确的评估指标。
AI.method: 研究跨越17个智能体基准的事前难度预测，涵盖编程、数学、机器学习、网页导航、函数调用等领域。引入了token级熵作为预测信号，并使用残差分析（预期难度与实际难度的差异）来揭示环境缺陷。对AUC作为评估指标的局限性进行了深入分析。
AI.result: 发现AUC可能掩盖较差的难度估计质量；token级熵是一个有效的预测信号；预期与实际难度之间的残差可以暴露环境中的隐藏缺陷，如数据污染和任务不可行性。
AI.conclusion: 本文为智能体基准的事前难度预测提供了系统性研究框架和新的评估视角，证明无需rollout即可实现有意义的难度预测，并展示了利用预测残差来诊断环境质量的价值。

title: Bayesian Expected Uncertainty Reduction (B-EUR) Model: A Computational Account of What Makes Design Options Worth Trying
summary:
This paper proposes the Bayesian Expected Uncertainty Reduction (B-EUR) model, which formalizes the value of trying a candidate design action as its expected reduction of epistemic uncertainty about action--outcome relations. The model addresses one part of the Uncertainty Driven Action (UDA) model's open question concerning how changes in uncertainty perception determine action selection. We examine two environmental properties: generalizability, or how far knowledge from one trial extends to neighboring candidates, and outcome discriminability, or how clearly differences among outcomes can be distinguished.
  We tested the model through simulations and human experiments using a graph-shape guessing task that isolates learning about action--outcome relations under a limited trial budget. Epistemic value followed an inverted-U-shaped relationship with generalizability and increased with outcome discriminability in the simulations. In the human experiments, the subjective value of trying and enjoyment followed inverted-U-shaped relationships with generalizability, while choice behavior reflected both properties.
  The B-EUR model provides a computational account of candidate-action evaluation within uncertainty-driven design activity and offers implications for constructing prototype sets, framing design problems, and organizing feedback to support informative exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯期望不确定性缩减（B-EUR）模型，将候选设计行为的价值形式化为其对行为-结果关系认知不确定性期望缩减的程度。通过模拟和人类实验（图-形状猜测任务）验证，发现认知价值与泛化性呈倒U型关系，随结果可分辨性增加而增加，为不确定性驱动的设计活动中的候选行为评估提供了计算解释。
AI.motivation: 解决不确定性驱动行为（UDA）模型中关于不确定性感知变化如何决定行为选择的开放性问题，形式化候选设计行为的信息价值评估机制。
AI.method: 提出B-EUR模型，通过贝叶斯框架计算尝试候选设计行为对行为-结果关系的认知不确定性期望缩减量；通过仿真实验和人类实验（图-形状猜测任务）在有限试验预算下检验模型，考察泛化性和结果可分辨性两个环境属性对认知价值的影响。
AI.result: 仿真中认知价值与泛化性呈倒U型关系，并随结果可分辨性增加而提高；人类实验中，尝试的主观价值和愉悦感与泛化性呈倒U型关系，行为选择同时反映两个属性。
AI.conclusion: B-EUR模型为不确定性驱动的设计活动中的候选行为评估提供了计算描述，对构建原型集、设计问题框架和组织反馈以支持信息性探索具有实践启示。

title: GAUGE: A Measurement-Grounded Benchmark for Physical Fidelity in Simulation Engines and Video World Models
summary: Physics engines facilitate large-scale training and evaluation for embodied intelligence, while generative video world models are emerging as implicit simulators of future states and interactions. However, existing evaluations of physical fidelity are often conducted in isolation and rely heavily on perceptual similarity or human judgments, providing limited insight into which physical principles or parameters are violated. We introduce GAUGE, a real-world-grounded diagnostic benchmark for jointly evaluating how numerical simulators and generative video world models reproduce or deviate from real-world physics. It comprises 22 controlled task families covering rigid bodies, flexible cables, textiles, and volumetric deformable objects. Grounded in real-world trajectories and paired with calibrated physical metadata, uncertainty annotations, and task-specific observables, these tasks cover fundamental physical processes including collision, friction, momentum transfer, oscillation, self-contact, and deformation across diverse materials and conditions. We benchmark Isaac Sim, Genesis, and Newton on 14 task families using generalized trajectory errors, and evaluate 6 image-to-video models on 5 rigid-body tasks by testing physical-law consistency and the temporal stability of inferred parameters. Our results reveal no uniformly faithful physics engine, with the largest discrepancies arising in impulsive contact, rapid textile motion, and volumetric deformation. We further find that video world models can produce trajectories with the expected equation form while recovering incorrect accelerations, momentum transfer, and oscillation timing. GAUGE lays the groundwork for developing more physically faithful simulators and world models for embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: GAUGE是一个基于真实世界物理的诊断基准，用于联合评估数值物理引擎（如Isaac Sim、Genesis、Newton）和生成式视频世界模型对真实物理的复现能力。它包含22个受控任务族，覆盖刚体、柔性缆线、纺织品和体积可变形的物体，通过真实轨迹和物理元数据对引擎与模型进行系统评测，揭示了当前技术在冲量接触、快速纺织品运动和体积变形等方面存在较大偏差。
AI.motivation: 物理引擎支持大规模具身智能训练与评估，而生成式视频世界模型正作为隐式模拟器涌现。然而现有物理保真度评估往往彼此隔离，且过度依赖感知相似性或人工判断，无法揭示具体违背了哪些物理原理或参数。因此需要一个统一、可诊断的基准来联合评估数值模拟器与视频世界模型。
AI.method: 构建GAUGE基准：包含22个受控任务族，覆盖刚体、柔性缆线、纺织品和体积可变形物体；以真实世界轨迹为基准，配以校准的物理元数据、不确定性标注和任务特定可观测量；涵盖碰撞、摩擦、动量传递、振荡、自接触和变形等基本物理过程。在14个任务族上使用广义轨迹误差基准评估Isaac Sim、Genesis和Newton三个物理引擎；在5个刚体任务上通过物理定律一致性和推理参数的时域稳定性对6个图像到视频（I2V）模型进行评估。
AI.result: 没有发现任何物理引擎在所有任务上保持一致的忠实性，最大偏差出现在冲量接触、快速纺织品运动和体积变形方面。视频世界模型能够生成具有预期方程形式的轨迹，但恢复出的加速度、动量传递和振荡时序是错误的。
AI.conclusion: GAUGE揭示了当前数值模拟器与视频世界模型在物理保真度上的系统性缺陷，为开发更物理忠实的模拟器和世界模型打下了基础，对具身智能研究具有重要价值。

title: G$^2$ARD-GS: Geometry-Guided Anchor-Regularized Gaussian Splatting Distillation
summary: Dense colored LiDAR maps provide accurate city-scale geometry, but lifting them into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) retains millions of primitives, making the resulting models costly to store, transmit, render, and adapt. Aggressive primitive reduction alleviates this burden, but can remove the local surface support needed for stable novel-view synthesis and downstream geometric use. We introduce G$^2$ARD-GS, a geometry-guided distillation method that converts a dense Gaussian prior instantiated either as a training-free point-cloud lift or a trained GS model into a compact, reusable representation. G$^2$ARD-GS progressively consolidates the prior into surface-aware representatives, then recovers appearance on the resulting fixed topology under construction-time anchor constraints, with no primitives added or removed during recovery. Under limited supervision, geometry-aware view selection allocates the available view budget. On MatrixCity, G$^2$ARD-GS achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS across matched $5\times$--$30\times$ compression budgets, outperforming PUP by $3.2$--$6.8$,dB in PSNR. When reused as frozen geometry, the compact model improves off-trajectory appearance adaptation by $3.7$--$4.9$,dB over PUP 3D-GS and preserves image-to-model registration accuracy on Cambridge KingsCollege at $30\times$ compression. Project page: https://patrick1159.github.io/gardGS-page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G²ARD-GS，一种几何引导的蒸馏方法，将稠密彩色LiDAR地图（通过无训练点云提升或已训练GS模型）转换为紧凑、表面感知的3D高斯表示，在5×到30×压缩下保持高渲染质量与几何可用性。
AI.motivation: 稠密彩色LiDAR地图转换为3D高斯泼溅后会保留数百万个图元，导致存储、传输、渲染和适配成本高昂。激进的图元削减虽能减轻负担，但会移除稳定的新视角合成和下游几何应用所需的局部表面支撑，因此需要在压缩与保持表面质量之间取得平衡。
AI.method: G²ARD-GS通过几何引导的蒸馏将稠密高斯先验（无训练点云提升或训练后的GS模型）逐步整合为表面感知的代表性图元；随后在固定的拓扑结构上，于构建期的锚定约束下恢复外观，此阶段不增删任何图元；在有限监督条件下，采用几何感知的视角选择来分配可用的视角预算。
AI.result: 在MatrixCity数据集上，G²ARD-GS在5×到30×的匹配压缩预算下取得了最佳PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标，PSNR比PUP高出3.2-6.8 dB。作为冻结几何复用时，紧凑模型在离轨外观适配上比PUP 3D-GS提高3.7-4.9 dB，并在30×压缩下保留了Cambridge KingsCollege上的图像到模型配准精度。
AI.conclusion: G²ARD-GS证明了在极低配额下仍可保持高质量渲染与几何可用性的可行性，为从稠密LiDAR地图生成紧凑、可复用的3DGS表示提供了有效的解决方案。

title: M$^3$R-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Metaphor Understanding
comment: 6 figures and 5 tables. Hong Jiang, Junnan Zhu, and Jingwang Huang contributed equally. Jiang Zhong and Kaiwen Wei are corresponding authors. Code and data are available at https://github.com/hongshi4/M3R-Bench
summary: Metaphor enables the understanding of abstract concepts through cross-domain mappings while conveying affective attitudes. In multimodal scenarios, visual and textual information jointly construct Target--Source mappings, requiring both conceptual understanding and cross-modal reasoning. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate metaphor understanding through isolated subtasks and lack evidence-grounded explanations, making it difficult to assess whether models establish mappings grounded in visual and textual cues.To address these limitations, we introduce M$^3$R-Bench, a unified and evidence-grounded benchmark containing 1,000 image--text instances with human-verified annotations. Guided by Conceptual Metaphor Theory and theories of nonliteral language understanding, M$^3$R-Bench provides joint annotations for metaphor occurrence, Target--Source mapping, sentiment, and stage-wise explanations following ``evidence identification--mapping establishment--sentiment inference.''Evaluations on M$^3$R-Bench reveal that existing models often overlook visual evidence, rely on superficial textual cues, and produce inaccurate Target--Source mappings, exposing a cross-modal evidence--mapping mismatch. To address this mismatch, we propose M$^3$R-Reasoner, which combines curriculum-based reasoning supervision with task-aware reinforcement learning to align model reasoning with metaphor interpretation. Experiments show that, with only an 8B-parameter backbone, M$^3$R-Reasoner outperforms larger proprietary MLLMs across four unified-task metrics and improves Visual Evidence and Sentiment Justification scores over GPT-5.5 by 28.45 and 30.11 points, respectively, while surpassing Claude-Sonnet-4.6 by 8.00 points in mean rubric score. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/hongshi4/M3R-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M³R-Bench，一个包含1,000个图文实例、基于概念隐喻理论构建的统一且可证据推理的隐喻理解基准，并提供逐阶段的解释标注（证据识别→映射建立→情感推理）。针对现有模型在视觉证据利用和多模态映射上的不足，作者提出M³R-Reasoner，结合课程式推理监督与任务感知强化学习，仅用8B参数即超越更大规模专有MLLM。
AI.motivation: 现有隐喻理解基准主要通过孤立子任务评估模型表现，缺乏基于证据的解释性标注，难以判断模型是否真正建立在视觉与文本线索上的目标-源域映射。多模态隐喻理解需要概念理解与跨模态推理的协同，但当前的评估体系无法全面度量这一能力。
AI.method: 提出M³R-Bench基准（1,000个图文实例，人工验证标注），基于概念隐喻理论与非字面语言理解理论，提供隐喻出现、目标-源映射、情感及逐阶段解释的联合标注。在此基础上提出M³R-Reasoner，通过课程式推理监督（curriculum-based reasoning supervision）与任务感知强化学习（task-aware reinforcement learning）对齐模型推理与隐喻解释过程。
AI.result: M³R-Reasoner在仅使用8B参数骨干的情况下，在四项统一任务指标上超越更大规模专有MLLM；在视觉证据与情感论证得分上分别超过GPT-5.5达28.45和30.11分，平均rubric分数超过Claude-Sonnet-4.6达8.00分。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型存在跨模态证据-映射错配问题（忽视视觉证据、依赖表面文本线索、产生不准确的目标-源映射），而M³R-Reasoner通过推理监督与强化学习的结合有效缓解了这一问题，展示了小参数模型在多模态隐喻推理上的潜力。

title: Refining Over Resampling: Test-Time Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning
summary: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by using additional inference compute, but wider sampling alone can suffer from diminishing returns: new rollouts often repeat existing answer patterns instead of adding useful reasoning diversity. Verifier-based selection offers an alternative, but its performance depends on the calibration of an external reward model. We propose a verifier-free breadth--depth refinement framework that uses test-time compute to both explore and improve candidate solutions. The method samples multiple independent reasoning rollouts, refines each rollout through iterative self-critique and self-correction, and aggregates the refined answers by majority voting. Breadth preserves diverse initial attempts, while depth repairs local reasoning errors before aggregation. Across AIME24, AIME25, AMC, OlympiadBench, and MATH500, our method consistently improves over greedy decoding, majority voting, verifier-based best-of-$N$, beam search, and lookahead decoding across multiple open-weight models. For instance, with Qwen2.5-1.5B, accuracy increases from the strongest verifier-based baseline to $58.0\%$ on MATH500, and from $25.0\%$ to $32.5\%$ on AMC. These results show that test-time compute can be more effective when used to refine sampled trajectories rather than only to sample more candidates or rely on verifier-guided selection.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需验证器的广度-深度细化框架（Breadth-Depth Refinement），通过采样多个推理轨迹、对每条轨迹进行迭代自我批评与自我修正，再通过多数投票聚合结果，从而在测试时计算中同时实现探索与改进。在多个数学推理基准上优于贪婪解码、多数投票、验证器引导的best-of-N等基线。
AI.motivation: 测试时缩放（test-time scaling）可通过增加推理计算来提升LLM推理能力，但单纯的更广泛采样存在收益递减问题——新的采样轨迹往往重复已有答案模式，而非提供有用的推理多样性。验证器引导的选择方法则依赖外部奖励模型的校准质量，性能不稳定。因此需要一种既无需验证器、又能有效利用测试时计算的推理增强方法。
AI.method: 提出广度-深度细化（breadth-depth refinement）框架：(1) 广度维度：采样多个独立的推理rollout以保留多样化的初始尝试；(2) 深度维度：对每条rollout通过迭代的自我批评（self-critique）和自我修正（self-correction）来修复局部推理错误；(3) 聚合：将修正后的答案通过多数投票（majority voting）进行汇总。整个框架无需外部验证器。
AI.result: 在AIME24、AIME25、AMC、OlympiadBench和MATH500五个基准上，该方法在多个开放权重模型上一致优于贪婪解码、多数投票、验证器引导的best-of-N、beam search和lookahead decoding等基线。例如Qwen2.5-1.5B在MATH500上从最强验证器基线提升至58.0%，在AMC上从25.0%提升至32.5%。
AI.conclusion: 测试时计算在用于细化采样轨迹（而非仅增加采样数量或依赖验证器引导的选择）时更为有效。广度-深度细化框架为无需外部奖励模型的推理增强提供了新的思路。

title: Observation-Grounded Self-Predictive Reinforcement Learning for Visual Continuous Control
summary: Sample-efficient policy learning from pixels is a long-standing challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). Recent dynamics-based representation learning methods have significantly improved the sample efficiency of model-free visual RL by learning dynamics-aware representations through auxiliary prediction performed either in latent space (self-prediction) or observation space (observation prediction). However, state-of-the-art methods from both categories still struggle on challenging visual control tasks when training data is limited. We posit that relying on either predictive objective alone may be insufficient. In contrast, observation prediction grounds learned representations in observation-level dynamics, but does not directly regularize the temporal predictability of latent representations over extended horizons. In this paper, we propose Observation-Grounded Self-Predictive Representations (OG-SPR), a model-free visual RL algorithm for continuous control that learns representations that are both temporally predictive in latent space and grounded in observation-level dynamics. OG-SPR incorporates two core auxiliary objectives: multi-step latent self-prediction and next-observation prediction. We empirically show that directly imposing latent self-prediction on the shared representation may over-constrain it and does not necessarily improve performance. To address this issue, OG-SPR introduces two lightweight adapters for latent self-prediction, allowing the shared representation to benefit from temporally predictive signals without being forced to directly satisfy the self-prediction objective. Experiments on 28 visual control tasks from the DeepMind Control Suite show that OG-SPR improves aggregate performance over state-of-the-art self-predictive and observation-predictive RL methods, with particularly pronounced gains in challenging domains such as dog and humanoid.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OG-SPR，一种用于连续控制任务的模型无关视觉强化学习算法。该算法将多步潜在空间自预测与下一观测预测两种辅助目标相结合，并通过两个轻量级适配器缓解共享表示被过度约束的问题，在28个DeepMind Control任务上超越了现有的自预测和观测预测类方法。
AI.motivation: 视觉强化学习中基于动态的表示学习方法（包括潜在空间自预测和观测空间观测预测）虽已显著提升样本效率，但在数据有限的条件下仍难以应对具有挑战性的视觉控制任务。作者认为单独依赖任一预测目标可能不够充分：观测预测将表示锚定在观测级动态中，但不能直接正则化潜在表示在长期范围内的时间可预测性；自预测虽能实现时间预测，但缺乏观测级动态的锚定。
AI.method: OG-SPR包含两个核心辅助目标：多步潜在自预测和下一观测预测。为避免直接在共享表示上施加潜在自预测造成过度约束，OG-SPR引入两个轻量级适配器用于潜在自预测，使共享表示能够受益于时间预测信号而无需直接满足自预测目标。
AI.result: 在DeepMind Control Suite的28个视觉控制任务中，OG-SPR在整体性能上优于最先进的自预测和观测预测强化学习方法，在dog和humanoid等具有挑战性的领域上提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明，将潜在空间时间预测与观测级动态锚定相结合，并通过轻量级适配器避免表示过度约束，是一种更有效的视觉RL表示学习策略，尤其适用于数据受限的困难控制任务。

title: LAWM-3D: Learning 3D-Aware Latent Actions from Human Videos for Generalizable Robot World Models
summary: World models enable agents to perform forward rollout and planning without real-world interaction. However, their application in open-world embodied intelligence remains limited by the high cost of action annotations and the heterogeneity of action spaces across platforms. Recently, latent action models (LAMs) have alleviated this bottleneck by learning action representations directly from unlabeled human videos in a self-supervised manner. Nevertheless, most existing LAMs rely on single-view inputs and operate primarily in 2D pixel space, raising a fundamental question: can simply incorporating multi-view videos into LAM training endow the learned latent actions with 3D-aware perception? Our study shows that the answer is negative. The primary reasons lie in future-frame appearance leakage as well as inter-camera appearance discrepancies and viewpoint variations. To address these issues, we propose LAWM-3D, which introduces three tightly coupled key designs: (1) a multi-view invariant unified action tokenization scheme for learning 3D-aware latent actions; (2) a geometric alignment constraint that anchors intermediate encoder features to a pretrained 3D foundation model, thereby explicitly providing cross-view geometric correspondences; and (3) a non-injective RGB-D joint reconstruction objective that prevents shortcut learning from future-frame appearance information, forcing the LAM to focus supervision on motion cues with geometric significance. Importantly, these components are not simply stacked but are tightly coupled through a unified motivation. Built upon a two-stage paradigm of large-scale human video pretraining followed by robot fine-tuning, extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed 3D-aware latent actions significantly improve world model performance, achieving SOTA results in generation quality, physical consistency, and generalization ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAWM-3D，一种通过多视角视频预训练学习3D感知潜动作（latent actions）的方法。研究发现简单地将多视角视频加入LAM训练并不能自动获得3D感知能力，主要因为未来帧外观泄漏、跨相机外观差异和视角变化等问题。LAWM-3D通过三个紧耦合的关键设计（多视角不变统一动作分词、几何对齐约束、非注入式RGB-D联合重建目标）来解决这些问题，在生成质量、物理一致性和泛化能力上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在开放世界具身智能中的应用受限于动作标注的高成本和跨平台动作空间的异质性。潜动作模型（LAMs）虽然能通过自监督方式从未标注的人类视频中学习动作表征，但现有LAMs大多依赖单视角输入并在2D像素空间操作。作者质疑能否仅通过将多视角视频纳入LAM训练使潜动作获得3D感知能力，并证明答案是负面的，这促使他们设计新的方法来真正实现3D感知潜动作学习。
AI.method: LAWM-3D包含三个紧耦合的核心设计：(1) 多视角不变统一动作标记化方案，用于学习3D感知潜动作；(2) 几何对齐约束，将中间编码器特征锚定到预训练的3D基础模型，显式提供跨视角几何对应关系；(3) 非注入式RGB-D联合重建目标，防止从未来帧外观信息中进行捷径学习，迫使LAM将监督聚焦于具有几何意义的运动线索。方法采用两阶段范式：大规模人类视频预训练后接机器人微调。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的3D感知潜动作显著提升了世界模型性能，在生成质量、物理一致性和泛化能力方面均达到SOTA结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明简单地加入多视角视频并不能使LAM自动获得3D感知能力，必须通过精心设计的几何约束和防捷径机制的耦合来显式引导模型学习3D感知的潜动作表征，从而在真实世界应用中显著提升世界模型的性能。

title: Decomposed Entailment for Factuality Checking and Hallucination Detection
summary: The reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) is often compromised by factual inconsistencies, including hallucinations---cases where generated content is not supported by the underlying source. We present HallDetect, a lightweight, reference-free, and black-box framework for hallucination detection that we evaluate not only on summarization but across a broader range of source-grounded generation settings. HallDetect builds on decomposition-based factuality evaluation: generated content is decomposed into atomic claims, each verified by a compact encoder-based entailment model through a contrastive formulation over a multi-scale library of source chunks, and aggregated with an asymmetric score in which a single confidently contradicted claim flags the response. Under a controlled protocol in which all methods share the same 4-bit quantized backbones and consumer-grade hardware budget, HallDetect outperforms comparably resourced generative and embedding-based baselines on three of four benchmarks while remaining stable across backbone families, and yields a claim-to-span audit trail that localizes each error.

AI.tldr: HallDetect是一个轻量级、无需参考、黑盒的幻觉检测框架，通过将生成内容分解为原子声明，并使用紧凑的编码器蕴含模型进行验证，在受控协议下优于同资源的生成式和嵌入基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）经常产生与源内容不一致的事实性错误（幻觉），影响其可靠性。现有幻觉检测方法往往依赖大型生成式模型或需要参考文本，计算成本高且缺乏可解释性。作者希望提出一种轻量、黑盒、无需参考的检测方案，在有限硬件预算下保持高性能。
AI.method: HallDetect采用基于分解的事实性评估：1）将生成内容分解为原子声明（atomic claims）；2）每个声明通过紧凑的编码器蕴含模型，使用对比公式在多尺度源块库中验证；3）通过不对称评分聚合，单个被置信反驳的声明即可标记整个响应。所有方法共享4-bit量化骨干和消费级硬件预算的受控协议。
AI.result: 在四个基准中的三个上，HallDetect优于同等资源（4-bit量化、消费级硬件）的生成式和编码器基线，且在骨干家族间保持稳定性。同时生成声明到文本跨度的审计轨迹，可定位每个错误。
AI.conclusion: HallDetect为幻觉检测提供了轻量级且有效的替代方案：在受限计算资源下超越生成式基线，同时可解释性更强（可局部化错误），适用于更广泛的基于源文本的生成场景（如摘要、问答等）。

title: Evidential Rule Learning for Interpretable Classification with Abstention
summary: Interpretable classification often requires more than accurate predictions for real-life deployment: models should be transparent about the evidence behind their decisions and abstain when they cannot decide reliably. We introduce Fast Evidential Rule Learning (FERL), a method that learns interpretable, accurate fuzzy rule models whose outputs are evidential. Unlike post-hoc calibration, FERL's belief, plausibility, and abstention capabilities arise directly from the fuzzy memberships in a single deterministic pass, with no auxiliary head, held-out set, or repeated inference. Our theoretical analysis further shows that FERL is Lipschitz stable, which means that its evidential outputs vary smoothly with the input. Against state-of-the-art rule learners, FERL is statistically significantly more accurate across a 30 tabular-dataset benchmark ($+2.6\%$ average accuracy over the second best). Its native set predictions attain the best utility-discounted accuracy among credal classifiers ($u_{65}/u_{80}=0.80/0.83$ vs.\ $0.79/0.80$ for the naive credal classifier), at higher set coverage ($0.92$ vs.\ $\le0.82$). FERL also matches dedicated out-of-distribution detectors on tabular near-OOD detection ($77.7$ vs.\ $77.4$ AUROC for the strongest baseline). Under detector-class-disjoint concept-bottleneck evaluation, its it is within $2.3$ AUROC points of the strongest dedicated detector on both CUB and AwA2, while attaining the best AwA2 AUPR-Out ($68.3$) and novel-class rejection ($57.2$), while being able to name which attributes are anomalous.

AI.tldr: FERL是一种可解释的模糊规则学习方法，其输出具有证据性质（belief、plausibility、abstention），在一次确定性前向传播中自然获得，无需后处理校准。理论证明其Lipschitz稳定，在30个表格数据集基准上优于现有规则学习器，并在set prediction、OOD检测和概念瓶颈评估中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 可解释分类模型不仅需要准确预测，还需要对决策证据透明，并在无法可靠决策时弃权。现有方法依赖事后校准，无法直接从模型结构中获得证据性输出。
AI.method: FERL通过模糊隶属度直接产生证据输出（信念、似然、弃权），无需辅助头、保留集或重复推理，单次确定性前向传播即可完成。论文还从理论上证明了FERL的Lipschitz稳定性，保证证据输出随输入平滑变化。
AI.result: 在30个表格数据集基准上，FERL比最强的规则学习器平均准确率高2.6%；set prediction的效用折扣准确率u65/u80=0.80/0.83（对比朴素credal分类器的0.79/0.80），set覆盖率达0.92（对比≤0.82）；表格近OOD检测AUROC 77.7（对比最强基线77.4）；在CUB和AwA2概念瓶颈评估中与最强专用检测器差距在2.3 AUROC以内，并在AwA2上取得最佳AUPR-Out（68.3）和新类别拒绝率（57.2），且能指出哪些属性异常。
AI.conclusion: FERL证明可解释的模糊规则模型可以直接内在地获得证据性输出能力，在准确性、set prediction、OOD检测和概念瓶颈异常识别等多个维度上均达到或超越专门的基线方法，同时保持模型的可解释性和理论上的稳定性保障。

title: A Unified Framework for Trajectory Prediction with Explicit Planning and Reaction Decomposition
summary: Trajectory prediction has shifted toward structured formulations with explicit social modeling. However, existing methods inadequately distinguish the functional roles of social influence in trajectory planning. Observing that agents typically form motion plans by anticipating others' future behaviors before making local reactive adjustments, we identify social interactions as playing staged roles, namely planning precedes reaction. We propose INTraJ, a unified framework that decomposes social influence into two stages: a planning stage constructs reference trajectories using future social information, and a reaction stage recovers local adjustments from the residual between full-context prediction and the reference. INTraJ supports both multi-target and single-target paradigms. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks, including Argoverse 2, Argoverse 2-ped, ETH/UCY, and SDD, demonstrate consistent improvements, particularly in FDE and long-horizon consistency, with state-of-the-art performance achieved in several settings. INTraJ reframes trajectory prediction as a planning-driven two-stage process, validating that staged social modeling is critical for stable predictions. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/11isnotavailable/INTraJ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出INTraJ框架，将轨迹预测中的社会交互影响分解为"规划优先、反应后置"的两阶段过程：规划阶段利用未来社会信息构建参考轨迹，反应阶段从全上下文预测与参考轨迹的残差中恢复局部调整。在Argoverse 2、Argoverse 2-ped、ETH/UCY和SDD四个基准上取得一致改进，尤其在FDE和长时程一致性方面达到SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹预测方法虽然采用结构化公式并显式建模社会交互，但未能充分区分社会影响在轨迹规划中的功能角色。作者观察到智能体通常先基于对他者未来行为的预期形成运动计划，再进行局部反应调整，因此社会交互存在阶段性作用（规划先于反应），现有方法未对此进行建模。
AI.method: INTraJ是一个统一框架，将社会影响分解为两阶段：(1) 规划阶段——利用未来社会信息构造参考轨迹；(2) 反应阶段——从全上下文预测与参考轨迹之间的残差中恢复局部调整。该框架同时支持多目标与单目标预测范式。
AI.result: 在Argoverse 2、Argoverse 2-ped、ETH/UCY和SDD四个标准基准上进行了广泛实验，结果表明INTraJ在FDE和长时程一致性指标上取得一致改进，在多个设定下达到当前最优（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: INTraJ将轨迹预测重新定义为由规划驱动的两阶段过程，验证了阶段性社会建模对稳定预测至关重要。代码已公开。

title: One Ranking, Any Budget: Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context Frame Selection for Long-Video Understanding
summary: Frame selection is essential for applying Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to long videos due to severe frame redundancy and limited context windows. Since the appropriate frame budget varies with the downstream LMM, reasoning demands, and latency constraints, a practical selector should serve multiple budgets. However, existing methods typically optimize an isolated frame subset for each predefined budget: when the budget changes, previously selected evidence may be replaced rather than progressively augmented. Ranking frames by a fixed score would allow prefix reuse across budgets, but it ignores the distinct roles of different ranking positions. In this paper, we formulate long-video frame selection as a Matryoshka ranking problem: constructing a single priority sequence whose small prefixes concentrate query-conditioned evidence, while progressively larger prefixes preserve this evidence and add broader temporal context. Efficiently constructing such a ranking is itself challenging, as densely sampling long videos and evaluating frame-query relevance incurs substantial overhead. We therefore introduce Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context (MEC) Frame Selection, a training-free framework that builds a reusable sparse video index, discovers candidates through sparse probing and local zooming, and greedily constructs a position-adaptive ranking: early positions emphasize evidence; later positions progressively favor temporal coverage while preserving visual diversity. A single ranking can thus be truncated to any target budget without rerunning the selector. Across four benchmarks and six frame budgets, MEC improves average accuracy over uniform sampling by 3.77 percentage points, matches strong state-of-the-art selectors, and reduces end-to-end selection latency by 47.37-51.19%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MEC（Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context）帧选择方法，将长时间视频帧选择建模为套娃（Matryoshka）排序问题：构建单一优先级序列，其小前缀集中查询相关证据，较大前缀保留证据并补充更广泛的时间上下文。通过可复用稀疏索引、稀疏探测与局部缩放，以及位置自适应贪婪排序，实现无需重新运行即可在任何目标预算下截断使用的通用帧选择器。
AI.motivation: 现有帧选择方法为每个预定预算优化独立的帧子集，当预算变化时已有证据可能被替换而非渐进式增补；而按固定分数排序虽支持前缀复用，却忽略了不同排序位置的独特作用。需要在多预算场景下兼顾证据集中与时间覆盖的自适应排序。
AI.method: MEC是一个训练无关（training-free）框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 构建可复用的稀疏视频索引；(2) 通过稀疏探测与局部缩放发现候选帧；(3) 贪心构建位置自适应排序——早期位置强调证据，后期位置渐进偏向时间覆盖并保持视觉多样性。单一排序可截断到任意预算而无需重新运行选择器。
AI.result: 在四个基准和六个帧预算下，MEC相比均匀采样平均提升3.77个百分点准确率，达到与强基线最先进选择器相当的性能，并将端到端选择延迟降低47.37%-51.19%。
AI.conclusion: MEC通过将帧选择重新定义为Matryoshka排序问题，实现了单一序列支持多预算的高效复用，在准确率、延迟与泛化性之间取得了良好平衡，为长视频下的LMM多预算帧选择提供了实用且有效的解决方案。

title: MoCA: Implicit Social Context Analysis
summary: Human social communication, such as affection and intent, is often conveyed in highly implicit ways, where underlying meanings are expressed through indirect, socially and culturally grounded signals rather than explicit statements. Such implicit social contexts are pervasive in real-world interactions, yet there remains a lack of a formal and systematic framework for studying them. In this paper, we introduce Implicit Social Context Analysis (MoCA), a novel task that systematically models implicit social scenarios along three key dimensions: affection, intent, and stance. We construct a high-quality benchmark containing 3,108 multimodal instances collected from real-world sources, with fine-grained cognitive annotations revealing who expresses what toward whom, as well as how and why it is conveyed. Using the MoCA dataset, we show that state-of-the-art multimodal large language models struggle significantly with this task because of their reliance on explicit cues and limited ability to reason over latent social contexts. To address this challenge, we propose Conflict-Driven Abductive Reasoning (CoDAR), a novel framework that models the discrepancy between observed expressions and expected truthful behavior as cognitive conflict, thereby enabling the inference of hidden mental states. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoDAR substantially improves model performance. Nevertheless, a large gap from human reasoning remains, highlighting the fundamental difficulty of implicit social understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出隐式社会情境分析（MoCA）任务，系统建模隐式社交场景中的情感、意图和立场三个维度，构建了包含3,108个多模态实例的高质量基准数据集。同时提出基于冲突驱动的溯因推理框架（CoDAR），通过建模观察表达与预期真实行为之间的认知冲突来推断隐含心理状态，实验表明该框架显著提升了模型性能，但与人类推理仍有较大差距。
AI.motivation: 人类社会交流中情感和意图等往往以高度隐式的方式传达，底层含义通过间接且具有社会文化背景的信号表达而非直接陈述。这种隐式社会语境在真实交互中普遍存在，但缺乏形式化、系统化的研究框架。
AI.method: 1）提出MoCA任务，从情感（affection）、意图（intent）和立场（stance）三个关键维度系统建模隐式社交场景；2）构建包含3,108个多模态实例的高质量基准数据集，具有细粒度认知标注（谁向谁表达什么，以及如何和为何传达）；3）提出CoDAR（冲突驱动溯因推理）框架，将观察到的表达与预期真实行为之间的差异建模为认知冲突，从而推断隐藏的心理状态。
AI.result: 实验表明，最先进的多模态大语言模型在MoCA任务上表现困难，原因在于它们依赖显式线索且对潜在社会语境的推理能力有限。CoDAR框架显著提升了模型性能，但与人类推理水平仍存在较大差距。
AI.conclusion: 隐式社会理解本质上具有根本性难度，尽管CoDAR框架有效，但当前模型与人类推理之间仍有显著鸿沟，凸显了这一任务对多模态大语言模型的持续挑战。

title: Beyond Feature Importance: A Comparative Analysis of Pattern Detection Methods in Cluster Interpretation
comment: 6 pages. Accepted in 36th Irish Signals and Systems Conference (ISSC) 2026
summary: Interpreting clustering outcomes remains a fundamental challenge in data analysis, particularly in domains such as healthcare where meaningful patterns must be extracted from high-dimensional data. While numerous explainability techniques exist, they are primarily designed to assess feature importance or provide local instance-level explanations rather than to identify structured patterns present within clusters. This work presents a comparative evaluation of commonly used post-hoc analysis methods for pattern detection in clustering results. To enable controlled evaluation, we introduce a suite of synthetic datasets in which predefined patterns are systematically injected. Three widely used techniques are evaluated: a Random Forest surrogate model with permutation feature importance, LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations), and principal component analysis. Results demonstrate that although each method can successfully recover relevant features, none consistently detects all injected pattern types. These findings high- light a critical gap between existing explainability tools and the requirements of pattern-level cluster interpretation, motivating the development of dedicated pattern detection methodologies.

AI.tldr: 本文比较评估了三种常用的后验分析（post-hoc）方法——随机森林替代模型结合置换特征重要性、LIME和主成分分析——在聚类结果中进行模式检测的能力。作者构建了可系统注入预定义模式的合成数据集，结果表明每种方法虽能恢复相关特征，但均无法一致地检测所有注入的模式类型，揭示了现有可解释性工具与模式级聚类解释需求之间的关键差距。
AI.motivation: 聚类结果的解释仍然是数据分析中的根本性挑战，尤其是在医疗保健等高维数据领域。现有可解释性技术主要关注特征重要性或局部实例级解释，而非识别聚类中存在的结构化模式，因此需要评估现有方法在模式级聚类解释中的表现，以明确工具差距。
AI.method: 作者设计了一组合成数据集，在其中系统注入预定义的模式，并采用受控评估的方式，对三种广泛使用的技术进行比较：基于随机森林替代模型与置换特征重要性、LIME（局部可解释模型无关解释）、以及主成分分析（PCA），评估它们在聚类结果中检测模式的能力。
AI.result: 结果表明，尽管每种方法都能成功恢复相关特征，但没有任何一种方法能够一致地检测所有注入的模式类型。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了现有可解释性工具与模式级聚类解释要求之间存在关键差距，这为开发专门用于聚类模式检测的新方法提供了动机和基础。

title: Grounded Well-Condition Anomaly Detection on the Volve Field: Constructed Labels, a Baseline, and a Dual-Head Model
summary: Most public benchmarks for machine-condition monitoring come from test rigs, where faults are induced on purpose and every event is known. Real production fields rarely offer that. They give you sensor histories with no fault log attached, which is exactly the situation where an anomaly-detection method has to invent its own labels, and where quiet assumptions can slip in unnoticed. We work with the open Volve field data released by Equinor and take two things seriously that such datasets usually skip. First, we build anomaly labels that are not just patterns in the numbers but are checked against what the field's own engineering documents say can physically go wrong, and we release the reasoning behind every label. Second, we test whether those constructed labels are learnable at all, using both an unsupervised baseline and a small dual-head model that marks when an event happens and what kind it is, an idea we carry over from earlier work on defect detection in metal parts. The results are honest. An unsupervised detector that never sees the labels still lands on the same regions our rules flagged, which tells us the labels are not arbitrary. A compact supervised model recovers event presence and event type well across wells it has never seen, and locates events in time only roughly. We report what worked, what did not, and every assumption in between. The dataset, grounded labels, per-label provenance, baseline scores, trained model, and code are released publicly under CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Equinor公开的Volve油田数据，构建了经工程文档验证的异常标注（含推理溯源），并测试了这些标注的可学习性。无监督基线能覆盖规则标注的区域，证明标注非任意；紧凑的双头监督模型能在新井上较好地恢复事件存在性和类型，但时间定位仅大致准确。数据集、标注、溯源、基线分数和代码均以CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0公开。
AI.motivation: 大多数机器状态监测的公开基准来自试验台，故障是人为诱导且事件已知；而真实生产现场的数据通常没有故障日志，异常检测方法需要自行生成标签，容易引入隐蔽且未经检验的假设。作者希望解决真实工业场景中无故障日志数据的标注可信度问题，确保标签不与数值模式随意对应，而是有物理和工程依据支撑。
AI.method: 使用Equinor公开的Volve油田数据：(1) 构建异常标签时，不仅依据数据中的数值模式，还对照油田自身的工程文档验证哪些故障在物理上可能发生，并为每个标签发布推理溯源；(2) 使用无监督基线检测器测试标签的可学习性，同时借鉴之前金属零件缺陷检测工作中的双头模型（同时标注事件发生时刻与事件类型）进行监督学习验证。
AI.result: 无监督检测器尽管从未见过标签，仍能在规则标注的区域上取得一致结果，说明标签并非任意构造；紧凑的监督模型在未见过的井上能较好地恢复事件存在性和事件类型，但对事件的时间定位只能做到大致准确。所有资源（数据集、标注、逐标签溯源、基线分数、训练模型和代码）均已发布。
AI.conclusion: 通过在真实油田数据上结合工程文档进行标注构建与验证，证明了：(1) 基于规则和物理依据的异常标注是可信且可学习的；(2) 无监督方法可以佐证标注的合理性；(3) 监督模型在跨井泛化上有效但时间定位精度仍有限。研究同时如实地报告了有效、无效之处以及所有潜在假设。

title: Iterative Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Viewpoint Planning for UAV Photogrammetry
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for publication at the 14th IEEE European Conference on Visual Information Processing (EUVIP 2026)
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry requires camera networks that provide sufficient surface coverage, image overlap, parallax, and resolution, yet conventional flight patterns are often poorly adapted to scene geometry resulting in local reconstruction errors. This paper proposes an iterative hybrid discrete-continuous viewpoint planning method for targeted UAV photogrammetry from a proxy reconstruction. The method scores sampled surface points using photogrammetric heuristics based on frontality, imaging distance, parallax, and multi-view observation count, while also evaluating the full viewpoint set in terms of visibility, pairwise overlap, and graph connectivity. Candidate viewpoints are generated around weakly observed regions, refined using clustered Covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES) optimisation, and removed when redundant. The final flight path combines close-range detail viewpoints with wider model-coverage viewpoints, balancing local reconstruction quality with global image-network robustness. Evaluation on three synthetic scenes shows that the proposed method improves both reconstruction accuracy and completeness compared with prior UAV path-planning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种迭代式混合离散-连续视点规划方法，用于基于代理重建的无人机针对性摄影测量，通过光度测量启发式打分、CMA-ES优化与冗余视点剔除相结合，平衡局部重建质量与全局影像网络鲁棒性，在三个合成场景上相较先前方法提升了重建精度与完整性。
AI.motivation: 传统无人机航线规划往往不能适应复杂场景几何结构，导致局部重建误差。需要一种能够针对场景几何特点自适应规划视点的方法，以提升重建质量。
AI.method: 提出迭代式混合离散-连续视点规划框架：1）基于代理重建对采样表面点用正对性（frontality）、成像距离、视差、多视角观测计数等摄影测量启发式进行打分；2）从整体评价视点集的可见性、成对重叠和图像连通性；3）在弱观测区域生成候选视点，用聚类CMA-ES（协方差矩阵自适应进化策略）进行连续优化；4）剔除冗余视点；5）最终路径融合近景细节视点与广域覆盖视点，平衡局部质量与全局鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在三个合成场景上，所提方法相比先前的无人机路径规划方法，在重建精度（accuracy）和完整性（completeness）两方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 混合离散-连续视点规划策略能有效提升无人机摄影测量的重建质量，兼顾局部细节与全局网络鲁棒性，为复杂场景下的无人机自主航迹规划提供了有效方案。

title: Enhancing Social Intelligence in LLMs with Hierarchical Reasoning and Utterance-Level Goal Rewarding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel in structured tasks but struggle with dynamic social interactions, where success requires long-term goal coordination and rapid adaptation. Current methods often apply uniform goal-based rewards to every utterance, overlooking the specificity of objectives at each dialogue turn and failing to account for the rationale of potential strategies. Inspired by the Theory of Planned Behavior, we propose the Think-Strategy-Response (TSR) framework, which decomposes social dialogue into two hierarchical stages: high-level strategic planning and low-level linguistic execution. To optimize TSR, we introduce Linearized Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Variance-Gated Rewards (LHRL-VGR), a novel algorithm that dynamically routes rewards - balancing goal completion and strategy adherence - based on the variance of goal achievement scores. Experiments on the SOTOPIA benchmark show that our approach fine-tunes a Qwen2.5-7B agent to surpass the GPT-4o baseline by 7.32% in goal completion success, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance in multi-agent social negotiation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出TSR框架，将社交对话分解为高层战略规划和低层语言执行两个层级，并引入LHRL-VGR算法通过方差门控奖励动态路由平衡目标完成与策略遵循，在SOTOPIA基准上使Qwen2.5-7B智能体超越GPT-4o基线7.32%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在结构化任务中表现出色，但在动态社交互动中面临挑战，因为社交互动需要长期目标协调和快速适应。现有方法对所有话语应用统一的目标奖励，忽略了每个对话轮次目标的特殊性，也没有考虑潜在策略的合理性。
AI.method: 借鉴计划行为理论，提出TSR框架将社交对话分解为两个层级：高层战略规划（策略决策）和低层语言执行（话语生成）。为优化TSR，引入LHRL-VGR算法，这是一种线性化分层强化学习算法，通过目标达成分数的方差动态路由奖励信号，在目标完成和策略遵循之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在SOTOPIA基准上进行实验，该方法微调的Qwen2.5-7B智能体在目标完成成功率上超越GPT-4o基线7.32%，在多智能体社会协商任务中达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层策略与方差门控奖励的联合设计，证明了在社交对话中显式区分战略规划与语言执行、并基于目标达成方差自适应调整奖励权重，可以显著提升大语言模型在复杂社交互动中的表现。

title: Alternating Levenberg-Marquardt Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Fourier-Enhanced Features
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often fail to accurately resolve partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-frequency or multi-scale solutions, as well as strongly nonlinear problems. Two factors underlie this difficulty: spectral bias, the tendency of neural networks to underfit high-frequency features; and representation-coefficient coupling, the entanglement of representation learning and coefficient fitting within a single nonconvex optimization objective. In this work, we propose the Fourier-enhanced alternating Levenberg--Marquardt PINN (FALM-PINN), an optimization framework that decouples representation learning from coefficient fitting. The upper-level problem learns a Fourier-enhanced basis that enriches the latent space with high-frequency components, while the lower-level problem resolves the coupling by fitting the projection coefficients on this basis, solving a nonlinear least-squares problem with the Levenberg--Marquardt algorithm. The framework applies to general nonlinear and coupled PDE systems, and reduces to a single-step convex optimization problem for linear PDEs. We prove global convergence of the alternating training scheme in both cases. Numerical examples on multiple challenging high-frequency and nonlinear PDEs show that FALM-PINN achieves relative $L^2$ errors up to two orders of magnitude lower than state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出FALM-PINN，一种将表示学习与系数拟合解耦的优化框架，通过傅里叶增强基和交替Levenberg-Marquardt算法解决PINN在高频、多尺度及强非线性PDE上的失效问题，相对L2误差比SOTA基线低两个数量级。
AI.motivation: PINN在处理具有高频或多尺度解的PDE以及强非线性问题时往往无法精确求解，根本原因有二：一是谱偏置（神经网络倾向于欠拟合高频特征）；二是表示-系数耦合（表示学习与系数拟合纠缠在同一非凸优化目标中）。
AI.method: 提出FALM-PINN框架：上层问题学习傅里叶增强基，在隐空间中补充高频分量；下层问题通过Levenberg-Marquardt算法在该基上拟合投影系数，求解非线性最小二乘问题。该框架适用于一般非线性和耦合PDE系统，对线性PDE可退化为单步凸优化问题。
AI.result: 在多个具有挑战性的高频和非线性PDE数值算例中，FALM-PINN的相对L2误差比最先进基线低两个数量级。同时证明了交替训练方案在两种情况下均具有全局收敛性。
AI.conclusion: FALM-PINN通过解耦表示学习与系数拟合，有效克服了谱偏置和表示-系数耦合这两个导致PINN失效的核心障碍，为高频和非线性PDE求解提供了精度显著提升的优化框架，并具备全局收敛的理论保证。

title: PhyLatent: Learning Dynamics-Relevant Representations for JEPA World Models
summary: We propose PhyLatent, a dynamics-relevant training objective for JointEmbedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Our key observation is that preventing global latent collapse does not ensure that a representation preserves physical states and action consequences. We identify three failure modes in JEPA world models: physical invariance collapse, physical identifiability collapse, and counterfactual dynamics collapse. PhyLatent addresses them through three training pathways: physical invariance, physical identifiability, and counterfactual dynamics, implemented with physical state grounding, future representation alignment, static visual invariance, counterfactual branch separation, and latent denoising. On OGBench-Cube, PhyLatent reduces the three failure rates from 15.60%, 6.71%, and 8.41% to 7.53%, 0.95%, and 4.62%, respectively, and improves model predictive control (MPC) success from 70.0% to 78.1%. With the same architecture and planner, it further improves success from 81.0% to 98.0% on TwoRooms and remains competitive on Reacher and PushT. These results show that global non-collapse alone is insufficient for learning a reliable JEPA worldmodel state space.

AI.tldr: 提出PhyLatent，一种针对JEPA世界模型的动力学相关训练目标，通过物理不变性、物理可辨识性和反事实动力学三条训练路径，解决JEPA世界模型中的三类物理坍缩失败模式，显著降低失败率并提升模型预测控制成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅关注防止全局潜在表征坍缩，但作者观察到防止全局坍缩并不能保证表征保留物理状态和动作后果，存在三类被忽视的物理相关坍缩问题。
AI.method: 提出三条训练路径：物理不变性（静态视觉不变性）、物理可辨识性（物理状态锚定、未来表征对齐）、反事实动力学（反事实分支分离与潜在去噪），共同构成动力学相关的训练目标。
AI.result: 在OGBench-Cube上，三类失败率从15.60%、6.71%、8.41%降至7.53%、0.95%、4.62%，MPC成功率从70.0%提升至78.1%；TwoRooms上成功率达98.0%，在Reacher和PushT上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 全局非坍缩不足以保证学习到可靠的JEPA世界模型状态空间，需要显式的动力学相关训练目标来确保表征保留物理状态与动作后果。

title: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
summary: We present MameLoshnLM, the first open-source 8B-parameter language model built specifically for Yiddish. Despite Yiddish's rich textual tradition, its limited digital presence and the scarcity of reliable evaluation resources have constrained progress in Yiddish language modeling. Existing multilingual corpora and benchmarks are often poor proxies for the language, containing substantial amounts of noisy, machine-translated, and misclassified text. We address these gaps by introducing Oytser, a high-quality Yiddish pretraining corpus that combines contemporary web-native sources with literary materials, and Kashes, a multi-task benchmark spanning translation, linguistic analysis, information extraction, and language understanding. Using these resources, we continue pretraining Llama 3.1 8B to obtain MameLoshnLM. Across the tasks in the benchmark, MameLoshnLM outperforms open baselines of similar scale. Our analyses show that these gains are not only quantitative: relative to general-purpose multilingual models, MameLoshnLM better captures language-defining lexical and morphological patterns, pointing to a broader failure mode of noisy web-scale multilingual data for low-resource languages. Our results provide both a foundation for Yiddish NLP and a practical template for language model development in historically rich but digitally underrepresented languages.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MameLoshnLM，首个专门为意第绪语构建的8B参数开源语言模型，并配套发布了高质量预训练语料库Oytser和多任务基准Kashes，通过继续预训练Llama 3.1 8B获得该模型，在各项任务上超越同规模开放基线，不仅定量提升且更好地捕捉了意第绪语的词汇和形态特征。
AI.motivation: 意第绪语虽拥有丰富的文本传统，但数字资源稀缺、可靠评测资源匮乏，现有多语言语料库和基准包含大量噪声、机器翻译和错误分类的文本，不能作为该语言的可靠代理，严重制约了意第绪语语言建模的发展。
AI.method: 构建了Oytser高质量意第绪语预训练语料库（结合当代网络原生文本与文学材料）和Kashes多任务基准（涵盖翻译、语言分析、信息抽取和语言理解），基于此对Llama 3.1 8B进行继续预训练得到MameLoshnLM。
AI.result: MameLoshnLM在Kashes基准的各项任务上均超越同规模开放基线；分析表明其增益不仅是定量的，相对通用多语言模型，该模型更好地捕捉了意第绪语定义性的词汇和形态模式，揭示了大规模多语言噪声数据对低资源语言造成的更广泛失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为意第绪语NLP奠定了坚实基础，同时为历史丰富但数字欠代表语言的模型开发提供了实用模板。

title: CohortHijack: Robustness of Single Cell Annotation to Companion Cell Removal
summary: Many single-cell annotation tools refine an initial cell label using nearby cells or cluster-level voting. We study whether this refinement can be manipulated without changing the target cell. We introduce CohortHijack, a robustness audit that removes selected non-target cells from the query cohort while preserving the target expression profile, base prediction, and trained model. We evaluate random and structured removal methods, together with greedy, multi-start, and beam search, on PBMC3K and Paul15 using logistic regression and calibrated linear SVM classifiers. Structured removal was consistently stronger than random removal on Paul15. Multi-start search changed 24.33% of linear-SVM targets and 19.67% of logistic-regression targets while removing a small fraction of the cohort and keeping mean collateral changes below 0.4%. Ablations confirmed that the effect disappeared when neighborhood refinement was disabled. We also evaluated CellTypist majority voting, where independent predictions remained unchanged across all evaluations, but refined labels changed after small companion-cell removals. These findings identify query cohort composition as a target-preserving attack surface in single-cell annotation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CohortHijack，一种针对单细胞注释工具中邻域/聚类级标签细化环节的鲁棒性审计方法。通过移除查询队列中的非目标细胞（同时保持目标细胞表达谱、基础预测和模型不变），该方法能够操纵细化后的标签。实验表明结构化移除显著强于随机移除，多起点搜索在PBMC3K和Paul15数据集上可改变约20-24%的目标标签，且附带损伤极小。这一发现将查询队列组成识别为单细胞注释中一种目标保持型攻击面。
AI.motivation: 现有的单细胞注释工具通常通过邻近细胞投票或聚类级投票来细化初始细胞标签，但这种细化过程是否存在可被操纵的漏洞尚未被系统研究。作者旨在探究是否可以在不改变目标细胞本身的情况下，通过操控其查询队列中的其他细胞来影响最终的细化标签，从而揭示标签细化环节的潜在安全风险。
AI.method: 提出CohortHijack鲁棒性审计框架：从查询队列中移除选定的非目标细胞，同时严格保持目标细胞的表达谱、基础预测和已训练模型不变。评估了随机移除和结构化移除两种策略，并采用贪心、多起点和束搜索等搜索算法。在PBMC3K和Paul15数据集上，使用逻辑回归和校准线性SVM作为基础分类器进行验证。同时评估了CellTypist的多数投票细化机制。通过消融实验验证当邻域细化被禁用时攻击效果消失。
AI.result: 在Paul15上结构化移除始终优于随机移除。多起点搜索改变了24.33%的线性SVM目标和19.67%的逻辑回归目标，且仅移除少量队列细胞，平均附带变化低于0.4%。消融实验确认禁用邻域细化后攻击效果消失。对于CellTypist，独立的多数投票预测在所有评估中保持不变，但细化标签在少量伴细胞移除后发生改变。
AI.conclusion: 查询队列的组成构成了单细胞注释中一种目标保持型攻击表面——攻击者可以通过操控非目标伴细胞来改变目标细胞的细化标签，而无需改动目标本身或模型。这揭示了现有标签细化机制的脆弱性，提示需要对此类邻域/聚类投票细化方案进行安全性加固。

title: Shaping Human-AI Interactions to Provide Improvement Pathways and Balance Competing Objectives
summary: When an AI system is deployed, the individuals who use and or are evaluated by it form beliefs about how the system operates and use those beliefs to strategically present their preferences, behaviors, or attributes. The system then responds with feedback or a decision outcome, thereby creating a human-AI interaction loop. This thesis studies how to design and shape such interactions to achieve three goals: (1) help individuals develop accurate beliefs about the AI systems so they can improve and or secure favorable outcomes at minimal cost, (2) encourage improvement and or discourage gaming behaviors, and (3) ensure that the AI system continues to achieve its intended objectives, such as maximizing accuracy. To address these goals, the thesis is organized into three complementary parts that examine and study human-AI interactions from the perspectives of both evaluated individuals and AI systems. Together, the work presented in this thesis advances human-centered machine learning by providing principles and methods for designing AI systems that align with human needs, values, and capabilities. Methodologically, this thesis integrates theoretical analysis, data-driven modeling, human-subject experiments, and empirical evaluations on real-world and semi-synthetic datasets.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究人机交互循环中AI系统的设计与塑造，目标包括：帮助个体建立对AI系统的准确信念、鼓励改进并抑制博弈行为、确保AI系统持续实现其预期目标。论文从被评估个体与AI系统双重视角出发，整合理论分析、数据驱动建模、人类受试者实验及真实/半合成数据集的实证评估，推进以人为中心的机器学习。
AI.motivation: AI系统部署后，用户或受评估者会形成对该系统运作方式的信念，并据此策略性地呈现自身偏好、行为或属性，形成人机交互循环。然而如何在这种交互中同时满足个体（获得准确信念、以最小成本改善结果）与系统（鼓励良性改进、抑制博弈、保持目标达成）的需求，缺乏系统性的设计原则与方法。
AI.method: 论文分为三个互补部分，从被评估个体和AI系统两个视角研究人机交互。方法论上整合了理论分析、数据驱动建模、人类受试者实验，以及在真实世界和半合成数据集上的实证评估。
AI.result: 论文提出了面向以人为中心的机器学习的设计原则与方法，用于设计能够与人类需求、价值和能力对齐的AI系统，并在人机交互循环中实现个体与系统双重目标的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过多方法论、多视角的研究，为设计既能帮助个体提升表现/获取有利结果，又能抑制博弈行为并维持系统目标的人机交互AI系统提供了系统的原则和方法，推进了以人为中心的机器学习领域发展。

title: Engram-E2VID: Reference-Based Event-to-Video Reconstruction via Generative Activation of Appearance Engrams
summary: Reference-based event-to-video reconstruction aims to recover target RGB frames from a reference frame and the event stream captured over the reference-to-target interval. Although events provide fine-grained temporal cues, they encode sparse and asynchronous log-intensity changes rather than absolute appearance, making faithful reconstruction intrinsically challenging. The central challenge lies in associating event-derived target-time structures with relevant appearance information from the reference frame, especially under complex motion and long temporal intervals. In this work, we propose Engram-E2VID, a structure-guided framework that reconstructs target frames through the generative activation of appearance engrams. Specifically, the reference frame is encoded into token-space appearance engrams, while the event stream and reference context are transformed into a target-time motion-structure scaffold that captures motion boundaries and event-induced structural changes. Within a one-step diffusion backbone, scaffold-derived structural tokens progressively interact with and activate relevant appearance engrams across layers. This token-space association allows target structures to access reference appearance without relying on direct pixel-wise correspondence, while the diffusion prior complements uncertain or newly revealed regions. Across three benchmarks, Engram-E2VID improves PSNR by up to 3.29 dB and reduces LPIPS by up to 0.08 over the strongest same-input baseline, while degrading more slowly as the reconstruction interval increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Engram-E2VID，一种基于结构引导的事件到视频重建框架，通过将参考帧编码为外观印记（engrams），将事件流转换为目标时刻的运动结构支架，在一阶扩散主干中实现结构令牌与外观印记的生成式交互激活，从而在三个基准上将PSNR提升最高3.29dB、LPIPS降低最高0.08。
AI.motivation: 事件到视频重建的核心挑战在于：事件流仅编码稀疏的、非同步的对数强度变化而非绝对外观信息，难以与参考帧的外观信息进行关联，尤其在复杂运动和长时间间隔下，直接基于像素对应的方法表现不佳。
AI.method: 1) 将参考帧编码为token空间的外观印记；2) 将事件流与参考上下文变换为目标时刻的运动结构支架，捕获运动边界与事件诱导的结构变化；3) 在一阶扩散骨干中，支架衍生的结构token跨层渐进地与相关外观印记交互激活；4) 通过token空间关联实现结构-外观访问，无需像素级对应，扩散先验补充不确定或新出现区域。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，Engram-E2VID相比最强同输入基线，PSNR最高提升3.29dB，LPIPS最高降低0.08，且随着重建间隔增大性能退化更慢。
AI.conclusion: Engram-E2VID验证了结构引导+扩散先验的事件到视频重建范式的有效性，通过token空间外观印记激活机制绕过了像素级对应的局限，在重建精度和长间隔鲁棒性上均优于现有方法。

title: Mapping Similarity Spaces across Embedding Models with Synthetic Query Probing
comment: Accepted for 29th International Conference on Discovery Science, October 5-9, 2026, Mainz, Germany
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems rely on similarity scores to retrieve relevant content, yet scores are not directly comparable across embedding models due to differing geometric properties, complicating model migration and limiting threshold reuse. We study how similarity scores can be related by learning mappings between score distributions rather than embeddings. We introduce Synthetic Query Probing, generating queries from documents to create controlled query-chunk pairs, enabling large-scale, reference-free analysis of cross-model similarity behavior. We evaluate the approach on multiple embedding configurations and learn score conversion functions using linear, isotonic, and quantile mappings. Experiments on SciFact and a proprietary corpus show that while models largely agree on rankings, their absolute scores exhibit systematic distortions. Learned mappings partially align these spaces and improve threshold portability, with isotonic regression performing best. Our results highlight the need for cross-model calibration and position Synthetic Query Probing as a scalable framework for analyzing embedding comparability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RAG系统中不同嵌入模型之间的相似度分数映射问题，提出Synthetic Query Probing方法，通过从文档生成查询来创建受控的查询-块对，从而在不依赖参考标注的情况下分析跨模型相似度行为，并学习分数转换函数以实现阈值的跨模型移植。
AI.motivation: RAG系统依赖相似度分数检索内容，但不同嵌入模型因几何性质不同导致分数不可直接比较，这阻碍了模型迁移和阈值复用。现有工作缺乏对跨模型相似度分数关系的研究。
AI.method: 提出Synthetic Query Probing（合成查询探测）方法：从文档生成查询，构建受控的查询-块对；使用线性、等距（isotonic）和分位数（quantile）三种映射函数学习跨模型的分数转换关系；在SciFact和专有语料库上评估多个嵌入配置。
AI.result: 实验发现不同模型在排序上大体一致，但绝对分数存在系统性扭曲；学习的映射函数能部分对齐分数空间并改善阈值的可移植性，其中等距回归（isotonic regression）效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显了跨模型校准的必要性，并将Synthetic Query Probing定位为分析嵌入可比性的可扩展框架，为RAG系统的模型迁移提供实用方案。

title: BioM-JEPA: joint-embedding prediction of graph-connected gene blocks in single cells
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, and 13 supplementary tables (Tables S1-S13); includes Supplementary Information with detailed training and evaluation protocols. Numerical source data for all figures are provided as ancillary files; training code and the BioM-JEPA checkpoint will be released via GitHub
summary: Single-cell transcriptomes are sparse observations of coordinated biological programmes, yet most self-supervised models learn by reconstructing individual genes. Here we present BioM-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that instead predicts aggregate representations of graph-connected gene blocks defined by protein-association and corpus-derived coexpression evidence. A student network infers each target-block representation from the remaining genes in a cell, while a slowly updated teacher supplies the corresponding target from the full observed gene set. Under the reported extraction procedure, block-level prediction produced embeddings with higher effective rank and weaker association with detected-gene depth in the tested diagnostics than token-prediction, random-block and reconstruction controls. Across CellBench tasks, frozen BioM-JEPA embeddings retained expression, pathway and neighbourhood information and achieved the lowest aggregate perturbation-response error among the evaluated models. Representation diagnostics were also consistent with canonical pancreatic programmes and compositional relationships between genetic perturbations. Linear attention avoids constructing a quadratic gene-by-gene attention matrix; in a matched one-epoch hPancreas experiment at batch size 8, BioM-JEPA provided 5.75-fold higher fine-tuning throughput and 3.76-fold higher held-out embedding throughput than scFoundation. Together, these results support graph-connected gene blocks as useful prediction units for JEPA-style representation learning in single-cell biology.

AI.tldr: BioM-JEPA是一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的单细胞转录组自监督学习方法，通过预测由蛋白关联和共表达证据定义的图连接基因块的聚合表征（而非单个基因），在CellBench任务中取得最佳扰动响应误差，并在匹配实验中相比scFoundation实现5.75倍微调吞吐提升和3.76倍嵌入吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: 单细胞转录组是协调生物学程序的稀疏观测，但现有自监督模型大多通过重构单个基因来学习表征，未能充分捕捉基因之间的协调性关系。
AI.method: BioM-JEPA采用联合嵌入预测架构：学生网络从细胞中其余基因推断目标基因块的聚合表征，慢速更新的教师网络则从完整观测基因集提供对应目标表征。预测单元为基于蛋白关联和语料共表达证据构建的图连接基因块，并使用线性注意力避免构建二次方的基因-基因注意力矩阵。
AI.result: 在报告提取流程下，块级预测相比token预测、随机块和重构对照产生更高有效秩的嵌入，且与基因检测深度的关联更弱。在CellBench任务中，冻结的BioM-JEPA嵌入保持表达、通路和邻域信息，并获得最低的聚合扰动响应误差。在匹配的单轮hPancreas实验中（batch size 8），微调吞吐提升5.75倍，嵌入吞吐提升3.76倍（对比scFoundation）。
AI.conclusion: 图连接的基因块可作为JEPA式表征学习在单细胞生物学中的有效预测单元。

title: RA-CAD: Learning Post-Execution Critique for State-Aware Text-to-CAD Generation
summary: Text-to-CAD generation translates natural-language design intent into editable and executable parametric computer-aided design (CAD) codes, reducing the expertise and effort required for manual modeling. Existing methods incorporate fixed, externally supplied, prompt-induced, or separately optimized critique mechanisms to optimize the generation process, but they do not necessarily optimize how feedback is interpreted and translated into effective corrective actions throughout the generation process. To bridge this feedback-utilization gap, we present RA-CAD (ReAct Agent for CAD), a state-aware agent that interacts with the CAD environment through a Generate--Execute--Critique--Rewrite loop. At each iteration, RA-CAD executes the current code and observes its outcome. Conditioned on the design instruction, current code, and execution feedback, the agent then generates an explicit post-execution critique as an intermediate policy action. This critique either validates the current result for termination or provides revision-oriented guidance that conditions the next rewrite. CAD Code Bootstrapping (CCB) first establishes fundamental parametric CAD coding capabilities through supervised fine-tuning. Feedback-Driven Agent Optimization (FAO) subsequently applies trajectory-level Group Relative Policy Optimization to both policy-generated code and critique sequences, assigning terminal F1 and Chamfer Distance rewards to the complete interaction trajectory. This formulation makes critique an outcome-aligned, learnable policy decision rather than an unoptimized auxiliary output. Experiments on CADFusion and Text2CAD show that RA-CAD achieves state-of-the-art execution validity and geometric quality compared with existing methods and strong proprietary language models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed state-aware text-to-CAD agent.

AI.tldr: RA-CAD是一种面向文本到CAD生成任务的状态感知智能体，通过生成-执行-批评-重写（Generate-Execute-Critique-Rewrite）循环与CAD环境交互。它利用CAD代码引导（CCB）进行监督微调建立基础能力，并通过反馈驱动的智能体优化（FAO）使用轨迹级GRPO策略同时优化代码和批评序列。在CADFusion和Text2CAD基准上取得SOTA性能，验证了将批评作为可学习策略决策的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到CAD生成方法虽然引入了批评机制（固定、外部提供、提示诱导或单独优化的），但并未真正优化"反馈如何被解读并转化为有效纠正动作"这一关键环节，即存在反馈利用鸿沟（feedback-utilization gap）。
AI.method: 1) 提出RA-CAD智能体，通过生成-执行-批评-重写循环与环境交互；2) 每次迭代中，智能体观察执行结果并生成显式的执行后批评（post-execution critique）作为中间策略动作，用于验证终止或指导重写；3) CAD Code Bootstrapping (CCB) 通过监督微调建立基础参数化CAD编码能力；4) Feedback-Driven Agent Optimization (FAO) 应用轨迹级GRPO，对代码和批评序列联合优化，以终点F1和Chamfer Distance作为轨迹奖励，使批评成为与结果对齐的可学习策略决策。
AI.result: 在CADFusion和Text2CAD基准上，RA-CAD在执行有效性和几何质量方面均达到SOTA水平，超越了现有方法以及强专有语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 将批评视为可学习、结果对齐的策略决策而非未经优化的辅助输出，能够有效提升文本到CAD生成的质量，验证了状态感知智能体范式的有效性。

title: LiteKD-Net: Lightweight Knowledge-Distilled Network for Mobile Image Denoising
summary: Mobile image denoising requires both good restoration quality and low computational cost. In addition, it's annoying to collect large-scale LQ-GT clean pairs. As a result, we propose LiteKD-Net, a lightweight knowledge-distilled network for mobile image denoising. First, a physics-guided noise simulation pipeline generates paired training data by adding pixel crosstalk compared with pipelines applied to cameras. Next, we adapt the Real-ESRGAN to identity-resolution denoising and construct a lightweight Student using Lite-RRDB blocks based on depthwise separable convolutions. Third, feature-level knowledge distillation is applied to transfer the Teacher's restoration capability to the Student without introducing additional inference cost. Experiments on real-world datasets show that our model reaches great reduction in runtime and increase in the inference rate with good restoration quality. Our model also reaches the best in all metrics compared with SwinIR. These results indicate that LiteKD-Net provides a great trade-off between restoration quality and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出了LiteKD-Net，一个轻量级知识蒸馏网络用于移动端图像去噪。通过物理引导的噪声模拟管线生成配对训练数据，基于深度可分离卷积构建轻量级Student网络，并使用特征级知识蒸馏从Real-ESRGAN迁移复原能力。实验表明在保持良好复原质量的同时大幅降低推理时间。
AI.motivation: 移动端图像去噪需要同时兼顾良好的复原质量和低计算成本；同时，收集大规模低质量-高质量干净配对数据集非常繁琐。
AI.method: 首先设计物理引导的噪声模拟管线，通过添加像素串扰（pixel crosstalk）生成配对训练数据；其次将Real-ESRGAN适配到同分辨率（identity-resolution）去噪任务，并基于深度可分离卷积构建包含Lite-RRDB块的轻量级Student网络；最后应用特征级知识蒸馏将Teacher的复原能力迁移到Student，且不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，模型在运行时间和推理速度上都有显著提升，同时保持良好的复原质量；在所有评估指标上均优于SwinIR。
AI.conclusion: LiteKD-Net在复原质量和计算效率之间实现了很好的权衡，适合移动端去噪应用。

title: MACRO: Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers
summary: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) execute layers sequentially. Dynamic layer routing, i.e. search for a different execution path through layers involving layer repetitions, skips and other moves, can improve performance. Existing routing approaches often require updating model weights, running expensive search loops per test instance, or demand ground-truth labels during inference. In this work, we propose Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers (MACRO), a framework that learns task-specific routes over LLM architectures without modifying underlying parameters. MACRO models layer routing as a context-dependent Markov policy conditioned on layer indices, computation budget phases, directional displacements, and operator context, supporting skip, repeat, and residual hidden-state addition operations. The Markov route distribution is updated via feedback on training data and decoded using a top-k Viterbi algorithm to isolate high-probability candidate programs. We evaluate MACRO across diverse reasoning and knowledge benchmarks on multiple open-weight LLMs. MACRO achieves a +5.0% average accuracy improvement over the unrouted baselines, with largest gains on small models. We outperform the best dynamic routing approach Dr. LLM by +7.2%, while reducing route-search time 9.4x (from 14.8 to 1.6 hours). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Batorskq/MACRO.

AI.tldr: MACRO是一种无需修改模型权重即可学习任务特定层路由策略的框架，将层路由建模为上下文相关的马尔可夫策略，通过top-k Viterbi算法解码，在多个LLM和基准上平均提升5.0%准确率，相比最优动态路由方法Dr. LLM提升7.2%，同时将路由搜索时间减少9.4倍。
AI.motivation: 标准LLM逐层顺序执行，而动态层路由（如层重复、跳过等操作）可提升性能，但现有路由方法要么需要更新模型权重、要么需要昂贵的逐实例搜索循环、要么依赖推理时的ground-truth标签，这些限制阻碍了动态路由的实际应用。
AI.method: MACRO将层路由建模为上下文相关的马尔可夫策略，其状态条件包括层索引、计算预算阶段、方向位移和算子上下文，支持skip、repeat和残差隐状态加法操作。路由分布通过训练数据上的反馈进行更新，并使用top-k Viterbi算法解码以筛选高概率的候选路径程序。
AI.result: 在多个推理和知识基准以及多个开放权重LLM上的评估表明，MACRO相比未路由基线平均提升5.0%准确率，小模型上增益最大；相比最优动态路由方法Dr. LLM提升7.2%，同时将路由搜索时间从14.8小时降至1.6小时（减少9.4倍）。
AI.conclusion: MACRO展示了在不修改底层模型参数的前提下进行高效、任务自适应的动态层路由的可行性，兼具体系结构灵活性和计算效率优势，为LLM推理路径优化提供了新思路。

title: How Far Do Simple Transformations Translate Across Text Embedding Models?
summary: We investigate whether simple transformations can translate representations across heterogeneous text embedding models. Understanding how independently trained models organize semantic information is an enabler for AI-to-AI latent communication without decoding into human-readable text. Focusing on lightweight translators such as linear mappings, we test the literature hypothesis of latent universality in a realistic text setting beyond simplified benchmarks. Across nine embedding models differing in architecture, pooling strategy, and training objective, we evaluate compatibility using CKA, downstream transfer, fidelity, and retrieval. Simple translators recover meaningful shared structure and support transfer for some compatible pairs, but fail sharply for others. Compatibility depends jointly on architecture, training objective, pooling, and data distribution. Overall, the results show that heterogeneous embedding spaces are not universally related by simple mappings as often suggested in some literature.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了异构文本嵌入模型之间是否可以通过简单线性映射实现"潜在空间通用性"的假设。作者在9个架构、池化策略和训练目标各异的嵌入模型上，使用CKA、下游迁移、保真度和检索等指标进行评估，发现简单的翻译器仅对部分兼容模型对有效，且兼容性取决于架构、训练目标、池化和数据分布的联合作用，否定了异构嵌入空间普遍存在简单映射关系的观点。
AI.motivation: 探索人工神经网络之间能否不经过人类可读文本解码，而通过潜在空间的直接映射实现AI到AI的潜在通信。现有文献提出了"潜在通用性"（latent universality）假设，但该假设多基于简化基准的验证，缺乏在真实文本设定下跨异构模型（不同架构、池化策略、训练目标）的系统检验。
AI.method: 选取9个在架构、池化策略和训练目标方面存在差异的文本嵌入模型，训练轻量级线性映射作为翻译器，通过四种互补指标进行综合评估：CKA（表征相似性）、下游迁移性能、翻译保真度以及检索效果，用于衡量源模型和目标模型嵌入空间之间的兼容性和可翻译程度。
AI.result: 简单的翻译器确实能从部分兼容的模型对中恢复出有意义的结构并支持跨模型迁移，但对其他模型对则显著失效。兼容性并非由单一因素决定，而是由架构、训练目标、池化策略和数据分布的联合作用共同决定。
AI.conclusion: 异构嵌入空间之间并非如部分文献所声称的那样普遍存在简单的映射关系，"潜在通用性"假设在真实文本设定下仅对部分特定模型组合成立，存在明显局限。

title: BlockPython: A Process-Aware Agent-Supported Platform for the Transition from Block-Based to Python Programming
summary: The transition from block-based to text-based programming requires learners to convert visible program structures into abstract textual expressions, which may create a cognitive gap between understanding computational concepts and expressing them in Python syntax. To support this transition, we designed and implemented BlockPython. The platform centers on bidirectional translation between blocks and Python and guides learners through four stages: Task Decomposition, Block-Based Practice, Code Challenge, and Extended Interaction. Across these stages, learners progressively establish connections among program structure, runtime behavior, and textual code. During learning, the platform continuously collects process evidence, including block artifacts, code versions, run outcomes, use of support, and dialogue. Deterministic diagnosis, program visualization, and the learning assistant use this evidence to identify different difficulties in computational understanding and Python expression.
