The rule-based system is responsible for program execution, objective evaluation, and stage control, while the learning assistant uses verified evidence to provide explanations, prompts, and guiding questions. This report describes the design rationale, learning workflow, and process-aware support mechanisms of BlockPython and provides a system-design reference for supporting the transition from block-based to text-based programming and for analyzing learning processes.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍BlockPython——一个支持学习者从块式编程过渡到文本编程（Python）的平台，通过块与Python代码的双向转换以及四阶段学习流程，帮助学习者建立程序结构、运行行为与文本代码之间的联系，并通过过程性证据收集与分析提供适应性支持。
AI.motivation: 从块式编程转向文本编程需要学习者将可见的程序结构转换为抽象的文本表达式，这一过程可能在理解计算概念与用Python语法表达之间产生认知鸿沟。
AI.method: 设计并实现了BlockPython平台，核心功能是块与Python之间的双向翻译。平台包含四个学习阶段：任务分解、块式练习、代码挑战和扩展交互。平台持续收集过程性证据（块工件、代码版本、运行结果、支持使用情况和对话），并采用确定性诊断、程序可视化和学习助手，基于规则的系统负责程序执行、客观评估和阶段控制，学习助手利用已验证的证据提供解释、提示和引导性问题。
AI.result: 本文提供了BlockPython的设计原理、学习工作流和过程感知支持机制的完整描述，作为一个支持从块式编程向文本编程过渡的系统设计参考。
AI.conclusion: BlockPython为块式到文本式编程过渡提供了一种系统化的设计参考，通过过程感知的多层支持机制来帮助学习者弥合计算理解与Python表达之间的差距，并支持对学习过程的分析。

title: ConceptADapt: Concept-guided Adaptive Feature Reconstruction with Dynamic Attention for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Few-shot industrial anomaly detection (FS-IAD) focuses on detecting and localizing visual defects in industrial inspection during the cold-start phase, where only a limited number of normal training samples are available per category. Recent advances in this field predominantly leverage visual features from foundation-model and have achieved promising performance. Despite the strong representational power of foundation-model features, the model generalization remains fragile due to the extreme scarcity of normal training data.To address this pivotal issue, we propose ConceptADapt, a concept-guided adaptive feature reconstruction model with dynamic attention. Specifically, our model pre-learns a set of fixed normal concepts from the limited support features and leverages them to mine relationships with query features, thereby recalibrating their statistics for improved anomaly detection at test time. To mitigate the prevalent feature shortcut problem, which is particularly severe under low-data regimes, we further develop a dynamic attention mechanism integrated with sparse autoencoders to learn robust normal concepts during training. Moreover, to enable fast adaptation during inference, our model remains lightweight by incorporating LoRA into the attention module, which introduces only minimal updating parameters.Extensive experiments on three widely adopted FS-IAD benchmarks, including MVTec-AD, VisA, and MPDD, demonstrate that our model consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches across both detection and localization tasks, achieving significant improvements under various shot settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConceptADapt，一种概念引导的自适应特征重建模型，用于少样本工业异常检测。该方法通过预学习固定正常概念、结合动态注意力与稀疏自编码器缓解特征捷径问题，并引入LoRA实现轻量级推理自适应，在MVTec-AD、VisA和MPDD三个基准上超越了现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 少样本工业异常检测中，尽管基础模型（foundation model）特征具有强大的表示能力，但正常训练样本极度稀缺导致模型泛化脆弱。现有方法未能有效解决这一关键问题。
AI.method: 1) 预学习一组固定的正常概念（normal concepts）并挖掘其与查询特征的关系，重新校准查询特征统计量以增强检测；2) 设计动态注意力机制与稀疏自编码器结合，在低数据条件下学习稳健的正常概念，缓解特征捷径问题；3) 在注意力模块中引入LoRA，仅更新极少量参数以实现推理阶段的快速自适应。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD、VisA和MPDD三个广泛采用的FS-IAD基准上，该模型在检测和定位任务中均一致超越SOTA方法，在不同shot设置下取得显著改进。
AI.conclusion: ConceptADapt通过概念引导的特征重建与动态注意力机制，有效解决了少样本场景下基础模型特征泛化脆弱和特征捷径问题，以轻量级设计实现了高效的少样本工业异常检测与定位性能。

title: Causal Episodic Memory for Feedback-Driven Agent Repair
summary: LLM agents that repair failures often discard successful corrections, forcing later episodes to rediscover similar solutions. We study whether finalized repair outcomes can improve subsequent Text-to-SQL episodes without parameter updates. We introduce MERIT, a training-free agent that maintains an online dual-polarity memory of oracle-verified corrections and observed unsuccessful directions. Under oracle-assisted benchmark feedback, only memories from earlier finalized episodes are eligible for retrieval. A deterministic classifier assigns a coarse failure type, which conditions a hybrid lexical-dense retriever before the frozen model generates each revision. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with identical initial predictions and repair budgets, MERIT improves execution accuracy over stateless iterative repair from \(66.34\%\) to \(69.79\%\) on Spider and from \(47.35\%\) to \(48.44\%\) on BIRD. Paired analyses provide clear evidence for the Spider gain but weaker evidence on BIRD. MERIT is not reliably separated from untyped dynamic retrieval on either benchmark, while Reflexion-style memory reaches \(51.24\%\) on BIRD at substantially higher inference cost. Ablations show that negative memory contributes modestly, the value of type conditioning and lexical--dense ranking is dataset dependent, and schema-local experience provides the most consistent benefit. These results clarify when causal cross-query memory improves repair and when broader memory representations remain preferable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MERIT，一种无需训练的Text-to-SQL修复代理，通过维护在线双极性记忆（含oracle验证的成功修正与失败方向），利用粗粒度失败类型分类器配合混合词法-稠密检索器，在不更新模型参数的情况下提升跨episode的修复效果。在Spider上执行准确率从66.34%提升至69.79%，在BIRD上从47.35%提升至48.44%。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在修复失败时往往会丢弃已成功的修正方案，导致后续episode需要重新发现类似解，造成计算浪费和修复效率低下。已有方法（如Reflexion式记忆）虽然利用了历史经验，但推理成本高且缺乏对记忆价值的精细分析。作者旨在探索在无参数更新的前提下，能否通过系统性地保留和利用最终确定的修复结果来改善后续Text-to-SQL任务的表现。
AI.method: MERIT采用训练无关（training-free）架构，包含三个核心组件：(1) 在线双极性记忆库，存储oracle验证的成功修正和观察到的失败方向（negative memories）；(2) 确定性分类器，对失败进行粗粒度类型划分；(3) 混合词法-稠密检索器，在类型条件下（type-conditioned）检索相关记忆，供冻结的生成模型在每次修订时参考。检索仅限先前已固化episode的记忆，不进行参数更新。
AI.result: 使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct且保持相同初始预测和修复预算的条件下，MERIT在Spider上执行准确率从66.34%提升至69.79%（+3.45%），在BIRD上从47.35%提升至48.44%（+1.09%）。配对分析显示Spider上的提升证据充分，但BIRD上证据较弱。MERIT与无类型动态检索在两种基准上均无显著差异；Reflexion式记忆在BIRD上达到51.24%但推理成本显著更高。消融实验表明：negative memory贡献有限，类型条件化和词法-稠密排序的价值因数据集而异，schema局部经验提供最一致的收益。
AI.conclusion: 跨查询的因果记忆能否改善修复效果取决于具体场景：在结构规整、schema信息丰富的基准（如Spider）上，类型化、双极性、schema局部记忆带来的收益更显著；而在更复杂多样的基准（如BIRD）上，更广泛的记忆表征（如Reflexion式）可能仍然更优，尽管成本更高。该工作厘清了什么时候因果跨查询记忆有所裨益，什么时候需要更宽的记忆表示。

title: Unified Agent: Managing Interactions across Devices
summary: As capabilities rapidly increase, AI agents can move from running inside one app to acting across a user's devices over time. Yet existing agent systems still fall short in this scenario. This is because observations are scattered across devices and moments, but mainstream systems are not designed around this fact: a single agent that treats devices as tools lacks effective state management for all devices across time, and multi-agent systems coordinate across agents but do not maintain the compact carried state a cross-device, cross-time request needs. We argue that the agent should maintain an effectively designed state that organizes engagement evidence, stated facts, and the standing request in a compact, action-ready form for deciding its action given the current observation. To compare state designs, we construct a benchmark of user-agent interaction across devices and time. We instantiate this principle in Unified Agent, a stateful agent that carries interaction evidence across devices and moments and uses it with the current observation to act. In the default setting, it significantly outperforms our adaptations of four published designs. Across changes in multimodal large language model (MLLM) family, capability, and reasoning effort, it remains ahead of all compared systems, demonstrating that the state-design advantage is robust across MLLM settings. Our code and data will be publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨设备、跨时间的AI智能体需要维护一个经过有效设计的紧凑状态，用于组织交互证据、陈述事实和待处理请求，从而在当前观察下做出决策。作者将这一原则实例化为Unified Agent，在构建的跨设备交互基准上显著优于四种改编的现有设计方案，且优势在不同MLLM设置下均保持稳健。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体能力快速提升，其应用场景应从单应用内扩展到跨用户设备、跨时间的操作。然而现有智能体系统未能很好地适配这一场景：将设备视为工具的单智能体方案缺乏跨设备、跨时间的有效状态管理；多智能体方案虽能协调各智能体，却无法维护跨设备跨时间请求所需的紧凑承载状态。因此需要一个经过有效设计的状态机制来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 作者论证了智能体应维护一个有效设计的状态，将交互证据（engagement evidence）、陈述事实（stated facts）和待处理请求（standing request）组织为紧凑且可直接用于行动决策的形式。基于该原则，提出Unified Agent——一个有状态智能体，跨设备和时刻携带交互证据，并结合当前观察做出行动。同时构建了一个跨设备、跨时间的用户-智能体交互基准来比较不同状态设计。
AI.result: 在默认设置下，Unified Agent显著优于四种改编的既有设计方案。在更换MLLM系列、能力水平及推理努力程度等条件下，其性能始终领先于所有对比系统，表明状态设计的优势在多种MLLM设置下均具有稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的智能体状态是跨设备、跨时间场景下智能体系统性能的关键因素，Unified Agent验证了这一原则的有效性和稳健性，为未来智能体状态管理系统设计提供了指导方向。

title: UniVVT: A Unified End-to-End Framework for High-Fidelity Video Virtual Try-on
summary: Video Virtual Try-On (VVT) synthesizes a video of a person wearing a target garment while preserving identity, motion, and scene dynamics. Dominant approaches cast VVT as mask-conditioned video inpainting and rely on separate modules for human parsing, pose estimation, and garment warping. This multi-stage design complicates deployment and, more critically, allows errors in explicit geometric priors to propagate irreversibly into the generated video. We present UniVVT, a unified end-to-end framework that reframes VVT as semantically conditioned video generation, eliminating mask, pose, and warping modules at inference. At its core, a scene-task perceiver built on a Multimodal Large Language Model jointly encodes the source video, target garment, and task instruction into compact, task-aware latent tokens, implicitly capturing what to transfer and where and how to transfer it. A lightweight semantic bridge then aligns these tokens with the conditioning space of a diffusion-based video generator, enabling coherent garment transfer. To robustly couple the heterogeneous components, we devise a three-stage progressive training strategy comprising semantic alignment, joint task adaptation, and flexible-resolution refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniVVT achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, validating implicit semantic guidance as a simple and effective alternative to fragile geometric preprocessing for end-to-end virtual try-on.

AI.tldr: UniVVT是一个统一的端到端视频虚拟试穿框架，将传统多阶段（掩码、姿态、形变）的试穿任务重新定义为语义条件视频生成，通过多模态大语言模型构建的场景-任务感知器和轻量级语义桥接器，配合三阶段渐进训练策略，在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿方法大多采用掩码条件视频修复的方式，依赖独立的人体解析、姿态估计和服装形变模块。这种多阶段设计不仅部署复杂，更关键的是显式几何先验中的错误会不可逆地传播到生成视频中，导致整体性能受损。
AI.method: UniVVT将VVT重构为语义条件视频生成任务，推理时无需掩码、姿态和形变模块。核心组件包括：(1) 基于多模态大语言模型的场景-任务感知器，将源视频、目标服装和任务指令联合编码为紧凑的任务感知潜在token，隐式捕捉转移区域和转移方式；(2) 轻量级语义桥接器，将token与基于扩散的视频生成器的条件空间对齐；(3) 三阶段渐进训练策略：语义对齐、联合任务适应和灵活分辨率精炼。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，UniVVT达到了最先进的性能，验证了隐式语义引导作为脆弱几何预处理的简单而有效的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 隐式语义引导提供了一种简化和稳健的端到端虚拟试穿新范式，避免了显式几何先验带来的误差传播问题，同时保持了最优的生成质量。

title: Clinical Communication Processing with Models Trained on LLM-Generated Synthetic Data: A Structured Survey and Novel Application Case Studies
summary: Much clinical value is conveyed not through structured records but through communication: exchanges in which patients describe symptoms, clinicians reason and give instructions, ambulances hand over to emergency departments, and nurses pass on a shift. Such language differs from tabular data because meaning depends on speaker role, intent, causality, uncertainty, omission, and channel noise. Healthcare natural language processing must therefore interpret information as conveyed rather than coded. This requires well-annotated corpora, which are scarce because authentic exchanges are private, fragmented, and costly to annotate. Large language models offer a way forward by transforming clinical sources, such as records, diagnostic labels, symptom lists, or care plans, into written and transcribed communication for downstream models. We present a structured narrative survey organized by source representation, communication form and participants, generation method, and downstream task, complemented by thirteen novel case studies. These build clinical NLP systems for communication channels and languages without labeled real-world data, including EMS pre-arrival reports, field-radio casualty documentation, nurse handoffs, patient-portal triage, and low-resource discharge communication. They show that synthetic communication can bootstrap such systems. Findings include the competitiveness of fine-tuned encoder models over evaluated zero-shot baselines and the value of deliberately degraded communication for robustness. The main limitation is that most studies evaluate on held-out synthetic communication, while train-on-synthetic, test-on-authentic evidence remains limited. We conclude that syn-thetic clinical communication is becoming a practical research resource; establishing it as reusable clinical infrastructure will require authentic-data transfer, safety and external validation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了利用大语言模型生成合成临床沟通文本（如EMS报告、护士交接、患者门户分诊等）来引导下游临床NLP系统的研究，提出了一个按源表示、沟通形式与参与者、生成方法及下游任务组织的结构化综述框架，并通过十三个新案例研究验证了合成临床沟通在无标签真实数据场景下引导NLP系统的可行性。
AI.motivation: 大量临床价值蕴含在非结构化沟通中（患者症状描述、临床推理、救护车交接、护士轮班交接等），这类语言与表格数据不同，其意义依赖说话者角色、意图、因果关系、不确定性和信息省略。然而真实的临床沟通语料因隐私、碎片化和标注成本高昂而稀缺，限制了医疗NLP的进展，因此需要探索生成合成沟通文本来引导下游模型的方法。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个结构化叙事综述，按四个维度组织：源表示（如医疗记录、诊断标签、症状清单、护理计划）、沟通形式与参与者、生成方法、下游任务。并补充了十三个案例研究，涵盖EMS预到报告、野战无线电伤员文档、护士交接、患者门户分诊及低资源出院沟通等场景，使用合成沟通引导无标注临床NLP系统的构建。
AI.result: 研究发现：（1）微调编码器模型在评估的零样本基线上具有竞争力；（2）刻意退化的合成沟通对系统鲁棒性有价值；（3）合成沟通可以引导各类临床沟通渠道和语言的NLP系统；（4）主要局限是大多数研究在保留的合成沟通上评估，而"在合成上训练、在真实上测试"的证据仍然有限。
AI.conclusion: 合成临床沟通正在成为一种实用的研究资源，但要将其确立为可复用的临床基础设施，仍需真实数据迁移验证、安全评估和外部验证。

title: Subliminal Learning is Non-Semantic Distillation
comment: Accepted as spotlight paper for the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop
summary: Subliminal Learning (SL) is a surprising type of generalization displayed by modern language models. It allows the transfer of a bias or behavior from a teacher model to a student by distilling from seemingly unrelated or random synthetic data from the teacher. This presents challenges in ensuring AI systems remain predictable and are trained safely, as standard auditing of the input data would not catch the hidden subliminal signal. Here, we investigate several open questions as to the enabling mechanisms and drivers of SL. First is the nature of the process by which biases are encoded in the data. We find that by adding Gaussian noise to the weights of the teacher and student models, the magnitude of subliminal transfer is increased by a factor of 1.9 in Gemma and 1.3 in Llama, suggesting that non-semantic weight structures play a crucial role. We show that steering vectors can be applied to the teacher to produce subliminal data, in addition to prompting and finetuning as used in previous studies. Analysis of the activations of the student models that have been trained on steered and prompted data demonstrates that students inherit not just the semantic meaning of the teacher's bias, but also the type of intervention that was used to apply it: steered students imitate steering vectors, prompted students do not. Additionally, the gradients of steered subliminal data show a linear correlation with the teacher's steering vectors, showing promise for data auditing. More broadly, as synthetic data becomes central to frontier training pipelines, being able to see the latent signals hidden in training data becomes paramount.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型中的潜隐学习（Subliminal Learning, SL）现象，通过实验发现向教师和学生的模型权重添加高斯噪声可将潜隐迁移幅度提升1.9倍（Gemma）和1.3倍（Llama）。作者证明了除了提示和微调外，还可以通过应用转向向量（steering vectors）在教师模型上生成潜隐数据。进一步分析表明，学生不仅继承了教师偏见的语义含义，还继承了施加该偏见时所使用的干预类型。此外，转向数据的梯度与教师转向向量呈现线性相关，为数据审计提供了可能。
AI.motivation: 潜隐学习使现代语言模型能够从看似无关或随机的合成数据中传递教师的偏置或行为，这对AI系统安全训练构成隐患，因为标准的数据审计无法捕获隐藏的潜隐信号。研究其作用机制和驱动因素对确保AI可预测性和安全训练至关重要。
AI.method: 通过对教师和学生模型的权重添加高斯噪声来量化潜隐迁移幅度的变化；使用转向向量（steering vectors）、提示（prompting）和微调（finetuning）三种方式在教师模型中生成潜隐数据；分析学生模型在转向和提示数据训练后的激活模式；计算转向潜隐数据的梯度与教师转向向量之间的相关性。
AI.result: 权重添加高斯噪声使潜隐迁移幅度在Gemma中增加1.9倍、在Llama中增加1.3倍；证明了转向向量可以作为生成潜隐数据的方法；学生模型不仅继承教师偏见的语义，还继承施加偏见的干预类型（转向学生模仿转向向量，提示学生则不）；转向潜隐数据的梯度与教师转向向量呈线性相关。
AI.conclusion: 非语义的权重结构在潜隐迁移中起关键作用；转向向量为生成潜隐数据提供了新途径且其数据梯度可用于审计；随着合成数据成为前沿训练管线核心，检测训练数据中潜在隐信号的能力变得至关重要。

title: GST-Bench: Can VLMs Develop Global Spatial Awareness from Video?
summary: Spatial intelligence is fundamental to embodied agents, yet existing benchmarks focus on local spatial perception from single or few viewpoints, overlooking global spatial awareness over continuous, long-horizon visual streams. To address this limitation, we introduce the Global-Spatial-Temporal Benchmark (GST-Bench), a VQA benchmark for global spatial intelligence in video understanding, comprising human-verified questions derived from 6,790 minutes of synthetically generated video. It requires models to perform accurate spatial inference from novel viewpoints unseen in the input video and to map egocentric observations onto global top-down images. A comprehensive evaluation of 22 state-of-the-art VLMs exposes a striking gap between models and humans: the strongest zero-shot model attains only 42.68, far below the human score of 79.08. To probe the cause of this gap, we construct GST-Bench-Local and find that models, despite strong local spatial understanding under the same task formulation, still fail to consolidate long-horizon observations into a globally consistent scene representation. We further provide GST-Train, a dataset for global spatial reasoning, as a complementary resource to facilitate future research on this challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GST-Bench，一个用于视频理解中全局空间智能的VQA基准，包含6,790分钟合成视频生成的人工验证问题，需模型从新视角进行空间推理并将第一人称观察映射到全局俯视图。22个SOTA视觉语言模型的评估显示最强零样本模型仅得42.68分，远低于人类79.08分，暴露出模型即使具备局部空间理解能力，仍难以将长时间跨度的观察整合为全局一致的场景表征。此外提供GST-Train辅助数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有空间智能基准仅关注从单一或少数视角的局部空间感知，忽视了在连续、长时间视觉流上的全局空间意识，而全局空间智能对具身智能体至关重要。
AI.method: 构建GST-Bench基准，基于6,790分钟合成视频生成人工验证的VQA问题，要求模型执行从输入视频中未见的新视角进行空间推理，以及将第一人称观察映射到全局俯视图。同时构建GST-Bench-Local对照实验和GST-Train训练数据集。
AI.result: 评估22个SOTA视觉语言模型，最强零样本模型得分42.68，远低于人类79.08分。GST-Bench-Local实验表明模型在相同任务形式下具备强局部空间理解，但无法将长时间观察整合为全局一致的场景表征。
AI.conclusion: 模型与人类在全局空间智能上存在显著差距，根因在于长时程观察的全局一致场景表征整合能力不足。GST-Bench可作为基准，GST-Train可作为资源，共同推动全局空间推理研究。

title: A Unified Risk View of Uncertainty: Posterior Risk for Disentanglement and Evaluation Beyond Proxies
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimates are critical in safety-sensitive applications, where understanding the sources of predictive uncertainty is essential. This often requires disentangling epistemic uncertainty from aleatoric uncertainty, yet these uncertainty types are not defined consistently across the literature, making it difficult to assess whether a method produces accurate uncertainty estimates. Evaluation is further complicated by the fact that ground-truth epistemic uncertainty is typically unavailable. Existing benchmarks therefore mostly rely on proxy tasks such as out-of-distribution detection, which do not provide complete ground-truth uncertainty targets and offer limited insight into the structure and quality of uncertainty estimates. We propose a unified definition of uncertainty as pointwise posterior risk, the expected loss of a predictor under the distribution of plausible ground-truth functions given the data. This view combines Bayesian uncertainty over functions with estimator-dependent deviations from the posterior mean, capturing effects such as misspecification and optimization error. This formulation constitutes the foundation of a theory-backed benchmark that enables direct computation of oracle epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty using semi-synthetic datasets with real covariates and known generative processes. By avoiding proxy evaluations, the benchmark enables fine-grained analysis of uncertainty estimates. Empirically, we find that accurate prediction does not guarantee reliable uncertainty disentanglement. The benchmark reveals practically useful differences between methods, identifying approaches with meaningful alignment to oracle uncertainty targets while exposing sensitivity to datasets and modeling choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将不确定性统一定义为逐点后验风险（点态后验损失期望），并以此为基础构建了一种基于理论支撑的基准测试方法。该方法利用半合成数据集（真实协变量+已知生成过程）直接计算神谕（oracle）认知不确定性与偶然不确定性，从而避免基于代理任务（如OOD检测）的评估局限。实验表明，预测准确并不保证不确定性分解的可靠性，基准能揭示不同方法之间的实际差异。
AI.motivation: 在安全敏感应用中可靠的不确定性估计至关重要，但现有文献对认知不确定性与偶然不确定性的定义不一致，且缺乏真实的不确定性真值，导致现有基准多依赖代理任务（如分布外检测），无法完整评估不确定性估计的质量和结构。
AI.method: 提出统一的不确定性定义——逐点后验风险，即预测器在给定数据下关于合理真实函数分布的期望损失，该定义融合了函数上的贝叶斯不确定性与预测器相对后验均值的偏差（可捕获模型误设和优化误差的影响）。以此为基础构建理论支持的基准，利用真实协变量和已知生成过程的半合成数据集直接计算神谕认知与偶然不确定性，避免代理评估。
AI.result: 实证发现预测准确性与不确定性分解的可靠性并不直接关联；基准揭示了方法之间实际有意义的差异，识别出与神谕不确定性目标具有较好对齐的方法，同时暴露了对数据集和建模选择的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一不确定性定义和基于半合成数据的直接真值计算方法，该基准为不确定性估计提供了更细粒度的评估手段，避免了代理任务的局限，并证明了其对方法筛选和诊断的实际价值。

title: When Do Prompt-Side Agent Playbooks Transfer? Accuracy, Cost, and Runtime Shift in Agent Deployment
summary: Prompt-side playbooks can improve tool-using language agents without retraining, but their portability beyond the source setting is unclear. We study frozen playbook transfer under a shared distill--validate--transfer protocol. On ALFWorld, transfer is beneficial under controlled greedy decoding and, in one near-budget-matched comparison, distilled guidance outperforms five fixed demonstrations. On TAU2-Bench, a prespecified aggregate contrast supports a modest average matched-domain advantage, but global Holm correction retains only one of 135 route-level effects; the remaining grid provides descriptive evidence of compatibility-sensitive heterogeneity. On XBench-DeepSearch, one artifact--runtime pairing preserves useful first-try heuristics while producing repeated queries, delayed stopping, and substantial cost inflation after a context-runtime shift. Across benchmarks, transferred and target-derived playbooks both require target-side validation of success, termination, protocol compatibility, and cost. Frozen transfer is therefore a conditional cold-start option, not a reuse-by-default strategy or a universally preferable alternative to target-side redistillation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于提示侧剧本（playbook）的工具使用语言代理在冻结迁移（frozen transfer）条件下的可移植性问题。作者在ALFWorld、TAU2-Bench和XBench-DeepSearch三个基准上采用统一的"蒸馏-验证-迁移"协议进行实证评估，发现冻结迁移在受控条件下有效但高度依赖场景：在ALFWorld上迁移有益且蒸馏指导优于固定演示；在TAU2-Bench上仅保留了一个经全局Holm校正的显著路由级效应；在XBench-DeepSearch上迁移虽保留了有用的先验启发，但引入了重复查询和成本膨胀。结论认为冻结迁移是条件性的冷启动选项，而非默认复用策略。
AI.motivation: 现有提示侧剧本（playbooks）能无需重训练即可改进工具使用语言代理，但其在源设置之外的可移植性尚不明确。作者旨在系统评估冻结剧本迁移在不同基准上的有效性，以确定其是否能作为一种通用的跨场景复用策略。
AI.method: 采用统一的"蒸馏-验证-迁移"（distill-validate-transfer）共享协议，在ALFWorld、TAU2-Bench和XBench-DeepSearch三个基准上进行冻结剧本迁移实验。实验中控制解码条件、进行预算匹配比较，并使用全局Holm校正进行多重检验校正，同时结合路由级效应分析和上下文运行时偏移测试来评估迁移效果。
AI.result: ALFWorld上冻结迁移在受控贪心解码下有益，且蒸馏指导优于五个固定演示；TAU2-Bench上全局Holm校正后仅保留135个路由级效应中的一个，其余证据仅为描述性兼容性敏感异质性；XBench-DeepSearch上迁移保留有用启发但产生重复查询、延迟停止和显著成本膨胀。所有场景中迁移和本地剧本均需目标侧验证。
AI.conclusion: 冻结剧本迁移是条件性的冷启动选项，而非默认的复用策略；在通用场景下也不一定优于目标侧重新蒸馏。迁移成功与否高度依赖于验证成功标准、终止条件、协议兼容性和成本等多维因素。

title: Beyond Relevance: Bayesian Evidence Acquisition for Agentic Whole-Slide Image Reasoning
summary: Whole-slide image (WSI) reasoning requires an agent to sequentially acquire visual evidence before answering a diagnostic question. Existing training-free agentic frameworks formulate this process as iterative patch retrieval based on semantic relevance to the question. However, semantic relevance does not necessarily imply diagnostic informativeness in computational pathology, where competing diagnoses often exhibit similar and overlapping morphological patterns, making many patches semantically relevant yet diagnostically non-discriminative. Consequently, relevance-based retrieval may acquire redundant observations and leave diagnostic uncertainty unresolved. We propose BEACON, a plug-and-play agentic framework that reformulates WSI reasoning as a Bayesian evidence acquisition problem. BEACON maintains a probabilistic belief over competing diagnostic hypotheses and sequentially acquires patches by maximizing expected information gain (EIG) to reduce diagnostic uncertainty. An evidence controller then determines whether to answer, acquire additional evidence, or perform higher-resolution inspection. Built entirely from off-the-shelf foundation models, BEACON requires no additional training or fine-tuning. Extensive zero-shot experiments across five WSI-VQA benchmarks demonstrate that BEACON achieves the strongest overall performance among training-free agentic frameworks while substantially improving evidence acquisition efficiency, establishing Bayesian evidence acquisition as a principled paradigm for uncertainty-aware agentic WSI reasoning. The code is available at https://github.com/bryanwong17/BEACON

AI.tldr: BEACON是一个即插即用的智能体框架，将全切片图像（WSI）推理重新定义为贝叶斯证据获取问题，通过最大化期望信息增益（EIG）来顺序采集切片以降低诊断不确定性，无需额外训练或微调。在五个WSI-VQA基准上的零样本实验表明，BEACON在训练-free的智能体框架中取得了最强的综合性能，同时显著提高了证据采集效率。
AI.motivation: 现有训练-free的智能体框架将WSI推理视为基于语义相关性的迭代切片检索，但语义相关性并不等于诊断信息量。在计算病理学中，竞争性诊断往往表现出相似且重叠的形态模式，导致大量切片语义相关却缺乏诊断区分度，最终造成冗余观测和诊断不确定性无法解决。
AI.method: BEACON将WSI推理构建为贝叶斯证据获取问题：维护竞争性诊断假设上的概率信念，通过最大化期望信息增益（EIG）顺序获取切片以减少诊断不确定性；同时引入证据控制器决定是回答、继续获得证据，还是进行更高分辨率的检查。整个框架完全由现成的基础模型构建，无需训练或微调。
AI.result: 在五个WSI-VQA基准上的广泛零样本实验中，BEACON在所有训练-free智能体框架中取得了最强的综合性能，并显著提升了证据获取效率。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯证据获取为不确定性感知的智能体WSI推理提供了一种有原则的范式，BEACON验证了该范式在实际病理诊断问答场景中的有效性和高效性。

title: FormBharo: Designing and Evaluating a Voice Agent for Conversational Form Filling in Rural India
summary: In India, almost every social benefit starts with a form, yet the people who need these benefits most are often unable to read or write. Reaching them requires a spoken conversation. Today that work falls to frontline health workers who enroll beneficiaries one at a time, a poor use of stretched capacity. We built FormBharo ("fill the form" in Hindi), a voice agent that fills a structured form over a phone call under tight latency and cost budgets by pairing Large Language Models (LLMs) with deterministic, rule-based validation and flow control. It is being piloted with ARMMAN, an NGO running large-scale maternal and child mobile-health programs in India, to enroll low-income, Hindi-speaking mothers in antenatal and postnatal care. To our knowledge, it is the first voice agent piloted to fill an enrollment form for this population. We openly release FormVoiceAgentBench, a benchmark pairing human-recorded Hindi audio with 3,760 multi-turn conversation tests across 960 simulated calls, to evaluate our agent's components (transcription, extraction, reply generation) and end-to-end form completion under real acoustic variations. Form completion drops by up to ~41 points when LLMs receive error-prone real-speech transcripts instead of reference ones. The rule-based controls recover many turn-level extraction errors, helping smaller, cheaper models match or surpass frontier models on form completion. Component performance does not predict end-to-end performance: GPT-5.5 leads turn-level extraction accuracy on reference transcripts (99.8%) but ranks lower on form completion. Since errors both propagate and cancel across the pipeline, the optimal model choice of models emerges only through end-to-end evaluation. Finally, no single model is best across accuracy, cost, and latency at once, so we use a Pareto-based weighted-sum scalarization to select a deployable configuration balancing the three.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了FormBharo，一个为印度低收入、不识字的孕妇设计的印地语语音代理系统，通过电话对话填写社会保障表格。系统结合大语言模型与规则化验证和流程控制，在严格的延迟和成本预算下运行。作者发布了FormVoiceAgentBench基准（960次模拟通话、3760个多轮对话测试），并发现：真实语音转写错误会导致表单完成率下降约41个百分点；规则控制可帮助小型模型匹配甚至超越前沿模型；组件性能无法预测端到端性能；需通过帕累托加权标量化在准确性、成本和延迟之间选择最优部署配置。
AI.motivation: 印度几乎所有社会福利都始于表格填写，但最需要这些福利的人往往不识字。目前的方案依赖一线卫生工作者一对一地帮助受益人填写表格，严重浪费本已紧张的资源。本文旨在构建一个语音代理系统，通过电话对话为低识字率人群（尤其是低收入印地语母亲）自动完成表格填写，以弥补这一服务空白。
AI.method: FormBharo将大语言模型与确定性、基于规则的验证和流程控制相结合：LLM负责语音转写、信息提取和回复生成，规则模块负责校验和流程控制。作者构建了FormVoiceAgentBench基准，包含人工录制的印地语音频和3760个多轮对话测试，用于评估转写、提取、回复生成等组件性能及端到端表单完成情况。最后使用基于帕累托的加权和标量化方法，在准确性、成本和延迟三个维度上选择最佳部署配置。
AI.result: 研究发现：1) 当LLM接收到含错误真实语音转写而非参考转写时，表单完成率最多下降约41个百分点；2) 规则控制可恢复许多回合级提取错误，使更小更便宜的模型在表单完成方面匹配或超越前沿模型；3) 组件性能无法预测端到端性能——GPT-5.5在参考转写上回合级提取准确率达99.8%，但表单完成排名较低；4) 错误在流水线中既会传播也会抵消，最优模型选择只能通过端到端评估确定；5) 没有单一模型能同时在准确性、成本和延迟上最优，需用帕累托加权标量化来平衡三者。
AI.conclusion: FormBharo作为首个为该人群（印度低收入印地语母亲）试点的语音表单填写代理系统，证明了在现实声学条件下，结合LLM与规则化控制可以构建可行的语音表单填写系统。研究的核心启示是：端到端评估至关重要，组件性能并不能可靠预测系统整体表现；在资源受限场景下，通过规则约束和帕累托优化，较小的模型可以成为比前沿模型更优的部署选择。该工作已与ARMMAN合作在印度实际试点。

title: Do Tabular Foundation Models Agree with Themselves?
summary:
Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are currently the best approach to tabular prediction problems. They are constructed as transformers that approximate the Bayesian posterior predictive distribution based on a pre-training prior. These univariate predictors can be converted into multivariate ones autoregressively by sampling one target and adding it to the features.
  However, the faithfulness of the resulting joint has not been investigated. Furthermore, TFMs cannot be evaluated against the posterior itself, at least not on real-world datasets, because the ground-truth distribution is unknown. We therefore propose asking a different question: could a model's predictions result from any joint distribution? To answer this question, we pose two requirements that any such model must satisfy. The first is marginalization consistency, which demands that marginalized conditionals are equal to directly predicted marginals. The second is factorization consistency, which demands that different factorization orders result in equal joint distributions. Every TFM that we evaluate violates both of these requirements for both classification and regression across all datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种评估表格基础模型（TFMs）联合分布忠实性的新方法。由于真实后验分布未知，作者提出通过"边际一致性"和"因式分解一致性"两个可检验的要求来评估模型预测是否可能来自任何有效联合分布。实验发现所有被评估的TFM在分类和回归任务上都违反了这两个要求。
AI.motivation: TFMs是目前表格预测问题的最佳方法，它们以自回归方式将单变量预测器转换为多变量预测器，但其生成的联合分布的忠实性从未被研究过。由于在真实数据集上无法获知真实后验分布，因此无法直接评估TFM与后验的匹配程度，需要提出新的评估框架。
AI.method: 作者提出两个任何有效联合预测模型都必须满足的要求：(1) 边际一致性（marginalization consistency）：通过对条件分布进行边际化得到的预测应与直接预测的边际分布相等；(2) 因式分解一致性（factorization consistency）：不同因式分解顺序得到的联合分布应该相等。通过对各种TFM进行分类和回归任务的实验来检验这两个要求。
AI.result: 所有被评估的TFM在所有数据集上的分类和回归任务中同时违反了边际一致性和因式分解一致性这两个要求，表明这些模型的联合预测分布并非来自任何有效的联合分布。
AI.conclusion: TFMs虽然作为单变量预测器表现出色，但其自回归构造的联合分布不具有一致性，因此直接将它们的预测视为真实后验联合分布的近似是不合理的，需要更严格的设计或评估框架。

title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay
summary:
Computer-use agents pay full frontier inference to re-derive routines their user has already performed, because an agent's memory today records what the user said, not what the user did. We compile passively captured screen activity into agent memory with a deterministic, zero-model pipeline: it segments a local capture stream into typed activity frames, bounded episodes carrying application, site, timing, input volume, and evidence pointers back to the raw rows, with no model in the loop, so the output is byte-identical, cacheable, and mechanically auditable. On one professional's single-user corpus of 128,756 frames over 51 active days, the compiler reduces a day of raw capture to a prompt-ready context block 86x smaller in 68 ms, and an agent reading that block answers questions about the day at 98.4% accuracy (Wilson 95% CI 91.7-99.7%) against an independent oracle, versus 66-80% for an LLM summary of the same capture, a mid-tier model reading the block matching a frontier one.
  The same compiler doubles as a demand-side cost instrument. Read off passive, pre-delegation human activity rather than agent rollouts, it supplies two parameters that agent-cost models assume but, to our knowledge, have not measured: the Routine Overhead Ratio R and the routine recurrence h. We report first values of R, a modeled upper bound, at 60-343x, and a delegable recurrence of 9.0% in-sample and 7.7% out-of-sample, for a realistic all-fleet token ceiling near 8%; a compiled routine replays deterministically with the model out of the loop, demonstrated live at zero model tokens on a guard-matched hit. Schema, compiler, and evaluation harness are open.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种零模型的确定性管线，将被动捕获的屏幕活动编译为智能体记忆（类型化活动帧/有界事件），使计算机使用智能体无需额外推理即可复用用户已执行过的例程。在单用户13万帧语料上，编译将一天原始数据压缩86倍（68ms），智能体读取后回答准确率98.4%（vs LLM摘要66-80%），并首次实测了智能体成本模型中的Routine Overhead Ratio（60-343x）和例程复发率（9.0%同样本/7.7%跨样本）。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体目前需要花费全前沿推理成本来重新推导用户已经执行过的例程，因为现有智能体记忆只记录用户说过什么，而非用户做过什么。这造成巨大的推理浪费，且缺乏对需求侧成本的实测参数。
AI.method: 1) 构建确定性零模型编译器：将本地屏幕捕获流分割为类型化活动帧和有界事件（携带应用、站点、时间、输入量及指向原始行的证据指针），无模型参与，输出字节级一致、可缓存、可机械审计；2) 将该编译器用作需求侧成本工具，从被动捕获的委派前人类活动中实测两个成本模型参数：Routine Overhead Ratio R和例程复发率h。
AI.result: 在一位专业人士51个活跃日、128,756帧的单用户语料上：a) 编译器68ms内将一天原始捕获压缩为提示就绪上下文块，压缩86倍；b) 智能体读取该块回答当日问题的准确率98.4%（Wilson 95% CI 91.7-99.7%），优于LLM摘要的66-80%，且中型模型读取该块可匹敌前沿模型；c) 首次报告R值为60-343x，委派性复发率同样本9.0%、跨样本7.7%，全舰队令牌上限约8%；d) 编译的例程可在模型离线时确定性重放，演示中零模型令牌命中。
AI.conclusion: 被动屏幕活动的确定性编译可作为智能体记忆的高效来源，大幅降低推理开销并提升下游任务准确率；同时该编译管道本身可作为需求侧成本测量仪器，为智能体成本模型提供首个实测参数。Schema、编译器和评估框架均已开源。

title: Flow-Map Distillation on Relation Manifolds for Image Restoration
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Knowledge distillation for image restoration typically aligns intermediate features or relation matrices between teacher and student networks as static targets, ignoring the dynamic structure of the knowledge transfer process. In this paper, we propose Flow-Map Distillation on Relation Manifolds (FoRM), which reformulates relation-based knowledge transfer as a continuous flow mapping problem on the relation manifold. Rather than regressing a constant velocity field between student and teacher relation states, FoRM learns a flow map operator $\mathcal{F}_θ(\mathbf{z}, t, s)$ that directly predicts the relation state at any target time $s$ given the current state at time $t$, enabling richer trajectory-level supervision. To ensure global self-consistency of the learned flow map, we introduce a safe semigroup consistency constraint that enforces compositional agreement using ground-truth bridge states, eliminating phantom-state error accumulation. An endpoint anchoring loss further prevents the operator from drifting away from the teacher target. Extensive experiments on five image restoration tasks, including super-resolution, deraining, denoising, deblurring, and low-light enhancement, demonstrate consistent gains over state-of-the-art distillation baselines across multiple backbone architectures, reducing training variance by approximately 50\% compared to naive flow matching distillation while achieving superior restoration quality.

AI.tldr: 提出FoRM（Flow-Map Distillation on Relation Manifolds），将基于关系的知识蒸馏重新建模为关系流形上的连续流映射问题，通过学习流映射算子实现轨迹级别的监督，并引入安全半群一致性约束和端点锚定损失，在五种图像恢复任务上超越现有SOTA蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 现有图像恢复知识蒸馏方法通常将中间特征或关系矩阵作为静态目标进行对齐，忽略了知识迁移过程的动态结构，无法充分利用教师与学生在关系流形上的演化轨迹信息。
AI.method: 1) 将关系蒸馏建模为关系流形上的连续流映射问题；2) 学习流映射算子F_θ(z,t,s)，直接预测从当前时间t到任意目标时间s的关系状态，而非回归恒定速度场；3) 引入安全半群一致性约束，利用真实桥接状态保证流映射的全局自一致性，消除幻影态误差累积；4) 端点锚定损失防止算子偏离教师目标。
AI.result: 在超分辨率、去雨、去噪、去模糊和低光增强五种图像恢复任务上，跨多种骨干网络架构一致超越现行最优蒸馏基线；相比朴素流匹配蒸馏，训练方差降低约50%，同时获得更优的恢复质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将关系蒸馏提升为流形上的连续流映射学习，并配合半群一致性约束与端点锚定，FoRM不仅能提供更丰富的轨迹级监督，还显著提升了训练稳定性与蒸馏性能，为图像恢复蒸馏提供了新的范式。

title: Training-Free Token-Level Steering for LLM Personalized Co-Writing
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show great promise for personalization, they often lack specialized domain knowledge. Conventional solutions like fine-tuning struggle with high computational costs and rapid data updates, while Retrieval-Augmented Generation fails to provide fine-grained, token-level steering. Furthermore, chat-based interfaces remain dominant, whereas productive co-writing paradigms have not yet been well exploited beyond the coding domain. To this end, we introduce SteerWrite, a training-free framework designed for personalized co-writing. Our method effectively adapts the base model to specialized domains without gradient updates, with specific designs tailored to small datasets. Experiments demonstrate that SteerWrite achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse datasets, metrics, and models, significantly reducing human editing effort.

AI.tldr: SteerWrite是一个无需训练的个性化协同写作框架，通过无梯度更新方式将基础大语言模型适配到专业领域，在多种数据集和模型上取得最先进性能，显著减少了人工编辑工作量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM个性化方案存在明显缺陷：微调计算成本高且难以应对快速更新的数据，检索增强生成无法提供细粒度的token级引导，且当前主流交互仍以聊天为主，缺乏超越编程领域的生产性协同写作范式。
AI.method: SteerWrite采用训练自由（training-free）的方法，无需梯度更新即可将基础模型适配到专业领域，并针对小数据集设计了特定方案来实现token级别的个性化引导。
AI.result: 在多种数据集、指标和模型上进行实验，SteerWrite取得了最先进（SOTA）的性能表现，并且显著降低了人工编辑成本。
AI.conclusion: SteerWrite证明了训练自由框架可以有效地实现个性化协同写作，克服了微调的高成本和RAG的粒度限制，为超越聊天界面的生产性写作场景提供了新的解决方案。

title: ProDVI: Programmatic Dynamics Priors for Value Network Initialization
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) is notoriously sample inefficient. One contributing factor is that RL agents are typically initialized from scratch, forcing them to acquire task-relevant knowledge through online interaction. Existing approaches obtain informative initializations through pre-collected datasets, high-fidelity simulators, or meta-learning over related tasks, but these prerequisites may be difficult to access or even unavailable. In this paper, we propose Programmatic Dynamics Priors for Value Network Initialization (ProDVI), a framework that leverages the commonsense and domain knowledge encoded in large language models to initialize RL agents without relying on these resources. Specifically, ProDVI prompts a code-generating language model to produce executable Python functions that encode coarse hypotheses about environment dynamics. These functions are then used to generate synthetic transitions. Based on these transitions, we construct an auxiliary dynamics prediction objective to pretrain the state-action encoder of the value network in an actor-critic framework. The learned representation provides dynamics-aware inductive biases before online RL begins. Importantly, the generated programs are used only for representation pretraining and are not required to faithfully simulate the target environment. While the generated programs may be inaccurate, their induced initialization can be corrected through online learning from real transitions and rewards. Experiments on OpenAI Gym and DeepMind Control Suite tasks show that ProDVI can effectively improve the sample efficiency of model-free RL algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProDVI框架，利用大型语言模型生成的代码程序编码环境动态的先验知识，通过合成转移数据预训练actor-critic框架中价值网络的状态-动作编码器，从而在无需预收集数据集、高保真模拟器或元学习的前提下提升深度强化学习的样本效率。实验表明ProDVI在OpenAI Gym和DeepMind Control Suite任务上能有效改善无模型RL算法的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习样本效率低下，其中一个核心原因是RL智能体通常从零开始初始化，需要通过在线交互获取任务相关知识。现有的初始化方法依赖于预收集数据集、高保真模拟器或元学习等前置资源，但这些资源在实际场景中可能难以获取甚至不可用。因此需要一个不依赖这些资源即可获得有信息量初始化的方法。
AI.method: ProDVI框架利用代码生成式大语言模型（LLM）产生可执行的Python函数，这些函数编码关于环境动态的粗略假设。随后利用这些函数生成合成转移数据（synthetic transitions），并在此基础上构建一个辅助动力学预测目标来预训练actor-critic框架中价值网络的状态-动作编码器。预训练获得的表示在在线RL开始前就提供了动力学感知的归纳偏置。值得注意的是，生成的程序仅用于表示预训练，不要求忠实模拟目标环境，不准确之处可通过在线学习从真实转移和奖励中校正。
AI.result: 在OpenAI Gym和DeepMind Control Suite任务上的实验表明，ProDVI能够有效提升无模型RL算法的样本效率。
AI.conclusion: ProDVI验证了利用LLM编码的常识与领域知识作为动力学先验来初始化价值网络表示的可行性。该方法不依赖预收集数据、高保真模拟器等难以获取的资源，且生成程序的欠准确性可通过在线学习校正，为提升深度RL样本效率提供了新的思路。

title: HyTBE: Hyperbolic Target-Background Expert Model for Cross-Domain Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) has achieved substantial progress under domain-consistent evaluation, yet detector performance often degrades markedly when generalizing to unseen infrared domains. Existing methods primarily improve detection by enhancing target responses and suppressing background interference. However, when trained on only a limited set of source domains, their learned decision rules are inevitably established from a restricted range of source-domain target-background relation patterns. We formulate this cross-domain failure as target-background relation shift: unseen domains may exhibit relation patterns that are not observed during training, thereby weakening the discriminative capability learned from the source domains. To address this problem, we propose HyTBE, a Hyperbolic Target-Background Expert model that expands source-domain relation patterns and adaptively adjusts visual representations using explicit relation cues. The Target-Background Relation Intervention selectively perturbs either targets or backgrounds, broadening the observable relation patterns during training while maintaining valid supervision. Subsequently, the Hyperbolic Relation Modeling maps multi-scale visual cues into a Poincaré ball and characterizes the target-background relation of each feature token according to its relative distances to the target and background anchors. The Hyperbolic-guided MoE Adapter further uses these hyperbolic relation representations to calibrate multi-scale visual features and aggregate expert-specific feature corrections for different relation patterns. Leave-one-domain-out experiments on NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K demonstrate that HyTBE achieves stronger cross-domain generalization than competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyTBE（Hyperbolic Target-Background Expert model），一种用于红外小目标检测（IRSTD）跨域泛化的方法。通过目标-背景关系干预扩展训练期间可见的关系模式，利用双曲关系建模将多尺度视觉线索映射到庞加莱球中刻画目标-背景关系，并通过双曲引导的MoE适配器校准多尺度视觉特征，从而应对跨域时目标-背景关系偏移导致的检测性能下降问题。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测在领域一致评估下已取得较大进展，但在泛化到未见过的红外域时性能显著下降。现有方法主要通过学习目标响应增强和背景抑制来提升检测，但由于仅从有限源域训练，学到的决策规则受限于有限的源域目标-背景关系模式，导致跨域失败。作者将此问题形式化为"目标-背景关系偏移"（target-background relation shift），即未见域可能呈现训练中未观察到的关系模式，削弱模型判别能力。
AI.method: HyTBE包含三个核心组件：(1) Target-Background Relation Intervention——选择性扰动目标或背景，在训练期间扩展可观察的关系模式，同时保持有效监督；(2) Hyperbolic Relation Modeling——将多尺度视觉线索映射到庞加莱球，根据每个特征token到目标和背景锚点的相对距离刻画目标-背景关系；(3) Hyperbolic-guided MoE Adapter——利用双曲关系表示校准多尺度视觉特征，并针对不同关系模式聚合专家特定的特征修正。
AI.result: 在NUAA-SIRST、NUDT-SIRST和IRSTD-1K数据集上进行留一域（leave-one-domain-out）实验，HyTBE相比竞争性基线取得了更强的跨域泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: HyTBE通过显式建模和扩展目标-背景关系模式，有效缓解了红外小目标检测中的跨域关系偏移问题，验证了双曲空间建模和专家混合机制在跨域红外小目标检测中的有效性。

title: Beyond Sequence Order: Syntax-Informed Positional Embeddings for Transformers
summary: Positional embeddings (PE) in Transformers encode token distance and order but are largely agnostic to \textit{syntactic structure}. We introduce \textbf{S}yntax-\textbf{i}nformed \textbf{P}ositional \textbf{E}mbeddings (\textbf{SiPE}), which learns a lightweight syntactic prior from dependency parses during pretraining and injects it across all three dominant PE families (absolute, relative, rotary), for both encoders and decoders, leaving self-attention and the rest of the architecture untouched. We isolate \emph{where} and \emph{how} the prior should enter the model, and find it depends on the architecture: for autoregressive decoders that use relative PE, the prior is strongest when coupled multiplicatively with the relative-position term of the attention score, outperforming injection into the input embeddings, into self-attention, or into the positional and attention terms jointly---while for encoders it is best added directly to the input embeddings, composing with each encoder's native positional mechanism. We find that models pre-trained with SiPE improve on the SyntaxGym benchmark by up to $10.3\%$ while simultaneously reducing perplexity by $9.0\%$ over a base model with no syntactic supervision---a metric nearly every existing syntax-injection method instead degrades. Crucially, these gains extend beyond syntactic generalization: SiPE also improves real-world language understanding, raising scores on the GLUE benchmark by up to $8.2\%$ over a model trained without it. Unlike existing syntactic language models that marginalize over many parses at inference or discard syntax at runtime, SiPE conditions on a single parse, establishing a new Pareto frontier between syntactic supervision and inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SiPE（Syntax-informed Positional Embeddings），一种在预训练阶段从依存句法分析中学习轻量级句法先验并注入到三类主流位置编码（绝对、相对、旋转）中的方法，适用于编码器和解码器，无需改变自注意力结构。在SyntaxGym基准上提升最高10.3%，同时困惑度降低9.0%，并在GLUE上提升最高8.2%，且仅需依赖单一解析树，建立了句法监督与推理成本之间的新帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer的位置编码能够编码token距离和顺序，但对句法结构几乎不可感知。已有的句法注入方法往往在推理时需要边际化大量解析树或运行时丢弃句法信息，且大多数方法在降低困惑度的指标上表现退化。作者希望找到一种既能注入句法先验、又不损害语言建模性能、且推理开销低的方法。
AI.method: SiPE从依存句法解析中学习轻量级句法先验，在预训练阶段将其注入到三类主流位置编码家族（绝对、相对、旋转）中，同时适用于编码器和解码器。作者系统性地隔离了句法先验应注入的位置（输入嵌入、自注意力、位置项与注意力项联合等）和方式（加法耦合或乘法耦合），发现：对于使用相对/旋转位置编码的自回归解码器，句法先验与注意力分数中的相对位置项进行乘法耦合时效果最优；对于编码器，则直接加到输入嵌入中效果最佳。整个过程中自注意力机制和模型其余结构保持不变。
AI.result: SiPE在SyntaxGym基准上最高提升10.3%，同时将困惑度降低9.0%（而现有句法注入方法大多在此指标上退化）；在GLUE基准上最高提升8.2%。SiPE仅依赖单一解析树，无需在推理时对多个解析进行边际化或丢弃句法信息，在句法监督与推理成本之间建立了新的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 句法先验的注入方式和位置因架构而异：解码器（相对PE）中应采用与相对位置项的乘法耦合，编码器中应采用对输入嵌入的加法注入。SiPE证明句法监督不仅不会损害语言建模性能，反而能同时提升句法泛化能力和真实语言理解能力，并且保持低推理开销。

title: BioKD: Selective Physiology-to-Video Knowledge Distillation via Reliability Gate for Emotion Recognition
summary: To address the limitations of video-based emotion recognition under ambiguous or socially masked behavioral cues, as well as the poor deployability of physiological signals, this paper proposes a reliability-aware physiology-to-video knowledge distillation framework, termed BioKD. The proposed framework leverages physiological signals as privileged information during training to guide a video-based student model in learning deep affective representations, while relying solely on non-intrusive video inputs at inference time. To cope with the high noise and instability of physiological teacher supervision caused by inter-subject variability, signal artifacts, and temporal inconsistency, BioKD incorporates a sample-wise reliability-aware gating mechanism together with a progressive distillation strategy. By adaptively regulating the strength of knowledge transfer, the framework suppresses negative transfer induced by unreliable physiological supervision and enables more stable cross-modal distillation. Experiments on DEAP and AMIGOS show that BioKD consistently outperforms representative baselines under both trial-wise and subject-wise evaluation protocols for valence and arousal recognition. For example, BioKD achieves 68.01\% on DEAP (trial-wise arousal) and 65.29\% under the more challenging subject-wise setting, demonstrating improved performance under a subject-independent evaluation setting. Further analyses show that BioKD effectively mitigates overconfident teacher errors and outperforms an entropy-only weighting strategy, confirming the importance of explicitly modeling supervision reliability. In addition, BioKD introduces no additional inference-time overhead relative to the same video student architecture and removes the need for physiological sensing and multimodal synchronization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可靠性感知的生理信号到视频知识蒸馏框架（BioKD），利用生理信号作为训练时的特权信息来指导视频学生模型学习深度情感表征，推理时仅依赖非侵入性的视频输入。通过样本级可靠性门控机制和渐进式蒸馏策略，抑制不可靠生理监督带来的负迁移。在DEAP和AMIGOS数据集上，其一致优于代表性基线，且推理零额外开销。
AI.motivation: 视频情感识别在模糊或社会掩蔽行为线索下性能受限，而生理信号虽更可靠但部署性差（需要传感器和多模态同步）。现有跨模态蒸馏方法未充分考虑生理教师监督的高噪声和不稳定性（如个体差异、信号伪影、时间不一致），导致负迁移问题。因此需要一种既利用生理信号优势又能稳定蒸馏、且推理时无额外代价的框架。
AI.method: BioKD框架的核心设计包括：(1) 以生理信号作为特权信息（privileged information）进行训练阶段的教师监督，推理阶段仅使用视频输入；(2) 样本级可靠性感知门控机制（sample-wise reliability-aware gating mechanism），自适应调节知识迁移强度，抑制不可靠生理监督带来的负迁移；(3) 渐进式蒸馏策略（progressive distillation strategy），促进更稳定的跨模态知识迁移。
AI.result: 在DEAP和AMIGOS数据集上，BioKD在试次级和受试者级两种评估协议下均一致优于代表性基线。在DEAP试次级唤醒度上达到68.01%，在更具挑战性的受试者级设定下达到65.29%。消融分析表明该框架有效缓解了过自信教师错误，并优于仅熵加权策略。
AI.conclusion: BioKD验证了显式建模监督可靠性在生理-视频知识蒸馏中的重要性，能够在利用生理信号优势的同时保持推理阶段的轻量与可部署性，且不引入额外推理开销，无需生理传感和多模态同步。

title: When Agentic AI Meets Integrated Sensing and Communication
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) from a function-oriented physical-layer technology into a goal-driven, closed-loop intelligent system, a paradigm we term AISAC. Existing work on learning-based sensing, resource allocation, reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS), edge intelligence, multi-agent coordination, and resilient networking has developed largely in isolation. This survey unifies the literature within a six-stage closed-loop framework comprising observation, contextualization, reasoning and prediction, planning and orchestration, execution and collaboration, and feedback and resilience. It also introduces five levels of agentic maturity, ranging from physical-layer primitives to fully closed-loop agentic ISAC. We use this framework to review advances in multimodal intelligence, large language models, reinforcement learning, federated learning, RIS-assisted control, Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and vehicular networks, and AI-native network management, and analyze privacy, security, resilience, and sustainability as cross-cutting requirements of the full perception-reasoning-action loop. An audit of representative studies against nine agentic-specific evaluation criteria shows that no system reports more than one or two of them, exposing a gap between claimed and demonstrated agentic maturity. We identify open challenges in physical-to-semantic grounding, predictive world models, real-time agent-PHY interaction, safe tool use, heterogeneous multi-agent collaboration, benchmarking, and resource-efficient autonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AISAC范式，将智能体人工智能（Agentic AI）引入集成感知与通信（ISAC）领域，构建了一个六阶段闭环框架和五级智能体成熟度模型，系统综述了相关技术进展，并通过九项评估标准审计发现现有研究在智能体成熟度方面存在声明与实证之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有关于ISAC的研究在基于学习的感知、资源分配、可重构智能表面（RIS）、边缘智能、多智能体协作和弹性网络等方向上大都独立发展，缺乏统一的框架来理解和推动ISAC从传统的面向功能的物理层技术向目标驱动的闭环智能系统演变。作者旨在通过提出统一框架来弥合这一文献碎片化的问题。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，构建了一个包含观察、情境化、推理与预测、规划与编排、执行与协作、反馈与弹性六个阶段的闭环框架，并定义了从物理层原语到完全闭环智能体ISAC的五个智能体成熟度级别。作者以此框架审视了多模态智能、大语言模型、强化学习、联邦学习、RIS辅助控制、UAV与车载网络、AI原生网络管理等领域，并提出九项智能体特定评估标准对代表性研究进行审计。
AI.result: 对代表性研究按九项智能体特定评估标准的审计表明，没有任何系统在超过一或两项标准上有所报告，暴露出声称的智能体成熟度与实际演示程度之间存在明显差距。此外，研究识别出物理到语义的接地、预测性世界模型、实时智能体-物理层交互、安全工具使用、异构多智能体协作、基准测试和资源高效自主性等开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: AISAC代表着ISAC从物理层技术向目标驱动的闭环智能系统的范式转变。尽管该领域前景广阔，但当前研究在智能体成熟度验证方面严重不足，亟需建立标准化的评估框架和基准，以推动智能体ISAC从概念走向实际部署。

title: SR-JEPA: Learning Predictive Latent State in 3D Scenes
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn by predicting latent representations of missing observations, yet many masked JEPAs are evaluated primarily through the encoders they produce. We ask what a trained predictive pathway itself infers when an entire entity is absent from a native 3D scene. We introduce SR-JEPA, a point-native JEPA for scene-scale point clouds whose original frozen predictive pathway can be queried at a supplied location. At evaluation, every point of one object is removed before encoding and replaced by the same shape-free 32-point query at its centroid. Training uses only self-contained 3D EMA targets: no reconstruction, semantic labels, language, or lifted 2D features. On 5,953 held-out ARKitScenes objects, the imputed latent reaches 43.13% semantic-identity macro accuracy, 22.18 points above the strongest floor. Randomizing the prediction path removes 9.78 points, while substituting matched donor context removes 21.98 points. On 8,570 Sr3D support pairs, the full latent reaches 41.15 AP; identity decoded from the missing-object latent, combined with anchor identity and geometry, reaches 39.37 AP, leaving an unresolved 1.78-point residual. These results reveal a queryable, compositional 3D predictive state: the model completes context-dependent entity content, which downstream computation combines with metric geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SR-JEPA，一种面向场景级点云的点原生联合嵌入预测架构。通过在物体质心处放置一个形状无关的32点查询，并冻结预测通路，模型能够在完整物体缺失时完成隐式语义内容推断。在ARKitScenes和Sr3D数据集上展示了显著优于基线的语义身份恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的掩码JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）主要通过对编码器的评估来衡量性能，但训练出的预测通路本身在完整实体缺失时能推断出什么内容，尚未被系统研究。本文旨在回答这一问题：当原生3D场景中某个完整实体完全缺失时，训练好的预测通路本身能推断出什么。
AI.method: 引入SR-JEPA，一种点原生JEPA架构，用于场景级点云。核心创新在于预测通路是可查询的：在评估时，先移除一个物体的所有点，然后在该物体质心处放置一个形状无关的32点查询。训练仅使用自包含的3D EMA目标，不涉及重建、语义标签、语言或2D特征。
AI.result: 在5,953个ARKitScenes物体上，插补隐式表征达到43.13%的语义身份宏精度，比最强基线高22.18个百分点。随机化预测通路导致9.78个百分点的下降，替换匹配供体上下文导致21.98个百分点的下降。在8,570个Sr3D支持对上，完整隐式表征达到41.15 AP；从缺失物体隐式表征解码的身份与锚点身份及几何结合达到39.37 AP，剩余1.78个百分点的未解析残差。
AI.conclusion: 实验揭示了一种可查询、可组合的3D预测状态：模型能够完成依赖于上下文的实体内容推断，下游计算可将此与度量几何信息相结合，形成场景理解能力。

title: Decolonizing Linguistic Policies in Automated Speech Recognition: A Framework for Cross-Culturally Competent Speech AI
comment: 10 Pages, 2 Figures, 2 Tables, Interspeech 2026 - Sydney, Australia
summary: This paper focuses on automatic speech recognition (ASR) and ASR-mediated voice interfaces that shape access to public services, healthcare, and education. We argue that persistent failures for low-resource, Indigenous, and non-standard language varieties are not only technical errors, but also implicit linguistic policies that reproduce colonial language hierarchies. Drawing on linguistic capital, raciolinguistic ideology, language policy research, and decolonial computing, we show how data, metrics, and model priors determine whose voices become machine-legible. We introduce the Three Harms (3M) taxonomy---Misrecognition, Misalignment, and Mistrust---and a seven-layer situatedness model for linguistic diversity in ASR and ASR-mediated voice interfaces. We then propose a participatory framework and minimum audit protocol for culturally competent ASR, positioning affected communities as co-designers, evaluators, and governance partners.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦自动语音识别（ASR）及其语音交互界面在公共服务、医疗和教育领域的作用，指出低资源、原住民及非标准语言变体在ASR中的持续失败不仅是技术错误，更是隐性的语言政策，反映出殖民语言等级制度的再生产。文章提出"三重伤害"（3M）分类体系（误识别、错位、不信任）和七层情境化模型，并倡导参与式框架与最低审计协议，推动文化胜任的ASR发展。
AI.motivation: ASR系统对低资源、原住民和非标准语言变体的系统性失败长期存在，但此前研究多将其视为纯技术问题，忽视了其中隐含的权力结构和殖民历史。作者旨在揭示这些技术失败背后的语言政策和意识形态维度，并推动社区赋权。
AI.method: 结合语言资本理论、种族语言学意识形态、语言政策研究与去殖民计算等跨学科框架进行理论分析，提出三重伤害（3M）分类体系和七层情境化模型，并设计参与式框架及最低审计协议。
AI.result: 提出了Misrecognition（误识别）、Misalignment（错位）、Mistrust（不信任）三重伤害分类体系；构建了涵盖语言多样性七个层面的情境化模型；提出了以受影响社区为共同设计者、评估者和治理伙伴的参与式框架与最低审计协议。
AI.conclusion: ASR技术中的语言偏见是一种隐性语言政策，需要通过将受影响社区纳入全流程设计、评估与治理，构建文化胜任的语音技术，以挑战并超越殖民语言等级体系。

title: Hybrid-Adaptive Thread Tuning to Mitigate Simulation Execution Bottlenecks in High-Performance Reinforcement Learning Inference
summary: In simulation-in-the-loop decision-making systems, reinforcement learning (RL) inference is often constrained by simulator-side execution overhead, where workloads are highly dynamic and sensitive to runtime thread configurations. Existing multithreaded strategies struggle to match thread resources before or during execution, causing resource contention, scheduling overhead, and reduced throughput. Through empirical analysis, we identify the ratio of task execution time to scheduling time as the key factor determining the optimal thread count. Building on this insight, we propose AutoThread, a hybrid adaptive thread-tuning method for mitigating simulation bottlenecks in RL inference. AutoThread employs a Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) as a thread-count predictor and incorporates a finite-source M/M/1 queueing model to constrain and guide prediction, enabling fast and accurate estimation under dynamic workloads. It further performs load-aware online fine-tuning to compensate for prediction errors and refine resource allocation. Experiments show that AutoThread improves average speedup by 18.4\% over static strategies, achieves average throughput of 1.7x and 1.8x that of XGBoost and Reinforcer, respectively, and reduces execution time by up to 83.8\% compared with state-of-the-art methods. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/suchenjm/AutoThread.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoThread，一种面向强化学习推理中仿真瓶颈的混合自适应线程调优方法。它利用物理信息神经算子（PINO）作为线程数预测器，并结合有限源M/M/1排队模型约束预测，同时通过负载感知的在线微调修正误差。实验表明相比静态策略平均加速18.4%，吞吐量为XGBoost和Reinforcer的1.7倍和1.8倍，相比最先进方法执行时间最高降低83.8%。
AI.motivation: 在仿真在环决策系统中，强化学习推理常受限于仿真器端的执行开销，工作负载高度动态且对运行时线程配置敏感。现有多线程策略难以在执行前或执行中匹配线程资源，导致资源竞争、调度开销和吞吐量下降。
AI.method: 通过经验分析识别出任务执行时间与调度时间之比是决定最优线程数的关键因素。基于此提出AutoThread：采用物理信息神经算子（PINO）作为线程数预测器，引入有限源M/M/1排队模型约束并指导预测，实现在动态工作负载下快速准确的估计；并执行负载感知的在线微调以补偿预测误差并细化资源分配。
AI.result: AutoThread相比静态策略平均加速18.4%，平均吞吐量达到XGBoost的1.7倍和Reinforcer的1.8倍，相比最先进方法执行时间最多降低83.8%。代码和数据集已公开。
AI.conclusion: AutoThread通过结合PIN0预测器与有限源排队模型约束，并辅以在线微调，有效缓解了RL推理中的仿真瓶颈，在动态工作负载下实现了优于静态与现有先进方法的线程调优性能。

title: When Self-Evolution Backfires: Pre-Commit Gating against Skill Contamination in LLM Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents accumulate capability by distilling reusable skills from their execution trajectories, but we find this process is not monotonic: past a critical pool size, newly added skills degrade performance instead of improving it. We formalize this capability-contamination phase transition and trace it to a structural cause: once a defective skill enters the decision context, it becomes reference material for distilling later skills, forming cross-round contamination chains. We further show the contamination is structurally irreversible: removing a source skill after the fact cannot erase the flawed reasoning its descendants have already inherited, so post-hoc rollback recovers only a small fraction of the lost performance. This makes skill admission a pre-commit necessity rather than a post-hoc fix, and motivates Verifier-as-Gatekeeper (VaG): a progressive trust hierarchy whose three heterogeneous critics - structural validity, behavioral harmlessness, and semantic consistency - filter each skill individually, coupled with a marginal-gain subset selection that removes combinatorial contamination at the top tier before skills reach the runtime context. On Terminal-Bench 2, unconditional accumulation rises to a peak and then degrades, giving back most of its gains as the pool keeps growing, and post-hoc removal of the culprit skills recovers only a small part of the drop - the empirical signature of irreversibility. In contrast, VaG improves every round, reaching 72% pass@1 with a pool roughly 5x smaller, and its frozen skill pool transfers positively to four other backbones and a second benchmark without re-evolution. Ablations confirm the three critics are complementary and mutually non-substitutable, each intercepting a largely disjoint class of harmful skills.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自我进化智能体的"能力污染相变"问题：当技能池超过临界规模后，新增技能反而降低性能。作者发现缺陷技能进入决策上下文后会产生跨轮次污染链，且该污染结构性不可逆。为此提出Verifier-as-Gatekeeper (VaG)框架，通过三个异构批评者（结构有效性、行为无害性、语义一致性）逐技能过滤，结合边际增益子集选择在顶层去除组合污染。在Terminal-Bench 2上VaG比无条件累积提高性能至72% pass@1且技能池小约5倍，并冻结后跨骨干和基准正向迁移。
AI.motivation: 自我进化智能体通过从执行轨迹中蒸馏可复用技能来累积能力，但作者发现这一过程不是单调的：超过临界池大小后，新加入的技能会降低而非提升性能。这一反直觉现象迫切需要理论形式化和结构成因分析，以指导技能管理策略。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"能力污染相变"并追踪其结构成因：缺陷技能进入决策上下文后成为后续技能蒸馏的参考材料，形成跨轮次污染链。2) 证明污染结构性不可逆：事后移除源技能无法消除后代已继承的错误推理。3) 提出Verifier-as-Gatekeeper (VaG)渐进信任层级：三个异构批评者（结构有效性、行为无害性、语义一致性）逐技能过滤，辅以边际增益子集选择在顶层消除组合污染。
AI.result: Terminal-Bench 2上，无条件累积性能先升至峰值后下降，且事后移除罪魁技能仅恢复小部分性能（不可逆性的经验证据）。VaG每轮都提升，达到72% pass@1，技能池约小5倍，冻结技能池无需重新进化即可正向迁移到四个其他骨干和一个第二基准。消融实验证明三个批评者互补且不可互相替代，各自拦截大致不相交的有害技能类别。
AI.conclusion: 自我进化中技能准入必须是"事前承诺"而非"事后修复"：污染一旦发生就结构性不可逆。Verifier-as-Gatekeeper通过分层的多视角验证器和组合污染筛除，实现了更小池、更高性能、更强可迁移性的技能积累，为自我进化智能体的可控成长提供了新的范式。

title: Vorch-Director: Interactive World Story Model via Noise-Aware Error Rectification
summary: Autoregressive continuation provides a natural path toward minute-scale audio-visual generation by repeatedly extending a short-window generator conditioned on previously generated video and audio. However, models are trained on clean ground-truth histories, while inference relies on their own generated histories, where accumulated errors cause identity drift, over-smoothing, and audio-visual desynchronization. Recent methods reduce this mismatch by reusing prediction residuals as synthetic corruption, but we observe that the effectiveness of residual correction critically depends on the flow-matching noise level at which residuals are produced. We propose Vorch-Director, a noise-level-aware residual correction strategy that associates each residual with its originating noise level and injects residuals from matched noise regimes during training. By aligning injected errors with the denoising process, Vorch-Director produces more realistic autoregressive histories while retaining efficient teacher-forcing training. Built on the audio-visual LTX-2 diffusion transformer, Vorch-Director further introduces task embeddings to distinguish historical video, reference images, and target video, enabling unified conditioning for long-horizon generation. Together with a clean conditioning sink and mixed-task training, Vorch-Director supports multi-shot, multi-subject, reference-guided audio-visual long-video generation. We evaluate Vorch-Director on ST-Bench and introduce a new long-horizon audio-visual benchmark with metrics for quality drift and long-range consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved stability and audio-visual fidelity over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Vorch-Director，一种噪声级别感知的残差校正策略，通过将合成残差与其来源的噪声级别关联并注入匹配的噪声区间进行训练，解决自回归音视频生成中训练与推理分布不匹配导致的身份漂移、过度平滑和音视频不同步问题。基于 LTX-2 扩散 Transformer 构建，并引入任务嵌入和混合任务训练，支持多镜头、多主体、参考图像引导的长时程音视频生成。
AI.motivation: 自回归式续写为分钟级音视频生成提供自然路径，但模型训练时使用干净的真实历史，推理时依赖自身生成的历史，这种分布不匹配导致累积误差引发身份漂移、过度平滑和音视频不同步。现有方法通过重用预测残差作为合成损坏来降低这种不匹配，但残差校正的有效性关键取决于生成残差时的流匹配噪声水平，而现有方法未对此进行区分。
AI.method: 1) 提出噪声级别感知的残差校正策略（Vorch-Director），将每个残差与其来源的噪声级别关联，并在训练时从匹配的噪声区间注入残差；2) 基于音视频 LTX-2 扩散 Transformer 构建模型；3) 引入任务嵌入区分历史视频、参考图像和目标视频，实现统一条件建模；4) 采用干净的条件汇（clean conditioning sink）和混合任务训练，支持多镜头、多主体、参考引导的长时程音视频生成；5) 评估在 ST-Bench 上进行，并提出新的长时程音视频基准，包含质量漂移和长程一致性指标。
AI.result: 在 ST-Bench 和提出的新长时程音视频基准上，Vorch-Director 相比强基线展现出更优的稳定性以及音视频保真度，在质量漂移控制和长程一致性方面均取得实质性改善。
AI.conclusion: 将注入残差与去噪过程对齐，能够生成更真实的自回归历史，同时保持高效的教师强制训练方式；任务嵌入与混合任务训练的联合设计进一步扩展了模型对统一条件长时程音视频生成的能力。

title: Routing Is Least Learnable Where It Is Most Valuable: Bounds on Representation Routing for Web Agents
comment: Preprint. Under review at the Second Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models (REALM), EMNLP 2026 (non-archival track)
summary: Web agents observe a browser through text, pixels, or both, and the choice is usually fixed once for all tasks. We measure six observation modes across eight site-model combinations (cells) on VisualWebArena and WebArena and ask what choosing per task would buy. The modes are complementary: each solves tasks the others miss, they fail in structurally different ways, and the best choice reverses between task sets. The obvious prize, an oracle that picks a winning mode for every task, looks large but is inflated by run-to-run noise: rerunning the same mode on the same tasks changes 12-14% of outcomes, so a second run of a mode already in hand gains about as much as adding a new one. What survives is a cost bound: sending only the tasks no mode solves to the cheapest mode cuts cost by 9.5-30.6% in 8 of 8 cells at unchanged success. We then test five routing policies (picking the mode, deciding when to spend on the strong mode, a zero-cost rule read off the task text, a confidence cascade, and pooled cost tiers), and none robustly beats simply fixing one well-chosen mode; the one exception is a fragile result in our sparsest cell. The central obstruction is that routing supervision is produced at the agent's success rate: the weaker the agent, the fewer labels a router gets, exactly where routing would be most valuable. This limit belongs to today's agents rather than to routing itself. Label supply and routing opportunity rise together (correlation 0.95 across cells), so a stronger agent can overturn the result, and we report the rerun noise bands and the full measurement protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文系统测量了Web Agent的六种观察模式（文本、像素或二者结合）在VisualWebArena和WebArena共8个site-model组合上的表现。发现各观察模式具有互补性：它们能解决彼此无法解决的任务，失败方式在结构上不同，且最佳选择在任务集之间反转。尽管"完美路由"的上限看似很高，但被运行噪声显著夸大（同一模式重复运行会改变12-14%的结果）。实际中，将无模式能解决的任务交给最便宜模式可在8/8个单元中降低9.5-30.6%的成本且成功率不变。测试了五种路由策略，无一能稳定胜过固定选择一种好模式。根本障碍在于路由监督信号产生于Agent自身的成功率水平：Agent越弱，路由器获得的标签越少，而这恰恰是路由最有价值的场景。但标签供应与路由机会高度相关（r=0.95），更强的Agent可以扭转这一结论。
AI.motivation: Web Agent的观察模式（文本、像素或两者结合）通常是预先固定的，但不同任务可能适合不同模式。作者想量化"按任务选择观察模式"能带来多少收益，以及这种路由策略是否真的可行。
AI.method: 在8个site-model组合上测量六种观察模式的表现（共48个cell），通过重复运行来估计运行噪声；测试五种路由策略：模式选择、强模式开销决策、基于任务文本的零成本规则、置信度级联和成本分层池化；并分析路由监督信号与Agent成功率之间的关系。
AI.result: 观察模式高度互补但完美路由收益被噪声高估（重复运行噪声12-14%）；成本路由可以在8/8单元中以不变成功率降低9.5-30.6%成本；五种路由策略全部输给固定一种好模式（仅一个最稀疏单元出现脆弱例外）；路由监督与Agent成功率高度相关（r=0.95）。
AI.conclusion: 当前Agent水平下，观察模式路由的价值有限，不稳健地优于固定策略；路由的有效性受限于Agent自身能力——更强的Agent能提供更多路由标签，从而可能实现路由的价值。该限制属于当前Agent而非路由本身。

title: Dynamic Graph Prompting via Topology-Routed Mixed-Curvature Experts
summary: Dynamic graph prompting freezes a pre-trained temporal backbone and adapts it to label-scarce downstream tasks using lightweight prompts. However, existing methods operate within a single, fixed embedding space. In this work, we reveal that temporal shifts in local clustering and degree heterogeneity actively reorganize the edge curvature spectrum---indicating that the optimal representation geometry dynamically evolves with local topology over time. We formalize this unaddressed mismatch as geometry under-adaptation. To overcome this limitation, we propose CurvPrompt, a topology-routed geometry prompting framework for dynamic graphs. Instead of relying on a single space, CurvPrompt maintains a bank of curvature-diverse Riemannian experts, each paired with a learnable prompt. A topology-aware gate dynamically routes each node--time instance to a sparse subset of experts, constructing a personalized mixed-curvature representation. To ensure parameter efficiency and training stability under extreme label scarcity, CurvPrompt employs soft routing during pre-training to build a continuous topology--geometry mapping, and transitions to hard Top-K routing with uniform weights during downstream adaptation. Extensive experiments across four benchmark datasets show that CurvPrompt significantly advances few-shot link prediction while delivering strong, consistent performance on node classification tasks, validating the necessity of geometry-adaptive prompting.

AI.tldr: CurvPrompt是一个面向动态图的拓扑路由几何提示框架，通过维护一组曲率多样的黎曼专家并结合可学习的提示词，实现混合曲率表示的自适应路由，从而解决现有动态图提示方法在固定嵌入空间中无法适应随时间演化的局部拓扑几何变化的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有动态图提示方法在单一固定嵌入空间中操作，但研究发现时间推移中局部聚类变化和度异质性会重组边的曲率谱，意味着最优表示几何随局部拓扑动态演化。作者将这一问题形式化为"几何欠适应"（geometry under-adaptation），并指出这是当前方法未解决的重大缺陷。
AI.method: CurvPrompt由三部分组成：(1) 维护一个曲率多样的黎曼专家库，每个专家配对一个可学习提示；(2) 拓扑感知门控（topology-aware gate）动态将每个节点-时间实例路由到稀疏专家子集，构建个性化的混合曲率表示；(3) 预训练阶段采用软路由以构建连续的拓扑-几何映射，下游适应阶段切换到均匀权重的硬Top-K路由，确保标签稀缺场景下的参数效率和训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，CurvPrompt在少样本链路预测任务上取得了显著提升，并在节点分类任务上表现出一致且稳定的性能，验证了几何自适应提示的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过引入拓扑感知的曲率自适应机制，证明了动态图提示中几何自适应的重要性，为标签稀缺下的动态图下游任务提供了一种全新的、有效的解决方案。

title: Cautious Context Steering for Language Model Personalization
summary: Personalizing language models (LMs) to individual user preferences is essential for aligning responses with diverse goals and backgrounds. Existing methods typically train a separate adapter for each user or learn a reward model whose scores depend on the user. Despite explicitly optimizing for each user, these methods must learn from limited observations and therefore suffer from data sparsity and poor generalization to unseen users and domains. In-context learning (ICL) and Context Steering (CoS) can instead provide more effective personalization by conditioning the base LM directly on user context and leveraging its pretrained capabilities without per-user training. Yet neither adapts the influence of that context across decoding steps: ICL leaves it uncontrolled, whereas CoS applies a fixed steering coefficient and requires two LM forward passes per step. We propose Cautious Context Steering (CCS), which adds a lightweight adapter to a frozen backbone LM to decide at each token whether and how strongly user context should affect generation. The adapter learns this behavior from an oracle context-conditioned LM and preserves the base LM when the context is not helpful. A single CCS adapter trained on only one dataset improves generation quality both in-domain and across four out-of-distribution personalization benchmarks, demonstrating robust generalization to new users and domains. CCS also avoids per-user fine-tuning and the additional context-conditioned forward pass required by CoS, substantially reducing inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出Cautious Context Steering (CCS)方法，通过在冻结的基础语言模型上添加轻量级适配器，在每个token生成时动态决定用户上下文对生成的影响程度，从而在不进行逐用户微调的情况下实现个性化，并在域内及跨域基准上表现出鲁棒的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的个性化方法分为两类：一是为每个用户训练独立适配器或依赖用户相关奖励模型，但面临数据稀疏和泛化到未见用户/领域困难的问题；二是基于上下文的方法（ICL和CoS），ICL对上下文影响不加控制，CoS使用固定引导系数并且每步需要两次前向传播。两类方法都存在局限，需要一种既能动态调节上下文影响又低开销的个性化方法。
AI.method: CCS在冻结的主干语言模型上增加一个轻量级适配器，该适配器逐token决定用户上下文是否以及以何种强度影响生成。适配器通过从oracle上下文条件语言模型中学习行为来训练，当上下文无帮助时保留基础LM的输出。训练仅需一个数据集。
AI.result: 单个CCS适配器仅在单一数据集上训练后，就能在域内以及四个分布外个性化基准上提升生成质量，展示了对新用户和新领域的鲁棒泛化。同时，CCS避免了逐用户微调，也免去了CoS所需的额外上下文条件前向传播，大幅降低了推理成本。
AI.conclusion: CCS通过轻量级适配器实现动态、可控制的上下文引导，在保持推理效率的同时，能够在个性化任务上实现良好的域内和跨域泛化，是一种高效且可扩展的个性化方案。

title: Evidence-Driven Dynamic Visual Selector for Efficient Long Video Understanding
summary: Recent advancements in MLLM-based long-form video understanding have mitigated inference-time computational cost and limited context lengths by selecting query-relevant frames. However, existing approaches predominantly rely on external proxy scorers and rigid heuristic rules, inevitably suffering from misalignment with the target MLLM's intrinsic evidence and failing to accommodate the non-uniform spatiotemporal information density. In this paper, we propose a fine-grained dynamic visual selection framework named EviSelect, grounded in the target MLLM internal attention evidence. Our method efficiently probes visual evidence via sparse prefilling as a structured prior to guide distribution-aware dynamic sampling. Specifically, we efficiently approximate attention maps of the target MLLM using highly compressed visual inputs and sparse attention, well-aligned to the full counterpart. Conditioned on three complementary attention components derived from this prior, we design a lightweight selector that not only precisely locates query-relevant timestamps but also adaptively adjusts the local sampling rate and spatial resolution. To enable evidence-conditioned spatiotemporal sampling, we formulate the selector as a stochastic policy and optimize it via GRPO under a joint accuracy--efficiency reward. By rewarding correct predictions under lower visual cost through group-relative comparisons, our method encourages the policy to allocate computation dynamically according to the information density of each video. Across three long video understanding benchmarks, EviSelect achieves superior performance compared to existing methods while reducing selected visual tokens by about 50\% and achieving a 3.9x end-to-end speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出EviSelect框架，利用目标MLLM内部注意力证据进行细粒度动态视觉选择，通过稀疏预填充近似注意力图作为先验，引导分布感知的动态采样，在长视频理解任务中实现约50%的视觉token削减和3.9倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM长视频理解方法依赖外部代理评分器和固定启发式规则进行帧选择，与目标MLLM的内在证据不对齐，且无法适应视频中非均匀的时空信息密度，导致选择结果不准确且计算效率低。
AI.method: 1) 通过高度压缩的视觉输入和稀疏注意力高效近似目标MLLM的注意力图作为结构化先验；2) 基于先前验提取三个互补注意力组件，设计轻量级选择器，同时定位查询相关时间戳并自适应调整局部采样率和空间分辨率；3) 将选择器形式化为随机策略，使用GRPO在联合准确率-效率奖励下优化，通过组相对比较鼓励策略根据信息密度动态分配计算。
AI.result: 在三个长视频理解基准上，EviSelect优于现有方法，同时减少约50%的视觉token选择，实现3.9倍端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 基于目标MLLM内在注意力证据的动态视觉选择框架能够更好地对齐模型自身的判断依据，实现根据视频信息密度自适应分配计算资源，在性能与效率之间取得更优平衡。

title: NeSy-RAG: Neuro-Symbolic RAG for Explainable Question Answering
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves question answering by grounding large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge such as text corpora. However, its reasoning process remains largely opaque: intermediate reasoning steps are difficult to verify and cannot be reliably attributed to specific evidence. Moreover, missing user-specific context is rarely detected systematically, often leading to incomplete or incorrect output.
  We propose NeSy-RAG, a modular neuro-symbolic RAG framework that synthesizes attributable Prolog modules from retrieved text chunks. For each chunk, the system generates semantically meaningful predicates that encode Boolean claims, which may depend on user facts. Using joint natural language-code embeddings, predicates are retrieved and composed into Prolog queries. To address incomplete user context, we introduce a symbolic knowledge-gap detection mechanism that identifies missing user facts whose truth values affect the query outcome and automatically triggers follow-up interactions.
  Executing the resulting Prolog queries yields deterministic answers together with transparent execution traces that link each reasoning step to its originating source. On the ShARC benchmark, without domain-specific training, NeSy-RAG achieves 61.1% accuracy, outperforming a same-model RAG baseline that achieves 42.8% accuracy.

AI.tldr: NeSy-RAG是一种模块化神经符号RAG框架，通过从检索文本中合成可溯源的Prolog模块，实现了可验证、可归因的推理过程，并引入符号化知识缺口检测来识别缺失的用户上下文，在ShARC基准上以61.1%准确率显著超越基线RAG（42.8%）。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统虽然通过外部知识提升了LLM的问答能力，但推理过程不透明，中间推理步骤难以验证且无法可靠归因到具体证据。此外，用户特定上下文的缺失很少被系统化检测，常导致不完整或错误的输出。
AI.method: NeSy-RAG将神经符号方法引入RAG框架：1) 从每个检索到的文本块中生成语义有意义的谓词，编码可依赖用户事实的布尔声明；2) 利用联合自然语言-代码嵌入检索谓词并组合成Prolog查询；3) 引入符号化知识缺口检测机制，识别影响查询结果但缺失的用户事实，并自动触发后续交互；4) 执行Prolog查询获得确定性答案及透明执行轨迹。
AI.result: 在ShARC基准上，无需领域特定训练，NeSy-RAG达到61.1%准确率，明显优于同模型RAG基线的42.8%，提升约18.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: NeSy-RAG通过神经符号结合实现了可溯源、可验证的RAG推理，有效弥补了传统RAG在推理透明性和用户上下文完整性方面的不足，为构建可信赖的RAG系统提供了新路径。

title: Does Latent Context Help? A Controlled Evaluation of Inverse Reinforcement Learning in Arctic Shipping
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted navigation can help Arctic shipping adapt to rapidly changing sea-ice conditions, but reliable deployment requires reward models that are interpretable and robust to changing environments. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a framework for recovering such rewards from vessel trajectories, while recent meta-IRL methods introduce latent context variables to capture behavioral heterogeneity. However, it remains unclear whether these latent representations recover genuinely hidden preferences or simply re-encode information already available in the observed state. We conduct a controlled evaluation on 3,186 AIS-derived voyages from 202 vessels across nine Arctic shipping seasons, comparing a linear shared reward, a nonlinear shared reward, and a latent-context model built on the same nonlinear architecture. The nonlinear reward improves held-out likelihood by 50.9% over the linear baseline, whereas adding vessel-specific latent context reduces performance by 16.5%. Behavioral analysis, context probes, and a pre-registered feature-hiding ablation show that apparent vessel-level variation is largely explained by observable route and environmental conditions rather than hidden vessel-specific factors. Moreover, predictive accuracy, route fidelity, and reward transfer yield different model rankings, demonstrating that no single metric is sufficient to evaluate learned rewards. These findings motivate testing whether the observed route, environmental, and vessel features already explain behavioral variation before adding per-vessel latent context. This supports more trustworthy AI deployment in safety-critical domains.

AI.tldr: 本文对3,186条北极航线数据进行了对照实验，比较线性共享奖励、非线性共享奖励和潜在上下文模型三种逆向强化学习（IRL）方法，发现非线性奖励比线性基线提升50.9%的held-out似然，而添加船级潜在上下文反而降低了16.5%的性能。研究表明观测到的航线和环境条件已能解释大部分行为变异，无需引入隐藏的潜在偏好变量。
AI.motivation: AI辅助导航在北极航运中具有重要应用前景，但要求奖励模型可解释且对环境变化鲁棒。元逆向强化学习（meta-IRL）引入潜在上下文变量来捕捉行为异质性，然而这些潜在表征是否真正恢复了隐藏偏好，还是仅仅重新编码了观测状态中已有的信息，这一问题尚不清楚。作者希望通过受控评估来检验这一点。
AI.method: 作者使用来自202艘船在9个北极航运季节的3,186条AIS衍生航线数据，对比三种模型：线性共享奖励、非线性共享奖励以及基于相同非线性架构的潜在上下文模型。评估手段包括held-out似然比较、行为分析、上下文化探针（context probes）以及预注册的特征隐藏消融实验（feature-hiding ablation），并考察了预测精度、路线保真度和奖励迁移三个维度的模型排名。
AI.result: 非线性奖励较线性基线将held-out似然提高50.9%；在非线性架构上添加船级潜在上下文反而使性能下降16.5%。行为分析和消融实验表明，表观上的船级变异主要由可观测的路线和环境条件解释，而非隐藏的船级专属因素。此外，预测精度、路线保真度与奖励迁移三个指标给出了不同的模型排名，说明单一指标不足以评估习得的奖励函数。
AI.conclusion: 在添加每船级潜在上下文之前，应先检验可观测的路线、环境和船级特征是否已能解释行为变异。这一发现有助于在安全关键场景中支持更可信的AI部署。

title: ViSR-KGC: Visual Subgraph Reasoning with Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion
summary: Knowledge graph completion (KGC) aims to infer missing entities or relations from incomplete graph structures, and has evolved into multimodal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC), where entities are associated with multiple modalities such as text and images. Traditional representation learning approaches follow the embedding-based paradigm and may struggle when relation-specific evidence is limited. Meanwhile, LLM-based reasoning methods typically linearize graph structures into textual prompts, which obscures structural topology and neglects vital visual information. While vision-language models (VLMs) excel at multimodal reasoning, they cannot natively interpret structured graph topology, particularly when it comes to knowledge graphs where nodes and edges carry complex semantics. To bridge this gap, we propose ViSR-KGC, a visual subgraph reasoning approach for KGC. It integrates three complementary capabilities to capture semantic correlations: identifying global topology dependencies via representation learning, analyzing local multimodal evidence using VLMs, and providing necessary commonsense knowledge inherent in pre-trained models. Based on learned multimodal embeddings, our framework first extracts a compact and query-aware subgraph from the MMKG. Then, this subgraph is transformed into a visually interpretable image using a layout strategy selected through empirical comparison.Finally, the visualized subgraph, entity images, textual descriptions, and candidate answers are combined into a unified prompt, enabling the VLM to infer the missing entity.

AI.tldr: 提出ViSR-KGC，一种通过将多模态知识图谱的子图视觉化并利用视觉语言模型进行推理的知识图谱补全方法，融合表示学习、VLM多模态推理和预训练模型中的常识知识。
AI.motivation: 传统嵌入方法在关系特定证据有限时效果不佳；LLM-based方法将图线性化为文本提示会丢失结构拓扑且忽略视觉信息；VLM擅长多模态推理但无法原生理解结构化图拓扑。三者各有短板，需弥合差距。
AI.method: ViSR-KGC包含三部分：1) 基于多模态嵌入的表示学习捕捉全局拓扑依赖；2) 从MMKG中提取紧凑且查询感知的子图；3) 通过经验比较选定布局策略将子图转化为视觉可解释图像，最后将可视化子图、实体图像、文本描述和候选答案组合为统一提示输入VLM进行缺失实体推理。
AI.result: 本文为摘要文本，未给出具体实验数值结果，但声称该框架整合了三种互补能力以更全面地捕捉语义相关性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将图结构可视化并利用VLM进行多模态推理，ViSR-KGC弥合了传统表示学习与LLM/VLM推理之间的差距，为MMKGC提供了一种新的视觉子图推理范式。

title: VSMP-IMU: Video-Grounded Semantic Motion Programs for Sensor-Aware Synthetic IMU Generation
summary: Wearable human activity recognition (HAR) is often limited by the scarcity of labeled sensor data, especially in low-resource, class-imbalanced, and subject-generalization settings. Synthetic IMU generation can reduce this dependency and enhance HAR machine learning model's performance, but existing approaches face a trade-off without addressing all factors: video-driven methods are visually grounded but sensitive to pose-estimation errors, while text-driven methods are controllable but often weakly grounded in how activities are actually performed. We present VSMP-IMU, a video-grounded framework for controllable synthetic IMU generation based on a structured Semantic Motion Program (SMP), which separates activity-defining semantics from label-preserving variation. Given an input video, VSMP-IMU extracts and augments an SMP, uses it to synthesize motion, converts the motion into virtual IMU signals, and grounds the resulting signals to the target wearable domain. We evaluate VSMP-IMU against state-of-the-art synthetic data generation methods on five public IMU-HAR datasets under leave-one-person-out evaluation. VSMP-IMU achieves an average Macro-F1 of 78.33%, improving over real-only training by 9.77% and over the strongest prior synthetic baseline by 4.04%. In low-resource settings with reduced training data-samples, it improves over real-only training by 18.54% and over the strongest prior synthetic baselines by more than 6% on average. Under long-tail evaluation in imbalanced datasets, it improves tail-class Macro-F1 by 19.86% over Real-only training and by 4.76% over SOTA. These results show that structured video-grounded semantics provide a practical foundation for controllable, wearable-relevant synthetic sensor data generation.

AI.tldr: VSMP-IMU是一种视频驱动的可控合成IMU数据生成框架，通过结构化语义运动程序（SMP）分离活动定义语义与标签保持变化，在五个公开IMU-HAR数据集上显著优于真实数据训练及现有合成方法。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴HAR常受标注传感器数据稀缺的限制，尤其在低资源、类别不平衡和跨被试泛化场景中。合成IMU数据可缓解此问题，但现有方法存在权衡：视频驱动方法对姿态估计误差敏感，文本驱动方法可控但对实际活动执行方式缺乏语义根基。
AI.method: VSMP-IMU采用结构化语义运动程序（SMP）将活动定义语义与标签保持变化分离。流程为：从输入视频提取并增强SMP，基于SMP合成运动，将运动转换为虚拟IMU信号，最终将信号对接到目标可穿戴域。
AI.result: 在五个公开IMU-HAR数据集上采用留一法（leave-one-person-out）评估，VSMP-IMU平均Macro-F1达78.33%，较仅真实训练提升9.77%，较最强先前合成基线提升4.04%。低资源场景中较真实训练提升18.54%，较长尾评估中尾部类别Macro-F1较真实训练提升19.86%，较SOTA提升4.76%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化视频驱动的语义为可控、可穿戴相关的合成传感器数据生成提供了实用的基础，有效解决了现有方法在视频接地性和可控性之间的权衡问题。
