title: Benchmarking and Enhancing LLMs for Rule-Intensive Review of National Standard Documents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support complex professional tasks, yet their capabilities in rule-intensive document review remain insufficiently evaluated. National standard documents, such as China GB/T standards, offer a representative testbed: they are lengthy, highly structured, and governed by explicit rules for scope, terminology, normative wording, and cross-section consistency. Existing benchmarks focus on domain knowledge and question answering, largely overlooking intrinsic quality review for professional documents. Such reviews rely heavily on human experts, making them costly and difficult to scale. To bridge this gap, we introduce GB/T-Bench, the first benchmark for the structured review of national standard documents. Its GB/T Review Taxonomy is a hierarchical schema covering document structure, scope alignment, normative modality, terminology consistency, and normative references, with 25 diagnosable error types. A controllable counterexample generation mechanism combines deterministic rules and constrained LLM rewriting to process 488 documents into 7,306 traceable review error instances for evaluation. We also develop a diagnosis-oriented evaluation protocol requiring exact matches on error location, review dimension, and error type, plus document-level coverage metrics. We further propose GB/T-Reviewer, a multi-agent framework that converts review knowledge into specialized skills and coordinates global inspection, targeted diagnosis, rule scanning, and result verification. Experiments with 14 mainstream LLMs reveal a substantial human-LLM gap: the strongest model achieves only 0.3280 CMCS versus 0.6640 for experts. GB/T-Reviewer raises the best CMCS to 0.5094, showing the value of structured skill coordination for rule-intensive document review. This work paves the way for trustworthy AI in standardization and other high-stakes document domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GB/T-Bench，这是首个面向国家标准文档结构化审查的基准，包含层次化审查分类体系（25种可诊断错误类型）、可控制的反例生成机制（488篇文档生成7,306个可追溯审查错误实例）以及面向诊断的评估协议。同时提出GB/T-Reviewer多智能体框架，通过专门技能协调完成全局检查、定向诊断、规则扫描和结果验证。实验表明最强模型仅达0.3280 CMCS（专家为0.6640），GB/T-Reviewer将其提升至0.5094。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在规则密集型文档审查方面的能力尚未得到充分评估。现有基准聚焦于领域知识和问答，忽视了专业文档的内在质量审查。国家标准文档（如GB/T标准）具有篇幅长、高度结构化、受明确规则约束等特点，是理想的测试平台，但此类审查严重依赖人类专家，成本高且难以规模化。
AI.method: 提出了GB/T-Bench基准，包含：(1) GB/T审查分类体系——覆盖文档结构、范围一致性、规范性模态、术语一致性和规范性引用五个维度的25种错误类型；(2) 可控制的反例生成机制——结合确定性规则和受约束的LLM重写，将488篇文档处理为7,306个可追溯错误实例；(3) 诊断导向的评估协议——要求错误位置、审查维度和错误类型的精确匹配及文档级覆盖率指标；(4) GB/T-Reviewer多智能体框架——将审查知识转化为专业技能，协调全局检查、定向诊断、规则扫描和结果验证四个环节。
AI.result: 对14个主流LLM的实验揭示了显著的人机差距：最强模型仅达到0.3280 CMCS，而专家达到0.6640。GB/T-Reviewer框架将最佳CMCS提升至0.5094，证明了结构化技能协调对规则密集型文档审查的价值。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为标准化及其他高风险文档领域的可信AI铺平了道路，表明多智能体结构化技能协调能够有效提升LLM在规则密集型文档审查中的表现，但当前模型与人类专家之间仍存在显著差距，需要进一步研究。

title: Kastor: An efficient fine-tuning strategy for generative emulation of PDE simulations
summary: Machine learning offers a promising avenue to accelerate physical simulations by replacing computationally expensive traditional Partial Differential Equation (PDE) solvers with fast, differentiable surrogate models. However, standard auto-regressive ML emulators often suffer from error accumulation over long horizons and struggle to capture the stochasticity of complex physical systems. In this paper, we propose Kastor, a comprehensive methodology to adapt a deterministic physics foundation model into a highly efficient and accurate generative surrogate. First, we introduce a two-stage inference scheme that combines a large-stride causal auto-regressive model with a non-causal temporal super-resolution network, significantly reducing error accumulation while minimizing computational cost. Second, we present Mean prediction regularization (MPR), a novel training objective that constrains the generative model to predict the deterministic distribution mean under null noise conditioning. This regularization dramatically improves the performance and stability of both Functional Generative Networks (FGN) and diffusion-based emulators. Finally, we demonstrate that incorporating spatial gradient matching improves the accuracy and physical fidelity of the simulations as measured by power spectrum density. Extensive evaluations on diverse simulation datasets of the benchmark The Well show that with these components, our model outperforms competing methods in forecasting accuracy, spectral consistency, and computational efficiency. Our model achieves a 42.9% average reduction in forecasting compared to our reference based on the Walrus finetuning methodology, and outperforms Walrus for 8 out of 10 datasets on variance-normalized RMSE (VRMSE).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kastor方法，将确定性物理基础模型转化为高效且准确的生成式替代模型，通过两阶段推理、均值预测正则化（MPR）和空间梯度匹配三大组件，在预报精度、频谱一致性和计算效率上均优于基线方法，相较于Walrus微调方法平均降低42.9%的预测误差。
AI.motivation: 标准自回归机器学习仿真器在长时间预测中容易累积误差，且难以捕捉复杂物理系统的随机性；同时传统PDE求解器计算成本高昂，亟需既能加速计算又能保持物理保真度的替代模型。
AI.method: Kastor包含三大核心组件：(1) 两阶段推理方案：大步长因果自回归模型结合非因果时间超分辨率网络，降低误差累积同时减少计算开销；(2) 均值预测正则化（MPR）：新的训练目标，约束生成模型在空噪声条件下预测确定性分布均值，显著提升FGN和扩散仿真器的性能与稳定性；(3) 空间梯度匹配：提升仿真精度和物理保真度（以功率谱密度衡量）。
AI.result: 在The Well基准的多个仿真数据集上，Kastor在预报精度、频谱一致性和计算效率方面均优于竞争方法。与基于Walrus微调方法的参考模型相比，平均预测误差降低42.9%，并在10个数据集中的8个上超越Walrus（以方差归一化RMSE衡量）。
AI.conclusion: Kastor通过两阶段推理、MPR正则化和梯度匹配三种协同设计，有效解决了生成式物理仿真中的误差累积与随机性建模难题，证明了将确定性物理基础模型改造为生成式替代模型的可行性和优越性。

title: Runtime Observability for Heterogeneous Attention Memory
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures. Code, artifacts, and Lean 4 development: https://github.com/metask-ai/witprobe-attention-memory
summary: Modern models no longer keep a plain KV cache: latent caches, learned sparse selectors and recurrent states each carry the model's memory in a different form, and each fails differently under compression. We give a runtime observability contract that covers all four memory classes with three operators, instantiate it on six model configurations across five architecture families, and compose the per-stage bounds into an executable request-level risk ledger. Contracts carry their error metric as a type -- composition is only defined when metrics match, and this check rejected our own first composed chain; the repaired chain crosses metrics through two proved bridges, and whatever no formal system can certify is measured instead, dropping the composed tier to empirical automatically: every claim is certified, partially certified, or empirical, composition inherits the weakest tier, and the tier is decided by the machine. Replayed over $12.4$M entry reads and run under eight-way concurrency with per-request budgets and fail-closed identity attribution, the ledger quantifies the honest trade-off on today's witness and holds its risk budget with zero violations. A fused always-on probe observes a declared one-layer subset under CUDA graphs inside the serving noise floor. Applied to a served DeepSeek-V4 stack with a packed compressed-KV prototype, the same machinery localizes a silent corruption to a precise structural boundary -- exact in the eviction-free, identity-isolated regime, with every observed failure in an eviction or slot-reuse regime -- through a machine-adjudicated discrimination campaign whose calculus rejected two of our own confounded inferences along the way. All artifacts, guards, and the Lean development are released at https://github.com/metask-ai/witprobe-attention-memory; every number in this paper regenerates from the shipped artifacts by one command.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套面向现代模型多种KV缓存记忆形态（潜在缓存、稀疏选择器、循环状态）的可观测性契约框架，通过三种算子覆盖四类记忆类，并在六个模型配置、五个架构家族上实例化，组合成可执行的请求级风险台账。系统通过带错误度量为类型的契约组合、自动化层级判定（完全认证/部分认证/经验）以及融合探针，在1240万次条目读取和8路并发下实现零违规的风险预算控制，并将某次静默损坏精确归因到结构边界。
AI.motivation: 现代模型的KV缓存已不再是单一形式：潜在缓存、学习式稀疏选择器、循环状态各以不同方式携带模型记忆，且在不同压缩条件下各自以不同方式失效。现有方法缺乏一种统一的、可观测的运行时契约来覆盖这些异构记忆类的行为与失效模式。
AI.method: 1) 设计运行时可观测性契约，用三种算子覆盖四类记忆；2) 在六种模型配置、五个架构家族上实例化契约；3) 将各阶段边界组合为请求级可执行风险台账，错误度量作为契约类型，仅在度量匹配时允许组合；4) 通过两个证明桥接跨度量组合，无法被形式系统证明的内容降级为经验测量，自动判定层级；5) 构建融合常开探针，在CUDA图形下于服务噪声底内监测声明的一层子集；6) 部署在DeepSeek-V4栈上，配合打包压缩KV原型定位静默损坏。
AI.result: 组合检查拒绝了首条自建链（度量不匹配），修复后通过桥接实现跨度量组合；在1240万条目读取和8路并发下，每个请求预算+关闭失败身份归属，达成零违规风险预算；融合探针在噪声底内运行；在DeepSeek-V4上精确定位静默损坏到结构边界，无逐出且身份隔离时精确，所有失败出现在逐出或槽位重用场景；机器裁决的判别行动还拒绝了两条自身有混淆的推断。所有产物和Lean开发均已开源，一项命令可复现全部数字。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了一种"度量即类型、组合即验证、降级即自动"的可观测性范式：形式系统能证明的予以认证，不能证明的自动降级为经验测量，层级由机器决定，从而在异构记忆形态下实现可审计、零违反的风险预算控制与精确的故障归因。

title: KVAE: Family of Tokenizers for Multimodal Generative Models
summary: Latent diffusion modeling (LDM), a prominent paradigm, utilizes tokenizers to map input signal to compressed representation. This dependency positions tokenizer as an integral part of generation process itself, since it affects learning speed, quality of synthesized samples and lay foundation for later applications. This report presents series of KVAE tokenizers for audio, image and video, all designed for subsequent text-conditioned generation: KVAE-Audio, a continuous full-band 48 kHz tokenizer with a 50 Hz latent of 64 channels; KVAE-3D -- two causal video tokenizers for 4x16x16 and 4x8x8 compression; KVAE-2D, an image model, compressing input by factor of 8 with 32 channels. We demonstrate that reconstruction (PSNR, LPIPS, PESQ, etc.) and generation results on objective (Frechet Distance, CLIP score, CLAP score, etc.) and subjective (side-by-side evaluation) metrics matches or surpasses frontier opensource tokenizers, such as VAEs from Wan-2.2, HunyuanVideo-1.5, FLUX.2, MovieGen, StableAudio and MMAudio. Considering difficulty of development, we share with community training details, model selection method and ablation on design choices. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/kandinskylab/kvae and https://github.com/kandinskylab/kvae-audio.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了KVAE系列tokenizer，覆盖音频（48kHz全频带）、视频（4x16x16和4x8x8压缩）和图像（8x压缩），旨在为文本条件生成提供高质量潜空间表示。实验表明KVAE在重构（PSNR、LPIPS、PESQ）和生成（FID、CLIP/CLAP分数、主观对比）等多维指标上达到或超越Wan-2.2、HunyuanVideo-1.5、FLUX.2、MovieGen、StableAudio和MMAudio等前沿开源tokenizer，并开源了代码与训练细节。
AI.motivation: LDM生成质量高度依赖tokenizer的压缩表示能力，但tokenizer本身常被视为辅助模块而缺乏系统化设计。本文旨在通过精心设计的KVAE系列tokenizer，为音频、图像和视频的文本条件生成任务奠定更优的潜空间基础。
AI.method: 提出KVAE系列tokenizer：KVAE-Audio（连续全频带48kHz，50Hz潜空间，64通道）、KVAE-3D（两种因果视频tokenizer，分别支持4x16x16和4x8x8压缩）、KVAE-2D（图像模型，8倍压缩，32通道）。报告涵盖训练细节、模型选择方法和设计消融实验。
AI.result: 在重构质量（PSNR、LPIPS、PESQ）和生成质量（Fréchet距离、CLIP分数、CLAP分数、主观对比评估）上，KVAE系列均达到或超越Wan-2.2、HunyuanVideo-1.5、FLUX.2、MovieGen、StableAudio和MMAudio等前沿开源tokenizer。
AI.conclusion: KVAE系列tokenizer在多种模态上均展现出与或优于前沿开源方案的表现，并公开代码与详细培训经验，为社区在扩散模型tokenizer设计方面提供可复现的参考和基线。

title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Benchmarks for Conversational Agents
summary: Task-oriented conversational agents are evaluated using curated or automatically generated benchmarks, yet benchmark quality is rarely assessed. Poor benchmarks may contain inconsistent tasks, simplistic scenarios, or limited policy coverage, leading to unreliable evaluations. We introduce a reference-free framework that uses LLM judges to assess benchmark consistency, complexity, and policy coverage, while providing actionable diagnostics of weaknesses. We validate the framework by demonstrating agreement with independent human annotations and by evaluating benchmarks generated by LLMs of varying capabilities, as well as benchmarks subjected to controlled quality-degrading perturbations. Across domains and judge models, the proposed metrics consistently distinguish between benchmark quality levels. We further demonstrate the framework's applicability to manually curated benchmarks. Our framework offers a practical approach for evaluating synthetic and manually curated conversational-agent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于LLM评判的无参考框架，用于评估面向任务的对话智能体基准的质量，包括一致性、复杂性和策略覆盖率三个维度，并提供可操作的弱点诊断。
AI.motivation: 任务型对话智能体通常使用精心整理或自动生成的基准进行评测，但基准本身的质量很少被评估。低质量的基准可能包含不一致的任务、过于简化的场景或有限的策略覆盖，导致评测结果不可靠。
AI.method: 提出一个无需参考标注的框架，利用LLM作为评判者来评估基准的一致性、复杂性和策略覆盖率，同时提供可操作的弱点诊断。通过独立人工标注的一致性验证框架，并分别对LLM生成的基准和经过质量退化的基准进行评测。
AI.result: 在多个领域和评判模型上，该框架提出的指标能够一致地区分不同质量的基准。同时，该框架也验证了对人工整理基准的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为评估合成和人工整理的对话智能体基准提供了一种实用方法，有助于提升基准质量和评测可靠性。

title: Is Self-Pretraining really useful to improve diagnosis in medical Time Series?
summary: Inspired by recent evidence that transformer architectures benefit from Self-PreTraining (SPT) on long-context benchmarks, we investigate whether similar gains extend to multimodal, multivariate, and even simple univariate medical time series. Our objective is to assess the impact of SPT on the performance and scalability of transformer-based models across diverse medical applications, particularly under limited data conditions. We evaluate transformer architectures on three representative medical time-series tasks: rehabilitation robotics (Camargo dataset), stress detection (Non-EEG Stress), and Parkinson's disease detection (Gait Parkinson's Disease). Models are trained either from scratch or through SPT using four masking-based objectives designed to promote temporal and cross-modal representation learning, and we systematically vary model depth to examine how capacity interacts with pre-training benefits. Across datasets and configurations, SPT consistently improves classification accuracy by 0-6 percentage points depending on masking strategy, dataset and architecture, with gains observed not only in multivariate settings but also when models are restricted to simple univariate inputs. The improvements increase for deeper models that can better exploit the enriched temporal representations learned during pre-training. These findings indicate that SPT is a simple and general strategy that enhances transformer performance on medical time-series tasks without requiring task-specific architectural changes, supporting its potential to improve robustness and accuracy in data-limited clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自预训练（SPT）对医学时间序列分类任务中Transformer模型性能的影响，在三个代表性医学数据集（康复机器人、压力检测、帕金森病检测）上系统评估了不同掩码目标和模型深度下的效果，发现SPT能持续提升分类准确率0-6个百分点，且对更深的模型收益更大。
AI.motivation: 近期证据表明Transformer架构在长上下文基准上受益于自预训练（SPT），但这一收益是否延伸到医学时间序列这一领域尚未明确。作者希望评估SPT对多模态、多变量甚至简单单变量医学时间序列的Transformer性能与可扩展性的影响，特别是在数据有限的临床条件下。
AI.method: 在三个医学时间序列任务（Camargo康复机器人数据集、Non-EEG Stress压力检测、Gait Parkinson's Disease帕金森病检测）上，训练Transformer模型。模型要么从头训练，要么通过SPT预训练，使用四种基于掩码的自监督目标以促进时序和跨模态表征学习。系统性地改变模型深度以考察模型容量与预训练收益之间的交互关系。
AI.result: 在所有数据集和配置下，SPT一致地提升了分类准确率0-6个百分点（取决于掩码策略、数据集和架构）。收益不仅在多变量设置中观察到，在仅使用简单单变量输入时也同样存在。对于更深的模型，性能提升更大，因为更深的模型能更好地利用预训练期间学习到的丰富时序表征。
AI.conclusion: SPT是一种简单且通用的策略，无需任务特定的架构修改即可提升医学时间序列任务中Transformer的性能，展示了其在数据有限的临床环境中提高模型鲁棒性和准确性的潜力。

title: Seeing Is Not Deciding: Can Multimodal LLMs Act as Effective CEOs?
summary: Large language models are increasingly applied as autonomous decision-making agents. However, in executive business decisions, existing benchmarks are limited to textonly settings. This makes it unclear whether models can perceive visual business evidence and effectively integrate it to improve decision quality. We introduce C-SUITEBENCH, a controlled multimodal benchmark that includes five decision tasks under paired text-only and multimodal conditions across 50 scenarios. We place nine frontier models in the role of a chief executive officer and evaluate their decision-making ability. Multimodal inputs consistently improve evidence-centric reasoning, with the largest and most reliable gains appearing in risk forecasting and board-facing justification. However, we uncover a multimodal integration paradox: adding visual business information degrades constrained resource allocation for all nine models, even as visual grounding itself improves. Ablation experiments reveal that this failure emerges from signal crowding, although each visual channel helps individually, their combination disrupts constraint satisfaction during decoding. These findings demonstrate that visual perception and constrained action are separable bottlenecks in multimodal agents, and that indiscriminate visual augmentation can harm high-stakes decision making, motivating selective grounding strategies for future executive AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C-SUITE-BENCH，一个包含5种决策任务、50个场景的受控多模态基准，用于评估LLM作为CEO在多模态（文本+视觉）条件下的决策能力。研究发现多模态输入总体上改善基于证据的推理（尤其在风险评估和董事会汇报中），但存在"多模态整合悖论"：视觉信息在所有9个模型中反而降低了约束资源分配的绩效，原因是信号拥挤（signal crowding）——各视觉通道单独有效，但其组合干扰了解码阶段的约束满足。
AI.motivation: 现有高层商业决策基准仅限纯文本设置，无法评估模型能否感知视觉商业证据并将其有效整合以提升决策质量。作者旨在填补这一空白，探究多模态信息在高管决策场景中的实际价值与潜在风险。
AI.method: 构建C-SUITE-BENCH受控多模态基准，包含5种决策任务，在50个场景下设置成对纯文本与多模态条件。将9个前沿模型置于CEO角色中评估决策能力，并通过消融实验分析各视觉通道的单独与组合效应。
AI.result: 多模态输入一致改善基于证据的推理，其中风险评估和董事会汇报提升最大且最稳定；但引入视觉商业信息使全部9个模型的约束资源分配绩效下降。消融实验表明该失败源于信号拥挤：每个视觉通道单独有效，但组合后干扰解码阶段的约束满足。
AI.conclusion: 视觉感知与约束行动是多模态代理中可分离的瓶颈；不加区分地增强视觉信息可能损害高风险的决策任务，应推动面向未来高管AI系统的选择性视觉接地（selective grounding）策略。

title: Vorch-Omni: Multi-Task Orchestration of Sight and Sound
summary: Recent advances in generative video modeling have enabled diverse generation, reference-based synthesis, extension, and editing, but existing approaches often rely on fragmented task-specific models. A general model must distinguish heterogeneous target, source, and reference signals to determine what to generate, preserve, or use as guidance, while reducing interference among tasks. Joint audio-visual generation further increases this challenge by introducing diverse conditioning and output configurations across modalities. We present Vorch-Omni, a unified multi-task framework for audio-visual synthesis based on an arbitrary-condition-to-arbitrary-output formulation. It flexibly treats video and audio signals as either conditioning inputs or generation targets. Token-level conditioning masks and task identifiers distinguish targets, source content, and references, while position types separate temporal context from independent conditions. To capture semantic and structural information, Vorch-Omni employs complementary visual conditioning pathways: a vision-language model interprets sampled frames with text instructions, and a video VAE encodes conditions into latent tokens for direct guidance. We further build a distributed data pipeline to curate diverse temporally aligned audio-visual clips, generate structured captions and metadata, and balance heterogeneous task distributions. Built on a single flow-matching diffusion transformer without task-specific architectural changes, Vorch-Omni supports over 10 tasks, including text-to-video, text-to-audio-video, image- and reference-conditioned generation, temporal extension, audio-driven generation, video transformation, and audio-visual editing. This unified framework provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose audio-visual generation and manipulation.

AI.tldr: Vorch-Omni是一个统一的音视频多任务合成框架，基于任意条件到任意输出的公式化设计，支持超过10种任务（如文生视频、图文生视频、参考条件生成、时间扩展、音频驱动生成等），无需任务特定架构即可在同一流匹配扩散Transformer上完成。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频建模方法通常依赖碎片化的任务特定模型，无法统一处理生成、参考合成、扩展和编辑等不同任务。同时，异构的目标、源和参考信号之间的区分以及任务间干扰问题未得到很好解决，而联合音视频生成进一步增加了多样条件与输出配置的复杂性。需要一个统一的多任务框架来提供可扩展的基础。
AI.method: Vorch-Omni基于"任意条件到任意输出"公式，将视频和音频信号灵活视为条件输入或生成目标。核心方法包括：(1) 令牌级条件掩码和任务标识符区分目标、源内容和参考信号；(2) 位置类型区分时间上下文与独立条件；(3) 互补的双视觉条件通路——视觉语言模型结合文本指令解释采样帧，视频VAE将条件编码为潜在令牌提供直接指导；(4) 分布式数据管线收集时序对齐的音视频片段并生成结构化描述和元数据，平衡异质任务分布。模型基于单一流匹配扩散Transformer，无需任务特定架构改动。
AI.result: Vorch-Omni在单一框架内支持超过10种任务，包括文本到视频、文本到音视频、图像和参考条件生成、时间扩展、音频驱动生成、视频转换以及音视频编辑，在统一架构下实现了多任务音视频合成能力。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架为通用音视频生成和操控提供了可扩展的基础，验证了通过统一条件-输出公式化设计和互补条件路径，可以在无需任务特定架构的前提下实现跨任务的音视频合成。

title: RP-OPSD: Reasoning-Pivot-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer
summary: Multilingual reasoning transfer is crucial for extending reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) beyond high-resource languages. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) and its variants have emerged as a promising paradigm, providing dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts, yet their objectives do not explicitly prioritize reasoning signals most critical to cross-lingual transfer. We characterize that target-language reasoning comprises the generation of both surface text and reasoning pivots, which are decisions that advance or redirect the reasoning process and shape subsequent inference. This motivates concentrating privileged distillation around such pivots. We therefore propose RP-OPSD, Reasoning-Pivot-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation, using the distributional shift between matched teacher views with and without an English reference solution as an operational proxy to guide privileged distillation and reference anchoring. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks covering 17 languages and multiple difficulty levels show that our method outperforms strong multilingual reasoning baselines and OPSD variants. Further analysis reveals that RP-OPSD concentrates privileged distillation on reasoning-control and problem-condistioned state-update tokens, while downweighting it for tokens that mainly support surface realization. Our code is available at https://github.com/NJUNLP/RP-OPSD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RP-OPSD（推理枢纽引导的在线策略自蒸馏）方法，通过识别目标语言推理中的"推理枢纽"（reasoning pivots）令牌，利用有无英文参考解的两个教师视图之间的分布偏移作为代理，引导特权蒸馏集中于这些关键令牌，从而提升LLM的低资源语言数学推理迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 多语言推理迁移对扩展LLM推理能力至低资源语言至关重要。虽然OPSD及其变体在自蒸馏中提供了密集的令牌级监督，但其目标函数并未显式优先处理对跨语言迁移最关键的推理信号。作者将目标语言推理分解为表层文本生成和推理枢纽生成，而推理枢纽是推进或改变推理过程、塑造后续推断的关键决策，因此有必要将特权蒸馏聚焦于此类关键令牌。
AI.method: 提出RP-OPSD方法，核心思想是将"有英文参考解"与"无英文参考解"的匹配教师视图之间的分布偏移作为操作性代理，用于引导特权蒸馏和参考锚定（reference anchoring）。该方法在推理枢纽处集中特权蒸馏信号，加权推理控制和问题条件化的状态更新令牌，同时降低对主要支撑表层实现的令牌的权重。
AI.result: 在覆盖17种语言、多个难度级别的数学推理基准上，RP-OPSD优于强多语言推理基线和OPSD变体。进一步分析表明，RP-OPSD确实将特权蒸馏集中在推理控制和问题条件化的状态更新令牌上，同时降低表层实现令牌的蒸馏权重。
AI.conclusion: RP-OPSD通过推理枢纽引导的特权蒸馏，有效提升了多语言数学推理的迁移效果，验证了将蒸馏信号聚焦于推理关键令牌而非均匀分布的优越性，代码已开源。

title: LLM Inference Under Bursty Workload Distribution: Modifying the WAIT Algorithm
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT and Claude are widely used for information retrieval and problem-solving. Recent work has focused on improving scheduling algorithms to boost throughput while maintaining low latency. However, these approaches often assume Poisson request arrivals with constant rates - an assumption that fails to reflect the inherently bursty and dynamic nature of real-world traffic. We propose a lightweight extension to the state-of-the-art WAIT algorithm [1], which adapts to time-varying arrival rates without prior traffic knowledge. The proposed algorithm performs online estimation of request intensity based on observed interarrival times. Using Markov Modulated Poisson Process (MMPP)-based synthetic workloads with diverse request types, we conduct a simulation-based evaluation demonstrating that the proposed method achieves higher throughput than Sarathi-Serve [2], ORCA [3], and vLLM [4] in the evaluated low arrival-rate shift scenarios while maintaining comparable latency.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM推理调度中现有算法假设泊松到达率恒定的局限，提出了一种对WAIT算法的轻量级扩展，通过在线估计请求强度以自适应时变的到达率，并在MMPP合成工作负载下验证了该方法在低到达率漂移场景中优于Sarathi-Serve、ORCA和vLLM，吞吐更高且延迟相当。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理调度算法多假设请求到达服从恒定速率的泊松过程，但真实流量具有突发性和动态变化特征，这一假设不成立，导致调度算法在真实场景下性能欠佳。
AI.method: 提出一种对WAIT算法的轻量级扩展，该方法无需先验流量知识，通过观测请求到达间隔时间在线估计请求强度，从而自适应时变的到达率；使用基于Markov Modulated Poisson Process（MMPP）的合成工作负载（包含多种请求类型）进行仿真评估。
AI.result: 在评估的低到达率漂移场景中，所提方法相比Sarathi-Serve、ORCA和vLLM实现了更高的吞吐量，同时保持了可比的延迟水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过在线估计请求强度并自适应调整调度策略，可以在无先验流量知识的情况下更好地应对真实世界中时变的突发请求流量，在提高吞吐的同时维持延迟性能。

title: Improving Interoperability among Defence and National Security Ontologies: Analysis and Evaluation Tasks
comment: Paper accepted at the Resource Track, the 25th International Semantic Web Conference (ISWC 2026), 25 - 29 October 2026, Bari, Italy
summary: The use of ontologies and knowledge graphs is becoming increasingly widespread in the defence and national security domain. Numerous ontologies have been developed through initiatives led by academia, industry, and government. Achieving interoperability across diverse defence and national security ontologies remains a major challenge due to the domain's breadth and specialisation. In this work, we analyse and document over 60 publicly available ontologies and introduce a new track for the Ontology Alignment Evaluation Initiative (OAEI). This track comprises eight matching tasks, consensus alignments and manually-curated (silver-standard) mappings. The consensus alignments are derived by aggregating the outputs of several state-of-the-art ontology alignment systems. The silver-standard is obtained from the manual validation of the consensus alignment together with a subset of the unique mappings (i.e., mappings suggested by only one system).

AI.tldr: 本文分析了60多个公开可用的国防与国家安全领域本体，并为此领域引入了OAEI（本体对齐评估倡议）的新赛道，包含八个匹配任务、共识对齐结果和人工标注的标准映射。
AI.motivation: 国防与国家安全领域的本体和知识图谱使用日益广泛，但该领域范围广且高度专业化，多个本体之间的互操作性仍是重大挑战。目前缺乏针对该领域的系统性本体对齐评估基准。
AI.method: 系统性分析和记录了60多个公开可用的本体；引入OAEI新赛道，包含八个匹配任务；通过聚合多个最先进的本体对齐系统的输出来构建共识对齐结果；对共识对齐及其唯一映射子集进行人工验证，形成金标准映射。
AI.result: 成功构建了国防与国家安全领域的本体对齐评估赛道，包括八项匹配任务、基于多系统聚合的共识对齐，以及经人工验证的金标准映射数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了国防与国家安全领域缺乏本体对齐综合评估基准的空白，为后续研究和系统评估提供了高质量的资源。

title: Ordered Diffusion for 3D Human Registration
summary: 3D human registration has historically been treated as a regression task, assuming a unique ground-truth alignment exists between the template and an input point cloud. In reality, acquisition noise, occlusions, and unknown soft tissue dynamics introduce inherent ambiguity into human scans. Regression-based methods consequently converge to an average prediction, often failing to represent a plausible geometry. In our work, we embrace such uncertainty by modeling the registration as a distribution of alignments. We propose ODin, which formulates registration as a 3D diffusion process that generates a point cloud aligned with the target geometry while preserving template semantics through consistent point ordering. To achieve this, ODin relies on global, local, and positional conditioning, guiding each point to its correct location. Our experiments demonstrate that such a generative formulation not only outperforms its regression-based baseline, but also establishes a new state of the art, surpassing highly engineered methods while reducing the registration time by two-thirds. Pre-trained models and code are available at https://riccardomarin.github.io/odin/.

AI.tldr: ODin 提出将3D人体配准建模为生成式扩散过程，而非传统回归任务，通过全局、局部和位置条件引导每个点到达正确位置，生成保持模板语义且与目标几何对齐的点云。实验表明该方法超越回归基线及高度工程化的方法，并将配准时间减少三分之二。
AI.motivation: 传统3D人体配准被当作回归任务，假设输入点云与模板之间存在唯一的真实对齐。然而采集噪声、遮挡和软组织动态变化使人体扫描存在固有歧义，回归方法只能收敛到平均预测，无法代表合理的几何形状。
AI.method: ODin将配准公式化为3D扩散过程，生成与目标几何对齐的点云，同时通过一致的点的顺序保持模板语义。模型依赖全局、局部和位置三种条件引导每个点到达正确位置。
AI.result: 实验表明生成式配准公式不仅优于其回归基线，还超越了高度工程化的方法，建立了新的最先进水平，并将配准时间减少了三分之二。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成式建模拥抱配准中的不确定性是更有效的方法，既能产生更合理的几何形状，又能显著提升计算效率。

title: The Bitter Lesson of Tool Calling
summary: Tool use transforms LLMs into agents that act beyond their training data, and for code-capable models, programmatic tool calling extends this further by replacing rigid JSON calls with scripts that chain and parallelize naturally. However, a systematic evaluation of tools as code on an established benchmark across current and prior model generations under real-world task conditions has not been conducted. In this work, we empirically compare programmatic tool calling (PTC) to native JSON tool calling across 14 language models on BFCL v4. In the programmatic tool calling paradigm, tools are exposed as typed Python stubs that the model invokes through code, with execution and results handled in a single agent turn. Programmatic tool calling matches or exceeds native JSON tool calling in 11 of 14 models on BFCL v4, with the GPT-5.6 family achieving a 10.6% improvement over the JSON tool calling baseline. Further, it matches or outperforms baseline in 13 of 14 models under parallel fan-out, and holds stable under context rot conditions where baseline degrades 2.3% on average. Our results demonstrate that programmatic tool calling is a viable and robust alternative to JSON tool calling, with performance tracking model capability across release generations.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了程序化工具调用（PTC）与原生JSON工具调用在14个语言模型上的性能表现，基于BFCL v4基准测试。结果显示PTC在11/14个模型上匹配或超越JSON工具调用，GPT-5.6系列提升10.6%，在并行扇出条件下13/14模型表现更好，且对上下文退化具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 已有工作尚未在既有基准上对多代模型在真实任务条件下系统地评估"工具即代码"（programmatic tool calling）范式，缺乏对PTC与JSON工具调用的全面实证对比。
AI.method: 在BFCL v4基准上，对14个语言模型进行程序化工具调用与原生JSON工具调用的对比实验。PTC将工具暴露为类型化Python桩（stub），模型通过代码调用，在单代理轮次内完成执行与结果处理。评估了整体性能、并行扇出（parallel fan-out）场景以及上下文退化（context rot）条件。
AI.result: PTC在14个模型中于11个上匹配或超越JSON工具调用；GPT-5.6系列较JSON基线提升10.6%；并行扇出条件下13/14模型表现匹配或更优；在上下文退化条件下保持稳定，而基线平均退化2.3%。
AI.conclusion: 程序化工具调用是JSON工具调用的可行且稳健的替代方案，其性能随模型发布世代变化而可靠追踪模型能力。

title: SkillTFM: Gated Skill Evolution for Training-Free Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models
summary:
Tabular data are ubiquitous in real-world applications and are crucial for data-driven prediction and decision-making across science, industry, finance, healthcare, and public services. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose tabular learning, offering reusable predictors across diverse datasets and substantially reducing the need for task-specific training, tuning, and model development. However, their practical deployment remains constrained by distribution shifts, heterogeneous feature semantics, and task-specific patterns that are difficult to capture without costly fine-tuning or additional labeled data.
  To this end, we propose SkillTFM, a training-free system that shifts TFM adaptation from parameter updates to the gated evolution of agentic skills. The core of SkillTFM is a verifiable and extensible skill bank that couples boundary evidence identification with gated skill evolution: the former characterizes task structure and base-model failure patterns, whereas the latter retrieves and extends reusable skills subject to explicit validation. Across simulated boundary settings and real-world electricity-price forecasting, SkillTFM improves AUC by 0.128--0.142, raises nonlinear-boundary AUC from 0.699 to 0.898. Furthermore, experiments across TFM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of SkillTFM.

AI.tldr: SkillTFM是一种免训练的表格基础模型（TFM）适配系统，通过将模型适配从参数更新转变为智能体技能的门控演化，在不进行微调或依赖额外标注数据的情况下，改善表格基础模型在面对分布偏移和异质特征语义时的实际部署性能。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）在实际部署中面临分布偏移、异质特征语义和任务特定模式等挑战，传统解决方案依赖昂贵的微调或额外的标注数据，成本高且难以广泛推广。作者旨在提出一种无需参数更新和额外标注的适配方案，使TFM在边界设置和真实场景下保持鲁棒性能。
AI.method: SkillTFM的核心是一个可验证且可扩展的技能库（skill bank），它由两个关键机制组成：（1）边界证据识别（boundary evidence identification）——刻画任务结构和基础模型失效模式；（2）门控技能演化（gated skill evolution）——在显式验证约束下检索和扩展可复用技能，从而实现从参数更新到智能体技能门控演化的范式转换。
AI.result: 在模拟边界设置和真实电力价格预测场景中，SkillTFM将AUC提升了0.128-0.142，并将非线性边界的AUC从0.699提升至0.898。此外，跨多个TFM主干网络的实验验证了SkillTFM的有效性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: SkillTFM证明了免训练、基于技能演化的方法可以作为TFM微调的有效替代方案，在提升边界性能的同时保持跨骨干网络的泛化能力，为表格基础模型的实际部署提供了新范式。

title: Personalized Deep Research Query Refinement with Graph-Scaffolded Evidence Grounding
summary: User requests serve as research specifications for deep research agents, shaping what evidence to seek and how to synthesize it. In personalized deep research, these specifications must additionally reflect user goals, constraints, preferences, and evaluation criteria. User context can be incorporated either within the deep research pipeline or into the research specification provided as its input. We focus on the latter, refining the user request into a personalized research specification before passing it to an unchanged deep research agent. This requires resolving three coupled decisions: which framing factors are relevant, whether the available user context sufficiently supports them, and whether to retrieve user memory, ask the user, or stop and refine the query. For training, G-STEER organizes framing factors as elicitation targets in an Intent Elicitation Graph that captures their dependencies. It learns a clarification policy from graph-scaffolded trajectories spanning diverse factor dependencies and evidence conditions. The policy produces a refined query while balancing target coverage against the costs of evidence acquisition. Experiments show that G-STEER achieves the strongest overall weighted target coverage and the highest downstream report personalization across both evaluated DRAs, while asking roughly one third as many user questions as a strong clarification baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G-STEER框架，在深度研究（Deep Research）流程之前，将用户请求细化为个性化研究规范。通过意图引导图（Intent Elicitation Graph）组织框架因素并学习澄清策略，在覆盖目标与获取证据成本之间取得平衡，实验表明其在目标覆盖率和报告个性化程度上均优于基线，且提问量仅约为强基线基线的三分之一。
AI.motivation: 在个性化深度研究中，用户请求需反映目标、约束、偏好和评估标准，但现有方法要么在管线内融合用户上下文，要么忽略个性化。作者聚焦于后者——在将研究规范输入不变的深度研究代理之前对其进行个性化细化，因此需要解决三个耦合决策：哪些框架因素相关、现有用户上下文是否充分支撑、以及是检索记忆、询问用户还是停止并改进查询。
AI.method: G-STEER将框架因素组织为意图引导图中的引导目标，以捕捉因素间的依赖关系。它从覆盖多种因素依赖与证据条件的图脚手架轨迹中学习一个澄清策略。该策略在生成精细化查询时，在目标覆盖率与证据获取成本之间进行权衡。
AI.result: 在两个评估的深度研究代理（DRA）上，G-STEER取得了最强的总体加权目标覆盖率（weighted target coverage）和最高的下游报告个性化程度，同时提问数量仅为强澄清基线的约三分之一。
AI.conclusion: G-STEER证明了在深度研究流程之前进行个性化研究规范细化是可行的，能够在显著减少用户交互负担的同时提升下游报告的个性化质量，为核心认知需求（如澄清策略学习与图结构引导）提供了一种可扩展的训练范式。

title: STAIL: Semantic Text-Anchored Incremental Learning for Medical Imaging via Large Language Models
summary: Deep learning models applied to medical image analysis suffer from severe catastrophic forgetting when continually adapting to new clinical tasks in dynamic environments. Mainstream incremental learning methods typically mitigate this by rehearsing raw historical images. However, this pixel-level rehearsal incurs significant storage overhead, raises privacy concerns, and fails to adequately capture the true data distribution with sparse exemplars. Inspired by human cognitive mechanisms, we propose a novel framework termed Semantic Text-Anchored Incremental Learning (STAIL) for sequential clinical tasks. To overcome the rehearsal bottleneck, STAIL introduces an asymmetric semantic consolidation buffer (SCB). By incorporating a minimal set of image anchors and extensive textual descriptions, the SCB enables dense semantic reconstruction of old tasks at a minimal storage cost. Furthermore, we design an LLM-derived Semantic Anchoring Mechanism (LSAM) that leverages the stable semantic space of frozen large language models as developmental priors. This mechanism explicitly anchors evolving visual features to textual representations, guiding and constraining plasticity and stability at both macroscopic and microscopic levels. Extensive experiments across three heterogeneous medical datasets, covering fundus, ultrasound, and X-ray imaging, demonstrate that STAIL acts as a highly effective plug-and-play module. It comprehensively enhances the performance of various existing baselines, achieving average gains of 2.24\% in AAA-AUC for sustained performance and 3.55\% in BWT-AUC for reduced forgetting. Code is available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAIL框架，利用语义文本锚定机制解决医学影像增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。通过构建非对称语义巩固缓冲区（SCB），以极小存储代价实现旧任务密集语义重建，并借助冻结大语言模型的稳定语义空间作为发展先验，显式锚定视觉特征到文本表示，在三个异质医学数据集上显著提升现有基线性能。
AI.motivation: 医学影像深度学习模型在动态环境中持续适应新临床任务时面临严重的灾难性遗忘问题。主流增量学习方法依赖回放原始历史图像，但像素级回放带来显著的存储开销、隐私风险，且稀疏样本难以真实刻画数据分布。
AI.method: STAIL包含两个核心组件：(1) 非对称语义巩固缓冲区（SCB），仅存储少量图像锚点和大量文本描述，以最小存储代价实现旧任务的密集语义重建；(2) LLM衍生语义锚定机制（LSAM），利用冻结大语言模型的稳定语义空间作为发展先验，在宏观和微观层面显式地将演化中的视觉特征锚定到文本表示，引导和约束可塑性与稳定性之间的平衡。
AI.result: 在涵盖眼底、超声和X-ray三类异质医学数据集上的大量实验表明，STAIL作为即插即用模块，全面提升了现有基线的性能，平均在AAA-AUC（持续性能）上提升2.24%，在BWT-AUC（遗忘降低）上提升3.55%。
AI.conclusion: STAIL通过语义文本锚定策略有效解决了基于像素级回放的增量学习方法在存储、隐私和分布表征方面的瓶颈，验证了利用大语言模型语义先验引导医学影像连续学习的可行性，为临床动态环境下的医学AI持续适应提供了新的范式。

title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
comment: Project Page at https://worldbench.github.io/scope GitHub Repo at https://github.com/worldbench/SCOPE HF Dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/worldbench/MIST-Bench
summary: Language models increasingly condition their answers on external signals, and a single misleading one can turn a correct answer wrong. The obvious remedy, training models to resist such signals, hides a failure mode: a model that ignores all context looks robust yet is useless when the context is worth trusting. We recast the problem as selective trust and introduce MIST, a human-annotated benchmark that renders each reasoning item under four matched conditions (clean, misleading, correct-context, and irrelevant-context), together with SC2W, a paired metric counting how often a misleading signal flips a clean-correct answer to wrong. Across a comprehensive benchmark study, we observe that such a susceptibility is universal. We then propose SCOPE, which mines clean-correct/misleading-wrong failures and optimizes a standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) objective over matched preference pairs balanced equally across all four conditions, rather than over misleading items alone. Our approach substantially reduces SC2W on popular open-sourced models while preserving accuracy when the added context is clean, correct, or irrelevant. With this work, we argue that models should be judged on selective trust, not on resistance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了语言模型对上下文信号的信任问题为"选择性信任"。作者提出了MIST基准（包含四种匹配条件的推理数据）和SC2W配对指标（衡量误导信号翻转正确回答的频率），并提出了SCOPE方法——通过从干净正确/误导错误样本中挖掘失败案例，对四种条件均等的配对偏好对进行标准DPO优化，从而在保持对有效上下文信任能力的同时显著降低模型对误导信号的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地依赖外部信号进行条件回答，但一个误导性信号就足以把正确回答变成错误的。显而易见的解决方案——训练模型抵抗这类信号——存在一个致命缺陷：忽略所有上下文的模型看起来"稳健"，却在应该信任何时有用的上下文时毫无用处。因此，问题不应仅仅是"抵抗误导"，而是"选择性信任"——既要避免被误导，又要保留对可信上下文的利用能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出MIST：人工标注基准，将每个推理条目渲染为四种匹配条件（干净、误导、正确上下文、无关上下文）。2) 提出SC2W：配对指标，计算误导信号将干净正确的回答翻转为错误回答的频率。3) 提出SCOPE：挖掘干净正确/误导错误的失败案例，并对四种条件均等平衡的匹配偏好对执行标准DPO目标优化（而非仅对误导样本优化），以提升选择性信任能力。
AI.result: 在全面的基准研究中，发现模型对误导信号的脆弱性具有普遍性。SCOPE方法在流行的开源模型上显著降低了SC2W指标，同时保持了在上下文干净、正确或无关情况下的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 模型的评估标准应为选择性信任（selective trust）而非单纯抵抗能力（resistance）。真正健壮的模型应当在面对误导信号时保持正确判断，同时在上下文确实可信时继续利用它。

title: Threshold-Based Early Stopping of Accumulations in Neural Networks with Binary Activation
summary: Binary neural networks are very attractive for constrained deployment, enabling small footprint and low-power inference. For binary activations, the dot products become sign-controlled additions or subtractions, but the number of operations is unchanged. Indeed, every neuron or output channel still accumulates all of its input, even though only the sign will be retained, which is often wasteful. As the accumulation progresses, the running partial sum frequently drifts so far from zero that its final sign becomes highly predictable long before the last term is reached; every contribution evaluated after that point changes the value of the sum but not the final output activation. This paper turns this observation into a post-training early-stopping mechanism. We characterize the behavior of the running accumulations on the training dataset and use this information to predict the final sign as soon as possible. No model parameter is retrained. We count the number of operations under an idealized ordering of weights. On VGG11 applied to the CIFAR-10 dataset, the method removes $86.6\%$ of the accumulation terms of the deepest convolution for a $0.37$-point accuracy drop, and $25\%$ of the full-network arithmetic when used on the three deepest convolutions simultaneously, for a $1.36$-point drop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向二值神经网络的训练后早期停止机制：在累加过程中，若当前部分和的符号已可高置信度预测最终输出的符号，则提前终止计算。该方法不重新训练任何模型参数，在VGG11/CIFAR-10上最深层卷积可减少86.6%的累加项，代价仅为0.37个百分点的精度下降。
AI.motivation: 二值神经网络虽将点积转化为符号控制的加减运算，但操作数量并未减少——每个神经元仍需累加全部输入，尽管最终只保留符号。观察到累加过程中部分和常偏离零点很远，最终符号在很早阶段就可预测，后续贡献仅改变数值而不改变输出激活，这造成了大量计算浪费。
AI.method: 本文提出一种训练后早期停止机制：在训练数据集上刻画运行累加值的行为特征，利用该信息尽早预测最终符号，从而跳过剩余累加项。在理想化权重排序假设下统计操作数量。无需对任何模型参数进行重新训练。
AI.result: 在VGG11/CIFAR-10上，最深层卷积可移除86.6%的累加项，精度下降仅0.37个百分点；同时对三个最深层卷积使用时，可减少全网络25%的算术运算，精度下降1.36个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 二值神经网络中的部分和存在高度可预测性，通过训练后早期停止可以有效跳过大量冗余累加操作，在很小的精度损失下显著降低计算开销，且无需重新训练模型。

title: AppDeltaWorld: Transition-Grounded Delta Code World Model for Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Mobile GUI agents can operate apps through pixel perception and touch actions, making them a promising interface for collecting and improving long-horizon mobile interaction policies. However, real trajectories are difficult to obtain for sensitive apps and privacy-critical operations. At the same time, existing simulated environments are costly to scale up, and GUI world models still suffer from unstable generation, limited modality coverage, and inconsistent action-transition logic. To address these limitations, we propose AppDeltaWorld, a transition-grounded delta code world model that predicts the next GUI as a reachable code update rather than as an unconstrained image or text description. AppDeltaWorld retrieves app-specific Level-1 HTML references under an action-transition constraint, generates Level-2 executable HTML conditioned on the current screen, action, predicted next-screen text, and retrieved structure, and inserts generated visual assets into image slots before browser rendering. As a world model, AppDeltaWorld achieves the highest fidelity on CMGUIBench-500 under Code2World evaluation, with clear gains in structural layout and UI element reconstruction over image-only and code-only baselines. As a training environment, AppDeltaWorld supports filtered closed-loop SFT data construction that, when combined with public supervision, enables AppDeltaAgent to achieve state-of-the-art performance on AndroidLens and consistent gains on MobileGym and MobileWorld. Moreover, world-model-based test-time reinforcement learning enables policy adaptation and shows further improvements without additional interaction with real apps.

AI.tldr: 提出了AppDeltaWorld，一个基于转换落地的delta代码世界模型，通过将下一个GUI预测为可达的代码更新（而非无约束的图像或文本描述），实现了高保真的GUI世界建模，并作为训练环境支持SFT数据构建和测试时强化学习，在多个基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 真实移动交互轨迹难以获取（敏感应用和隐私关键操作），现有模拟环境扩展成本高，GUI世界模型存在生成不稳定、模态覆盖有限、动作转换逻辑不一致等问题。
AI.method: AppDeltaWorld通过动作转换约束检索应用特定的Level-1 HTML参考，基于当前屏幕、动作、预测的下一屏幕文本和检索结构生成Level-2可执行HTML，并将生成的视觉资产插入图像槽后再进行浏览器渲染。同时支持过滤式闭环SFT数据构建和世界模型驱动的测试时强化学习。
AI.result: 在CMGUIBench-500的Code2World评估中达到最高保真度，在结构布局和UI元素重建上优于仅图像和仅代码基线；结合公共监督训练的AppDeltaAgent在AndroidLens达到SOTA，在MobileGym和MobileWorld上持续提升；测试时强化学习实现策略适应并进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于代码转换的世界模型方法能有效解决GUI世界建模中的稳定性和动作一致性难题，并可作为高效训练环境支持策略学习与自适应，无需与真实应用额外交互。

title: Energy-Guided Flow Matching
summary: Pixel-space generative models bypass lossy latent compression, yet necessitate joint learning of global structure and fine-grained details in a high-dimensional space. Standard flow matching interpolates noise toward a fixed clean-image endpoint, leaving the spectral evolution to be learned implicitly. In this paper, we introduce Energy-Guided Flow Matching(EG-FM) that explicitly models a coarse-to-fine generative trajectory by moving endpoint. Specifically, EG-FM replaces the fixed endpoint with a heat-kernel-filtered endpoint that evolves smoothly from low-frequency image to clean image.The fraction of high-frequency signal in moving endpoint is released by an image-specific energy-guided scheduling, leading to the re-targeting of velocity in flow matching.Our framework requires no adaptation of the backbone and training data, bringing negligible cost on the training and inference stages. In our experiment, EG-FM consistently achieves lower FID on the ImageNet class-conditional image generation task at $256 \times 256$ with fewer epochs, reaching an FID of 1.55 at 200 epochs and 1.45 at 600 epochs. We continue training the generation task on the setting of $512 \times 512$ resolution, yielding a FID of 1.58 after only 40 high-resolution adaptation epochs.Furthermore, we transfer EG-FM on text-to-image generation and achieve 0.85 on GenEval score and 83.9 on DPG-Bench. Code is available at https://github.com/ysng123/EG-FM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出能量引导流匹配（EG-FM），将固定端点的标准流匹配替换为热核滤波的移动端点，通过图像特定的能量引导调度逐步释放高频信号，显式建模从粗到细的生成轨迹，在图像生成任务中以极小额外开销取得更优FID。
AI.motivation: 像素空间生成模型需在高维空间中联合学习全局结构与细粒度细节。标准流匹配在固定干净图像端点间插值噪声，频谱演化只能隐式学习，导致粗到细的生成过程缺乏显式控制。
AI.method: EG-FM将流匹配的固定端点替换为热核滤波（heat-kernel-filtered）端点，该端点从低频图像平滑演化到干净图像；通过图像特定的能量引导调度（energy-guided scheduling）释放移动端点中的高频信号比例，从而重新定向流匹配中的速度场。该方法无需修改骨干网络和训练数据，训练与推理开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在ImageNet类条件图像生成任务256×256下，以更少epoch达到更低的FID：200 epoch时为1.55，600 epoch时为1.45；512×512分辨率下仅40个高分辨率适配epoch即达到FID 1.58。迁移到文生图任务，GenEval得分0.85，DPG-Bench得分83.9。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模粗到细的生成轨迹并移动端点而非固定端点，EG-FM在几乎零额外成本下显著提升了流匹配生成模型的性能与训练效率，验证了能量引导调度在频谱演化控制中的有效性。

title: SAGA: Score-Weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment for Low-Resource Nordic Language Models
summary: Preference optimisation has proven effective for improving large language models but typically relies on costly human preference annotations. Extending these methods to morphologically rich, low-resource languages remains challenging because such annotations are scarce. We present SAGA (Score-weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment), a parser-guided preference optimisation framework that replaces human labels with dependency-parser supervision. SAGA converts parser judgements into preference pairs for delta-DPO, combines parser quality with lexical diversity in a composite reward, filters low-information pairs using a reward-gap criterion, and monitors reward hacking to maintain reliable supervision. Across Danish, Icelandic, and Norwegian Bokmål using GPT-SW3-1.3B, SAGA consistently improves grammatical quality without requiring human preference labels. Danish parse success increases from 69.0% to 93.8%, Icelandic achieves a +4.5 percentage-point improvement on an independent Stanza evaluation (three-run mean +3.3 percentage points) while native speakers prefer SAGA outputs in 80% of pairwise comparisons, and Norwegian Bokmål improves by +28 percentage points. These results demonstrate that parser-derived supervision is a practical alternative to human preference annotation for grammatical alignment in low-resource languages where high-quality dependency parsers are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGA（Score-weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment），一种基于依存句法解析器监督的偏好优化框架，用解析器判断替代人工偏好标注，通过delta-DPO、复合奖励和奖励劫持监控，在丹麦语、冰岛语和挪威语上显著提升语法质量，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 偏好优化虽能有效改进大语言模型，但依赖昂贵的人工偏好标注。在形态丰富、资源稀缺的低资源语言中，人工标注尤其难以获取，因此需要一种无需人工标注的替代方案来提升低资源语言的语法质量。
AI.method: SAGA框架包含四个核心组件：(1) 将依存解析器的判断转换为偏好对用于delta-DPO训练；(2) 结合解析器质量和词汇多样性的复合奖励函数；(3) 使用奖励差距标准过滤低信息量偏好对；(4) 监控奖励劫持以维持可靠的监督信号。
AI.result: 在GPT-SW3-1.3B上对丹麦语、冰岛语和挪威布克莫尔语进行评估：丹麦语解析成功率从69.0%提升至93.8%；冰岛语在独立Stanza评估上提升4.5个百分点（三次运行均值+3.3个百分点），母语者在80%的两两比较中偏好SAGA输出；挪威布克莫尔语提升28个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 解析器派生的监督信号是低资源语言中人工偏好标注的实用替代方案，尤其适用于已有高质量依存解析器可用的语言。

title: ECG-LENS: Lead-Aware Clinical Context Enriched ECG Report Generation and Evaluation
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) is one of the most widely used non-invasive tools for diagnosing cardiovascular disease, but transforming multi-lead ECG recordings into reliable clinical reports remains challenging. Automating ECG report generation could reduce clinicians' interpretive workload, improve diagnostic efficiency, and expand access to cardiac assessment in underserved communities. Unlike image-based report-generation tasks, ECG interpretation requires the analysis of subtle temporal morphologies, followed by coherent diagnostic reasoning expressed in dense clinical terminology. Existing systems predominantly focus on classification, while current report-generation methods often produce outputs that remain inadequate for practical clinical use. To address these challenges, we propose ECG-LENS, an end-to-end ECG report-generation framework that jointly integrates multi-lead signal modeling, diagnosis-aware representations, and clinically grounded text generation. ECG-LENS combines lead-wise encoders that preserve localized waveform morphology with a global encoder that captures inter-lead dependencies. To guide report generation, we fuse signal representations with clinically enriched textual prompts that condition a GPT-2 decoder. We further introduce an ECG-specific report-preprocessing strategy that helps the model focus on clinically meaningful findings. Finally, because lexical metrics may under- or overestimate report quality, we propose F1-ECGBERT, a BERT-based, ECG-specific metric that measures agreement between diagnostic labels extracted from generated and reference reports. In-domain experiments on PTB-XL and cross-domain evaluation on MIMIC-IV-ECG show that ECG-LENS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with absolute gains of 4.0%, 6.3%, and 11.5% in METEOR, ROUGE-L, and F1-ECGBERT, respectively, over the strongest baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ECG-LENS，一个端到端的心电图（ECG）报告生成框架，联合集成多导联信号建模、诊断感知表示和临床文本生成。该系统采用导联级编码器保留局部波形形态，配合全局编码器捕捉导联间依赖，并将信号表示与临床增强文本提示融合以条件化GPT-2解码器。同时提出ECG专用报告预处理策略和基于BERT的ECG专用评估指标F1-ECGBERT。在PTB-XL和MIMIC-IV-ECG上的实验表明，ECG-LENS在METEOR、ROUGE-L和F1-ECGBERT上分别比最强基线绝对提升4.0%、6.3%和11.5%。
AI.motivation: 将多导联ECG记录转换为可靠的临床报告仍然具有挑战性。现有系统主要聚焦于分类任务，而当前的报告生成方法产出质量不足以用于实际临床场景。ECG解读需要分析细微的时间形态学特征，并以密集的临床术语进行连贯的诊断推理，这不同于基于图像的报告生成任务。
AI.method: ECG-LENS框架包含四个核心组件：(1) 导联级编码器保留局部波形形态 + 全局编码器捕捉导联间依赖；(2) 将信号表示与临床增强文本提示融合，条件化GPT-2解码器生成报告；(3) ECG专用报告预处理策略，帮助模型聚焦于临床有意义的发现；(4) F1-ECGBERT，一种基于BERT的ECG专用评估指标，衡量生成报告与参考报告中提取的诊断标签之间的一致性。
AI.result: 在PTB-XL上进行域内实验，在MIMIC-IV-ECG上进行跨域评估，ECG-LENS持续优于最先进方法。与最强基线相比，在METEOR、ROUGE-L和F1-ECGBERT上分别获得4.0%、6.3%和11.5%的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: ECG-LENS通过联合优化多导联信号建模、诊断感知表示和临床文本生成，显著提升了ECG报告生成的临床实用性。ECG专用的预处理策略和评估指标进一步增强系统的可靠性和可用性，为自动化ECG报告生成提供了新的基准。

title: Bayesian adaptively-weighted ensembles for few-shot abdominal segmentation
comment: Accepted at DEMI at MICCAI 2026 - The 4th MICCAI Workshop in Data Engineering in Medical Imaging
summary: Few-shot learning has emerged as a promising approach for anatomical segmentation when labelled data are scarce. However, different few-shot learning algorithms exhibit complementary strengths and weaknesses, with performance varying across anatomical targets and institutions. Existing few-shot segmentation ensembles, that combine predictions from multiple algorithms, typically employ fixed weighting schemes and therefore cannot adjust model contributions according to the target domain. In this work, we propose a Bayesian adaptively-weighted ensemble framework for segmentation under label scarcity and domain shift. Multiple few-shot segmentation algorithms are first adapted using a small labelled support set. Bayesian optimisation is then used to automatically identify ensemble weights that maximise segmentation performance on a target-domain validation set. The learned weights are subsequently fixed and applied to combine predictions on previously unseen query images from the target domain. The proposed framework is evaluated on the Cross-institution Male Pelvic Structures dataset using held-out anatomical structures and institutions to simulate simultaneous label scarcity and institutional domain shift. Results demonstrate statistically significant improvements over individual few-shot learners, fixed-weight ensembles, training-from-scratch baselines and recent state-of-the-art ensembling approaches. By adapting model contributions to the target anatomy and institutional domain, the proposed framework provides a practical mechanism for deploying segmentation systems to new clinical sites under severe annotation constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯优化的自适应加权集成框架，用于标签稀缺和域偏移场景下的少样本解剖分割。通过在小标注支持集上适配多个少样本分割算法，再利用贝叶斯优化在目标域验证集上自动寻优集成权重，最后将学习到的权重固定应用于未见查询图像。在跨机构男性盆腔结构数据集上取得了优于单个学习器、固定权重集成、从头训练基线及最新集成方法的显著改进。
AI.motivation: 不同的少样本分割算法在不同解剖目标和机构上表现出互补的优缺点，而现有集成方法通常采用固定权重方案，无法根据目标域自适应调整各算法的贡献权重。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯自适应加权集成框架：(1) 利用小标注支持集适配多个少样本分割算法；(2) 使用贝叶斯优化在目标域验证集上自动搜索最优集成权重以最大化分割性能；(3) 将学到的权重固定并应用于目标域的未见查询图像预测。
AI.result: 在Cross-institution Male Pelvic Structures数据集上，通过留出解剖结构和机构模拟标签稀缺与机构域偏移场景，实验结果表明该方法在统计上显著优于单个少样本学习器、固定权重集成、从头训练基线以及近期最先进的集成方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将模型贡献自适应地适配目标解剖结构和机构域，该框架为在严重标注约束下向新临床站点部署分割系统提供了实用的机制。

title: Continual Learning in Transition
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Survey on continual learning in the LLM and agentic-AI era
summary: Classical continual learning (CL) has primarily focused on enabling models to update and retain knowledge through parameter-centric mechanisms, e.g., training strategies, architectural designs, and weight adaptation. However, emerging paradigms are reshaping the scope of CL beyond this traditional model adaptation view. For instance, on-policy learning broadens the space of update mechanisms; test-time training extends CL from the training phase to inference; and external harness components such as memory, skill libraries, and interaction protocols extend the evolutionary boundaries of model capabilities far beyond the static parameter space. Collectively, these developments indicate a transition from parameter-centric learning toward system-level adaptation. To characterize this transition, we examine the evolution of continual learning through three dimensions: When, How, and Where learning occurs. The How dimension encompasses off-policy, on-policy, and beyond-gradient optimization mechanics. The When dimension captures evolution across pre-training, post-training, and inference-time stages. The Where dimension delineates updates occurring within internal parameters versus external structural constraints. Anchored by this tri-axial framework, we systematically survey representative methods, trace the ongoing transition of continual learning, and discuss the key challenges, broader implications, and future directions arising from this paradigm shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个三维框架（When/How/Where）来刻画持续学习从参数中心化的模型自适应向系统级自适应演进的范式转变，并系统梳理了该转变中的代表性方法、挑战与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 传统持续学习主要关注通过参数中心化机制（训练策略、架构设计、权重调整）实现知识更新与保持，但新兴范式正在超越这一视角：on-policy学习拓宽了更新机制空间，test-time训练将CL扩展到推理阶段，外部组件（记忆、技能库、交互协议）将模型能力进化边界延伸到静态参数空间之外。为此需要一个新的分析框架来刻画这一转变。
AI.method: 作者提出一个三轴分析框架：How维度涵盖off-policy、on-policy和超越梯度的优化机制；When维度涵盖预训练、后训练和推理阶段；Where维度区分内部参数更新与外部结构约束。基于这一框架，系统性地综述代表性方法，追踪持续学习的演进轨迹。
AI.result: 系统梳理了持续学习从参数中心化学习向系统级自适应过渡的完整图景，涵盖各维度下的代表性方法，并识别了范式转变带来的关键挑战及其广泛影响。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习正经历从参数中心化向系统级自适应的根本性转变，本文的三维框架为理解和推进这一范式转变提供了有效的组织视角，同时揭示了值得关注的未来研究方向。

title: GSBF: Gaussian Splatting for Environment-Aware Beamforming
summary: Beamforming plays a key role in multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) communication systems. However, conventional beamforming design normally requires accurate instantaneous channel state information (CSI) and iterative optimization, which incur substantial pilot overhead and computational complexity. Recognizing that radio propagation is intrinsically governed by the physical geometry, we develop a 3D Gaussian splatting for environment-aware beamforming (GSBF) pipeline based on multi-modal data, which characterizes the environment through a persistent 3D Gaussian representation. Specifically, GSBF models the environmental scattering response with reciprocity-preserving bidirectional spherical Gaussian (Bi-SG) kernels and performs two-sided electromagnetic rasterization to render an angular propagator map. The rendered map is then aggregated through an over-complete array-manifold dictionary and projected to the constant-modulus beamformers, thereby synthesizing beams directly from the access point (AP) pose and user position without online instantaneous CSI. Simulations demonstrate that GSBF consistently outperforms baselines such as exhaustive beam alignment (EBA) with lower latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于3D高斯溅射的环境感知波束成形（GSBF）流水线，利用多模态数据将无线电传播环境建模为持久的三维高斯表示，从AP姿态和用户位置直接合成波束，无需在线瞬时CSI，仿真表明其性能优于穷举波束对齐基线且延迟更低。
AI.motivation: 传统波束成形设计依赖精确的瞬时信道状态信息（CSI）和迭代优化，导致大量导频开销和计算复杂度。无线电传播本质上受物理几何约束，利用环境先验信息可绕过在线CSI采集，降低开销与复杂度。
AI.method: GSBF流水线主要包括三个步骤：1）基于多模态数据构建持久的三维高斯环境表示；2）利用保持互易性的双向球面高斯（Bi-SG）核建模环境散射响应，并通过两侧电磁光栅化渲染出角度传播子图；3）通过过完备阵列流形字典聚合渲染图，并投影到恒模波束成形器，从而直接从AP姿态和用户位置合成波束，无需在线瞬时CSI。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，GSBF在性能上持续优于穷举波束对齐（EBA）等基线方法，且具有更低的延迟。
AI.conclusion: GSBF验证了利用三维环境几何先验进行免CSI波束成形的可行性，能以较低延迟超越传统穷举波束对齐方案，为环境感知通信提供了新思路。

title: Controllable Clothing: Precise Labels and Generation for Virtual Try-On with Latent Diffusion Models
summary: In this technical report, I present a new method for guiding image generation in the context of Virtual- Try-On (VITON). The proposed method leverages new open source Ai models to augment the image data with labels, such as lengths and styles. By training adapters with these labels paired with images of the garments, the model can produce a more diverse set of images that the user can control. For the end user, such as a retailer, this means that they can assure that the produced image is as true to the true fit as possible, not misleading consumers

AI.tldr: 该技术报告提出了一种新的虚拟试衣（VITON）图像生成引导方法，利用开源AI模型为服装图像添加长度、风格等标签，通过训练适配器实现用户可控的多样化图像生成，确保生成图像真实反映服装实际穿着效果，避免误导消费者。
AI.motivation: 在虚拟试衣（VITON）场景中，生成的图像可能无法真实反映服装的实际穿着效果，从而误导消费者。作者希望引入一种可控的图像生成方法，使零售商能够确保最终展示给消费者的图像与真实穿着效果尽可能一致。
AI.method: 利用新的开源AI模型对服装图像进行数据增强，自动添加长度、风格等标注信息；然后使用这些带标签的图像训练适配器（adapters），使模型能够根据用户指定的标签生成多样化且可控制的试穿图像。
AI.result: 该方法能够生成更多样化且可由用户控制的图像，使零售商能够确保生成图像尽可能真实地反映服装的实际穿着效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入标签引导的适配器训练，该方案提升了虚拟试衣图像生成的多样性和可控性，有助于维持商品展示的真实性，降低消费者误导风险。

title: Timestep-Conditioned Transformers for Global Weather Forecasting
summary: Existing machine-learning weather forecasting models rely on predetermined and fixed autoregressive timesteps. The choice of model timestep involves a fundamental trade-off: shorter timesteps (e.g. 1 to 6 hours) finely resolve atmospheric dynamics within the diurnal cycle but increase error accumulation for a given forecast horizon, while longer timesteps (e.g. 24 hours) reduce error accumulation but limit the usability of short-range forecasts where sub-daily predictability is high. In this work, we present GEM-3, a probabilistic global weather model that addresses this trade-off through explicit multi-timestep inference. With a single set of trained weights, the model timestep can be configured at inference time to balance predictability and usability across a broad forecast horizon. Additionally, we find that mixed-timestep training consistently improves rollout stability relative to timestep-specialist models. Under the hood, GEM-3 is a lightweight neighborhood-attention transformer with ~134M parameters on an equirectangular grid with a number of architectural advancements beyond its predecessor GEM-2. The result is a practical forecasting system that couples near-SOTA medium-range probabilistic skill, stable extended-range rollouts, efficient training and inference, and decision-relevant diagnostics.

AI.tldr: GEM-3是一个轻量级概率全球天气预测模型（~134M参数），通过显式多时间步推理解决固定自回归时间步长带来的精度与可用性权衡问题，实现单组权重在推理时可配置时间步长，并利用混合时间步长训练提升扩展期rollout稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习天气预报模型使用预定的固定自回归时间步长，存在根本性权衡：短时间步长（如1-6小时）能精细解析日内循环的大气动力学，但给定预测时域内误差累积增大；长时间步长（如24小时）减少误差累积但限制了亚日可预测性较高的短时预报可用性。
AI.method: GEM-3采用显式多时间步推理机制，使用单一训练权重，在推理时配置模型时间步长来平衡可预测性与可用性；采用混合时间步长训练提升rollout稳定性；底层架构为轻量级邻域注意力Transformer（~134M参数），基于等距矩形网格，并在前代GEM-2基础上进行了多项架构改进。
AI.result: GEM-3展示了接近最先进的（near-SOTA）中期概率预报技能、稳定的扩展期rollout、高效的训练与推理，以及决策相关的诊断输出。
AI.conclusion: GEM-3提供了一种实用的天气预报系统，通过多时间步推理设计有效解决了时间步长权衡问题，在保持轻量高效的同时实现接近SOTA的概率预报技能。

title: CourseGraph: Finding overlaps and differences in Computer Science courses across universities
summary: Student mobility programs such as Erasmus+ enable students to take courses at other universities, broadening their academic and cultural horizons. However, this flexibility also leads to a practical challenge: ensuring that students do not take courses elsewhere that substantially overlap with courses in their home curriculum. In this work, we propose CourseGraph, a methodology that automates the evaluation of external courses based on insights obtained from the process followed by curriculum administrators when assessing courses for inclusion in a degree program. Course- Graph extracts information such as course titles, descriptions, and learning outcomes from the course webpage. Then, this information is represented semantically using a BERT-based language model, after which the pair-wise similarity between courses can be computed. This information is then used by a Random Forest classifier to determine whether a candidate course abroad overlaps with a course already contained in the student's curriculum. We evaluate CourseGraph using (1) the Computer Science program at Eindhoven University of Technology, which contains information about courses with substantial overlap, and (2) six approved international programs from students enrolled in the Computer Science program at Lund University, including the corresponding decisions made by a curriculum administrator. The experimental results indicate that CourseGraph provides an effective approach for identifying overlapping courses and supporting curriculum alignment across universities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CourseGraph，一种利用BERT语义模型和随机森林分类器自动评估外部课程与本校课程重叠度的方法，用于支持学生交换项目（如Erasmus+）中的课程认证决策。
AI.motivation: 学生交换项目允许学生在他校修课，但需要确保外校课程与本校课程没有大量重叠。目前这一评估过程依赖课程管理人员人工判断，缺乏自动化工具支持，效率低且主观性较强。
AI.method: CourseGraph模拟课程管理人员的评估流程：首先从课程网页提取课程标题、描述和学习成果等信息；然后利用基于BERT的语言模型对课程信息进行语义表示；接着计算课程之间的两两相似度；最后使用随机森林分类器判断候选外国课程是否与本校课程存在重叠。
AI.result: 在Eindhoven理工大学计算机科学项目和Lund大学计算机科学项目的六个批准的国际交换项目数据上进行评估，实验结果表明CourseGraph能有效识别重叠课程，并为跨大学的课程对齐提供支持。
AI.conclusion: CourseGraph为自动化课程重叠评估提供了一种有效的方法，能够辅助课程管理人员进行决策，促进跨大学课程体系的衔接与对齐。

title: Accurate Localization of Road Traffic Objects on the Road Plane Using Surveillance Camera Imagery
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 2026 Progress in Applied Electrical Engineering (PAEE) conference
summary:
Accurate vehicle localization from monocular roadside surveillance cameras is important for intelligent transportation systems, traffic monitoring, and traffic conflict analysis. Standard approaches often estimate vehicle position from the center of the detector bounding box, which can produce large errors due to perspective distortion and parallax, especially for elevated cameras and large vehicles.
  This paper proposes a two-stage geometry-aware localization pipeline that estimates the projection of the vehicle footprint onto the road plane. First, vehicles are detected using a YOLO26-based detector. Second, a dedicated ResNet34 regression network predicts four corner points corresponding to the projected vehicle base. The final position is computed as the geometric center of the predicted quadrilateral.
  The method was trained on synthetic data generated in CARLA and fine-tuned on real-world roadside imagery from DAIR-V2X. Experiments on synthetic and real data showed clear improvements over naive bounding-box-center localization. On DAIR-V2X, the mean image-space localization error decreased from 31.77 px to 15.30 px, a 51.8% improvement, while the median error decreased to 4.29 px. Median ground-plane error for medium-range vehicles decreased from 5.52 m to 0.90 m, and for far-range vehicles from 8.67 m to 1.84 m.
  The results also show that contextual information surrounding the detector bounding box is important for geometric localization. The largest gains were observed for distant vehicles and geometrically challenging cases affected by strong perspective distortion and parallax.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段几何感知定位方法，利用YOLO26检测车辆，再用ResNet34回归网络预测车辆在地面上的投影四角点，以四边形几何中心作为车辆位置，显著优于传统的检测框中心定位方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的从单目路边监控摄像头进行车辆定位的方法通常取检测器边界框的中心作为车辆位置，但由于透视畸变和视差效应，这种方法在摄像头架设较高或车辆较大时会产生较大的定位误差，难以满足智能交通系统、交通监控和冲突分析的精度需求。
AI.method: 提出两阶段几何感知定位管线：第一阶段使用YOLO26检测器检测车辆；第二阶段使用专用的ResNet34回归网络预测车辆在地面上投影的四个角点坐标，最终以预测四边形的几何中心作为车辆位置。模型先在CARLA合成的数据上训练，再在DAIR-V2X真实路边图像上进行微调。
AI.result: 在DAIR-V2X数据集上，图像空间平均定位误差从31.77像素降至15.30像素（改善51.8%），中位误差降至4.29像素；中等距离车辆的地面平面中位误差从5.52米降至0.90米，远距离车辆从8.67米降至1.84米。实验还表明检测框周围的上下文信息对几何定位至关重要，最显著的提升出现在远距离车辆和受强透视畸变与视差影响的几何挑战性场景中。
AI.conclusion: 基于车辆地面投影四角点的几何感知定位方法相比传统的边界框中心定位能显著提升精度，尤其在远距离和透视畸变严重的场景下优势明显，验证了利用车辆在路面上投影几何信息进行定位的有效性。

title: A Six-Dimensional Taxonomy of Post-Training Adaptation Techniques with Applications in AI Governance
summary: Post-training adaptation has become central to modern machine learning practice and includes techniques such as retraining, fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, alignment, retrieval augmentation, model editing, unlearning, calibration, and Multimodal Instruction Tuning. However, the literature remains fragmented across technique families, model classes, and deployment contexts, making it difficult to compare methods or describe how a trained model has been modified. This survey synthesizes the post-training adaptation literature and introduces a six-dimensional taxonomy organized by mechanism, goal, data requirement, persistence, structural scope, and model type. The taxonomy distinguishes commonly conflated terms such as fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, and prompting, and shows how adaptation strategies evolve from traditional machine learning through deep learning, foundation models, large language models, and multimodal large language models. It also maps relationships among techniques, including inheritance, supersession, hybridization, and layered deployment stacks. The resulting vocabulary can support technical documentation, model-change tracking, and governance analysis. The survey concludes by identifying open challenges in evaluation, reproducibility, persistent inference-time adaptation, unlearning, multimodal adaptation, and governance-aware post-training workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文献综述系统梳理了后训练（post-training）适应技术的全景，提出了一个六维分类法（机制、目标、数据需求、持久性、结构范围、模型类型），区分了微调、检索增强、提示等常被混淆的概念，并映射了技术之间的继承、替代、混合与分层部署关系，为技术文档、模型变更追踪和治理分析提供了统一词汇。
AI.motivation: 后训练适应技术（如重新训练、微调、参数高效适应、对齐、检索增强、模型编辑、去学习、校准、多模态指令微调等）已广泛应用于现代机器学习实践，但相关文献分散在不同技术族、模型类别和部署场景中，缺乏统一的比较框架和描述语言，难以系统比较方法或刻画已训练模型的修改过程。
AI.method: 本文采用综述研究方法，综合后训练适应文献，提出一个六维分类学框架，涵盖机制、目标、数据需求、持久性、结构范围和模型类型六个维度；同时通过映射技术间关系（继承、替代、混合、分层部署栈）来展示适应策略从传统机器学习、深度学习、基础模型、大语言模型到多模态大语言模型的演进路径。
AI.result: 提出了一个六维分类法，成功区分了微调、检索增强、提示等常被混淆的术语，建立了技术间的关系图谱（继承、超集、混合、分层部署栈），并形成了可支持技术文档编写、模型变更追踪和治理分析的统一词汇体系。
AI.conclusion: 综述识别了后训练适应研究中的开放挑战，包括评估、可复现性、持续推理时适应、去学习、多模态适应以及面向治理的后训练工作流等方面，指出了未来研究的方向。

title: Overcoming Attention Drift: Homogeneity-Heterogeneity Guided Feature Aggregation for Low-Light Remote Sensing Image Enhancement
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Yaozi Zhong and Xingxing Yang contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/AlexYangxx/HALO
summary: Restoring high-fidelity remote sensing imagery from extreme low-light degradation is indispensable for reliable Earth observation and downstream machine vision. However, under severe noise and illumination corruption, existing methods suffer from attention drift, erroneously aggregating features across distinct physical boundaries and causing severe structural blurring and color distortion. To address this, we propose HALO, a dual-prior-driven enhancement framework that formulates enhancement as a guided feature aggregation problem driven by foundation model priors. Specifically, an illumination-invariant semantic prior provides regional homogeneity as a positive bias for content-consistent aggregation, while a pseudo-3D topological prior provides boundary heterogeneity as a negative penalty to strictly prevent cross-boundary confusion. To cooperatively incorporate these two priors, we propose a Homogeneity-Heterogeneity Cooperative Attention Module (H2CAM) to resolve feature conflicts during cross-modal prior fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HALO achieves state-of-the-art performance across 8 challenging synthetic and real-world remote sensing benchmarks, significantly improving physical boundary sharpness and color fidelity while maximizing the preservation of discriminative features for downstream Earth observation tasks.

AI.tldr: HALO是一个双先验驱动的遥感图像极低光增强框架，通过光照不变语义先验和伪3D拓扑先验分别提供区域同质性正偏置和边界异质性负惩罚，并设计H2CAM模块融合两种先验，在8个基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 极低光退化的遥感图像恢复对地球观测和下游机器视觉至关重要，但现有方法在严重噪声和光照退化下存在注意力漂移问题，会跨物理边界错误聚合特征，导致结构模糊和颜色失真。
AI.method: 提出HALO框架，将增强形式化为由基础模型先验引导的特征聚合问题。包括：(1) 光照不变语义先验提供区域同质性正偏置；(2) 伪3D拓扑先验提供边界异质性负惩罚防止跨边界混淆；(3) 同质性-异质性协作注意力模块(H2CAM)解决跨模态先验融合中的特征冲突。
AI.result: 在8个具有挑战性的合成和真实世界遥感基准上达到SOTA性能，显著提升物理边界锐度和颜色保真度，并最大化保留用于下游地球观测任务的判别性特征。
AI.conclusion: HALO通过双先验引导的特征聚合有效解决了低光遥感增强中的注意力漂移问题，验证了同质性正偏置与异质性负惩罚相结合的有效性，为遥感图像增强提供了一种新的范式。

title: MetaboLLM: a metabolomics-specialized large language model for biochemical knowledge integration and predictive metabolite graph construction
comment: 60 pages, 3 figures, 16 tables; includes Supplementary Information
summary: Metabolomics knowledge is distributed across heterogeneous resources and remains difficult to translate into predictive representations. We developed MetaboLLM, a metabolomics-specialized large language model adapted through continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and structured retrieval, together with MetaboLLM-GIN, which converts generated biochemical descriptions into metabolite graphs for patient-level prediction using a graph isomorphism network. Across four backbone families, MetaboLLM outperformed corresponding base and medically adapted models on metabolomics knowledge, relational, and description tasks, and transferred to an external public benchmark. MetaboLLM-GIN achieved the highest AUC for stress hyperglycemia prediction after coronary artery bypass grafting (0.8616) and postmenopausal hormone-regimen classification (0.8123), outperforming conventional models, alternative graph constructions, and graphs generated from unadapted or non-retrieval LLM configurations. Model interpretation further produced biologically meaningful findings in both applications. These results show that domain-specialized language models can organize heterogeneous biochemical knowledge into predictive and interpretable metabolite graph representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MetaboLLM，一个通过持续预训练、监督微调和结构化检索适配的代谢组学大语言模型，以及MetaboLLM-GIN，后者将生成的生化描述转换为代谢物图用于患者级预测。在两个临床应用中，MetaboLLM-GIN取得了最佳预测性能并产生生物学上有意义的发现。
AI.motivation: 代谢组学知识分散在异构资源中，难以转化为可预测的表示形式，缺乏能够整合这些分散生化知识并用于临床预测的专门模型。
AI.method: 通过持续预训练、监督微调和结构化检索对大型语言模型进行领域适配，构建MetaboLLM；再通过MetaboLLM-GIN将生成的生化描述转换为代谢物图，利用图同构网络进行患者级预测。在四个骨干模型家族上评估，并比较多种模型配置和图形构建方式。
AI.result: MetaboLLM在代谢组学知识、关系及描述任务上优于对应的基础和医学适配模型，并成功迁移到外部公共基准。MetaboLLM-GIN在CABG后应激性高血糖预测（AUC 0.8616）和绝经后激素方案分类（AUC 0.8123）上取得最高AUC，超过常规模型、替代图构建方法以及未适配或无检索的LLM配置。模型解释产生生物学上有意义的发现。
AI.conclusion: 领域专门化的语言模型能够将异构生化知识组织为可预测且可解释的代谢物图表示，为代谢组学驱动的精准医疗提供了一种新的有效途径。

title: VLMs for Videogame Data Annotation
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents have revolutionized how engineers approach complex problems in real-world applications. Their adoption in video games is on the other hand limited by the extreme variability of the synthetic scenarios and their poor compliance with real-world physics. Here we investigate the use of VLMs for annotating video game frame sequences with reward signals, a task with several potential applications including, among others, conditioned training and offline reinforcement learning. We show that VLMs often struggle to answer basic questions on racing video games (although we observed a similar behavior on other game genres) and discuss countermeasures such as VLM output mixing and prompt optimization. We also show how input sequence length, resolution, and question batching affect the annotation quality and its token consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用视觉语言模型（VLMs）为视频游戏帧序列标注奖励信号的任务，发现VLMs在赛车类游戏（以及其他游戏类型）上难以回答基本问题，并探讨了输出混合、提示优化等应对措施，同时分析了输入序列长度、分辨率和问题批处理对标注质量和token消耗的影响。
AI.motivation: VLMs和AI代理已在现实应用中广泛用于解决复杂问题，但在视频游戏领域的应用受到合成场景极端多变性和与真实物理不符的限制。作者希望探究VLM在游戏帧序列中标注奖励信号的可行性，该任务有潜力应用于条件训练和离线强化学习等多个场景。
AI.method: 作者系统地测试了VLMs在赛车视频游戏帧序列上进行奖励信号标注的能力，通过改变输入序列长度、分辨率以及问题批处理方式等参数，评估标注质量与token消耗，并尝试了VLM输出混合和提示优化等对策来改善性能。
AI.result: 研究表明VLMs在回答赛车视频游戏的基本问题时存在困难（其他游戏类型也有类似现象），但通过输出混合和提示优化可以在一定程度上缓解这些问题。输入序列长度、分辨率和问题批处理方式都会显著影响标注质量和token消耗。
AI.conclusion: VLMs虽然具有标注视频游戏帧序列奖励信号的潜力，但其当前性能在游戏场景中仍存在明显局限，需要结合适当的优化策略（如输出混合和提示优化）以及合理配置输入参数来平衡标注质量与计算成本。

title: Curia-MAE: Multi-Modal Multi-Anatomy MAE Pre-Training for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Radiology foundation models learn transferable representations that can be adapted to new tasks by training only small layers on top of a frozen encoder. Dense prediction tasks such as 3D segmentation are, however, underrepresented in their evaluation, and, with the encoder kept frozen, pre-trained models still fall short of nnU-Net, the state-of-the-art reference trained from scratch. To close this gap we extend convolutional MAE pre-training with a robust reconstruction objective, a feature regularizer, and a local-global similarity objective. Using this method, we propose Curia-MAE, a multi-modal, multi-anatomy MAE model pre-trained on 300,000 CT and MRI images covering a large number of anatomical sites. On eight anatomy- and lesion-focused segmentation benchmarks, Curia-MAE improves frozen-encoder performance over a strong MAE baseline, while remaining competitive under full finetuning and superior on lesion tasks, where labeled data is scarce. These results indicate that a single frozen encoder can be reused across diverse segmentation tasks, reducing the cost of adapting and deploying such models in clinical workflows. We will make our pre-trained model weights publicly available.

AI.tldr: Curia-MAE是一个多模态、多解剖区域的卷积掩码自编码器（MAE）预训练模型，在30万张CT和MRI图像上训练，通过鲁棒重建目标、特征正则化和局部-全局相似性目标三大改进，在冷冻编码器设置下超越了现有MAE基线，在病变分割任务上胜过从零训练的nnU-Net，证明单个冷冻编码器可复用于多样的分割任务。
AI.motivation: 放射学基础模型在密集预测任务（如3D分割）上的评估不足，且冷冻编码器下的预训练模型性能仍不及从零训练的最先进参考模型nnU-Net，需要弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 在卷积MAE预训练基础上扩展三个组件：(1) 鲁棒重建目标；(2) 特征正则器；(3) 局部-全局相似性目标。模型在300,000张覆盖大量解剖部位的CT和MRI图像上进行多模态、多解剖区域预训练。
AI.result: 在8个解剖和病变分割基准上，Curia-MAE在冷冻编码器设置下显著优于强MAE基线，在全微调下保持竞争力，在标注数据稀缺的病变任务上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 单一冷冻编码器可跨多样分割任务复用，降低模型在临床工作流中适配和部署的成本；预训练权重将公开发布。

title: RxnCLF: Contrastive Transformation-Aware Reaction Foundation Model for Improved Reactivity Prediction
summary: Reaction yield prediction remains challenging because labeled data are scarce and reaction space is both combinatorially large and sparsely populated, limiting the generalization of existing reaction representations. String-, fingerprint-, and graph-based reaction encodings only partially capture chemical transformations, making accurate prediction difficult for reactions with complex substrates. We propose reaction contrastive learning foundation (RxnCLF), a self-supervised contrastive framework for reaction representation learning. RxnCLF is built on a condensed reaction graph (CRG) that unifies reactant and product information into a single graph, enabling the model to learn explicit and enriched transformation structure rather than disconnected graphs. Pretrained on 1.7 million Pistachio reactions, RxnCLF learns a compact and continuous latent space that captures both reaction-center features and broader side chain contexts, making it transformation-aware and chemically interpretable. Fine-tuned on multiple yield prediction benchmarks, including Buchwald-Hartwig, Pd-catalyzed BH coupling, and proprietary HTE C-N coupling and amide formation datasets, RxnCLF consistently outperforms graph and sequence-based baselines, improving R2 and achieving the best performance overall. Our results highlight the promise of CRG-based RxnCLF as a scalable reaction foundation model, with the potential to generalize across broader reaction spaces and support diverse downstream reaction informatics tasks, including regioselectivity prediction, enantioselectivity prediction, and reaction condition optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RxnCLF，一个基于自监督对比学习的反应表征学习框架，利用压缩反应图（CRG）统一反应物与产物信息，在170万反应上预训练，并在多个产率预测基准上超越图与序列基线模型。
AI.motivation: 反应产率预测面临标注数据稀缺和反应空间组合爆炸的挑战，现有字符串、指纹、图等反应编码仅部分捕获化学转化信息，难以对复杂底物的反应进行准确预测。
AI.method: RxnCLF基于压缩反应图（CRG）构建，将反应物与产物信息统一为单一图结构，通过自监督对比学习框架进行预训练，学习紧凑且连续的反应表征空间，同时捕获反应中心特征和侧链上下文信息。
AI.result: 在170万Pistachio反应上预训练后，在Buchwald-Hartwig、Pd催化的BH偶联、专有HTE C-N偶联及酰胺化等多个产率预测基准上进行微调，一致优于图和序列基线模型，R2指标提升并取得最佳整体性能。
AI.conclusion: CRG-based RxnCLF展现出作为可扩展反应基础模型的潜力，有望推广到更广泛的反应空间，并支持区域选择性预测、对映选择性预测和反应条件优化等多种下游反应信息学任务。

title: Training a Conditioned Video Game Agent on a VLM Annotated Dataset
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a powerful but far from easy-to-use technique for policy learning. In the specific case of video games, access to the game engine is required to get rewards for training (e.g. to collect rewards from the environment). Furthermore, the proper identification and weighting of the rewards generally requires a difficult trial-and-error approach. Lastly, rewards are often sparse and understanding how they eventually affect the learned policy is a non-trivial exercise. To ease these issues we propose annotating a video game dataset with Vision Language Models (VLMs) instructed to extract human defined rewards. We show that offline RL can then be used to train a conditioned agent that responds accordingly to the desired returns and we discuss the difficulties and limitations that emerged in our early experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用视觉语言模型（VLMs）自动标注视频游戏数据集中的奖励，从而替代传统依赖游戏引擎获取奖励的方式，并利用离线强化学习训练条件智能体以响应期望回报，同时讨论了早期实验中的困难与局限。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在策略学习中虽然强大但难以使用，特别是在视频游戏场景下需要访问游戏引擎才能获取奖励；此外奖励的识别与加权通常需要困难的试错过程，且奖励往往稀疏，难以理解其对学习策略的影响。
AI.method: 使用视觉语言模型（VLMs）按照人类定义的奖励规则对视频游戏数据集进行标注，然后利用离线强化学习训练一个条件智能体，使其能够根据期望的回报目标做出相应行为。
AI.result: 展示了离线RL可以基于VLM标注的奖励成功训练条件智能体，但同时早期实验揭示了一些困难和局限性。
AI.conclusion: VLM标注奖励结合离线强化学习的方案为缓解传统RL中对游戏引擎依赖和奖励工程困难提供了可行方向，但仍需进一步解决实验中发现的挑战。

title: DTRNet: Dual Text-Radical Decoding for Handwritten Chinese Text Recognition with Faked Character Detection
summary: In K-12 educational scenarios, handwritten Chinese text recognition should not only transcribe student writing, but also detect faked characters. However, existing recognition models are usually confined to a predefined set of normal characters and therefore cannot explicitly identify faked characters. Existing detection methods exhibit complementary limitations: character-level methods provide interpretable structural evidence but suffer from low efficiency, whereas line-level methods are efficient but rely heavily on confidence scores, making them prone to missed detections and lacking explicit structural evidence. Thus, the key challenge is to preserve character-structural evidence independent of contextual inference while maintaining line-level efficiency. To this end, we propose DTRNet, a dual Text-Radical decoding framework for line-level faked character detection. DTRNet decouples context-aware text recognition from character-wise structural verification, where the text branch performs line-level transcription and the radical branch predicts legal Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS) for lexicon-based faked character judgment. We further introduce IDS-Guided Confidence Adjustment (IGCA) to refine text predictions using structural evidence during inference. Experimental results demonstrate that DTRNet effectively detects faked characters while maintaining strong recognition performance and providing interpretable radical-level evidence. Code, checkpoints, and the processed dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/BNU-ERC-ITEA/DTRNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DTRNet，一种基于双文本-部首（Text-Radical）解码框架的K-12场景手写中文伪造字符检测方法，通过将上下文感知的文本识别与字符级结构验证解耦，在保持行级检测效率的同时提供可解释的部首级结构证据。
AI.motivation: 在K-12教育场景中，手写中文文本识别不仅需要转录学生书写，还需检测伪造字符。然而，现有识别模型仅局限于预定义的正常字符集，无法显式识别伪造字符；现有检测方法存在互补性局限：字符级方法提供可解释的结构证据但效率低，行级方法效率高但依赖置信度分数，容易漏检且缺乏显式结构证据。核心挑战在于在保持行级效率的同时，保留独立于上下文推理的字符结构证据。
AI.method: 提出DTRNet双Text-Radical解码框架，将上下文感知的文本识别与字符级结构验证解耦。文本分支负责行级转录，部首分支预测合法的表意文字描述序列（IDS）用于基于词典的伪造字符判定。另外引入IDS引导的置信度调整（IGCA）机制，在推理阶段利用结构证据优化文本预测。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DTRNet能有效检测伪造字符，同时保持强大的识别性能，并提供可解释的部首级证据。
AI.conclusion: DTRNet成功在行级效率与字符级结构证据之间取得平衡，为K-12教育场景中的伪造手写中文检测提供了可行方案，代码、检查点和处理后的数据集已公开。

title: Hypothesis Testing with Conditional Queries: Learnability and the Value of Interaction
summary: Model evaluations may fix all tests before observing any responses or select later tests using earlier responses. We study this choice in a conditional-query model on a finite outcome space $\mathcal{X}$ with $|\mathcal{X}|=N$. We first ask which pairs of distribution classes can be reliably distinguished. We then ask how many additional queries are required to match an adaptive tester when all queried events must be fixed in advance. We show that learnability holds if and only if the two classes have positive separation in their pairwise conditional probabilities. When this separation is zero, the optimal worst-case error is exactly $1/2$ at every finite query budget.
