However, existing methods primarily reward final-answer cor rectness or intermediate progress, without directly assessing whether post-retrieval actions are grounded in the retrieved evidence. This misalignment encourages prior-driven reason ing: agents form conclusions based on internal knowledge and use retrieval mainly to confirm them, resulting in confirma tion bias and inefficient evidenceuse.Toaddressthisissue, we propose Contextual Information Policy Optimization (CIPO), an evidence-oriented reinforcement learning framework that explicitly aligns policy optimization with external evidence use. CIPO assigns dense, turn-level credit to reasoning ac tions influenced by retrieved information, while combining this evidence-use signal with a global outcome reward to pre serveanswercorrectness.Withthismanner,CIPOdiscourages evidence-detached guesses and promotes reasoning trajecto ries in which retrieved facts can guide or revise subsequent reasoning. Importantly, CIPO requires neither human process annotations nor an additional reward model. Extensive exper iments on seven in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that CIPO reduces the prevalence of prior-driven rea soning and achieves excellent performance on most tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文信息策略优化（CIPO），一种以证据为导向的强化学习框架，通过将策略优化与外部证据使用对齐，为受检索信息影响的推理动作分配细粒度的逐步信用，并结合全局结果奖励，从而减少先验驱动的推理（确认偏差），提高检索增强搜索代理在知识密集型任务中的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索代理的强化学习方法主要奖励最终答案正确性或中间进展，不直接评估检索后动作是否基于检索到的证据。这导致先验驱动推理：代理基于内部知识形成结论，仅用检索来确认，产生确认偏差和证据利用低效的问题。
AI.method: CIPO框架包括两方面的奖励信号：（1）证据使用信号——在检索后为受到检索信息影响的推理动作分配密集的turn级信用；（2）全局结果奖励——保留答案正确性。该方法不需要人工过程标注或额外的奖励模型。
AI.result: 在七个域内和域外基准上的广泛实验表明，CIPO减少了先验驱动推理的发生率，并在大多数任务上取得了优异的性能。
AI.conclusion: CIPO通过证据导向的强化学习有效对齐了策略优化与外部证据使用，抑制了证据脱离的猜测，促进了检索事实引导或修正后续推理的轨迹，证明了无需人工标注和额外奖励模型即可改善检索增强搜索代理的可靠性。

title: Iterate or Widen? When Test-Time Refinement Helps LiDAR Scene Completion: A Controlled Study of Evidence Geometry, Training Coverage, and Compute
summary: Should a completion model spend extra test-time compute by iterating, or spend a similar parameter budget on a wider one-shot predictor? The answer is easily confounded by denoising curricula, corruption augmentation, capacity, and unpaired evaluation. We study this question in LiDAR semantic scene completion by comparing a one-shot predictor, a parameter-matched wider predictor, and a weight-tied multigrid refiner initialized from the same frozen predictor. The protocol separates coherent region removal, independent thinning, range-dependent attenuation, and additive clutter while preserving exact scene-condition pairing. Across five training seeds and 815 SemanticKITTI sequence-08 frames, the full iterative system improves mIoU over the wide control by 0.911 points under contiguous angular removal, with a 95% moving-block bootstrap interval of [0.804, 1.040] that clears a predeclared 0.5-point practical margin. Under independent 75% thinning, iteration adds only 0.300 points [0.166, 0.436], whereas observation-family augmentation adds 5.975 points [5.662, 6.140]. Neither intervention repairs additive clutter. The iterative system also costs 10.74 ms and 0.75 GiB per frame, versus 6.25 ms and 0.23 GiB for the wide control. These results establish a geometry-conditioned empirical boundary rather than a universal advantage: coherent gaps can justify fixed-depth refinement, broadly thinned evidence is addressed more effectively by training coverage, and spurious evidence requires a different robustness mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LiDAR语义场景补全中迭代式补全模型与更宽的单次预测器的对比。通过精心设计的协议解耦去噪课程、损坏增强、容量和不配对评估等混淆因素后，发现迭代系统在连续角度移除场景下显著优于宽度匹配的对照组（mIoU提升0.911点，置信区间[0.804, 1.040]），但在独立75%稀疏化场景下提升有限，而训练覆盖（观测族增强）反而带来更大增益（5.975点）。结论强调不存在普适优势，几何条件决定了哪种策略更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有文献中比较迭代式补全模型与一次性更宽预测器时，结果容易被去噪课程、损坏增强、容量差异和不配对评估等因素混淆，导致难以得出可靠结论。本文旨在通过严格控制的实验协议，厘清"迭代计算"与"参数预算扩大"这两种策略在LiDAR语义场景补全中的真实优劣关系。
AI.method: 研究采用三组对比：单次预测器（one-shot predictor）、参数匹配的更宽预测器（parameter-matched wider predictor）、以及基于相同冻结预测器初始化的权重共享多重网格精化器（weight-tied multigrid refiner）。实验协议分离四种退化类型：相干区域移除、独立稀疏化、距离相关衰减和加性杂波，同时保持精确的场景-条件配对。在5个训练种子和815帧SemanticKITTI序列08上评估，使用95%移动块bootstrap区间进行统计推断。
AI.result: 迭代系统在连续角度移除下比宽对照组提升0.911点mIoU（CI [0.804, 1.040]，超过预声明的0.5点实用边际）；在独立75%稀疏化下仅提升0.300点（CI [0.166, 0.436]），而观测族增强带来5.975点提升（CI [5.662, 6.140]）；两者均无法修复加性杂波。计算开销方面，迭代系统每帧10.74ms/0.75GiB，宽对照组为6.25ms/0.23GiB。
AI.conclusion: 不存在迭代优于宽模型或反之的普适结论，而是存在一个几何条件依赖的经验边界：相干间隙可证明固定深度迭代精化的价值；广泛稀疏化的证据更适合通过训练覆盖增强来解决；加性杂波则需要不同的鲁棒性机制。这为选择测试时计算投入vs训练时覆盖投入提供了实证指导。

title: FinEvo-Bench: A Longitudinal Benchmark for Self-Evolving Agents in Professional Financial Workflows
summary: Most agent benchmarks evaluate tasks independently and cannot measure whether experience from one task helps with later tasks. Existing self-evolution benchmarks do not jointly cover professional workflows, open-ended deliverables, and multi-aspect evaluation. We introduce FinEvo-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark with 120 real-case-grounded tasks, 20 business scenes across six financial domains. Institution-provided professional procedures define the required operations and constraints. Eligible institution-provided and publicly documented cases supply the task facts. Each scene contains six related but substantively distinct cases that share a professional procedure and a manually reviewed rubric for task quality and financial compliance. We compare four self-evolving agent scaffolds using the same Qwen3.7-Max backbone and three independently shuffled, globally interleaved task streams. Paired non-evolving controls estimate each scaffold's self-evolution gain from retained experience, while an independent Claude Code scoring agent backed by Claude Opus 4.6 evaluates all outputs. Letta achieves the highest evolved score (91.65) and fewest compliance issues (0.09 per task); Codex achieves the largest self-evolution gain (+19.37). Across scaffolds, the evolving condition raises scores by 9.33-19.37 points and reduces compliance issues by 0.12-0.44 per task. Paired score gains at within-scene ranks 4-6 exceed those at ranks 1-3 by 6.10-8.70 points. In Claude Code, skill-only evolution produces higher task quality and fewer compliance issues than memory-only and combined memory-skill evolution. Across all four scaffolds, rubric feedback also yields higher scores and fewer compliance issues than reference-answer feedback. FinEvo-Bench measures both professional performance and self-evolution ability: how effectively an agent turns prior experience into later improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinEvo-Bench，一个包含120个真实案例、覆盖六大金融领域20个业务场景的纵向自进化基准测试，用于评估智能体将先前经验转化为后续任务改进的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准大多独立评估任务，无法衡量经验迁移带来的持续改进；已有的自进化基准未能同时覆盖专业工作流、开放式交付物和多维度评估。需要一个能衡量专业表现与自进化能力的综合基准。
AI.method: 构建FinEvo-Bench：120个真实案例任务，来自机构提供的专业流程定义操作和约束，可公开案例提供任务事实；每个场景包含6个相关但不同案例，共享专业流程和人工审核的评分标准。比较四种自进化智能体框架，使用相同的Qwen3.7-Max骨干模型和三个独立打乱的全局交错任务流，通过配对非进化对照估算自进化增益，使用Claude Code评分代理和Claude Opus 4.6评估输出。
AI.result: Letta达到最高进化分数（91.65）和最少合规问题（每任务0.09）；Codex获得最大自进化增益（+19.37）。进化条件使分数提升9.33-19.37分，合规问题减少0.12-0.44每任务。场景内排名4-6的配对分数增益超过排名1-3达6.10-8.70分。技能进化优于记忆进化和组合进化；rubric反馈优于参考答案反馈。
AI.conclusion: FinEvo-Bench能有效衡量专业表现与自进化能力，揭示了不同进化策略和反馈机制对智能体持续改进效果的影响，为自进化智能体研究提供了标准化的评估框架。

title: PaCoNet: Deep Data Extraction for Parallel Coordinates
summary: Extracting data from visualizations has long challenged computer vision, with current research focused on bar, line, and pie charts, among other low-dimensional visualizations. However, parallel coordinates as a widely used high-dimensional data visualization approach, remain largely unexplored in this context. As parallel coordinate plots can quickly become cluttered and difficult to interpret when poorly designed or densely populated, automated data extraction from such visualizations is of particular interest. In this paper, we propose PaCoNet, the first approach for parallel coordinate data extraction. PaCoNet not only extracts line coordinates, but also enables the extraction of individual data samples for further analysis. Towards this end, we make the following contributions. We present the first deep learning approach tailored for parallel coordinate analysis, and demonstrate that it outperforms unadapted baselines by a significant margin. We further introduce a large-scale parallel coordinate dataset for training and testing. Together, these key contributions enable for the first time the automated analysis and redesign of parallel coordinate plots. PaCoNet thus lays the groundwork for complex visualization analysis, and further advances the intersection of computer vision and data visualization. All code, trained models, and data generation scripts will be made publicly available upon acceptance of the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaCoNet，这是第一个用于平行坐标图数据提取的深度学习方法，不仅能提取线条坐标，还能提取单个数据样本用于进一步分析，并引入了大规模平行坐标数据集。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉在从可视化图表中提取数据方面已有研究，但主要集中于柱状图、折线图和饼图等低维可视化。平行坐标作为高维数据可视化的常用方法，在自动数据提取方面几乎未被探索。由于平行坐标图在设计不佳或数据密集时容易变得杂乱难以解读，因此自动提取数据具有重要价值。
AI.method: PaCoNet是第一个专为平行坐标分析设计的深度学习方法。具体贡献包括：1）提出针对平行坐标分析的第一个深度学习模型，超越未适配的基线方法；2）引入大规模平行坐标数据集用于训练和测试。
AI.result: 实验表明PaCoNet显著优于未适配的基线方法，能够提取线条坐标及个体数据样本，首次实现了平行坐标图的自动化分析和重新设计。
AI.conclusion: PaCoNet为复杂的可视化分析奠定了基础，推进了计算机视觉与数据可视化两个领域的交叉研究。代码、训练模型和数据生成脚本将在论文被接收后公开。

title: Schema-Guided Hierarchical Information Extraction and Semantic Evaluation Using Generative AI
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. To be published in Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on e-Science (e-Science), Naples, Italy
summary:
We present a schema-based framework for extracting complex, structured information from unstructured text documents using generative AI, followed by automated semantic evaluation of the extracted information against a gold standard. The schema, serving as an information model encoding domain knowledge, provides a unified, systematic, and consistent framework for extraction of hierarchical, nested information, with attributes of variable cardinality, and subsequent evaluation of the results. Information extraction from a document is performed in a single call to the model, in zero-shot mode.
  In the evaluation step, we introduce a path-based semantic matching algorithm to align the nested, variable-cardinality attributes in the extracted results with those in the gold standard. We use generative AI for semantic comparison of the extracted and gold standard values of an attribute, and introduce a rubric to classify the result of the comparison, according to domain-specific considerations, as an exact, semantic, useful, or non-match.
  We were able to extract 12 out of 14 attributes with an F1 score of $>$90\% from documents published by the health technology assessment organisation NICE, using the generative AI model Claude Opus 3. The time needed to extract the attributes from a document was $\sim$30 times lower than the time taken by a human domain expert. We further demonstrate generalisability of this framework across different generative AI models and transferability across different HTA organisations and languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于schema的框架，利用生成式AI从非结构化文本中提取复杂结构化信息，并通过路径语义匹配算法对提取结果进行自动语义评估。在NICE健康技术评估文档上，14个属性中12个达到F1>90%，提取速度比人类专家快约30倍。
AI.motivation: 从非结构化的复杂文档（如健康技术评估报告）中提取层次化、嵌套且属性基数可变的结构化信息是一项挑战性任务。现有方法缺乏统一框架来同时支持信息提取和结果评估，且在零样本模式下难以高效完成。
AI.method: 该框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 一个编码领域知识的schema作为信息模型，为层次化、嵌套且具有可变基数属性的信息提供统一、系统且一致的提取框架，通过单次零样本调用生成式AI完成提取；(2) 引入路径式语义匹配算法对齐提取结果与金标准中的嵌套可变基数属性，并使用生成式AI进行语义比较，通过领域特定的rubric将比较结果分为完全匹配、语义匹配、有用匹配或不匹配四类。
AI.result: 在NICE健康技术评估组织发布的文档上，使用Claude Opus 3模型成功提取14个属性中的12个，F1分数超过90%，提取时间约为人类领域专家所需时间的1/30。框架还在不同的生成式AI模型之间展示了泛化能力，并在不同HTA组织和语言之间展示了可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 该schema-based框架为复杂结构化信息提取及自动语义评估提供了统一、高效且可泛化的解决方案，在保持高准确率（F1>90%）的同时显著提升了提取效率，并证明了其跨模型、跨组织和跨语言的广泛适用性。

title: PaDoc: Layout-Grounded Parallel Decoding for Document Parsing
summary: End-to-end document parsers provide a unified interface, but serialize page layouts and regional contents into one autoregressive sequence. This formulation forces independent regions onto a decoding path whose length grows with the total content, whereas crop-based two-stage parsers expose region-level parallelism at the cost of repeated visual prefills and fragmented page context. To retain full-page context while removing dependencies, we propose PaDoc, a layout-grounded parser that treats the predicted layout as a branching structure over a shared page representation. Under a region-sufficiency assumption, we derive a prefix-conditioned factorization in which the layout stream and regional content branches advance concurrently, reducing the decoding depth to the longest layout-content path. We realize this factorization within a single MLLM: packed variable-length ancestor attention preserves the visibility under standard next-token training, while masked parallel decoding creates branches that the evaluated vLLM backend serves as concurrent requests with cache-resident shared-prefix reuse. On OmniDocBench Full, PaDoc attains an Overall layout F1 of 91.1 and, among end-to-end parsers, a top-tier Overall score of 94.24 together with the best Text Edit (0.038) and Formula CDM (95.59). On a 384-page subset and one A800 GPU, it is the fastest end-to-end parser at five concurrency levels, improving valid-page throughput by 67.4-118% and reducing P95 latency by 39.2-54.9% relative to a same-backbone Sequential SFT baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/Longin-Yu/Padoc

AI.tldr: PaDoc是一个布局接地（layout-grounded）的端到端文档解析器，它将预测的布局视为共享页面表示上的分支结构，通过前缀条件化分解实现布局流与区域内容分支的并行推进，将解码深度缩短为最长布局-内容路径的长度。在OmniDocBench Full上，PaDoc的Overall布局F1达91.1，Overall得分94.24（端到端解析器中顶级），Text Edit最佳（0.038），Formula CDM达95.59。在一张A800 GPU上，它在五个并发级别下均为最快的端到端解析器，相比同骨干的Sequential SFT基线，有效页面吞吐量提升67.4-118%，P95延迟降低39.2-54.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有的端到端文档解析器将页面布局和区域内容串联成一个自回归序列，导致独立区域被迫在同一解码路径上推进，解码长度随总内容增长；而基于裁剪的两阶段解析器虽然支持区域级并行，但需要重复的视觉预填充且页面上下文被碎片化。作者希望在保留完整页面上下文的同时消除区域间的解码依赖。
AI.method: PaDoc提出布局接地的文档解析框架：在区域充分性假设下推导出前缀条件化分解，使布局流与区域内容分支可并发推进，将解码深度降低到最长布局-内容路径。实现上采用单一MLLM，通过packed variable-length ancestor attention在标准next-token训练下保持可见性，并使用masked parallel decoding创建分支，由vLLM后端以并发请求方式执行，复用cache-resident共享前缀。
AI.result: 在OmniDocBench Full上，PaDoc的Overall布局F1达91.1，端到端解析器中Overall得分94.24为顶级，Text Edit（0.038）与Formula CDM（95.59）均为最佳；在384页子集和单张A800 GPU上，五个并发级别下均为最快端到端解析器，有效页面吞吐量较Sequential SFT基线提升67.4-118%，P95延迟降低39.2-54.9%。
AI.conclusion: PaDoc通过将布局作为分支结构来消除端到端文档解析中独立区域之间的解码依赖，在保持完整页面上下文的同时实现了区域级并行，兼顾了解析质量（精度）与效率（吞吐量和延迟），验证了基于布局分支分解在文档解析任务中的有效性。

title: DARAD: Dual Adapters and Ranking-Aware Distillation for Continual Remote Sensing Image-Text Retrieval
summary: With the rapid growth of Earth observation technologies, remote sensing archives are rapidly expanding, making remote sensing image-text retrieval (RS-ITR) increasingly important. However, continual RS-ITR remains challenging because scale variation and distribution shifts in RS aggravate cross-modal alignment space distortion, making it difficult for existing continual learning (CL) methods to support reliable continual retrieval. To address this challenge, we propose DARAD, a dual-adapter and ranking-aware distillation framework that preserves the historical cross-modal ranking structure while learning new visual and textual concepts from evolving archives. Specifically, the visual branch introduces a spatial fusion adapter, which integrates coarse regional cues and fine-grained patch cues to accommodate RS scale variation while anchoring visual updates to the pretrained alignment space. The textual branch employs multi-expert semantic routing, which separates shared textual semantics from semantically specialized residuals to absorb newly emerging descriptions while constraining global text embedding drift. Furthermore, bidirectional ranking distillation uses a frozen teacher model and historical anchors to preserve the historical cross-modal ranking structure, thereby mitigating alignment space distortion across continual stages. Experiments under a multi-stage continual retrieval protocol show that DARAD achieves superior performance over existing CL methods, improving adaptation to newly arrived data while maintaining effectiveness on historical data.

AI.tldr: 提出DARAD框架，通过双适配器和排序感知蒸馏解决遥感图像文本检索中的持续学习难题，应对尺度变化和分布偏移导致的跨模态对齐空间扭曲。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像文本检索（RS-ITR）日益重要，但持续RS-ITR面临挑战：遥感数据中的尺度变化和分布偏移会加剧跨模态对齐空间的扭曲，使得现有持续学习方法难以支持可靠的持续检索。
AI.method: 提出DARAD（双适配器和排序感知蒸馏框架），包含三个核心组件：(1)视觉分支的空间融合适配器，整合粗粒度区域线索和细粒度补丁线索以适应遥感尺度变化，并将视觉更新锚定到预训练对齐空间；(2)文本分支的多专家语义路由，将共享语义与语义专门化残差分离，吸收新涌现描述同时约束全局文本嵌入漂移；(3)双向排序蒸馏，利用冻结教师模型和历史锚点保留历史跨模态排序结构，缓解持续阶段的对齐空间扭曲。
AI.result: 在多阶段持续检索协议下的实验表明，DARAD优于现有持续学习方法，在适应新数据的同时保持对历史数据的检索有效性。
AI.conclusion: DARAD通过视觉尺度适应性适配、文本语义路由和双向排序蒸馏三管齐下的策略，有效解决了持续RS-ITR中因尺度变化和分布偏移导致的对齐空间扭曲问题，为遥感检索领域的持续学习提供了新的范式。

title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed within agentic systems, their capabilities depend not only on the model weights but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, control flow, memory, and orchestration code surrounding them. This makes automated harness optimization -- the iterative and evaluation-guided improvement of a harness by an AI system -- both an important route to improving AI systems and a demanding capability for AI systems themselves. Yet the community lacks a common protocol for measuring how well frontier LLMs perform at this task. We introduce HarnessOpt-Bench, a benchmark for end-to-end harness optimization under expensive and stochastic evaluation. An optimizer, an LLM paired with a coding harness, receives a target agent's seed harness, graded evaluation feedback, and a fixed target-evaluation budget. It edits the harness and nominates a final candidate, which is scored by its normalized gain over the seed on a held-out test partition that remains inaccessible throughout search. A trusted execution environment enforces the evaluation boundary, meters target-agent resource use, and preserves candidate versions for audit. We evaluate 5 frontier LLMs as optimizers both under a shared coding harness and under their native harnesses across 4 downstream tasks, over 111 scored runs. Experiment results show that optimizer models separate more than the coding harnesses they act through, native harnesses are not consistently superior, and gains vary substantially across tasks and seed regimes. These results establish harness optimization as a measurable and discriminative capability with large space for improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarnessOpt-Bench，一个用于端到端harness优化评测的基准，在昂贵且随机的评估条件下测量LLM作为优化器改进目标智能体harness（提示、工具、控制流、记忆和编排代码）的能力。通过受信任执行环境强制评估边界，在4个下游任务上对5个前沿LLM进行了111次评分实验，结果显示优化器模型之间的差异大于其使用的编码harness的差异，且增益在任务和种子设置间差异显著，表明harness优化是一个可测量、可区分且仍有很大改进空间的能力。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在智能体系统中被越来越多地部署，其能力不仅取决于模型权重，还取决于围绕它们的harness（提示、工具、控制流、记忆和编排代码）。自动harness优化既是改进AI系统的重要途径，也是对AI系统本身的严苛能力要求，但社区缺乏衡量前沿LLM在此任务上表现的通用协议。
AI.method: 提出HarnessOpt-Bench基准：优化器（LLM配上编码harness）接收目标智能体的种子harness、分级评估反馈和固定评估预算，编辑harness并提名最终候选方案。该候选在不可访问的留出测试分区上按相对于种子的归一化增益评分。受信任执行环境强制执行评估边界、计量目标智能体资源使用并保留候选版本以供审计。在共享编码harness和原生harness两种条件下评估5个前沿LLM优化器，覆盖4个下游任务共111次评分运行。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：优化器模型之间的区分度大于它们所使用的编码harness之间的差异；原生harness并不一致性地优于共享harness；增益在不同任务和种子设置之间差异显著。这些结果确立了harness优化作为可测量且可区分的LLM能力，且存在较大的改进空间。
AI.conclusion: HarnessOpt-Bench为自动化harness优化提供了一个标准化、可审计的评测协议，证明该能力可以被可靠测量和区分，同时也揭示了当前前沿LLM在此任务上的表现仍有很大提升空间，为该领域后续研究奠定了基础。

title: CogVis: Must Open-Vocabulary Change Detection Perceive the Scene Anew for Every Query?
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, including 3 supplementary figures. Code: https://github.com/KotlinWang/CogVis
summary: Earth-surface monitoring requires change detection models capable of recognizing arbitrary semantic categories. Open-Vocabulary Change Detection (OVCD) addresses this need. However, existing methods often entangle temporal perception, semantic discrimination, and region verification, causing unstable results and redundant computation. Inspired by human visual change perception, we propose CogVis, a cognitive memory-guided framework that reformulates OVCD as a perception-memory-verification paradigm. CogVis first employs a Scene Change Perceptron (SCP) to extract a reusable, category-agnostic change prior from frozen bi-temporal features, thereby decoupling temporal evidence from semantic category decisions. A Semantic Memory Calibrator (SMC) then compensates for category-dependent score shifts by dynamically estimating an image-query-specific decision threshold. Finally, an Adaptive Region Filter (ARF) filters connected candidates using learned semantic, temporal, and structural reliability. Experiments on seven benchmarks spanning semantic change detection, binary change localization, and building-damage assessment show that CogVis achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated datasets. By sharing scene-level change perception, CogVis further avoids repeating category-agnostic temporal perception across queries and improves inference throughput by 28.50%.

AI.tldr: CogVis是一个受人类视觉变化感知启发的认知记忆引导框架，将开放词汇变化检测（OVCD）重构为"感知-记忆-验证"范式，通过场景变化感知器、语义记忆校准器和自适应区域过滤器三个模块解耦时间感知与语义决策，在七个基准数据集上取得SOTA性能并将推理吞吐量提升28.50%。
AI.motivation: 现有OVCD方法常将时间感知、语义判别和区域验证纠缠在一起，导致结果不稳定和计算冗余。作者希望借鉴人类视觉变化感知的认知机制，解耦各阶段任务，实现更稳定高效的开放词汇变化检测。
AI.method: 提出CogVis框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) 场景变化感知器（SCP）从冻结的双时相特征中提取可复用的、与类别无关的变化先验，解耦时间证据与语义类别决策；(2) 语义记忆校准器（SMC）通过动态估计图像-查询特定的决策阈值，补偿类别相关的分数偏移；(3) 自适应区域过滤器（ARF）利用学习的语义、时间和结构可靠性过滤连通的候选区域。
AI.result: 在覆盖语义变化检测、二元变化定位和建筑损害评估的七个基准数据集上，CogVis在所有评估数据集上均取得最先进（SOTA）性能；通过共享场景级变化感知，避免了跨查询重复的类别无关时间感知，推理吞吐量提升28.50%。
AI.conclusion: CogVis通过"感知-记忆-验证"的认知记忆引导范式有效解耦了OVCD中的时间感知、语义判别与区域验证，不仅提升了检测精度，还通过共享场景级变化先验显著提高了推理效率，验证了认知启发的设计思路在地表监测变化检测任务中的有效性。

title: Learning from Failures: Retrieval-Centric CoT via Hard Negatives for Unified Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Unified multimodal retrieval aims to identify candidates that satisfy complex user intent expressed through heterogeneous inputs. Although Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM)-based retrievers are efficient and scalable, directly encoding raw multimodal inputs often misses fine-grained discriminative cues, leading to confusion among semantically similar candidates. Recent methods mitigate this limitation by generating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales to enrich the query representation. However, such reasoning is typically derived from the query alone: it explains what the query describes, but not what the retriever misunderstands. We argue that effective retrieval reasoning should instead be conditioned on retrieval feedback. Based on this insight, we introduce UniME-R1, an embedder-adviser framework that learns to reason over initially retrieved candidates and generate Retrieval-Centric Chain-of-Thought (RC-CoT). The adviser analyzes candidates individually to identify the discriminative cues confused by the embedder. If the target appears in the initial top-k set, UniME-R1 directly reranks the candidates; otherwise, it generates RC-CoT to refine the retrieval direction and performs full-corpus re-retrieval with a dual-mode embedder. To train the framework, we mine hard negatives to simulate realistic retrieval failures, jointly optimize direct retrieval and RC-CoT-augmented retrieval, and align the adviser with retrieval outcomes through supervised learning and retrieval-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and a diverse set of general multimodal retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that UniME-R1 consistently improves retrieval performance over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: UniME-R1是一个面向统一多模态检索的embedder-adviser框架，通过基于检索反馈生成检索中心思维链（RC-CoT）来增强检索能力。当目标出现在初始top-k结果中时直接重排序；否则生成RC-CoT细化检索方向并执行全库重新检索。通过硬负样本挖掘、联合优化和检索导向强化学习训练，在MMEB-V2等多个基准上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的LVLM-based检索器直接编码原始多模态输入，容易丢失细粒度判别线索，导致语义相似候选之间的混淆。已有方法通过生成CoT理由来丰富查询表示，但这些推理仅基于查询本身，解释的是查询描述了什么，而非检索器误解了什么。作者认为有效的检索推理应基于检索反馈来条件化。
AI.method: 提出embedder-adviser框架UniME-R1。adviser组件分析初始检索到的候选，生成检索中心思维链（RC-CoT），识别embedder混淆的判别线索。若目标在初始top-k中则直接重排序；否则生成RC-CoT细化检索方向，并通过双模式embedder执行全库重新检索。训练方面：挖掘硬负样本模拟真实检索失败，联合优化直接检索与RC-CoT增强检索，通过监督学习和检索导向强化学习对齐adviser与检索结果。
AI.result: 在MMEB-V2及多种通用多模态检索基准上的大量实验表明，UniME-R1相较于强基线持续提升检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 将检索反馈条件化到推理过程中是提升多模态检索性能的关键。UniME-R1通过在adviser中生成检索中心思维链，有效解决了LVLM检索器容易混淆语义相似候选的固有问题。

title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation over long documents is dominated by one design: chunk the text, embed the chunks, and surface the top-k nearest neighbours of the query. We argue that for an important class of documents -- financial statements, audit reports, regulatory returns -- this design is structurally unsound, and we make the argument measurable. On a 780-page government financial report, 86.8% of content lines are table rows, thousands of near-identical figures compete in one embedding space, and a figure inherits its unit from a header a median of 13 lines above it -- so a chunk boundary routinely separates a number from whether it is in lakh or crore, an error of two orders of magnitude. A table-aware chunker built as a steelman fixes the unit problem but leaves 27-30% of numeric chunks with no fiscal-year header at every chunk size we tried. We propose READ (Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search), in which an agent reads the raw document through three deterministic operations -- normalized lexical search, structural navigation, and bounded span reads -- exposed over the Model Context Protocol, so a trajectory is a replayable audit trail, not an opaque similarity score. On 51 verified questions READ answers 58.8% against dense retrieval's 15.7% (p_Holm = 2 x 10^-5) -- or 35.3% tuned, which READ still leads by 23.5 points (p_Holm = 0.017). An agent given the same loop but a top-k tool reaches only 27.5%, locating the gain in the interface rather than in iteration. We also report what the evidence does not support: BM25 is statistically indistinguishable from READ, so our result separates embedding-based from embedding-free retrieval, not agentic from lexical search.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了基于嵌入的检索增强生成（RAG）对以表格为主的长文档（如财务报表、审计报告）在结构上不健全，提出了一种无嵌入的智能体文档检索方法READ（Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search），通过三种确定性操作（归一化词法检索、结构化导航、受限跨度读取）在51个验证问题上取得58.8%的准确率，远超稠密检索的15.7%。
AI.motivation: 长文档检索增强生成的现有主导方案——切块、嵌入、检索top-k最近邻——对财务报告等表格密集型文档在结构上存在根本性缺陷。研究发现：一篇780页的政府财务报告中有86.8%的内容行是表格行，大量近乎相同的数字竞争同一嵌入空间，数字的单位（如lakh或crore）平均在13行之上的表头中继承，块边界经常将数字与其单位分隔开，造成两个数量级的误差。即使使用针对表格感知的chunker，仍有27-30%的数字块缺少财政年度表头。
AI.method: 提出READ系统，采用无嵌入的智能体设计：智能体通过三种确定性操作读取原始文档——归一化词法搜索（normalized lexical search）、结构化导航（structural navigation）和受限跨度读取（bounded span reads），所有这些操作通过Model Context Protocol (MCP)暴露。每个智能体的执行轨迹都是可重放的审计轨迹，而非不透明的相似度分数。此外，研究者还进行了一系列消融实验，包括替换工具（用top-k工具替代三种确定性操作）以隔离性能提升的来源。
AI.result: 在51个经过验证的问题上，READ达到58.8%的准确率，远高于稠密检索的15.7%（p_Holm = 2 x 10^-5）；即使稠密检索经过调优后达35.3%，READ仍领先23.5个百分点（p_Holm = 0.017）。将同一智能体循环与top-k工具组合仅达到27.5%，说明性能提升来自接口设计而非单纯迭代。值得注意的是，BM25与READ在统计上不可区分，表明结果的分离维度是嵌入与无嵌入，而非智能体与词法搜索。
AI.conclusion: 对于表格密集型长文档，基于嵌入的检索在结构上不适合，READ通过无嵌入的确定性操作实现显著更优的性能。结果揭示性能提升的关键在于检索接口设计而非智能体迭代本身，且该发现不构成对非智能体词法检索（BM25）的优势证据。

title: iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation
summary: Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to natural-language task requirements. iARCS uses a two-stage strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific fine-tuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. Experiments show improved constraint fidelity on walkability, reachability, and clearance-focused tasks, effective task-specific constraint optimization, and competitive scene diversity. We further show that data generated by iARCS improves a base generator, supporting its value as a practical synthetic data generation tool rather than only a controllable scene editing method.

AI.tldr: iARCS是一个迭代式智能体强化学习框架，通过两阶段策略（通用奖励预训练+任务特定奖励微调），将预训练的场景生成器适配到自然语言任务需求上，提升合成3D场景在可通行性、可达性和间距约束等方面的保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有的合成3D场景生成器往往只优化感知真实感，无法可靠满足任务关键的功能约束（如可通行性、可达性、空间规则符合性），导致合成数据在下游训练中的实用性受限。
AI.method: iARCS采用两阶段策略：(1) 通用奖励预训练，提升物理合理性和布局质量；(2) 任务特定微调，使用LLM生成的奖励程序，并根据训练反馈进行迭代优化。
AI.result: 实验表明iARCS在可通行性、可达性和间距任务上提升了约束保真度，实现了有效的任务特定约束优化，同时保持了竞争力的场景多样性；且iARCS生成的数据还能改进基础生成器。
AI.conclusion: iARCS展示了任务约束感知的合成数据生成价值，不仅作为可控场景编辑方法，更可作为实用的合成数据生成工具，提升下游模型训练效果。

title: Bar-JEPA: Extracting Values from Bar Chart with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
summary: Bar charts are commonly used in data visualization, and while they are easily understood by humans, it is non-trivial to extract the underlying data computationally. For a machine-learning-based approach, training chart de-rendering models usually requires labeled, real-world data. Labeling data is a time consuming task, which is why annotated data is scarce. Models can learn more efficiently when provided with features of high semantic quality, which a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) is designed to learn in a self-supervised manner. We present a per-bar, numerical value recovery pipeline for bar charts, where a JEPA encoder is used to produce semantically rich latent features. The decoder model consuming these features is simple and quick to train and outputs the coordinates of ticks and bars, which can be used to recover bar values. The effectiveness of self-supervised finetuning and quality of the extracted features is evident when comparing our model to end-to-end supervised baselines. Code, datasets and checkpoints are available on \href{https://github.com/dralois/Bar-JEPA}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于JEPA自监督编码器的柱状图数值恢复流水线，通过语义丰富的潜在特征训练简洁解码器，从柱状图中恢复每个柱子的数值，效果优于端到端监督基线。
AI.motivation: 柱状图在数据可视化中广泛使用，但计算机自动提取底层数据具有挑战性。基于机器学习的方法需要大量标注的真实世界数据，而标注耗时且数据稀缺。JEPA能够在自监督方式下学习高语义质量的特征，有望提高模型学习效率。
AI.method: 提出一个逐柱数值恢复流水线，使用JEPA编码器生成语义丰富的潜在特征，再训练一个简洁快速的解码器模型来输出刻度（ticks）和柱子的坐标，从而恢复柱值。将自监督微调与端到端监督基线进行对比。
AI.result: 实验对比表明，JEPA编码器产生的特征质量高，自监督微调有效，整体方法优于端到端监督基线模型。
AI.conclusion: JEPA编码器配合简单解码器即可高效完成柱状图数值恢复任务，验证了自监督学习方法在图解构（chart de-rendering）领域的有效性，代码、数据集和检查点已开源。

title: The Next Screenshot Knows: Gated Hindsight Distillation for Mobile GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents are commonly trained offline from successful interaction trajectories. Standard training decomposes each trajectory into prefix-action pairs: the agent predicts an action from the current screen and interaction history, while the subsequent observation is discarded. This removes the rationale of why an action is correct: the evidence often appears only on the subsequent screen. For example, to enable Soft Wrap, the agent should click Edit or View, but nothing reveals this until the menu opens. Without such evidence, standard imitation gives the model little chance of ever sampling and thus learning the correct reasoning. To address this issue, we propose Gated Hindsight Distillation (GHD), which uses the next screenshot as privileged information during training. A student predicts from the observable trajectory prefix, while a parameter-sharing teacher additionally observes the next screenshot and re-scores the student's on-policy responses. We apply distillation only when the student fails and the hindsight-conditioned teacher recovers the demonstrated action. GHD improves task success over GRPO on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab across two vision-language models. The code and checkpoints will be made available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gated Hindsight Distillation (GHD)方法，通过在训练时利用下一屏幕截图作为特权信息来教授GUI智能体正确推理，解决标准模仿学习中动作合理性证据缺失的问题。
AI.motivation: 标准离线训练GUI智能体时，轨迹被分解为前缀-动作对，后续观测被丢弃，导致动作正确的理由（常出现在后续屏幕上）不可见。例如点击"Edit"或"View"以启用Soft Wrap，但只有菜单打开后才会显示证据。没有这种证据，标准的模仿学习模型几乎无法采样并学习到正确的推理路径。
AI.method: GHD使用下一屏幕截图作为训练时的特权信息。学生模型仅从可观测的轨迹前缀预测动作，而参数共享的教师模型额外观测下一屏幕截图，并对学生的在线策略响应进行重新评分。仅当学生失败且事后条件化的教师能恢复演示动作时，才应用蒸馏。
AI.result: 在AndroidWorld和AndroidLab基准上，GHD相较于GRPO在两个视觉语言模型上均提升了任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过事后的屏幕信息（下一帧截图）作为特权信号，有条件地蒸馏纠正学生模型的错误预测，能有效弥补标准模仿训练中推理证据缺失的问题，提升GUI智能体的任务完成能力。

title: MicroEvo: Knowledge-Guided LLM Sampling for Efficient Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration
summary: Microarchitecture design space exploration suffers from expansive search spaces and expensive PPA evaluation, leaving only a small simulation budget for design decision-making. Existing methods perform blind search without considering microarchitectural dependencies and fail to learn from the iterative search effectively, leading to wasted evaluations and weak Pareto convergence. In this paper, we propose MicroEvo, a knowledge-guided framework that couples off-the-shelf LLMs with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for multi-objective microarchitecture optimization. MicroEvo combines LLM-driven evolutionary operators, a Pareto-aware tree policy that balances Pareto contribution and diversity, an active knowledge accumulation mechanism that extracts and reuses optimization insights, and state-aware directives that adapt the search behavior online. Experiments show that MicroEvo improves Pareto-front quality by up to 36.2% over NSGA-II and achieves 10.6x higher search efficiency, and also demonstrates strong scalability to a complex industrial-scale core. The code repository is available at: https://github.com/GEAR-SEU/MicroEvo-ICCAD-26.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MicroEvo框架，将LLM与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）结合，用于多目标微架构设计空间探索，通过知识引导的进化算子、Pareto感知树策略、主动知识积累机制及状态感知指令，显著提升Pareto前沿质量和搜索效率。
AI.motivation: 微架构设计空间探索面临搜索空间庞大和PPA评估昂贵的问题，仅有有限仿真预算用于设计决策。现有方法进行盲目搜索，不考虑微架构依赖关系，也无法从迭代搜索中有效学习，导致评估浪费和Pareto收敛性差。
AI.method: MicroEvo将现成的LLM与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）相结合，包含四个关键组件：(1) LLM驱动的进化算子，用于生成新的微架构配置；(2) Pareto感知的树策略，平衡Pareto贡献与多样性；(3) 主动知识积累机制，提取并复用优化洞察；(4) 状态感知指令，在线自适应调整搜索行为。
AI.result: 实验表明，MicroEvo相比NSGA-II将Pareto前沿质量提升最高36.2%，搜索效率提高10.6倍，并对复杂的工业级核心展现出强可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: MicroEvo通过将LLM的知识能力与MCTS的结构化搜索能力相结合，有效解决了微架构设计空间探索中的盲目搜索和知识浪费问题，为多目标微架构优化提供了一种知识引导的高效方案，并可扩展至工业级复杂场景。

title: Domain-Grounded Candidate Selection for Agentic Image Editing: A Shadow Removal Case
summary: Commercial vision-language models are reshaping computer vision, with visual priors broad enough to rival task-specific systems. This raises a natural question: do they reduce the need for classic, physics-informed low-level vision? We study this through shadow removal, a problem shaped by scene geometry, illumination, materials, and occluders, where paired shadow and shadow-free data are hard to collect at scale. We find that a commercial generative editor, used directly, can produce clean shadow-free edits that preserve surface texture and local appearance. However, this comes with a new failure mode: the same editor can regenerate scene content, hallucinate objects, or misread a shadow as material or geometry, producing plausible but physically wrong edits. We address this with an agentic candidate-selection pipeline: the editor generates a guided probe, an evaluator screens for major failures, retries when needed, samples multiple candidates, filters them, and selects a final result balancing shadow removal against scene preservation. Grounding this process in shadow-formation physics makes it more reliable: prompting the generator and evaluator to treat shadows as illumination effects caused by light occlusion, not material or object structure, measurably improves quality and consistency. On the ShadowRemovalRefine benchmark, our physics-oriented pipeline achieves a CDD of 0.0075, reducing CDD by at least 47% over the strongest prior method. These results suggest that commercial vision-language models do not replace classic low-level vision priors; instead, such priors remain useful for constraining and steering physically underconstrained generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了商用视觉语言模型在阴影去除任务中的表现，发现其能产生干净的阴影去除效果但存在物理上错误的编辑（如幻觉物体、误读阴影为材质/几何）。作者提出一个基于代理的候选选择管线，将阴影形成物理原理注入生成器和评估器的提示中，在ShadowRemovalRefine基准上将CDD降至0.0075，较最优先前方法降低至少47%。结论表明经典物理先验并未被VLM取代，反而对约束物理欠约束的生成至关重要。
AI.motivation: 商用视觉语言模型（如生成式编辑器）拥有足够广泛的视觉先验，可能匹敌甚至超越传统任务专用系统。这引发一个根本性问题：经典物理启发的低级视觉先验是否仍被需要？阴影去除是一个理想的研究场景——它受场景几何、光照、材质和遮挡物共同影响，且配对数据难以大规模收集，恰好能检验VLM对物理先验的替代能力。
AI.method: 提出一个基于代理的候选选择管线（agentic candidate-selection pipeline）：1) 生成式编辑器产生引导探针；2) 评估器筛查重大失败并决定是否重试；3) 采样多个候选结果并过滤；4) 在阴影去除与场景保留之间权衡选择最终结果。关键创新在于将阴影形成物理原理注入提示——明确告知生成器和评估器将阴影视为由光遮挡引起的照明效应（而非材质或物体结构），从而物理约束欠约束的生成过程。
AI.result: 在ShadowRemovalRefine基准上，物理导向管线达到CDD 0.0075，相对于最强先前方法将CDD降低至少47%。该方法能产生干净的阴影去除编辑且保留表面纹理和局部外观。
AI.conclusion: 商用视觉语言模型并不能取代经典低级视觉先验；相反，物理先验在约束和引导物理欠约束的生成中仍然具有不可替代的价值。生成式模型的成功依赖对底层物理过程的理解来提供结构和约束。

title: Comparative Approaches to Agent Retrieval over Large Skill Libraries
summary: Agents backed by large skill libraries must decide which skills to load and in what order. Loading the entire library into context is expensive and provides no structure for autonomous sequencing. We study two systems for this problem over a corpus of 690 skills: a hybrid ranker combining lexical and dense-embedding retrieval for sparse, on-demand loading, and a typed knowledge graph encoding workflow relations such as prerequisites, data flow, and ordering. On a set of 117 realistic, non-echoing queries, the hybrid ranker retrieves the correct skill within the top five in 73.5% +/- 8.0 of cases, leaving roughly a quarter of queries unserved. When used as the design intended (substituting graph neighbours for additional ranked results at matched token budget), the graph is significantly worse (-11.2 points, p = 0.0007). Its LLM-generated edge layer adds nothing over neighbours obtained free from a local embedding pass, and 73% of the queries the ranker misses are not reachable through the graph at all. We attribute this to a pre-filter topology bound. Because the graph's candidate edges are drawn from the same embedding neighbourhood the ranker already searches, 98.6% of typed edges connect skills the ranker had already surfaced together. The graph can enrich relation semantics but cannot extend retrieval reach. We further show that evaluating on author-written queries overstates hit@5 by up to 44 points, which would have hidden these results entirely. Our contribution is a mechanistic account of why added structure does not improve retrieval over a strong ranker, and identify the conditions under which adding structural interdependence into the retrieval is optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型技能库中技能加载与排序问题，对比了混合检索排序器与类型化知识图谱两种方法。实验表明混合排序器在117个真实查询上top-5准确率达73.5%，而知识图谱比排序器差11.2个百分点。核心原因是图谱的候选边与排序器所搜索的嵌入邻域高度重叠（98.6%），导致图谱只能丰富语义关系但无法扩展检索覆盖范围。此外，作者查询会高估hit@5达44个百分点。论文贡献在于提供了结构为何不能改进强排序器检索的机制性解释。
AI.motivation: 大型技能库驱动的智能体需要决定加载哪些技能及加载顺序，但将整个技能库加载进上下文既昂贵又缺乏自主排序的结构。现有方法未系统比较不同技能检索与排序机制的效果。
AI.method: 在690个技能语料库上比较两种系统：一是结合词法与稠密嵌入检索的混合排序器（用于稀疏按需加载），二是编码前置条件、数据流和排序等工作流关系的类型化知识图谱。在117个真实非回声查询上评估，并通过预过滤拓扑分析解释图谱失效原因。
AI.result: 混合排序器在top-5命中率为73.5%±8.0；图谱在匹配token预算下比排序器差11.2个百分点（p=0.0007）。98.6%的图谱类型化边连接的是排序器已共同检索出的技能，73%的排序器未命中的查询通过图谱也无法到达。作者编写的查询会高估hit@5达44个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱可以丰富关系语义，但由于候选边来源于排序器已搜索的同一嵌入邻域，受预过滤拓扑约束，无法扩展检索覆盖。在强排序器存在的情况下，附加结构不应作为提升检索覆盖的手段，而应仅用于语义关系表达；负载检索应在拓扑候选生成之前进行。

title: Dense-Cast: A lightweight ensemble of deep learning architectures for precipitation nowcasting
summary: Proper short-term forecasting of precipitation is crucial in disaster management and preparedness. Nonetheless, the variability and nonlinearity of precipitation make short-term forecasting challenging for meteorologists. Moreover, capturing temporal dependencies in spatiotemporal data is a challenge in precipitation nowcasting. In this article, we introduce a lightweight deep learning model for half-hourly precipitation nowcasting. This model has been designed by incorporating the DenseNet architecture, residual connections, and transformer encoders for effective precipitation nowcasting with reduced model parameters. The North-Eastern region of India has been selected as the area of interest for our study. The region receives the highest precipitation during the months of June-September due to the monsoon season. The proposed model takes the previous five time-steps of half-hourly precipitation as inputs and predicts the precipitation in the next two half-hours. The GPM IMERG precipitation dataset with a 30-minute cadence has been used in this study for training and testing the model. The proposed architecture achieves best MAE of 0.235 millimetres, RMSE of 0.735 millimetres, and KGE score of 0.816 at an interval of 30 minutes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级深度学习模型用于半小时尺度的降水临近预报（nowcasting），该模型融合DenseNet、残差连接和Transformer编码器，以较少的模型参数有效捕捉时空数据的时间依赖关系。模型以印度东北部地区为研究区域，使用GPM IMERG 30分钟降水数据，输入前5个时间步预测未来2个半小时的降水，取得了MAE 0.235毫米、RMSE 0.735毫米和KGE 0.816的最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 短期降水预报对灾害管理和应急准备至关重要，但降水的多变性和非线性使预报具有挑战性。此外，在时空数据中捕捉时间依赖关系是降水临近预报的一个难点，需要更有效的模型来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 设计了一个轻量级深度学习模型，结合DenseNet架构、残差连接和Transformer编码器来实现高效的降水临近预报。研究区域为印度东北部（6-9月季风季节降水最丰沛的地区）。模型以过去五个半小时时间步的降水为输入，预测未来两个半小时的降水，训练和测试数据使用GPM IMERG 30分钟分辨率的降水数据集。
AI.result: 该模型在30分钟预测间隔下取得了最佳MAE为0.235毫米、RMSE为0.735毫米、KGE评分为0.816，展示了良好的预报精度。
AI.conclusion: 提出的轻量级混合深度学习架构能够以较少的参数有效完成半小时尺度的降水临近预报任务，在印度东北部季风区取得了优异的预报性能，为降水临近预报提供了一个高效的解决方案。

title: EnvACE: Internalizing Environment Dynamics via World Rehearsal for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Training large language model agents for long-horizon tool use typically relies on interactions with real or synthesized executable environments, whose construction and verification are costly, or on external simulators that are difficult to ground. We introduce EnvACE, an agentic reinforcement learning method that replaces external environment interaction during training with world rehearsal. The policy alternates between acting and rehearsal: it first generates a tool call, then plays the role of the environment to produce the response induced by that action, and conditions subsequent decisions on the rehearsed response. Both roles are jointly optimized end-to-end using task-success rewards. Through world rehearsal, the policy internalizes the relationship between actions and their environment responses in its parameters, yielding an agent world model that directly supports decision making. Across BFCL-v4, tau^2-Bench, VitaBench, and FinMCP-Bench, EnvACE achieves strong and transferable performance, outperforming environment-scaling baselines in the overall evaluation. Controlled studies further show that world rehearsal consistently improves policy learning across model scales. At test time, the internalized world model enables private rehearsal before committed execution, yielding further gains under a moderate rehearsal budget without additional external interaction. Our findings establish world rehearsal as a new path toward scaling LLM agent training beyond the constraints of external environments. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Within-yao/EnvACE.

AI.tldr: EnvACE是一种无需外部环境交互的智能体强化学习方法，通过"世界排练"（world rehearsal）机制让策略模型在训练中交替扮演行动者和环境角色，从而内化动作-环境响应关系，在多个真实工具使用基准上取得超越环境扩展基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 训练大语言模型智能体进行长期工具使用通常依赖真实或合成可执行环境，这些环境的构建和验证成本高昂；外部模拟器又难以与环境对齐。本文旨在突破外部环境约束，探索一种新的训练范式。
AI.method: EnvACE采用代理式强化学习，用"世界排练"替代训练期间的外部环境交互。策略交替执行两个角色：先产生工具调用，再扮演环境生成该动作引发的响应，并将后续决策基于排练出的响应进行。两个角色通过任务成功奖励进行端到端联合优化，使策略将动作与环境响应的关系内化到参数中，形成支持决策的智能体世界模型。
AI.result: 在BFCL-v4、tau^2-Bench、VitaBench和FinMCP-Bench等基准上，EnvACE取得了强劲且可迁移的性能，在总体评估中优于环境扩展基线。受控实验表明世界排练在不同模型规模下均能一致地提升策略学习效果。在测试阶段，内化的世界模型支持私有排练后再执行，在适度的排练预算下无需额外外部交互即可获得进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: 世界排练（world rehearsal）为扩展LLM智能体训练提供了一条超越外部环境约束的新路径，其代码已公开。

title: Confidence matters: Leveraging Multi-view Geometric Priors for GS-based Reconstruction
summary: 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a widely-used tool for novel view synthesis, offering real-time rendering in a sparse representation. However, the method's reliance on structure-from-motion initialization and photometric optimization can lead to suboptimal geometric reconstruction, particularly for objects with high specularity. In this work, we investigate the integration of geometric priors, in the form of predicted normal and depth maps, into the 3DGS framework to improve the reconstruction quality. We analyze the effect of incorporating these priors into GS-based methods and our evaluation reveals that multi-view predictions, as they are done by the recent visual geometry grounded transformer (VGGT), outperform single-view alternatives. A major factor is the existence of a confidence map for the estimations, which comes as a by-product of multi-view models and which can significantly improve the effectiveness of priors by weighting each prediction appropriately. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent improvement in reconstruction quality and significant gains in complex scenes including specular objects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将几何先验（预测的法线图和深度图）集成到3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）框架中以提高重建质量。实验表明，多视图预测（如VGGT）优于单视图方法，其置信度图可作为副产品有效加权各预测，在标准基准上取得一致提升，尤其在包含高镜面反射物体的复杂场景中增益显著。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽然能以稀疏表示实现实时渲染，但其依赖运动恢复结构（SfM）初始化和光度优化，导致几何重建质量欠佳，尤其对高镜面反射物体。因此需要引入几何先验来改善重建效果。
AI.method: 作者系统分析将预测的法线和深度图作为几何先验集成到3DGS框架中的影响。对比了单视图和多视图预测方法（多视图采用视觉几何基础Transformer，VGGT），并利用多视图模型生成的置信度图来加权各预测，以提高先验的有效性。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在重建质量上取得一致的改进，在包含镜面物体的复杂场景中获得显著增益。多视图预测结合置信度加权优于单视图先验方案。
AI.conclusion: 将多视图几何先验（特别是带有置信度图的预测）集成到3DGS中是提升几何重建质量的有效途径，尤其对高镜面物体的复杂场景帮助显著，为3DGS的几何优化提供了新方向。

title: TS-RAG: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Time Series Forecasting
summary: While deep learning models, particularly transformer-based architectures, have shown impressive performance in time series forecasting, the application of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in this domain remains limited. Since RAG has proven effective in enhancing the capabilities of large language models by incorporating relevant external information, retrieving similar time series sequences as references might also improve accuracy in time series forecasting tasks. However, most time series models are constrained by limited training data, smaller parameter scales, and a lack of the extensive generative capabilities found in large language models. Simply concatenating reference sequences into the prompt, as done in language models, may not yield the expected results. To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach, TS-RAG, which leverages RAG to enhance forecasting performance. The framework introduces specially designed reference tokens to effectively fuse information from the input sequence with that from retrieved similar sequences, enabling a more robust capture of complex temporal dynamics. Experimental results demonstrate that TS-RAG achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance across several real-world forecasting benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TS-RAG，一种利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术提升时间序列预测性能的新型框架。通过引入专门设计的参考token，有效融合输入序列与检索到的相似序列信息，在多个真实世界基准上取得了一致的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管RAG在大型语言模型中已被证明能通过引入相关外部信息显著增强能力，但该技术尚未被充分应用于时间序列预测领域。已有的简单思路是在提示中直接拼接参考序列，但由于大多数时间序列模型受限于训练数据量小、参数量少且缺乏LLM的生成能力，这种方式难以奏效。因此亟需一种专门为时间序列预测设计RAG适配方法。
AI.method: TS-RAG框架包含两个关键设计：(1) 利用RAG检索与输入时间序列相似的历史参考序列；(2) 引入专门设计的参考token（reference tokens），通过注意力机制将输入序列信息与检索到的相似序列信息进行有效融合，从而更稳健地捕捉复杂的时序动态特征。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界的时间序列预测基准数据集上，TS-RAG取得了稳定且一致的最先进（state-of-the-art）性能表现，验证了其在时间序列预测中应用RAG的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TS-RAG通过专门设计的参考token实现了RAG在时间序列预测领域的有效应用，克服了时间序列模型在参数规模和生成能力上的局限，为将检索增强技术扩展到时间序列领域提供了可行的新路径。

title: Sample-Adaptive Latent Rewards for Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Post-Training
summary: Latent reward models can supervise visual diffusion models without decoding intermediate states into pixel space. This makes alignment with human preferences more efficient. However, existing latent reward models output only scalar scores. They do not estimate the uncertainty of each prediction. The generator therefore cannot determine which feedback is reliable. This can drive optimization in the wrong direction and lead to reward hacking. We propose \textsc{SURE}, a unified latent-space framework for image and video diffusion models. It learns reward distributions and directly uses their reliability to guide dense post-training. First, we propose sample-adaptive latent reward model (\textsc{SURE-LRM}). It predicts a Gaussian utility for each noisy latent. Its mean predicts the reward score. Its variance reflect the uncertainty of prediction without human annotation. The learned distribution then guides post-training through uncertainty-guided reward feedback learning (\textsc{SURE-REFL}). This method provides uncertainty-guided dense feedback along the denoising trajectory. At selected transitions, \textsc{SURE-REFL} queries the frozen \textsc{SURE-LRM}. It converts detached variance into reliability weights for samples at the same transition. Each weighted reward is backpropagated only through its local transition. The entire process remains in latent space and requires neither pixel-space decoding nor the full denoising graph. Experiments show that \textsc{SURE-LRM} improves preference prediction over strong baselines. \textsc{SURE-REFL} achieves the sota performance among various metrics and further improves optimization stability. It also achieves the highest VBench quality, semantic, and total scores among the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SURE框架，一个统一的潜空间对齐框架，用于图像和视频扩散模型。它包含两个核心组件：SURE-LRM（样本自适应潜空间奖励模型），为每个噪声潜变量预测高斯分布（均值预测奖励分数，方差反映预测不确定性）；以及SURE-REFL（不确定性引导的奖励反馈学习），利用预测的可靠性沿去噪轨迹提供稠密后训练反馈。整个流程在潜空间中完成，无需像素空间解码，实验证明其在偏好预测和后训练性能上均达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的潜空间奖励模型只能输出标量分数，无法估计预测的不确定性，导致生成器无法判断哪些反馈可靠，可能将优化推向错误方向并引发奖励黑客问题。需要一种能同时预测奖励分数和量化不确定性的统一框架来更有效地指导扩散模型的对齐。
AI.method: 1) SURE-LRM：为每个噪声潜变量预测高斯分布，均值对应奖励分数，方差反映预测不确定性，无需人工标注；2) SURE-REFL：利用SURE-LRM的方差将不确定性转换为可靠性权重，沿去噪轨迹在选定转换处提供稠密反馈，每个加权奖励仅通过局部转换反向传播，全程保持在潜空间。
AI.result: SURE-LRM在偏好预测上优于强基线；SURE-REFL在多种指标上达到最先进水平，并进一步提升了优化稳定性，同时在VBench质量、语义和总分数上均取得最高分。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入不确定性估计并利用其引导稠密后训练，SURE框架有效解决了潜空间奖励模型中反馈可靠性不足的问题，在不离开潜空间的前提下实现了更稳定、更高质量的扩散模型对齐。

title: DASH: Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons for On-Policy Self-Distillation of Reasoning Models
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Code at https://github.com/DBtxy/DASH-OPSD
summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models using automatically verifiable outcome signals, but these signals are typically sparse and at the sequence-level. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) mitigates this sparsity by querying a privileged teacher at student-visited prefixes and providing dense token-level distributional supervision. Although this dense supervision alleviates signal sparsity, we find that standard OPSD still underexploits the temporal structure of the rollout. It assigns every local divergence the same coefficient, regardless of its position or the divergence sequence in which it occurs. In on-policy autoregressive generation, the same divergence magnitude can follow different discrepancy histories, reflecting different evolutions of the mismatch between the teacher and student. Since the local scalar alone cannot distinguish these temporal contexts, standard OPSD cannot adapt its token-level weights to the realized discrepancy sequence. To address this limitation, we propose Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons (DASH). DASH maps the gap between each local distillation signal and the sequence-level mean to an adaptive propagation gate and then uses these gates to control backward multi-step aggregation. By doing so, DASH adjusts token-level supervision weights according to how local divergences evolve during generation. Experiments on three mathematical reasoning benchmarks across three model scales show that DASH improves over our matched vanilla OPSD reruns on every benchmark at all three scales. DASH reuses the teacher and student distributions that OPSD already computes, so the gains require no additional teacher or student forward pass.
  Code: https://github.com/DBtxy/DASH-OPSD

AI.tldr: 本文提出DASH（Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons）方法，针对带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中信号稀疏的问题，改进标准的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）方法。OPSD通过特权教师提供稠密的token级分布监督，但将每个局部散度分配相同系数，忽略了时间结构；DASH通过将局部蒸馏信号与序列级均值的差距映射为自适应传播门，控制反向多步聚合，从而根据局部散度的演化动态调整token级监督权重。在三个数学推理基准和三个模型规模上的实验表明，DASH在所有设置下均优于vanilla OPSD，且无需额外的前向计算开销。
AI.motivation: RLVR虽然利用自动可验证的结果信号提升了LLM的推理能力，但这类信号通常稀疏且为序列级。OPSD通过特权教师在学生访问过的前缀处提供稠密的token级分布监督来缓解信号稀疏问题，但标准OPSD未能充分利用rollout的时间结构：它对所有局部散度分配相同权重，忽略了同一散度可能对应不同的teacher-student失配演化历史，因此无法根据实际的散度序列自适应调整token级权重。
AI.method: DASH将每个局部蒸馏信号与序列级均值之间的差距映射为自适应传播门（adaptive propagation gate），利用这些门控制反向多步聚合过程。具体而言，局部散度与序列均值的偏差反映了该位置的监督信号相对于整体分布的偏离程度，DASH据此调整信息向后传播的范围和强度，从而实现token级监督权重的时序自适应。由于DASH复用OPSD已有的teacher和student分布，不引入额外的前向计算。
AI.result: 在三个数学推理基准（覆盖三个不同模型规模）上的实验表明，DASH在所有基准和所有规模上均优于匹配的vanilla OPSD基线，验证了其时序自适应监督的有效性，同时不增加额外计算开销。
AI.conclusion: DASH证明了在OPSD框架中引入对散度序列时间结构的自适应建模能够进一步提升RLVR的推理性能，且该收益来自对已有计算资源的更有效利用，为后续基于时序感知的稠密监督信号设计提供了新的方向。代码已开源。

title: Patient Pose Assessment Using a CT-Based Framework for Synthetic Data Generation
comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:027
summary: An adequate diagnostic quality of radiographs is essential for reliable diagnoses and treatment planning. The patient's pose during radiography is one of the most important factors determining the diagnostic quality. Since patient positioning is difficult and not standardized, an automated AI-based approach using depth images to automatically assess the patient's pose before the radiograph has been taken would be helpful. Due to regulatory hurdles, however, it is difficult in practice to acquire the required depth images and corresponding radiographs. In this paper, we present a framework that can generate such training data synthetically from Computed Tomography scans. We further show that by pretraining on our generated synthetic dataset consisting of 3077 image pairs of upper ankle joints, the pose assessment of real upper ankle joints can be improved by up to 11 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个从CT扫描合成生成深度图像与X光片配对训练数据的框架，用于训练AI系统自动评估患者拍摄X光片前的体位，以提高放射影像诊断质量。在3077对上踝关节合成数据上预训练后，真实上踝关节的体位评估准确率最高提升11个百分点。
AI.motivation: 放射影像的诊断质量高度依赖于患者拍摄时的体位，但体位摆放困难且缺乏标准化。由于监管障碍，难以获取真实场景中所需的深度图像与X光片配对数据来训练AI模型，因此需要一种能够合成生成此类训练数据的方案。
AI.method: 提出一个从CT扫描数据中合成生成训练数据的框架，该框架能够生成深度图像与对应X光片的配对数据。利用该框架生成了包含3077对上踝关节图像对的合成数据集，并在此数据集上进行预训练。
AI.result: 通过在合成的3077对上踝关节图像对上预训练，真实上踝关节的体位评估性能最高提升了11个百分点，验证了合成数据预训练的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该合成数据生成框架能够有效缓解真实配对数据难以获取的问题，为训练基于深度图像的AI体位评估系统提供了可行的数据来源，显著提升真实场景下的评估精度。

title: Improving the Realism of Synthetic Clinical Benchmarks Under Utility Constraints
summary:
Synthetic clinical benchmarks for enterprise AI agents can pass existing utility checks and still remain structurally unrealistic, especially in privacy-sensitive healthcare settings where operational data are hard to access. We study how to improve such benchmarks without breaking the downstream utility checks already used in practice.
  We formulate benchmark revision as utility-constrained realism improvement: dataset changes should increase realism while staying above an operational utility floor. We instantiate this idea on a care-gap benchmark derived from Synthea-generated patients exercised through demonstration electronic health record workflows and then processed by the same downstream pipeline as operational data. Realism is measured through missingness structure, simplicity, structural plausibility, and population alignment.
  The baseline benchmark is extremely thin: sampled-pair missingness is 79.44%, only 12.75% of rows are actionable, 38.94% of patients have zero actionable measures, and top-three token concentration reaches 100.0%. Two deterministic revisions improve these panels while remaining above the current utility floor, whereas a naive densification control preserves unrealistic templating. We further show that internal benchmark realism and source fidelity to an aggregate operational reference are related but distinct objectives. These results suggest that synthetic benchmark quality should be optimized explicitly, with utility treated as one constraint rather than as sufficient evidence of realism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将合成临床基准的修订形式化为"效用约束下的真实感提升"问题，在保持下游效用检查通过的前提下优化基准的结构真实感。在Synthea生成的护理缺口基准上，两种确定性修订方法在仍高于效用下限的同时显著改善了缺失率结构、简单性、结构合理性和人群对齐等真实感指标，而朴素稠密化对照组则保留了不真实的模板化特征。
AI.motivation: 现有的合成临床基准虽然能通过既有工具性效用检查，但在隐私敏感的医疗场景中由于难以获取真实运营数据，其结构可能仍然不真实。这种"表面合格实则失真"的基准会误导企业AI智能体的评估，因此需要在不破坏已有下游效用检查的前提下提升基准的真实感。
AI.method: 将基准修订形式化为效用约束下的真实感优化问题——任何数据集变更必须同时提高真实感并保持高于运营效用下限。在Synthea生成患者经过演示电子健康记录工作流并采用与运营数据相同的下游管线处理的护理缺口基准上，通过缺失结构、简单性、结构合理性、人群对齐四个维度测量真实感，并对比两种确定性修订方法与一种朴素稠密化控制方法。
AI.result: 基线基准极度薄弱：采样对缺失率79.44%，仅12.75%的行可操作，38.94%的患者无可操作指标，前三token集中度达100.0%。两种确定性修订在保持效用下限的前提下改善了全部真实感面板，而朴素稠密化对照组无法消除不真实的模板化。此外，内部基准真实感与对聚合运营参考的源保真度是相关但不同的目标。
AI.conclusion: 合成基准的质量应被显式优化，效用只是约束条件之一而非真实感的充分证据。在隐私敏感的医疗场景中，需要同时关注基准的内部结构真实感和对外部运营参考的源保真度。

title: Learning visual representations for compositional analysis of artworks and photographs
summary: Composition, the deliberate arrangement of visual elements, is central to how meaning, emotion, and aesthetic quality are conveyed in artwork, yet it remains among the least formalized dimensions of visual understanding. Prior work highlights a persistent gap in learning meaningful compositional representations, attributing it to semantic bias and suggesting that human-inspired approaches may be key. We compare two parallel paradigms for composition analysis: a human-inspired method grounded in perceptual grouping, and fine-tuned foundation models enabled by recent large-scale compositional datasets. The human-inspired approach uses object-centric models for region-level decomposition and a graph attention network to capture spatial relationships between elements. Both paradigms are evaluated on composition score/category prediction, compositional image retrieval, and visual saliency detection. With frozen encoders, the human-inspired method achieves competitive performance while remaining interpretable. When sufficient data enables fine-tuning, large self-supervised models outperform significantly, but at the cost of interpretability and cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了两种构图分析范式：基于感知分组的人类启发方法（对象中心模型+图注意力网络）与基于大规模构图数据集微调的基座模型，在构图评分/分类、构图图像检索和视觉显著性检测任务上评估，发现冻结编码器时人类启发方法具有竞争力且可解释，数据充足时微调大模型表现更优但牺牲可解释性和跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 构图是视觉理解中最不形式化的维度之一，先前工作指出学习有意义的构图表征存在语义偏差的持续挑战，并提出人类启发的思路可能是关键，因此需要系统比较人类启发方法与基座模型范式在构图分析中的优劣。
AI.method: 采用并行双范式比较：人类启发方法利用对象中心模型进行区域级分解，并通过图注意力网络捕获元素间的空间关系；基座模型范式利用近期大规模构图数据集对自监督模型进行微调。两者在构图评分/类别预测、构图图像检索和视觉显著性检测三个任务上评估。
AI.result: 冻结编码器条件下，人类启发方法达到与基座模型相当的性能且保持可解释性；数据充足时，大规模自监督模型微调后显著超越人类启发方法，但可解释性和跨域泛化能力下降。
AI.conclusion: 构图分析中两种范式各有优劣：人类启发方法在可解释性和跨域泛化上更有优势，而数据充足时微调基座模型在性能上限更高，二者之间存在准确率与可解释性/泛化性的权衡。

title: The Illusion of Visual Tool-Use: A Causal Audit of Thinking with Images
summary: The "thinking-with-images" paradigm equips multimodal LLMs with active visual operations such as crop-and-zoom. However, models using these operations often achieve only marginal or negative gains over direct inference at substantially higher token cost. They may also repeatedly crop irrelevant regions and fail on questions that direct inference answers correctly. We ask whether the returned visual evidence causally affects the answer. To answer this question, we formulate visual tool-use as a causal graph that separates observation-mediated paths from action-induced shortcuts. We then audit it through interventions at the three levels: policy (comparing tool-use with direct inference), trajectory (corrupting all observations during rollout), and step (counterfactually replacing one individual observation under a fixed prefix). Our step-level estimand, Visual Evidence Gain, isolates the contribution of each returned observation. Across six representative models and five fine-grained perception benchmarks, we uncover policy miscalibration with two failure modes. In Calling Without Looking, returned observations have no causal effect on the answer. In Looking Without Planning, observations are informative but the call schedule is incoherent. A trajectory-level diagnostic decomposes the policy-level accuracy gain and shows that the gain is concentrated in a Calibrated minority. We term this discrepancy the illusion of visual tool-use: despite aggregate accuracy gains, visual tool-use is not causally effective across a broad range of rollouts. The code is available at https://github.com/OpenCausaLab/CauAudit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种因果审计框架CauAudit，用于评估多模态大语言模型中"图像思考"（thinking-with-images）范式下视觉工具调用的因果有效性。通过策略级、轨迹级和步骤级三种干预，作者发现视觉工具使用存在两类失败模式："不看就调"（观察返回对答案无因果影响）和"不规划就调"（观察有信息但调用安排不一致），揭示了视觉工具使用存在"幻觉"现象——尽管聚合精度有所提升，但视觉工具在广泛的轨迹中并非因果有效。
AI.motivation: 现有的"thinking-with-images"范式通过裁剪、缩放等主动视觉操作增强多模态LLM，但这类方法往往仅在更高token成本下获得边际或负面收益，且可能反复裁剪无关区域并在直接推理能正确回答的问题上失败。作者质疑：返回的视觉证据是否真正因果地影响答案？为回答该问题，需要将视觉工具使用形式化为因果图，分离观察介导路径与动作诱导捷径。
AI.method: 将视觉工具使用形式化为因果图，区分观察介导路径与动作诱导捷径。在三层实施干预审计：(1)策略级：比较工具使用与直接推理；(2)轨迹级：在rollout期间破坏所有观察；(3)步骤级：在固定前缀下反事实替换单个观察。提出步骤级估计量"Visual Evidence Gain"（视觉证据增益）来隔离每个返回观察的贡献。在六个代表性模型和五个细粒度感知基准上进行评估。轨迹级诊断分解策略级精度增益。
AI.result: 发现策略级存在校准不良，包含两种失败模式：Calling Without Looking（返回观察对答案无因果效应）和Looking Without Planning（观察有信息但调用安排不连贯）。策略级精度增益集中在少数"校准良好"的子集上，作者将其定义为"视觉工具使用幻觉"：尽管聚合精度有提升，视觉工具在广泛rollout中并非因果有效。
AI.conclusion: 视觉工具使用的聚合精度提升具有误导性，掩盖了其因果无效性的广泛存在。需要从因果视角重新审视视觉工具使用的有效性评估，而非仅依赖聚合指标。

title: BendTwin: Robust Dense-to-Sparse Physical Reconstruction with Bending-Aware Differentiable Spring-Mass Models
summary: Reconstructing objects with mechanical properties from video observations enables physically consistent dynamic prediction, benefiting robotics planning and interaction. Existing spring--mass based physical driven reconstruction approaches offer efficient and differentiable physical reconstruction, but they typically rely on axial springs alone. Such formulations oversimplify the underlying structural mechanics and can become mechanically under-constrained when the physical graph is coarsened, limiting their ability to preserve stable local deformation. We present BendTwin, a bending-aware differentiable spring--mass framework for video-based reconstruction and future prediction of deformable objects. BendTwin introduces bending stiffness and damping over local surface triplets, penalizing deviations from rest angles and regularizing higher-order deformation. These bending constraints improve mechanical stability while preserving the simplicity of spring--mass system. Experiments show that BendTwin consistently outperforms the axial-only PhysTwin baseline. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the bending constraints maintain system stability across different downsampling ratios and consistently improve upon the original PhysTwin formulation. Overall, BendTwin provides an effective approach for constructing mechanically faithful digital twins from sparse-view RGB-D videos.

AI.tldr: BendTwin 提出了一种弯曲感知的可微弹簧-质量框架，用于从视频中重建可变形物体的物理孪生并进行未来预测。与传统仅依赖轴向弹簧的方法（如 PhysTwin）不同，BendTwin 引入了局部表面三元组上的弯曲刚度和阻尼，惩罚与静止角度的偏差并正则化高阶变形，从而增强力学稳定性，同时保持弹簧-质量系统的简洁性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于弹簧-质量的物理驱动重建方法通常仅使用轴向弹簧，这过度简化了底层结构力学。当物理图被粗化（downsampling）时，系统会出现机械欠约束问题，限制其保持稳定局部变形的能力，从而影响重建精度和未来预测的物理一致性。
AI.method: BendTwin 在弹簧-质量框架中引入弯曲感知约束：在局部表面三元组（三个相连质点）上定义弯曲刚度和弯曲阻尼，通过惩罚质点相对于静止角度的偏差来正则化高阶变形。该方法保持弹簧-质量系统的可微性和效率，同时提升机械稳定性。
AI.result: 实验表明，BendTwin 在重建和未来预测任务上一致优于仅含轴向弹簧的 PhysTwin 基线。消融研究进一步证明，弯曲约束在不同下采样比例下都能维持系统稳定性，并且始终优于原始 PhysTwin 公式。
AI.conclusion: BendTwin 提供了一种从稀疏视角 RGB-D 视频中构建机械保真数字孪生的有效方法，兼顾了弹簧-质量系统的计算效率与弯曲约束带来的力学保真度。

title: QuanTiMedAI: Quantum-Enhanced Time-Series Model guided by Agentic AI for Cardiac Arrest Mortality Prediction
summary: Cardiac arrest remains one of the most lethal conditions encountered in intensive care units. Despite the growing availability of electronic health record data, existing mortality prediction studies in this population largely depend on static summaries derived from early admission. Such approaches ignore the temporal progression of physiological deterioration and recovery that unfolds throughout a patient's ICU stay. To address this limitation, we introduce QuanTiMedAI, a quantum-agentic framework developed for cardiac arrest mortality prediction using agentic AI guided quantum enhancement time series model. The proposed system combines an agentic large language model (LLM) for clinically informed feature discovery with a compact quantum recurrent network for temporality aware mortality prediction. Our findings demonstrate that agentic LLM-guided feature selection consistently outperforms conventional feature selection approaches, and the proposed quantum architecture achieves competitive predictive performance through nonlinear feature enhancement while keeping the number of parameters very low. Through extensive experimentation on a MIMIC-IV cohort of cardiac arrest patients, QuanTiMedAI's quantum-enhanced architecture attains an AUROC of 0.852 using only 605 parameters, an improvement of approximately 2.9\% over a current state-of-the-art baseline for this task. A structured ablation study systematically validates the contribution of each architectural design choice. These results show that quantum-enhanced sequential modeling can exceed classical recurrent networks while using substantially fewer parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QuanTiMedAI框架，结合智能体大语言模型（LLM）进行临床特征发现与紧凑型量子循环网络进行时序建模，用于ICU心脏骤停患者的死亡风险预测。在MIMIC-IV队列上，该框架仅用605个参数即达到0.852的AUROC，比当前最先进基线提升约2.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有ICU心脏骤停患者死亡率预测研究主要依赖入院早期提取的静态摘要数据，忽略了患者在整个ICU住院期间生理恶化和恢复的时间动态演变过程。这种静态方法无法捕捉临床状态的时序变化，限制了预测准确性。
AI.method: QuanTiMedAI包含两大核心组件：（1）智能体大语言模型（agentic LLM）用于临床信息驱动的特征选择/发现；（2）紧凑型量子循环网络（quantum recurrent network）用于时间感知的死亡率预测。系统通过量子非线性特征增强实现高性能的同时维持极低参数规模。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV心脏骤停患者队列上，QuanTiMedAI达到0.852的AUROC，仅使用605个参数，较当前最先进基线提升约2.9%。智能体LLM引导的特征选择优于传统特征选择方法；结构化消融实验系统性验证了各架构设计选择的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 量子增强的时序建模在显著减少参数量的情况下可超越经典循环网络，证明了量子计算与智能体AI结合在临床时序预测任务中的潜力。

title: Support Operation Factorization: Compositional Readout of Frozen Vision Encoders under Controlled Interventions
summary: Compositional analysis of frozen vision encoders should determine both what changed and where it changed. Standard factor probes score these axes separately, however, and can reward multiple operations that reuse the same predicted slot. We call this failure operation laundering. We introduce an injectively aligned leave-one-cell-out protocol over support x operation grids and SO-OPF, a readout that factors cell energy into support salience and a competitive operation posterior. This formulation separates two questions that aggregate scores conflate: whether the carrier composes held-out bindings when the grid is known, and whether that grid can be recovered from flat cell labels. With frozen DINOv3 features, known factorial assignment reaches 0.874 injective accuracy on Shapes3D-Extended and 0.799 on globally image-disjoint COCO; learning the assignment from flat labels reaches 0.769 and 0.762, respectively. Under matched-axis-aware supervision on Shapes3D, the factored carrier improves learned-assignment accuracy from 0.653 to 0.841 over a dense carrier and eliminates its laundering gap. SigLIP2 replicates the COCO separation. A rebuilt MuJoCo substrate exposes a boundary: learned-assignment accuracy is 0.569 with DINOv3 and 0.484 with SigLIP2, with substantial slot collapse. Thus factored readout and injective evaluation recover held-out bindings on two substrates while exposing, rather than hiding, a renderer-specific failure boundary; they do not establish universal recovery from flat labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SO-OPF与留一细胞剔除协议，将冻结视觉编码器的组合分析分解为支持显著性与操作后验，解决操作洗白（operation laundering）问题，在两个数据集上验证了组合绑定恢复能力，同时揭示了渲染器相关的失败边界。
AI.motivation: 标准因子探针分别对支持轴和操作轴打分，无法区分多个操作复用了同一预测槽位的情况（即操作洗白）。这导致组合分析无法准确回答"什么改变了"和"在哪里改变"两个问题，需要一种能解耦这两种信号的方法。
AI.method: 提出两个组件：(1) 注入式对齐的留一细胞剔除（leave-one-cell-out）协议，在支持×操作网格上进行评估；(2) SO-OPF读头，将细胞能量分解为支持显著性和竞争性操作后验。该框架将"载体是否在已知网格下组合held-out绑定"与"网格能否从扁平细胞标签中恢复"这两个问题分离。
AI.result: 在DINOv3特征上，已知阶乘分配在Shapes3D-Extended达0.874注入式准确率，全局图像不相交COCO上达0.799；从扁平标签学习分配分别达0.769和0.762。在匹配轴感知监督下，因子载体将学习分配准确率从0.653提升至0.841并消除洗白差距。SigLIP2复现了COCO分离。在重建的MuJoCo子基上，DINOv3学习分配准确率0.569，SigLIP2为0.484，并出现显著槽位坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 因子化读头和注入式评估能够在两个子基上恢复held-out绑定，同时暴露而非隐藏渲染器特定的失败边界；但并不能证明从扁平标签中实现通用恢复的可行性。

title: Bias Analysis of L2 Speaking Assessment Systems Using Concept Activation Vectors
summary: Automatic speaking assessment systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings to mark second language (L2) learners' speaking tests, making it critical to show that their scores depend on speaking proficiency rather than irrelevant speaker attributes such as first language (L1) or age. Transformer-based foundation models have improved the accuracy of these L2 speaking graders, but their black-box representations make fairness and interpretability analysis more difficult. Building on prior work that used Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) to detect bias towards unwanted attributes (`concepts') in feature-based graders, we extend CAV-based analysis to two neural speaking assessment systems: a text-based BERT grader and a speech-and-text multimodal grader based on Whisper. CAVs represent human-interpretable concepts as directions in a model's activation space, allowing us to distinguish between whether a concept is encoded in a model's internal representations and whether it influences the predicted score, the latter quantified using a gradient-based sensitivity metric. Since CAVs rely on linear separability, which is less likely in complex neural embedding spaces, we also investigate whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide cleaner concept directions by learning CAVs in a sparse latent space and mapping them back to activation space. Our analysis shows that concept recoverability depends strongly on the representation and architecture being probed, rather than on the concept alone. Sensitivity to concepts is also architecture-dependent. SAEs make concepts more linearly recoverable, but attenuate the original activation-space sensitivity, especially in low-dimensional layers. These findings highlight the need to distinguish concept recoverability from concept influence when auditing bias in speaking assessment systems.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了基于概念激活向量（CAVs）的偏差检测方法，将其应用于两个基于Transformer的神经口语评估系统（基于BERT的文本评分器和基于Whisper的语音-文本多模态评分器），并探究了稀疏自编码器（SAEs）能否在复杂神经嵌入空间中提供更清晰的概念方向。研究发现概念的可恢复性主要取决于被探测的表征和架构，而非概念本身；SAEs能使概念更线性可恢复，但会衰减原始激活空间中的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 自动口语评估系统在高风险场景中越来越广泛部署，其评分必须依赖口语熟练度而非与说话人无关的属性（如第一语言或年龄）。虽然基于Transformer的基础模型提高了评分精度，但其黑盒表征使得公平性和可解释性分析更加困难，亟需有效的偏差审计方法。
AI.method: 将先前基于特征评分器中用于检测不想要属性偏差的CAVs方法扩展到两个神经口语评估系统：基于文本的BERT评分器和基于Whisper的语音-文本多模态评分器。CAVs将人类可解释概念表示为模型激活空间中的方向，区分概念是否被编码在模型内部表征中与概念是否影响预测分数（后者通过基于梯度的敏感性度量量化）。同时，由于CAVs依赖线性可分性而在复杂神经嵌入空间中不可靠，本文还研究了通过学习稀疏潜空间中的CAVs并映射回激活空间的方式，探究SAEs是否能提供更清晰的概念方向。
AI.result: 分析表明概念的可恢复性强烈依赖于被探测的表征和架构，而非仅由概念本身决定；概念敏感性同样是架构相关的。SAEs使概念更线性可恢复，但会衰减原始激活空间的敏感性，尤其在低维层中。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现强调了在审计口语评估系统偏差时，需要区分概念的可恢复性与概念的影响（即概念是否真正影响分数），这为神经口语评分系统的公平性审计提供了方法论上的指导。

title: EvReflection: Event-Driven Micro-Dynamics for Reflection Removal
summary: Despite remarkable progress in reflection removal, current methods primarily exploit static image priors from a single frame and still suffer from severe residual artifacts due to the inherent ambiguity between the reflection and transmission layers. In this paper, we propose leveraging event signals to break this ambiguity. By employing event cameras to capture micro-dynamics, we reveal the differential motion between these two layers. We thereby present a novel event-driven reflection removal network, EvReflection, that utilizes these dynamic cues for layer separation. Specifically, we design a Micro-Dynamics Decoupler to disentangle layer-specific motions from event streams as priors, which then guide a Parallax-Attention Rectifier to cleanly remove artifacts from the RGB image. Furthermore, to address data scarcity, we develop a parallax-aware simulation pipeline and construct the EVR$^2$ benchmark dataset, the first real-world dataset for this task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EvReflection achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks, surpassing the best competing method by more than 1.6 dB and 1.2 dB in PSNR, respectively. The code, dataset, and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/JiaxiaoWang/EvReflection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvReflection，首个利用事件相机（event camera）信号进行反射去除的网络。通过事件流捕捉反射层与透射层之间的微动态差异，设计Micro-Dynamics Decoupler解耦层间运动先验，并配合Parallax-Attention Rectifier消除RGB图像中的反射伪影。同时构建了首个真实世界数据集EVR^2，在合成与真实基准上均达到SOTA，PSNR分别超过最佳对手1.6 dB和1.2 dB。
AI.motivation: 现有反射去除方法主要依赖单帧静态图像先验，由于反射层与透射层之间的固有歧义（inherent ambiguity），仍存在严重的残余伪影。作者旨在利用事件相机捕获的微动态信息打破这种层间歧义，因为事件信号能揭示两层之间的差异运动（differential motion）。
AI.method: 提出事件驱动反射去除网络EvReflection，包含两个核心模块：(1) Micro-Dynamics Decoupler——从事件流中解耦层专属运动（layer-specific motion）作为动态先验；(2) Parallax-Attention Rectifier——利用这些动态先验引导视差注意力机制，从RGB图像中干净地去除反射伪影。此外，开发了视差感知（parallax-aware）的仿真管线并构建了EVR^2真实世界基准数据集。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准上均达到最先进性能，PSNR分别超过最佳竞争方法1.6 dB和1.2 dB。代码、数据集和预训练模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 事件信号提供的微动态信息能有效解决反射去除中层间歧义问题，EvReflection验证了多模态（RGB+事件）融合在该任务上的优越性，并为该领域提供了首个真实世界基准数据集以促进后续研究。

title: HOPE: Hand-Object Pressure Estimation from Monocular Videos
summary: Estimating physical pressure from vision is essential for understanding contact-rich hand-object interaction. However, prior vision-based pressure estimation methods are largely limited to planar surfaces and single image input, making them difficult to apply to dynamic hand-object interaction with diverse objects. We instead formulate pressure estimation as a hand-centric video prediction problem with monocular video as input. This formulation predicts temporally evolving per-vertex normal pressure and contact directly on the hand mesh, yielding a unified output space independent of object shape and sensor layout. Building on this formulation, we propose \textbf{HOPE}, a framework with two key components. First, we lift tactile-glove pressure, planar-sensor pressure, and distance-based hand-object contact annotations into a shared hand vertex space, allowing bare-hand contact data to regularize pressure learning where metric labels are unavailable. Second, we introduce a vertex-anchored video transformer that treats each vertex as a persistent token, aggregates visual features and hand pose over time, and uses a contact-gated pressure head to enforce that pressure vanishes without contact. Experiments on OpenTouch, PressureVisionDB, and hand-object contact benchmarks validate HOPE across object-pressure, surface-pressure, and contact-supervised HOI settings. Despite using metric pressure supervision primarily from gloved-hand videos, HOPE generalizes to bare-hand egocentric and in-the-wild videos, producing joint contact and pressure predictions beyond the scope of contact-only or planar-pressure baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出HOPE框架，将物理压力估计形式化为手部中心的视频预测问题，通过单目视频预测手网格上的逐顶点法向压力和接触，统一输出空间，并利用触觉手套/平面传感器/距离接触标注进行跨域正则化，在OpenTouch、PressureVisionDB等基准上验证其可泛化到裸手和野外视频。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的压力估计方法主要局限于平面表面和单张图像输入，难以应用于具有多样物体的动态手-物交互场景。需要一个统一的、与物体形状无关的框架，能够在手部网格上同时预测压力和接触。
AI.method: 1) 将压力估计形式化为手中心视频预测问题，输出手网格上随时间演化的逐顶点法向压力和接触。2) 将触觉手套压力、平面传感器压力和基于距离的手-物接触标注统一映射到手顶点空间，用裸手接触数据正则化缺乏度量标签的压力学习。3) 提出顶点锚定的视频Transformer，将每个顶点视为持久token，聚合时间维度上的视觉特征和手部姿态，并使用接触门控压力头确保无接触时压力为零。
AI.result: 在OpenTouch、PressureVisionDB和手-物接触基准上的实验验证了HOPE在物体压力、表面压力和接触监督的HOI设置中的有效性。尽管度量压力监督主要来自戴手套视频，HOPE仍能泛化到裸手自我中心和野外视频，产生超出仅接触或平面压力基线的联合接触与压力预测。
AI.conclusion: HOPE通过统一手网格输出空间和跨域标注正则化，证明了从单目视频预测手-物交互中物理压力是可行的，且能有效泛化到不同的物体、采集设备和场景，为压力估计任务提供了新的范式。

title: CFGPNet: Cross-Attention-Based Fused Gradient Programmed Network Framework for Multispectral Object Detection
summary: RGB--T object detection exploits the complementary strengths of visible and infrared imagery, supporting robust perception in low-light, adverse-weather, and complex multi-scale environments. However, existing methods still suffer from insufficient cross-modal interaction, unstable fusion from modality distribution gaps, and the high computational cost of heavy attention-based architectures. To address these issues, CFGPNet is proposed, a Cross-Attention-Based Fused Gradient Programmed Network framework for multispectral object detection. CFGPNet uses an improved GELAN backbone with RepViT-style re-parameterized blocks to strengthen feature representation while preserving computational efficiency. A Cross Computation Efficient Attention (CrossCEA) module is introduced to enhance cross-modal feature interaction and reduce redundant information transfer between visible and thermal branches. To generate compact and discriminative fused representations, an Attention Selection and Aggregation Fusion (ASAF) network combines dense feature aggregation with selective attention-based emphasis. Moreover, a programmable-gradient auxiliary branch is integrated into each CFGPNet variant to improve gradient delivery and optimization quality. Experiments on five public multispectral benchmarks, FLIR, M3FD, LLVIP, VEDAI, and MFAD, demonstrate that CFGPNet achieves strong and consistent performance across diverse scenes, object scales, and modality balances. In particular, the framework attains 80.7% mAP50 / 45.0% mAP50:95 on FLIR, 89.9% / 63.4% on M3FD, and 97.8% / 68.9% on LLVIP. It also reaches 83.3% / 56.9% on VEDAI and 83.4% / 61.8% on MFAD. These results show that CFGPNet is an effective, practical solution offering useful accuracy--efficiency trade-offs across three model scales. The code, data, and fine-tuned models are available at https://github.com/NimaHatami99/CFGPNet.

AI.tldr: CFGPNet是一个基于交叉注意力的融合梯度编程网络框架，用于多光谱(RGB-T)目标检测。它通过改进的GELAN骨干网络、CrossCEA跨模态交互模块、ASAF融合网络以及可编程梯度辅助分支，在五个公开基准数据集上实现了高效且一致的性能，同时兼顾了精度与计算效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的RGB-T目标检测方法面临三大挑战：跨模态交互不足、由于模态分布差异导致的融合不稳定、以及基于重注意力架构的高计算成本。作者旨在解决这些问题，提出一种既高效又准确的多光谱目标检测方案。
AI.method: CFGPNet包含四个核心组件：(1)改进的GELAN骨干网络，采用RepViT风格的重参数化块以增强特征表示并保持计算效率；(2)Cross Computation Efficient Attention (CrossCEA)模块，用于增强跨模态特征交互并减少可见光与热红外分支间的冗余信息传递；(3)Attention Selection and Aggregation Fusion (ASAF)网络，结合密集特征聚合与选择性注意力强调以生成紧凑且有判别力的融合表示；(4)可编程梯度辅助分支，集成到每个CFGPNet变体中以改善梯度传递和优化质量。框架提供三种模型规模。
AI.result: 在FLIR、M3FD、LLVIP、VEDAI和MFAD五个多光谱基准数据集上，CFGPNet取得了优异且一致的性能：FLIR上80.7% mAP50/45.0% mAP50:95，M3FD上89.9%/63.4%，LLVIP上97.8%/68.9%，VEDAI上83.3%/56.9%，MFAD上83.4%/61.8%，在多样场景、目标尺度和模态平衡条件下均表现稳定，且在三种模型规模下提供良好的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: CFGPNet是一种有效且实用的多光谱目标检测方案，在精度和计算效率之间实现了良好的折衷，并在多个公开基准上证明了其泛化能力和鲁棒性。代码、数据和微调模型均已开源。

title: TRAJDEBUG: Tracing Error Lifecycle to Identify Critical Failures in Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
summary: LLM-based agentic systems have shown remarkable capabilities in complex domains, while suffering from cascading errors and difficulty in debugging. Critical error detection aims to locate the earliest error step in a failed trajectory that is responsible for the final failure. However, progress faces two main challenges. First, long trajectories make it difficult to identify individual errors, since the evidence for judging a step may be scattered across distant instructions, observations, and prior context. Second, failed trajectories often contain multiple local errors with different downstream effects, only some of which remain responsible for the final failure. In this work, we propose TrajDebug, an error-lifecycle tracing framework that addresses long-trajectory error discovery with multi-granularity history compression and evidence-based error identification, and supports critical attribution by tracing each error's resolution status and terminal impact. We further construct TrajErrBench, a benchmark of 486 manually annotated failed trajectories from Tau2Bench and SWE-Bench Pro, covering realistic tool-use and coding scenarios. Experiments across diverse agent benchmarks show that TrajDebug achieves the best overall performance over existing baselines, and application studies further demonstrate that its diagnoses provide actionable feedback for improving downstream agent success.
